x: oud and data center, Internet VPN jitter is unacceptable, so use a dedicated circuit or cloud exchange and demand latency and loss figures in the SLA rather than bandwidth alone (10 Gbps with 3% loss can be far worse for small transactions than 1 Gbps with 0.05% loss). - What the network can deliver : path optimization, QoS guarantees, TCP parameter tuning, connection reuse on the application side, and local points of presence. - What the network cannot deliver : N+1 queries per call between tiers, repeated round trips caused by missing caches, and poorly split transactions. Those can only be fixed in the application. - The right deliverable : a per-tier cloud feasibility table (latency sensitivity, statefulness, migration risk, target location for each tier) plus an explicit list of what the application side must do. Never promise that the network will solve an application problem. 参考思路 ： - 先算时延预算，再谈搬家。 2400 万次/天 ≈ 278 次/秒，单次往返 0.2ms → 若 RTT 升到 2ms，单事务耗时增加约 1.8ms；在并发受限的场景下，这会直接压低吞吐。 这类"高频小事务 + 紧耦合应用层/数据库"的组合，是上云最典型的硬骨头。 - 结论通常是"分层上云"而不是整体平移 ：Web 层（无状态、用户侧时延敏感但对后端 RTT 不敏感）优先上云；应用层与数据库必须在同一低时延域内（同园区、同可用区、或专线直连且实测 RTT 达标）。 - 连接模型选择看确定性 ：若应用层与数据库跨"云—机房"，Internet VPN 的抖动不可接受，应选 专线/云交换 ，并要求 SLA 中的时延与丢包指标，而不是只看带宽（10Gbps + 3% 丢包的小事务性能，可能远不如 1Gbps + 0.05% 丢包）。 - 网络补得到的 ：路径优化、QoS 保障、TCP 参数调优、连接复用（应用侧）、就近接入。 - 网络补不到的 ：应用层与数据库之间每次调用的 N+1 查询问题、缺少缓存导致的重复往返、事务拆分不合理。 这些只能改应用。 - 正确产出 ：一张"按层拆解的上云可行性表"（每层标注时延敏感度、状态性、迁移风险、目标位置）+ 明确的"需要应用侧配合的清单"。 不要承诺网络能解决应用的问题。 Scenario 2: "The Network Got Slower" After Microservices · 情景二：微服务化之后"网络变慢了" Situation : an internet company split its monolith into 120 microservices running across two clouds (A active, B for disaster recovery) plus its own data center. s: Design Scenarios (2) · 设计情景演练（2 个）
x: ：跨云调用 P99 时延从 40ms 涨到 260ms；故障定位平均耗时从 20 分钟涨到 3 小时；安全团队无法说清"服务 A 能否访问服务 B"。 Questions to answer : 1. What common root cause underlies all three symptoms? 2. Which capabilities must the network design add? 3. Should the "two clouds plus data center" architecture be adjusted? 要回答的问题 ： 1. 这三个现象的共同根因是什么？ 2. 网络设计要补哪些能力？ 3. "双云 + 机房"的架构是否应该调整？ Reference approach : - The common root cause is loss of control over east-west traffic. In the monolith era traffic was mostly north-south with fixed paths; in the microservices era it is mostly east-west with dynamic call relationships. The old design assumptions — edge-centric, IP-identified, static ACL policy — all fail in the new shape. - Latency : a large part of the 260 ms is not the link but serial calls plus missing locality routing plus no connection pooling . The first step is not more bandwidth but flattening the call chain (same-domain first, locality routing, caching), then re-evaluating whether the cross-cloud call is needed at all. - Observability : correlate distributed tracing, service-level metrics and network flow logs. Network device logs alone will never tell you which service is slow. - Security policy : move from "IP + port" to "identity + service" (service mesh mTLS, workload-identity policy); otherwise an access matrix for 120 services cannot be maintained by hand. - The two-cloud trade-off : fully active cross-cloud brings cross-cloud consistency and latency problems. The usual design is "close the loop inside each domain, synchronize only what is necessary across domains" — each cloud region is self-contained for calls, and the cross-cloud path carries asynchronous replication and a small number of critical queries. - In one sentence : microservices redefine the network problem as a joint problem of topology, identity and observability — adding bandwidth alone or firewalls alone solves nothing. 参考思路 ： - 共同根因：东西向流量失控。 单体时代是"南北向为主、路径固定"；微服务时代是"东西向为主、调用关系动态"。原来的网络设计（以边界为中心、以 IP 为标识、以静态 ACL 为策略）在新形态下全部失效。 - 时延

x: ：跨云调用 260ms 中有很大一部分不是链路，而是 多次串行调用 + 缺少就近路由 + 无连接池 。第一步不是扩带宽，而是把 调用链压平 （同域优先、就近路由、缓存），再评估跨云调用是否必要。 - 可观测性 ：需要分布式追踪、服务级指标、网络流日志三者的关联。 只有网络设备日志，永远定位不到"哪个服务慢"。 - 安全策略 ：从"IP + 端口"转向"身份 + 服务"（服务网格 mTLS、基于工作负载身份的策略），否则 120 个服务的访问矩阵无法人工维护。 - 双云架构的取舍 ：双云"同时活跃"会带来跨云数据一致性与时延问题，通常应设计为 "同域内闭环、跨域只做必要同步" ，即每个云区域内自成调用闭环，跨云只承载异步复制与少量关键查询。 - 一句话 ： 微服务化把"网络问题"重新定义为"拓扑 + 身份 + 可观测性"的联合问题 ，只加带宽或只加防火墙都无解。

The position is one sentence: as soon as a single design decision treats security as "we will add it later", the security ceiling of the architecture is already fixed. 第 1 章把"普适安全"列为设计原则，这一章把它拆成可执行的东西：策略来源、信任模型、CIA、合规。核心立场只有一句： 只要有一个设计决策把安全当成"后面再补"，这个架构的安全上限就已经定了。 Eight lessons that are easy to miss: 八个容易踩空的认知： 1. Security is fundamentally about changing the defaults. Default allow plus restrictions added afterwards, versus default deny plus explicit permission, are two entirely different architectures. What sets the security level is not the device list, it is the default. 1. 安全的本质是"改变默认值"。 默认允许 + 事后加限制，与默认拒绝 + 按需放行，是两种完全不同的架构。 决定安全水平的不是设备清单，而是默认值。 2. Security policy has four sources, and their cost of change differs enormously. Laws and standards (almost non-negotiable), contracts and SLAs (negotiable commercially, but technically binding), internal policy (negotiable but needs time), architecture principles (debatable, but exceptions must be recorded). Treating internal policy as law wastes budget; treating law as a suggestion gets people fired. 2. 安全策略有四个来源，变更成本差别极大。 法规与标准（几乎不可协商）、合同与 SLA（商务可谈、技术必须兑现）、内部制度（可协商但要时间）、架构原则（可讨论，但例外要留痕）。 把"内部制度"当成"法规"会浪费预算，把"法规"当成"建议"会出事。 3. The perimeter model is not dead, but it is no longer sufficient. Users are at home, applications are in the cloud and data sits in third-party SaaS — the premise "inside equals trusted" has disappeared. Zero trust does not remove the firewall; it stops using location as the only basis for trust . 3. 边界模型并没有"死"，但已经不够用。 用户在家里、应用在云上、数据在第三方 SaaS 里——"内网 = 可信"这个前提消失了。零信任不是把防火墙拆掉，而是 不再用"位置"作为信任的唯一依据 。 4. Zero trust is not a product you buy, it is a set of architecture decisions. It requires at minimum trusted identity, device posture assessment, fine-

Deploying one "zero trust gateway" without identity governance and log analytics is just a more expensive perimeter. 4. 零信任不是能买到的产品，是一组架构决策。 它至少要同时具备：可信身份、设备状态评估、细粒度策略（按应用/按请求）、持续遥测与动态判定。 只上了一个"零信任网关"而没有身份治理和日志分析，等于换了个更贵的边界。 5. The three CIA goals pull against each other, so the design must trade off explicitly. Encrypting everything everywhere weakens detection (content becomes invisible); strong isolation reduces availability and operational efficiency; keeping too much log data creates a new exposure surface. No design maximizes all three at once. 5. CIA 三者会互相拉扯，设计必须显式取舍。 全链路加密会削弱检测能力（看不见内容）；强隔离会降低可用性与运维效率；过度留存日志又制造新的泄露面。 没有一个方案能同时把三者拉满。 6. Compliance is not security. An organization that passes a PCI DSS audit can still fall to a phishing email. Compliance is a floor and a body of evidence ; security is continuous risk management . Keep them separate in the design: compliance items are evidence you must have, security items are exposure you must reduce. 6. 合规 ≠ 安全。 通过 PCI DSS 审计的组织依然可能被钓鱼攻破。合规是 下限与证据 ，安全是 持续的风险管理 。设计时要把两者分开：合规项是"必须有的证据"，安全项是"必须降低的敞口"。 7. Data sovereignty is one of the hardest technical constraints. The sentence "data may not leave the country" directly determines application placement, backup strategy, whether cross-border links may exist, and even the access path used by operations staff. It is an architecture-changing input, not a footnote in the proposal. 7. 数据主权是最硬的技术约束之一。 "数据不得出境"这一句，会直接决定应用部署位置、备份策略、跨境链路是否存在、甚至运维人员的访问路径。 它属于"改架构"级别的输入，不是一条可以在方案里备注的条款。 8. Rank security spend by exposure × likelihood × impact, not by vendor recommendation. Ninety percent of budget goes to the schemes that look advanced, while what actually gets exploited is unpatched edge devices, expired accounts and over-privileged operational access. 8. 安全投入应按"敞口 × 概率 × 影响"排序，而不是按厂商推荐排序。 90% 的预算花在"看起来高级"的方案上，而真正被利用的往往是未打补丁的边界设备、过期的账号和高权限的运维通道。 One-sentence summary : the output o

x: AF HTTP 层攻击 对外发布的应用前端 只覆盖 Web，不理解非 HTTP 协议 代理 / CASB 出向访问控制与审计 互联网出口 需要终端配合（代理设置或 PAC） ⚠️ Three hard constraints in chokepoint design : 1. Chokepoints must be few and explicit — inter-domain traffic has to converge on a small number of points, otherwise policy consistency and capacity planning become impossible; 2. Encryption and inspection are inherently in conflict — anything inside IPsec/TLS is invisible to IPS and DLP. Either terminate encryption at the chokepoint or accept that the segment is unobservable, and that trade-off must be written into the design document ; 3. Stateful device pairs must synchronize state — otherwise every long-lived connection (database, SSH, ERP) breaks at the moment of failover, which presents as "the switchover succeeded but the business is down". ⚠️ 检查点设计的三条硬约束 ： 1. 检查点要"少而明确" ——跨域流量必须收敛到少数几个点，否则无法保证策略一致性，也无法对它做容量规划； 2. 加密与检查天然冲突 ——凡是过 IPsec/TLS 的流量，IPS 与 DLP 都失效。要么在检查点终结加密，要么接受"这段不可见"， 这个取舍必须写进设计文档 ； 3. 有状态设备的双机必须同步状态 ——否则切换瞬间所有长连接（数据库、SSH、ERP）全部中断，表现为"切换成功但业务断了"。

x: Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) · 零信任架构 Traditional security assumes everything inside the perimeter is trusted and only the outside is hostile. Once users, applications and data are spread across the Internet, home networks, public clouds and SaaS, that assumption collapses. Zero trust treats every access as untrusted by default and decides every time based on identity, device and context. 零信任架构是对安全的范式转变——不再是边界防火墙模型，而是 无边界架构，拒绝所有访问直到明确允许 。 The Pillars of Zero Trust · 零信任架构的支柱 Verify identity, every time : identity is the new security perimeter, and authentication applies to users and devices alike Assess device posture : are patches current, is disk encryption on, is EDR running, is the device managed Least privilege : grant only the access needed for the task, never permanent broad access Microsegmentation : enforce policy between workloads and applications, not just at the perimeter Continuous monitoring and response : log, detect, analyze and respond; trust is dynamically adjusted Assume breach : design as if the attacker is already inside — limit lateral movement and shorten dwell time 网络始终被假定为敌对的 外部和内部威胁随时随地在 每个设备、应用、用户和网络流都被认证和授权 自动化系统是构建和运营零信任网络的基础 策略必须是动态的，从尽可能多的数据源计算 所有活动都被记录 Key Concepts · 零信任架构概念 Concept Meaning Static factors Relatively stable attributes: user identity, role, department, device type Dynamic factors Attributes that change at runtime: location, time, patch state, behavior baseline Entitled to access The resource set a subject is allowed to reach under policy Trust score A continuous measure of how trustworthy the subject is right now Risk score The potential impact if this access goes wrong Authorization for access The final decision: allow, deny, or allow with constraints Inventory The inventory of identities, assets and applications — the prerequisite for policy Policy Engine Evaluates policy and produces the decision Trust Engine Aggregates static and dynamic factors into a trust score Endpoint device The device from which access origina

s: The CIA Triad · 安全 CIA 三要素
x: The CIA Triad · 安全 CIA 三要素 The CIA triad is the classic model of information security: 机密性、完整性和可用性是信息安全的基础。这些元素帮助构建保护信息和资源免受未授权访问、修改、检查或破坏的安全系统。 Element Definition Typical threats Design means Confidentiality Data is seen only by authorized parties Eavesdropping, data theft, over-privileged access Encryption (in transit and at rest), access control, segmentation Integrity Data is modified only by authorized parties and is complete and accurate Tampering, replay, code injection Hashing and signatures, change control, immutable logs Availability Authorized parties can use resources when needed DDoS, device failure, misconfiguration Redundancy, capacity margin, DDoS mitigation, backup and recovery 要素 特征 实现机制 机密性 (Confidentiality) 防止未授权访问信息，维持传输信息的保密性 加密、用户 ID 和密码（双因素认证更常见）、安全令牌 完整性 (Integrity) 端到端维持准确信息，确保未被未授权实体篡改 加密、数据校验和、哈希 可用性 (Availability) 确保服务和系统始终可用，授权用户可在需要时访问。现代网络中可用性不仅用上线/下线时间衡量，还用质量衡量（如恶意流量增加延迟导致 VoIP 质量下降） 高可用性系统设计（网络、存储、计算、应用层），防止 DoS 等攻击 Design Means for Each Element and Their Conflicts · 三要素对应的设计手段与代价 The three CIA goals constantly pull against each other in design: encryption hides traffic from inspection, isolation raises availability risk, and log retention widens the exposure surface. The table below maps each goal to its primary means and to the conflict the means creates. 三要素不是并列的口号，而是一组 会互相打架的目标 。设计者的工作是在具体场景里排出优先级： Goal Primary means Side effect of the means How to handle the conflict Confidentiality Encryption, segmentation Encrypted traffic cannot be inspected, so detection weakens Terminate encryption at inspection points; compensate unobservable segments with endpoint EDR and behavior baselines Integrity Signatures, change control, immutable logs Strict change control slows response to failures Pre-approve emergency change paths and audit them afterwards Availability Redundancy, capacity margin Attack surface and cost rise Rank availability targets by business function (RTO/RPO) rather than applying the same standard everywhere 要素 设计手段 代价 /

s: The CIA Triad · 安全 CIA 三要素
x: 副作用 机密性 链路加密（IPsec/MACsec）、存储加密、访问控制、数据分级 加密后 IPS/DLP 看不见内容；加解密消耗性能；密钥管理成为新的单点 完整性 数字签名、哈希校验、配置基线与变更审计、防篡改日志 需要额外的签名/校验环节；日志本身必须防篡改（否则审计无效） 可用性 冗余（设备/链路/运营商）、容量与 DDoS 清洗、限速与队列、快速收敛 冗余带来复杂度与成本；清洗中心会改变路径与源地址；限速可能误伤正常突发 ⚠️ CIA is a triangle of trade-offs, not three checkboxes . Every encryption and every segmentation choice takes something away from the other two goals. The design document should say which goal was traded for which, or the security design cannot be reviewed or defended. ⚠️ 最常见的三对冲突 （评审时必须问）： 1. 加密 vs 检测 ：全链路加密后，IPS 与数据防泄漏形同虚设。解法通常是"在检查点终结加密"，或接受这段不可见并靠终端侧 EDR 补偿。 2. 可用性 vs 机密性 ：为了抗 DDoS 把所有流量牵引到清洗中心，等于把流量交给第三方可见。 3. 完整性 vs 可用性 ：严格的配置基线校验会阻止"故障中的应急修改"，而应急修改往往是恢复业务最快的手段。解法是 允许应急但强制事后反哺 （第 12 章漂移检测的做法）。

s: Lessons Learned · 实战经验总结
x: Lessons Learned · 实战经验总结 Lesson Explanation Write the control objective before choosing the technology "Cross-domain access must be auditable" is a control objective; firewall, WAF and proxy are means. Objectives are stable, means are replaceable The same policy has several implementations differing by an order of magnitude in cost Encrypted VLL, application-layer encryption and physically dedicated circuits all satisfy "must be encrypted"; lay out the options and their costs first The number of domains is a trade-off, not an ideal Finer domains mean stronger isolation and higher maintenance cost. Find the number the team can genuinely maintain The segment you cannot see needs compensating controls When encrypted traffic cannot be inspected by IPS, cover it with endpoint EDR, log correlation and behavior baselines Compliance deliverables need an evidence chain Logs + unified NTP time + change records + periodic review records; miss one and the audit fails Identity is the new perimeter, but the identity system is not owned by the network team Zero trust projects must include HR, IT desktop and the identity team, or they stall at the inventory step The security design must be acceptable to the business Express it in business language: downtime, onboarding time, audit pass rate — not "how many appliances were deployed" Reject the "security equals buying appliances" path dependency Case 1 shows that with every appliance in place the enterprise was still breached; what was missing was admission control, segmentation, privileged accounts and detection 经验 说明 先写控制目标，再选技术 "跨域访问必须可审计"是控制目标，防火墙/WAF/代理是手段。目标稳定，手段可换 同一策略有多种实现，成本差一个数量级 加密 VLL、应用层加密、物理独占都能满足"必须加密"，先把选项与代价摆出来 域的数量是取舍不是理想 域越细，隔离越强，维护成本越高。找"团队真的能维护"的那个数量 不可见的那一段必须有补偿手段 加密流量无法被 IPS 检查时，靠终端 EDR、日志关联、行为基线补上 合规交付物里要有证据链 日志 + NTP 统一时间 + 变更记录 + 定期复核记录，缺一项审计就通不过 身份是新的边界，但身份系统不在网络团队手里 零信任项目必须拉上 HR/IT 桌面/身份团队，否则卡在"清单"环节 安全方案要能被业务验收 用业务语言表达：停机时间、上线周期、审计通过率，而不是"部署了几台设备" 拒绝"安全 = 买盒子"的路径依赖 案例一说明：设备齐全仍被攻破，缺的是准入、分段、特权账号与检测

x: Design Scenarios (2) · 设计情景演练（2 个） Scenario 1: One Sentence, "Data May Not Leave the Country", Redesigned Three Layers · 情景一：一句"数据不得出境"，改了三层架构 Situation : a multinational medical device company has an R D center in China (R D data in a local equipment room). The Asia-Pacific headquarters in Singapore uses the same global PLM system (deployed in Ireland). China employees need PLM access for design reviews; the global operations team needs access to the operations interfaces of the China equipment room for patching and backup. Legal is explicit: R D data generated in China and patient-related data may not leave the country. 场景 ：某跨国医疗器械公司在华有研发中心（研发数据存本地机房），亚太区总部在新加坡使用同一套全球 PLM 系统（部署在爱尔兰）。中国区员工需要访问 PLM 做设计评审；全球运维团队需要访问中国机房的运维接口做补丁与备份。法务明确：中国境内产生的研发数据与患者相关数据不得出境。 Questions to answer : 1. Which traffic is "business essential" and which is simply "convenient"? 2. How far must the network design change? 3. How can the operations channel be preserved without violating data sovereignty? 要回答的问题 ： 1. 哪些流量是"业务必需"、哪些是"图省事"？ 2. 网络设计要改到什么程度？ 3. 运维通道怎么在"不违反数据主权"的前提下保留？ Reference approach : - The first step is not design, it is data classification. Split data into "must stay in country", "may leave (after de-identification or aggregation)" and "irrelevant". Without classification, every architecture decision turns into a tug of war between legal and IT. - Data decides the architecture position : since the PLM data may not leave, move compute next to the data — deploy a local PLM instance or cache layer in China, or use the provider's in-country regional node — instead of having employees reach Ireland across the border. - Only essential traffic crosses the border : design review deliverables (3D models, drawings) can be synchronized after de-identification, with direction, frequency and approval written into the design. Do not mirror the whole database across the border — expensive and non-compliant. - Operations channel : the global team must pass through an in-country jump host + s

Two incidents in the past two years: a contractor used a VPN account to scan the intranet laterally, and a departing employee's account was not revoked in time. The group wants "zero trust"; the vendor quote is 8M with a 12-month implementation. 场景 ：某集团 3000 人，现状是总部双防火墙 + 全员工 VPN 接入内网（VPN 后即"内网可信"）。近两年发生两起事件：外包人员用 VPN 账号横向扫描内网；离职员工账号未及时回收。集团要求"上零信任"，安全厂商报价 800 万，实施周期 12 个月。 Questions to answer : 1. What is the real shortcoming today, and can buying a zero trust product fix it? 2. Which group of people and which set of applications should the migration start with? 3. In the 8M proposal, what is mandatory and what can be deferred? 要回答的问题 ： 1. 现状真正的短板是什么？买零信任产品能解决吗？ 2. 迁移应该从哪一批人和哪一批应用开始？ 3. 800 万的方案里，哪些是必须的、哪些是可后置的？ Reference approach : - The shortcoming is not "no zero trust appliance" but "identity lifecycle" and "lateral reachability". s: Design Scenarios (2) · 设计情景演练（2 个）
x: hose two are fixed, any new product just moves the same risks somewhere else. - Start with a "minimum viable zero trust" : ① identity governance (automatic joiner/mover/leaver synchronization, full MFA coverage); ② change "the intranet is reachable" into "each application is reachable" (segment ten high-risk applications first, such as finance, HR and the code repository); ③ add device compliance checks (patching, encryption, EDR state); ④ connect logs and alerting. - Roll applications out in batches : start with "high value + low coupling + concentrated users" (OA, finance), prove out policy, user experience and operations, then move to engineering applications. Zero trust projects that switch everything at once fail at a very high rate. - Budget ordering : identity and MFA (mandatory), application segmentation and policy enforcement points (mandatory), device compliance assessment (should do), UEBA/behavior analytics (deferrable), full traffic decryption and inspection (high risk, high cost, proceed carefully). - Acceptance criteria must be measurable : not "deployment complete", but "a contractor account loses all access within 15 minutes of the offboarding process being triggered" and "the success rate of lateral probing from any endpoint to the finance system is zero". - One sentence : the order for implementing zero trust is "identity → segmentation → policy → telemetry"; products are only the carrier for those steps. 参考思路 ： - 短板不是"没有零信任设备"，而是"身份生命周期"和"横向可达性"。 账号不回收、VPN 后能扫全网——这两个问题不解决，任何新产品都只是把同一批风险挪个位置。 - 先做"最小可行零信任" ：① 身份治理（入职/离职/转岗自动同步、MFA 全覆盖）；② 把"内网可达"改成"按应用可达"（先做 10 个高风险应用的分域，例如财务、HR、代码库）；③ 加设备合规检查（补丁、加密、EDR 状态）；④ 打通日志与告警。 - 应用分批 ：从"高价值 + 低耦合 + 用户集中"的应用开始（如 OA、财务），跑通策略、体验、运维三件事，再推工程类应用。 一次性全量切换的零信任项目，失败率极高。 - 预算排序 ：身份与 MFA（必须）、应用分域与策略执行点（必须）、设备合规评估（应做）、UEBA/行为分析（可后置）、全流量解密与检测（高风险高成本，谨慎）。 - 验收标准要可测 ：不是"部署完成"，而是"外包账号在离职流程触发后 15 分钟内失去全部访问权限""从任一终端到财务系统的横向探测成功率 = 0"。 - 一句话 ： 零信任的落地顺序是"身份 → 分域 → 策略 → 遥测"，产品只是这几步的载体。

s: Chapter Summary · 本章小结
x: Chapter Summary · 本章小结 Chapter 4 is the constraints chapter of the book: it offers no technology, only the boundaries that the other 17 chapters must respect. 第 4 章是全书的 约束章 ：它不给技术，给的是"其他 17 章都必须遵守的边界"。 Security policy (four sources: law / contract / internal policy / architecture principle) ↓ translated into control objectives Security domains + chokepoints (trust level defines domains; inter-domain traffic converges on a few points) ↓ zero trust fills in the inside is not trustworthy either Identity + device + context → trust score → authorization (ZTNA replaces network-level access) ↓ the three goals pull against each other CIA: encryption vs. inspection, availability vs. confidentiality, integrity vs. emergency response ↓ everything must ultimately be provable Compliance evidence chain: logs + time synchronization + change records + periodic review 安全策略（四类来源：法规 / 合同 / 内部制度 / 架构原则） ↓ 翻译成控制目标 安全域 + 检查点（信任等级决定域，域间流量收敛到少数检查点） ↓ 用零信任补齐 内部也不可信 身份 + 设备 + 上下文 → 信任分数 → 授权（ZTNA 取代网络级接入） ↓ 三条目标互相拉扯 CIA 三要素：加密 vs 检测、可用性 vs 机密性、完整性 vs 应急 ↓ 最终都要能被证明 合规证据链：日志 + 时间同步 + 变更记录 + 定期复核 Three sentences that must be taken away: 三句必须带走的话： Conclusion Meaning Security cannot be bolted on afterwards It must be design input. Bolting it on only adds appliances; it cannot change identity, segmentation or process Domains and chokepoints should be "few and explicit", not "many and vague" 5–12 domains and a handful of chokepoints are maintainable Compliance looks at evidence, not configuration Configured but unprovable is the same as not configured 结论 含义 安全不能事后追加 它必须是设计输入。事后追加只能加设备，改不了身份、分段与流程 域与检查点是"少而明确"，不是"多而模糊" 5–12 个域、少数几个检查点，才维护得动 合规看的是证据，不是配置 配了但证明不了，等于没配 One-line memory hook : the deliverable of security design is "boundaries + paths + evidence", not an appliance list. 一句话记忆 ： 安全设计的交付物是"边界 + 路径 + 证据"，而不是"设备清单"。 This chapter expands into concrete technology in Chapter 10 (hardening, admission control, segmentation, encryption) and becomes a layer of constraint inside concrete architecture

s: Chapter Overview: Why a Designer Needs "Borrowed Wisdom" · 本章导读：为什么设计师需要"借来的智慧"
x: Chapter Overview: Why a Designer Needs "Borrowed Wisdom" · 本章导读：为什么设计师需要"借来的智慧" The previous four chapters were about how to think — design mindset, business language, the purpose of the network, security. They answer questions of direction . 前四章讲的是"怎么想"——设计思维、业务语言、网络目的、安全。它们回答的是 方向 问题。 In a real project, however, you immediately hit an awkward question: what makes you believe your design is right? 但到了真实项目里，你会立刻遇到一个尴尬： 你凭什么认为自己的设计是对的？ A client says "we do enterprise architecture following TOGAF", and you must be able to hold up your end of the conversation Your boss asks "how do we justify this investment", and you need a shared language Your own "best practice" — what makes it "best"? 客户说"我们按 TOGAF 做的企业架构"，你要能接得上话 老板问"这个投资怎么证明合理"，你需要一套共同语言 你自己加的"最佳实践"，凭什么就是"最佳"？ Reference architectures, reference models and frameworks are the tools that solve this: they turn pitfalls other people already fell into into reusable patterns . You do not have to invent an architecture language from scratch; you only have to pick the right framework and then do the actual design inside its skeleton. 参考架构、参考模型、框架，就是解决这个问题的工具： 它们把别人踩过的坑整理成了可复用的句式 。你不用从零发明架构语言，只需选择合适的框架，然后在它的骨架里做具体设计。 ⚠️ The core attitude of this chapter (and it runs throughout) : a framework is scaffolding, not the building . A framework tells you which dimensions to consider; it will never tell you whether to choose OSPF or EIGRP. What really counts is whether you can make the right trade-offs inside those dimensions, given your business constraints . ⚠️ 本章的核心态度（贯穿全章） ：框架是 脚手架 ，不是 建筑 。框架告诉你需要考虑哪些维度，但不会告诉你选 OSPF 还是 EIGRP。真正见真章的是——你能不能在框架给的维度里，结合业务约束做出正确取舍。

s: Three Concepts That Are Easy to Confuse · 三个容易混淆的概念
x: Three Concepts That Are Easy to Confuse · 三个容易混淆的概念 In practice and in documentation these three words are often used interchangeably, even though they sit at different levels: 实际工作和文档里，这三个词经常被混用，但它们层次不同： Concept What it is What it does Examples Reference model An abstract, layered general framework Provides thinking dimensions and vocabulary The OSI seven-layer model, the TCP/IP model Reference architecture A structured template for a class of scenarios Provides a reusable design blueprint Cisco SAFE, the layered campus architecture Framework Manages process and methodology Provides the steps and governance for doing the work TOGAF, ITIL, FEAF 概念 英文 是什么 作用 举例 参考模型 Reference Model 抽象的、分层的 通用框架 提供思考维度和术语 OSI 七层模型、TCP/IP 模型 参考架构 Reference Architecture 针对某类场景的 结构化模板 提供可复用的设计蓝本 Cisco SAFE 安全架构、园区网分层架构 框架 Framework 管理 流程与方法论 提供做事的步骤与治理 TOGAF、ITIL、FEAF The relationship can be understood like this: 三者的关系可以这样理解： Framework → which process should I follow to do architecture? (HOW to do architecture) ↓ produces Reference architecture → what does this class of scenario usually look like? (WHAT it looks like) ↓ referenced by Reference model → describe it with a common language and layering (HOW to describe it) 框架（Framework） → 我该按什么流程做架构？（HOW to do architecture） ↓ 产出 参考架构（Ref. Arch.） → 这类场景通常长什么样？（WHAT it looks like） ↓ 参考 参考模型（Ref. Model） → 用统一的语言和分层来描述它（HOW to describe it） 💡 The key distinction : TOGAF is a framework, not a reference architecture . TOGAF will not tell you whether the data center should use spine-leaf or a three-tier design; it only tells you "align stakeholders with an architecture vision first, then do the technology architecture". This is one of the most common confusions. 💡 关键区分 ： TOGAF 是框架，不是参考架构 。TOGAF 不会告诉你数据中心该用 spine-leaf 还是三层架构，它只告诉你"要先用架构愿景对齐利益相关者，再做技术架构"。这是最常见的混淆点之一。

lb: Chapter 5 · Reference Architecture Models and Frameworks (English)
s: From Frameworks to Network Reference Architectures · 从框架到网络参考架构
x: From Frameworks to Network Reference Architectures · 从框架到网络参考架构 Frameworks are generic, but network design needs concrete blueprints. The network reference architectures commonly used in the industry include: 框架是通用的，但网络设计需要具体的蓝本。业界常见的网络参考架构包括： Reference architecture Scope Problem it solves Cisco SAFE Security architecture Security domain design and chokepoint placement (the subject of Chapter 4) Cisco Validated Design (CVD) Validated designs per domain Tested configuration baselines and scale boundaries Layered campus architecture Campus network Modularity and fault isolation across core/distribution/access Enterprise WAN / SD-WAN architecture Wide area network Transport selection, topology, centralized policy Data center spine-leaf Data center East-west scalability and low latency 参考架构 覆盖范围 解决的问题 Cisco SAFE 安全架构 安全域划分、检查点部署位置（对应第 4 章） Cisco Validated Design (CVD) 各领域验证设计 提供经过测试的配置基线与规模边界 园区分层架构 园区网 核心/分布/接入的模块化与故障隔离 企业 WAN / SD-WAN 架构 广域网 传输选型、拓扑、策略中心化 数据中心 Spine-Leaf 数据中心 东西向流量的可扩展性与低延迟 ⚠️ A critical judgement : a reference architecture tells you "how it is usually done", but it does not carry your constraints . If a scenario contains special constraints (an extremely tight budget, a legacy system that cannot be touched, compliance requiring data to stay in country), you must deviate from the reference architecture deliberately and be able to explain why . Citing "that is how the reference architecture does it" as your design rationale is the classic "best practice trap" from Chapter 1. ⚠️ 关键判断 ：参考架构给你"通常怎么做"，但 它不承担你的约束 。如果场景里出现特殊约束（预算极紧、遗留系统不能动、合规要求数据不出境），你必须 有意识地偏离参考架构，并说得出理由 。拿"参考架构就是这么做的"当作设计依据，是最典型的第 1 章"最佳实践陷阱"。

x: Case Studies · 实战案例 Case 1: A Bank "Moves to the Cloud" — Phase A Cannot Be Skipped · 案例一：银行"上云"——A 阶段不能跳 Background : the business side of a city commercial bank proposed "move the core business to the cloud within two years". The architecture team went straight to technology selection: private or public cloud, which SDN vendor, VXLAN or EVPN. 背景 ：某城商行业务部门提出"两年内核心业务上云"，架构团队直接开始做技术选型：私有云还是公有云、SDN 用哪家、VXLAN 还是 EVPN。 The problem : after four months of work, the CFO asked three questions in the review meeting — 1. "Once we are in the cloud, how much does each transaction cost us less?" 2. "How many weeks does go-live get shorter?" 3. "If we do not move to the cloud, what do we lose?" 问题 ：方案做了四个月，评审会上 CFO 问了三个问题—— 1. "上云之后，我们的每笔交易成本降多少？" 2. "上线时间缩短几周？" 3. "如果不上云，会损失什么？" The architecture team could not answer. Because phase A (architecture vision) and phase B (business architecture) had never been done , they jumped straight to D (technology architecture). 架构团队答不出来。因为 从来没有做过 A 阶段（架构愿景）和 B 阶段（业务架构） ，直接跳到了 D（技术架构）。 After redoing it in TOGAF, the real pain point emerged : it was not "we have not moved to the cloud", it was "a new business launch averages eleven weeks, while competitors take three" — and six of those weeks were spent requesting network resources . 回到 TOGAF 重做后才发现 ：真实的业务痛点不是"没上云"，而是"新业务上线平均要 11 周，竞品只要 3 周"，其中 6 周花在 申请网络资源 上。 The genuinely effective solution : not a wholesale move to the cloud, but self-service network resource requests plus automated provisioning (Chapter 12), compressing the six weeks to two days. Results in three months, at one tenth of the original cost. 真正有效的方案 ：不是全面上云，而是先做 网络资源自助申请 + 自动化开通 （第 12 章自动化），把 6 周压到 2 天。项目 3 个月见效，成本只有原方案的 1/10。 💡 Lesson : before the requirement is clarified, any technical proposal is guesswork. Phases A and B of TOGAF look "soft", but they are the only gate against technology for its own sake. 💡 教训 ： 需求没澄清之前，任何技术方案都是在猜。 TOGAF 的 A、B 阶段看起来"虚"，但它们是防止"技术自嗨"的唯一闸门。 Case 2: A Manufacturing Group With the Wrong Operati

x: ng Model · 案例二：制造集团运营模型错配 Background : a manufacturing group has five business units (auto parts, home appliance parts, tooling, trading, new energy). Headquarters required "one unified network architecture and unified management across the group". 背景 ：某制造集团有 5 个事业部（汽车件、家电件、模具、贸易、新能源），总部要求"全集团统一网络架构、统一管理"。 The misjudgement : headquarters IT assumed the group was a Unification operating model and pushed unified IP planning, unified security policy and a unified egress. 误判 ：总部 IT 认为集团属于 统一型 运营模型，于是强推统一 IP 规划、统一安全策略、统一出口。 The actual conflicts : 实际冲突 ： Business unit Real characteristics Problem created by unification Auto parts EDI integration with OEMs; the dedicated circuit must use the carrier the customer specifies The unified egress design cannot be implemented Home appliance parts Runs its own e-commerce and needs fast CDN and cloud changes The change approval chain is far too long Tooling Only 200 people; IT is a part-time role Nobody can take on the complexity of a unified management platform New energy A brand-new plant that shares almost no data with the group Forcing the unified architecture into the plant build slows it down 事业部 实际特征 统一带来的问题 汽车件 与主机厂做 EDI 对接，专线必须走客户指定的运营商 统一出口方案无法落地 家电件 有自建电商，需要快速变更 CDN/云资源 变更审批链路过长 模具 只有 200 人，IT 是兼职的 统一管理平台的复杂度无人能接手 新能源 新建工厂，与集团几乎不共享数据 强绑统一架构拖慢建厂 Repositioning with standardization × integration : the facts point to Diversification (low standardization, low integration: independent units plus a few shared services), at most transitioning toward Coordination . 用标准化 × 集成重新定位 ：事实是 多样化型 （低标准化、低集成，各单元独立 + 少量共享服务），最多向 协调型 过渡。 The corrected architecture : - Headquarters unifies only three things: the shared Internet egress service, the group-level security baseline, and the WAN transport framework - Each business unit keeps its own addressing plan and change authority - Layered policy templates (a mandatory security baseline plus optional network templates) replace the one-size-fits-all approach 修正后的架构 ： - 总部只统一三件事： 互联网出口共享服务、集团级安

x: 全基线、WAN 传输框架 - 每个事业部保留自己的地址规划与变更权 - 用 分层的策略模板 （强制的安全基线 + 可选的网络模板）代替"一刀切" 💡 Lesson : get the operating model wrong and every downstream design is wrong. Two questions settle it: do the units do things the same way? do the units need to share data frequently? 💡 教训 ： 运营模型判断错误，会导致所有下游设计都错。 判断只需两问：各单元做事方式一样吗？单元之间需要频繁共享数据吗？ Case 3: A Security Project That Could Not Prove Its Value and Lost Its Budget · 案例三：安全项目无法证明价值，预算被砍 Background : a retailer invested 8M in a network-wide security overhaul (firewalls, microsegmentation, NAC). A year later its request for phase-two funding was rejected. 背景 ：某零售企业投入 800 万做全网安全改造（防火墙、微隔离、NAC），一年后申请二期预算被拒。 The reason : the business case said only "improve the overall security level" — not SMART, therefore not verifiable. What the CIO saw was "8M spent and no visible change". 原因 ：立项时只写了"提升整体安全水平"——不满足 SMART，无法验证。CIO 看到的是"花了 800 万，没看到任何变化"。 The measurement framework rebuilt afterwards : 重做后的度量体系 ： Metric Before After MTTD (mean time to find a compromised host) 21 days 4 hours (NetFlow plus centralized logging) MTTR (mean time to repair) 5 days 6 hours (automated isolation playbooks) Non-compliant endpoint connection events 30+ per month 2 per month 指标 改造前 改造后 MTTD （发现失陷主机平均时间） 21 天 4 小时（靠 NetFlow + 日志集中） MTTR （修复平均时间） 5 天 6 小时（靠自动化隔离剧本） 违规终端接入事件 每月 30+ 起 每月 2 起 Phase-two funding was approved — because the CIO could take that table to the board. 二期预算顺利通过 ——因为 CIO 能拿这张表向董事会汇报。 💡 Lesson : MTTD depends on visibility, MTTR on resilience and automation. Fixing those two metrics at design time effectively locks in the technical direction: to improve MTTD add monitoring points, to improve MTTR add redundancy and automation. 💡 教训 ： MTTD 靠可见性，MTTR 靠弹性与自动化。 设计之初就确定这两条指标，等于提前锁定了技术方向：想改善 MTTD 就加监测点，想改善 MTTR 就加冗余和自动化。

lb: Chapter 5 · Reference Architecture Models and Frameworks (English)
s: Lessons Learned · 实战经验总结
x: Lessons Learned · 实战经验总结 Lesson Explanation Set the alignment level before the design depth A pure selection project should not carry the heavy process of business transformation; conversely a transformation need cannot be closed out with a selection report Trim the framework until it produces deliverables Cut any phase that produces neither a decision nor a constraint after review. The value of a framework is at the decision points, not in the volume of documents Position the operating model with two questions "Do we want unified standardization?" and "do we want unified integration?" — the answers land directly on one of four models, and that step fixes the scope of all later standardization Use reference architectures as a starting checklist, not the answer SAFE and CVD give you dimensions and validated scale boundaries, not configurations to copy Metrics must be set on Day 0 MTTD (detection) and MTTR (recovery) decide whether you buy monitoring or redundancy; metrics added afterwards are not metrics Separate architecture from projects EA sets direction and standards; projects only deliver inside those standards. Without EA, every project grows its own locally optimal island Tie architecture to money Architecture output must enter budgeting and project review, or it stays a beautiful document. Phase two was approved because the CIO had a table the board could read 经验 说明 先定对齐级别，再定设计深度 只做选型的项目不要套用"业务转型"级别的重型流程；反之业务转型需求也不能用一份选型报告交差 框架要裁剪到"能产出交付物" 凡是评审后既不产出决策、也不产出约束的阶段，一律砍掉。框架的价值在决策点，不在文档数量 运营模型用两问定位 "要不要统一标准化？""要不要统一集成？"两个问题的答案直接落到四种模型（统一/协调/复制/多样化），这一步决定后面所有标准化范围 参考架构当起点清单，不当标准答案 SAFE、CVD 给你的是维度和验证过的规模边界，不是可以直接抄的配置 指标在 Day 0 就要定 MTTD（检测）与 MTTR（恢复）决定了要买监测还是买冗余，事后补指标等于没有指标 架构与项目分层 EA 决定方向与标准，项目只负责在标准内交付。缺了 EA，项目会各自长出"本地最优"的孤岛 把架构和钱绑在一起 架构产出必须能进入预算与立项评审，否则永远是"漂亮的文档"。案例里二期预算能过，是因为 CIO 有一张能对上董事会语言的表

s: Design Scenarios (2) · 设计情景演练（2 个）
x: Design Scenarios (2) · 设计情景演练（2 个） Scenario 1: After an Acquisition, Two Architecture Languages Coexist · 情景一：并购之后，两套架构语言并存 Situation : Group A (financial services, using TOGAF with centralized IT and a network planned by headquarters) acquires Company B (an internet business running Scrum with autonomous product teams, each building its own network). The group requires "a unified enterprise architecture within three years". At the first architecture review, B's team said "your architecture phases are too long, we run two-week iterations", and A's architect said "you have no architecture governance, you will never be auditable". 场景 ：A 集团（金融，用 TOGAF + 集中式 IT，网络由总部统一规划）收购 B 公司（互联网业务，用 Scrum + 产品团队自治，网络由各产品线自建）。集团要求"三年内统一企业架构"。第一次架构评审会上，B 的团队说"你们的架构阶段太长，我们两周一个迭代"，A 的架构师说"你们没有架构治理，以后无法审计"。 Questions to answer : 1. Is the conflict really about frameworks, or about operating models? 2. Which side's cadence should the network architecture follow? 3. What is the first deliverable that becomes the "common language"? 要回答的问题 ： 1. 冲突的本质是框架之争，还是运营模型之争？ 2. 网络架构应该按哪一边的节奏走？ 3. 第一个可交付的"共同语言"是什么？ Reference approach : - The essence is an operating model mismatch, not one framework being better. A is centralized (pursuing standardization and compliance), B is federated/autonomous (pursuing speed). Forcing one framework on both only makes the fast side slow and does not make the slow side better. - Govern in layers by risk level : network domains involving compliance, funds and customer data (core trading, payments, customer data) follow A's centralized governance (TOGAF phases with audit evidence); growth-oriented domains (marketing, experimental products) keep B's autonomy but must satisfy a minimum architecture baseline (addressing plan, security baseline, observability onboarding, cost attribution). - Run two tracks in terms of cadence : architecture decisions reviewed quarterly, technical work delivered in iterations. The framework governs decisions and their evidence, agile govern

x: s the delivery method; the two do not conflict — what conflicts is mistaking the framework for a project plan. - The first common language : a capability map plus interface contracts (which capabilities the center provides, which stay autonomous, and how SLAs and security responsibility are defined at the boundary). It produces real value faster than any framework document. - Acceptance : not "the architecture documents are complete", but "a new business launch does not need an exception from headquarters" and "no unaudited change has occurred in the compliance domains". 参考思路 ： - 本质是运营模型错配，不是框架优劣。 A 是集中式（追求标准化与合规），B 是联邦/自治式（追求速度）。 强行统一框架，只会让快的一方变慢、慢的一方也没变好。 - 按"风险等级"分层治理 ：涉及合规、资金、客户数据的网络域（如核心交易、支付、客户数据）走 A 的集中治理（TOGAF 阶段 + 审计留痕）；面向增长的业务域（如营销、试验性产品）保留 B 的自治，但必须满足"最小架构基线"（地址规划、安全基线、可观测性接入、成本归属）。 - 节奏上做双轨 ：架构决策按季度评审，技术实施按迭代交付。 框架规定"决策与留痕"，敏捷规定"交付方式"，两者不冲突，冲突的是把框架当成项目计划。 - 第一个共同语言 ：一份 能力地图 + 接口契约 （哪些能力由中心提供、哪些自治，边界处的 SLA 与安全责任如何界定）。它比任何框架文档都更快产生实际价值。 - 验收 ：不是"架构文档齐全"，而是"新业务上线不需要向总部申请例外"且"合规域没有出现未审计的变更"。 Scenario 2: In a Budget Review, the Network Investment Cannot Explain Its Value · 情景二：预算评审会上，网络投资说不清价值 Situation : at the group's annual budget review, the network team requests 26M for a campus and WAN overhaul, with the justification "equipment is out of support, the architecture is dated, and we need to move to SD-WAN + Wi-Fi 6E". The CFO's response: "we just did a security project last year, why do you need money again? What does this spending bring?" The request was cut to 9M. 场景 ：集团年度预算评审，网络团队申请 2600 万做园区与 WAN 改造，理由写的是"设备已过保、架构陈旧、需要升级到 SD-WAN + Wi-Fi 6E"。CFO 的反馈是："去年刚做过安全项目，今年为什么又要钱？这些投入带来什么？" 结果被砍到 900 万。 Questions to answer : 1. Which pieces of business language are missing from the request? 2. How can KPIs translate a technology upgrade into business outcomes? 3. If only part of the budget can be saved, what should be protected first? 要回答的问题 ： 1. 这份申请缺了哪几块业务语言？ 2. 如何用 KPI 把技术升级翻译成业务成果？ 3. 如果只能保住一部分预算，优先保什么？ Reference approach : - Three things are missing: alignm

lb: Chapter 5 · Reference Architecture Models and Frameworks (English)
s: Design Scenarios (2) · 设计情景演练（2 个）
x: ent to business goals, quantified current pain, and the consequence of not investing. "Out of support" is technical language; what the CFO hears is "the vendor is raising prices". - Translate into KPIs : map each technical item to business metrics — wireless overhaul → failed meeting/desk handovers and mean troubleshooting time; WAN overhaul → new store onboarding cycle and P95 latency for key applications across regions; SD-WAN → circuit cost and change-ticket duration. Every KPI needs "current value → target value → money or risk". - Write the consequence of not investing as risk exposure : recovery time for out-of-support equipment failures (no spares means weeks), compliance risk from unpatched known vulnerabilities, and how much the old architecture drags on new business launch cycles (for example new store in 45 days versus 7 days for competitors). - Prioritize : protect "compliance and security red lines" (non-negotiable), protect items that directly generate revenue or shorten time to market, cut "experience optimization" items. Splitting 26M into three phases passes far more easily than insisting on a single request. - One sentence : the CFO is not unwilling to spend money, but unwilling to spend it on things that cannot be measured. Referring to the four alignment levels and the KPI section of this chapter, attach the plan to group-level goals. 参考思路 ： - 缺三样东西：业务目标的对齐、可量化的现状痛点、不投资的后果。 "设备过保"是技术语言，CFO 听到的是"厂商要涨价"。 - 翻译成 KPI ：把技术项一一对应到业务指标——无线改造 → 会议/工位切换失败次数、平均排障时长；WAN 改造 → 新门店上线周期、跨区访问关键应用 P95 时延；SD-WAN → 线路成本与变更工单时长。 每个 KPI 要有"现状值 → 目标值 → 对应金额或风险"。 - 不投资的后果要写成风险敞口 ：过保设备的故障恢复时长（无备件 → 按周计）、已知漏洞无法修补带来的合规风险、老架构对新业务上线周期的拖累（例如新开店 45 天 vs 同行 7 天）。 - 优先级排序 ：保"合规与安全红线"（不可谈）、保"直接产生收入或缩短上市时间"的项、砍"体验优化类"项。 把 2600 万拆成三期，比坚持一次性申请更容易通过。 - 一句话 ： CFO 不是不愿意花钱，而是不愿意为无法度量的东西花钱。 参照本章"业务架构四个对齐级别"与 KPI 小节，把方案挂到集团级目标上。

x: Chapter Overview: Transport Is "Somebody Else's Network" · 本章导读：传输层是"别人家的网" Chapters 6 and 7 (Layer 2 technologies) are easy to confuse, so let us draw the line first: 第 6 章和第 7 章（二层技术）容易混淆，先划清界限： Chapter Perspective Focus Chapter 6, Transport Technologies Looking outward — the service the carrier sells What exactly am I buying from the carrier? Chapter 7, Layer 2 Technologies Looking inward — the Layer 2 network I build myself How do I design my own STP, VLANs and trunks 章节 视角 关注点 第 6 章 传输技术 向外看 ——运营商提供的服务 我从运营商手里买到的到底是什么？ 第 7 章 二层技术 向内看 ——自己建的二层网络 我自己的 STP、VLAN、Trunk 怎么设计 In other words, this chapter is about service procurement and selection , not device configuration. That matters especially for CCDE, because the first step in a great many real designs is: should this site connect over MPLS L2VPN, over L3VPN, or straight over the Internet with SD-WAN? 换句话说，本章讨论的是 服务采购与选型 ，而不是设备配置。这对 CCDE 尤其重要，因为大量真实设计的第一步就是： 这个站点应该接 MPLS L2VPN、L3VPN、还是直接走 Internet + SD-WAN？ ⚠️ The design tension of this chapter : Layer 2 services deliver maximum flexibility and "migration without anyone noticing", but the price is a larger failure domain, an invisible control plane and limited scalability . Almost every design trade-off in this category is fundamentally a balancing act between those two sides. ⚠️ 本章的设计张力 ：二层服务能提供最大的灵活性和"无感迁移"，但代价是 故障域扩大、控制平面不可见、可扩展性受限 。几乎所有这一类的设计取舍，本质都在权衡这一对矛盾。

x: Foundation Topics · 基础内容 Layer 2 Media Access · 二层介质接入 Carriers understand the importance of offering a flexible and responsive network architecture that supports current and future requirements without large-scale change. As a result, nearly every service provider has migrated part or all of its core infrastructure to MPLS. That lets them use the MPLS infrastructure to deliver both L2 and L3 services over one common MPLS core. 运营商理解提供灵活和响应迅速的网络架构的重要性，该架构支持当前和未来需求而无需大规模变更。因此，几乎所有服务提供商都已部分或完全将核心基础设施迁移到 MPLS。这使他们能够利用 MPLS 基础设施，通过一个统一的 MPLS 核心为客户提供 L2 和 L3 服务。 Key insight : the core of a modern carrier is MPLS , and Layer 2 services are merely "emulation running on top of MPLS". Therefore: 关键理解 ：现代运营商的核心是 MPLS ，二层服务只是"跑在 MPLS 上的仿真"。所以： What the subscriber sees: a transparent Ethernet wire (or a transparent LAN) What actually carries it: CE → PE (attachment circuit, AC) → MPLS label switching → PE → CE (pseudowire, PW) 订户看到的：一条透明的以太网线（或一个透明 LAN） 实际承载的：CE → PE（接入电路 AC）→ MPLS 标签交换 → PE → CE（伪线 PW） 💡 Why carriers turn everything into "labels" : because MPLS lets one core carry different services (L2VPN, L3VPN, multicast VPN) with the same infrastructure, and economies of scale are the carrier's core driver. This also explains why EVPN later uses BGP: it follows the mature BGP control-plane approach of L3VPN. 💡 为什么运营商要把所有东西都变成"标签" ：因为 MPLS 可复用同一套核心承载不同服务（L2VPN、L3VPN、组播 VPN）， 规模经济 是运营商的核心驱动力。这也解释了后面 EVPN 为什么用 BGP——它沿用了 L3VPN 成熟的 BGP 控制平面思路。 Carrier Ethernet · Carrier Ethernet（载波以太网） Service providers that deliver modern Layer 2 Ethernet services (such as metro Ethernet) are called Carrier Ethernet providers. 现代提供二层以太网服务（如城域以太网）的服务商被称为 Carrier Ethernet 提供商。 The five Carrier Ethernet attributes defined by the MEF (the usual test for "is this really a Carrier Ethernet service"): MEF 定义的 Carrier Ethernet 五大属性 （判断"这是不是真正的 Carrier Ethernet 服务"的常用标准）： Attribute Meaning Practical impact on design Standardized services Three standard services: E-Line / E-LAN / E-Tree Service names ar

x: Virtual Private Wire Service (VPWS) Design Considerations · 虚拟专线服务设计考量 VPWS is built on the pseudowire (PW) concept (RFC 3916): a connection between two edge nodes that ties two attachment circuits (ACs) together and emulates a direct AC connection. VPWS 基于伪线 (Pseudowire, PW) 概念（RFC 3916），是两个边缘节点之间的连接，将两条接入电路 (AC) 连接起来，模拟直接 AC 连接。 In one sentence : VPWS = pulling an "invisible cable" from point A to point B . It does no MAC learning and no switching — it just moves frames. 一句话理解 ：VPWS = 把一条"看不见的网线"从 A 点拉到 B 点 。它不做 MAC 学习，不做交换，只逐帧搬运。 Key PW Mechanisms · PW 的关键机制 AC1 PW (pseudowire) AC2 CE1 ──[attachment circuit]── PE1 ═══════════════════ PE2 ──[attachment circuit]── CE2 │ encapsulation: control word + label stack │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘ AC1 PW（伪线） AC2 CE1 ──[接入电路]── PE1 ═══════════════════ PE2 ──[接入电路]── CE2 │ 封装：控制字 + 标签栈 │ └────────────────────────┘ Element Description AC (Attachment Circuit) The customer-side attachment circuit, which may be a physical port or a VLAN PW (Pseudowire) A logical connection carried over MPLS that encapsulates and transparently forwards AC frames Control word Preserves frame ordering, pads short frames, and handles fragmentation and misordering Signaling LDP (Martini) / BGP (Kompella) / static configuration 要素 说明 AC (Attachment Circuit) 客户侧接入电路，可以是物理端口或 VLAN PW (Pseudowire) 承载在 MPLS 上的逻辑连接，把 AC 帧封装后透传 控制字 (Control Word) 保证帧顺序、填充短帧，处理分片与乱序 信令方式 LDP（Martini 方式）/ BGP（Kompella 方式）/ 静态配置 💡 Two signaling schools (extended material): - Martini (LDP) : per-PW signaling, simple and intuitive, requires LDP sessions between PEs. The mainstream deployment approach - Kompella (BGP) : BGP carries the PW information, allows auto-discovery, scales better, and has a more complex configuration model This distinction reappears in the EVPN section — EVPN essentially takes Kompella's "BGP auto-discovery" idea and develops it fully. 💡 两个信令流派 （扩展知识点）： - Martini（LDP） ：逐条 PW 信令，简单直观，PE 间需 LDP 会话。 主流部署方式 - Kompella（BGP） ：BGP 承载 PW 信息，可

x: Virtual Private LAN Service (VPLS) Design Considerations · 虚拟专用 LAN 服务设计考量 VPLS meets the need to interconnect multiple sites over one common Layer 2 network, and supports Layer 2 extension and virtual machine mobility in modern data centers. VPLS 满足通过一个通用二层网络互联多个站点的需求，支持现代数据中心的二层扩展和虚拟机移动性。 In one sentence : VPLS = the carrier builds "one big switch spanning geographies" for you , so every site looks like it plugs into the same switch. 一句话理解 ：VPLS = 运营商帮你建了一个"跨地域的大交换机" ，所有站点像接在同一台交换机上。 VPLS Architectural Components · VPLS 架构组件 Component Function N-PE (network-facing PE) Provides VPLS termination and L3 services U-PE (user-facing PE) Provides the customer UNI CE (customer edge) Customer equipment VSI (virtual switching instance) Performs standard LAN bridging, including learning and forwarding based on MAC addresses and VLAN tags MTU (multi-tenant unit) An aggregation device in the hierarchical model that acts in the U-PE role 组件 功能 N-PE (网络面向 PE) 提供 VPLS 终止/L3 服务 U-PE (用户面向 PE) 提供客户 UNI CE (客户边缘) 客户设备 VSI (虚拟交换实例) 执行标准 LAN 桥接功能，包括基于 MAC 地址和 VLAN 标签的学习和转发 MTU (多租户单元) 分层模型中的汇聚设备，充当 U-PE 角色 VPLS Control Plane · VPLS 控制平面 The main difference between VPLS and VPWS: VPLS needs a full mesh of PWs among all participating PEs. Automatic PE discovery and automatic PW establishment therefore become important factors. VPLS 与 VPWS 的主要区别：VPLS 需要所有参与的 PE 之间建立 全互联 PW 。因此 PE 自动发现和 PW 自动建立是重要因素。 Why must it be full mesh? Because VPLS is essentially one "virtual switch": 为什么必须全互联？ 因为 VPLS 本质是一台"虚拟交换机"： If PE1–PE2 and PE2–PE3 have PWs but PE1–PE3 does not: a frame from CE1 to CE3 arrives at PE1 over the PE2 PW → forwarding it on to PE3 would loop So either full mesh (every PE reaches every other directly), or explicit loop protection 如果 PE1–PE2、PE2–PE3 有 PW，但 PE1–PE3 没有： CE1 发往 CE3 的帧 → PE1 从 PE2 的 PW 收到 → 若再转发给 PE3 就形成环路 因此要么全互联（每个 PE 都能直达），要么必须加环路防护 ⚠️ The VPLS "split horizon" rule : a PE does not forward a frame received from one PW out another PW. MTU 成为单点 ——MTU 挂了，其下所有站点失联（除非双归属） 2. 故障域扩大 ——一个 MTU 的 STP/环路可能影响整个 VPLS 域 3. 多一层配置 ——运维复杂度上升（Day 2 成本） 这正是第 5 章"可管理性"原则的具体体现。 VPLS Scalability Limits · VPLS 可扩展性限制 Limit Description Mitigation MAC learning PEs must learn every customer MAC address; memory is constrained at scale Cap MACs per VPLS, tune aging, PBB (MAC-in-MAC) Full-mesh PWs With many PEs the PW count grows as O(n²) H-VPLS hierarchy , EVPN Flooding Unknown unicast, multicast and broadcast flooding consumes bandwidth ARP proxy, multicast optimization, EVPN No control plane MACs are learned only in the data plane, so convergence is slow EVPN's BGP MAC advertisement 限制 说明 缓解手段 MAC 学习 PE 需要学习所有客户的 MAC 地址，大规模部署时内存受限 限制每 VPLS 的 MAC 数、老化优化、 PBB（MAC-in-MAC） PW 全互联 大量 PE 时 PW 数量呈 O(n²) 增长 H-VPLS 分层 、EVPN 泛洪 未知单播、组播和广播泛洪消耗带宽 ARP 代理、组播优化、 EVPN 无控制平面 MAC 只能靠数据面学习，收敛慢 EVPN 的 BGP MAC 通告 💡 The key CCDE judgement : VPLS's problem is not performance, it is the absence of a control plane . MAC learning relies on flooding, multihoming on MC-LAG, and recovery on re-flooding — all patches in the data plane. EVPN exists to move that machinery into the control plane. 💡 CCDE 的关键判断 ：VPLS 的问题 不是性能，而是"缺乏控制平面" 。MAC 学习靠泛洪、多归属靠 MC-LAG、故障恢复靠重新泛洪——都是"数据面打补丁"。EVPN 出现就是为了把这套东西搬到控制平面。

x: EVPN Design Models · EVPN 设计模型 EVPN (Ethernet VPN) is the next-generation L2VPN technology. It uses BGP (MP-BGP) as its control plane and removes the scalability limits of VPLS. EVPN（Ethernet VPN）是下一代 L2VPN 技术，基于 BGP（MP-BGP）作为控制平面，解决了 VPLS 的可扩展性限制。 Core Idea: Turn MACs into Routes · 核心思想：把 MAC 变成路由 The VPLS world: a MAC address = something learned in the data plane (by flooding, by aging) The EVPN world: a MAC address = a BGP route (with a next hop, attributes, policy control) VPLS 世界：MAC 地址 = 数据面学到的东西（靠泛洪、靠老化） EVPN 世界：MAC 地址 = 一条 BGP 路由（有下一跳、有属性、可策略控制） Once you adopt that view, every EVPN advantage follows naturally: 这个视角一旦建立，EVPN 的所有优势都是自然推论： Consequence Result A MAC is a route MAC movement equals a route update — fast convergence after a VM migration, with no "duplicate MAC" Routes have next hops Flooding-based learning disappears — convergence changes from "re-flood" to "BGP update" Routes have attributes Traffic engineering and aliasing (multipath load sharing) become possible BGP has multihoming mechanisms All-Active multihoming is native , with no MC-LAG needed The control plane knows the MACs ARP proxying becomes possible, and BUM traffic drops sharply 推论 结果 MAC 是路由 MAC 迁移 = 路由更新 ，VM 迁移后收敛快，不会出现"双份 MAC" 路由有下一跳 不再需要泛洪学习 ，收敛从"重新泛洪"变为"BGP 更新" 路由有属性 可做 流量工程、aliasing（多路径负载分担） BGP 有多归属机制 All-Active 多归属原生支持 ，无需 MC-LAG 控制平面已知 MAC ARP 代理 成为可能，BUM 大幅减少 EVPN versus VPLS · EVPN vs VPLS 对比 Dimension VPLS EVPN Control plane LDP/RSVP (builds PWs only, carries no MACs) MP-BGP (carries MAC/IP) MAC learning Flooding in the data plane BGP advertisement in the control plane Flooding High (unknown unicast, ARP) Low (ARP proxy) Multihoming Limited (MC-LAG with cross-device coordination) Native All-Active (ESI plus DF election) Scalability Medium (O(n²) PWs and MAC table pressure) High (BGP routes, no full mesh required) MAC mobility Limited Optimized (MAC Mobility extended community plus sequence number) Failure convergence Slow (re-flood and re-learn) Fast (BGP withdraw plus A-D

Type 5 matters a lot — it means EVPN can do Layer 2 and Layer 3 at the same time , the foundation of "one control plane for everything" in modern data centers and campuses (see the overlay design in Chapter 9 on network virtualization). 💡 记忆法 ： 1 发现、2 MAC、3 泛洪、4 选举、5 前缀 。 Type 5 很重要——它意味着 EVPN 可以同时做二层和三层 ，这是现代数据中心与园区"一张控制平面搞定一切"的基础（对应第 9 章网络虚拟化的 Overlay 设计）。 PBB-EVPN PBB-EVPN combines PBB (Provider Backbone Bridging) with EVPN: PBB-EVPN 结合了 PBB (Provider Backbone Bridging) 和 EVPN： Hides customer MAC addresses, so only carrier MACs are carried in the core Improves scalability further Suits scenarios with an enormous number of MAC addresses 隐藏客户 MAC 地址，只在核心传输运营商 MAC 进一步提高可扩展性 适合 MAC 地址数量极大的场景 In one sentence : MAC-in-MAC encapsulation — customer MACs are wrapped inside carrier MACs, and core PEs look only at the outer (carrier) MAC. 原理一句话 ： MAC-in-MAC 封装 ——客户 MAC 被包在运营商 MAC 里面，核心 PE 只看外层（运营商）MAC。 Dimension Plain EVPN PBB-EVPN MACs the core PEs must learn Every customer MAC Only carrier B-MACs Effect of customer MAC count Directly hits core table sizes Isolated at the edge BEB Propagation of customer MAC changes Advertised network-wide Never crosses the core Suited to Medium scale, fine-grained policy Very large scale, MAC explosion 维度 普通 EVPN PBB-EVPN 核心 PE 需学习的 MAC 所有客户 MAC 只有运营商 B-MAC 客户 MAC 数量影响 直接影响核心表项 被隔离在边缘 BEB 客户 MAC 变化传播 全网通告 不跨核心传播 适合 中等规模、需要精细策略 超大规模、MAC 数量爆炸 ⚠️ The cost : another encapsulation layer (MTU shrinks again), more operational complexity and harder troubleshooting. The key question is whether a detection mechanism exists that is independent of the data path . ⚠️ 其中 "黑洞故障" 是最容易被忽略的一类故障：物理层/逻辑层显示正常，但流量静默消失。判断关键—— 是否存在独立于数据面的检测机制 。

x: Extended: Why EVPN Converges Faster · 扩展：EVPN 收敛为什么更快 This is the key to appreciating EVPN's value, and it comes up often: 这是理解 EVPN 价值的关键，也常被追问： VPLS failure recovery: link down → PW down → MAC table must age → unknown-unicast flooding → relearn time = detection + aging timer (tens of seconds) + flooding convergence EVPN failure recovery: link down → BGP withdraws the Type 1/2 routes → upstream removes that next hop immediately time = BFD detection (milliseconds to seconds) + BGP update propagation multihomed case: Type 1 A-D routes allow mass withdrawal — one update removes every MAC of an ESI VPLS 故障恢复： 链路断 → PW 断 → MAC 表需老化 → 未知单播泛洪 → 重新学习 耗时 = 检测 + 老化定时器（数十秒）+ 泛洪收敛 EVPN 故障恢复： 链路断 → BGP 撤消 Type 1/2 路由 → 上游立即删除该下一跳 耗时 = BFD 检测（毫秒~秒级）+ BGP 更新传播 多归属场景：Type 1 的 A-D 路由支持 批量撤消 ，一条更新撤掉整个 ESI 的 MAC 💡 Design implication : EVPN turns "data-plane uncertainty" into "control-plane determinism". This is also why EVPN keeps reappearing in Chapter 9 (virtualization) and Chapter 12 (automation) — programmable and predictable is the foundation of modern networks. 💡 设计含义 ：EVPN 把"数据面的不确定性"转成"控制面的确定性"。这也是第 9 章（虚拟化）与第 12 章（自动化）里 EVPN 反复出现的原因—— 可编程、可预测 是现代网络的基础。

s: Lessons Learned · 实战经验总结
x: Lessons Learned · 实战经验总结 Lesson Explanation Ask first "how big must the Layer 2 domain be" Keep only what Layer 2 genuinely requires, and send the rest over Layer 3. Layer 2 across sites is a last resort, not a default Always verify the MTU Every encapsulation (MPLS, VXLAN, IPsec, GRE) eats bytes. MTU problems show up as "it connects but will not transfer" Layer 2 services move LAN problems along Broadcast, ARP, STP, loops, MTU — none of them disappear, they just break out somewhere else Build visibility before talking about optimization Tunnels and carrier networks make localization harder, so OAM, BFD and flow analysis must be in place before go-live Migrate in two steps First move as an equivalent to protect the business, then optimize cost and architecture Do not over-design for "flexibility" Taking EVPN/PBB-EVPN into small environments usually costs more in complexity than it returns Count TCO, not CAPEX Carrier-side VLAN coordination, change tickets and fault demarcation are all long-term costs 经验 说明 先问"二层域要多大" 二层只保留"真的必须"的部分，其余走三层。跨站点二层是最后手段，不是首选 MTU 永远要核对 任何封装（MPLS、VXLAN、IPsec、GRE）都会吃掉字节。MTU 问题表现为"能连但传不了" 二层服务会搬运 LAN 的问题 广播、ARP、STP、环路、MTU——一个都不会少，只是换了地方发作 先建可见性，再谈优化 隧道与运营商网络让定位变难，OAM/BFD/流量分析要在上线前就位 迁移分两步走 先等价搬迁保证业务不断，再优化成本与架构 别为"灵活"过度设计 小规模场景上 EVPN/PBB-EVPN，复杂度成本通常大于收益 算 TCO，不算 CAPEX 运营商侧 VLAN 协调、变更工单、故障定界都是长期成本

x: Design Scenario Exercises (2) · 设计情景演练（2 个） Scenario 1: Must an Active-Active Data Center "Extend Layer 2"? · 情景一：双活数据中心"必须二层延伸"吗 Situation : a retailer wants active-active data centers within one metro, 38 km apart. The application team states the requirement: "both computer rooms must be in the same Layer 2 domain, otherwise virtual machine migration breaks." Available from the carrier: EPL (1G/10G point-to-point), EVPL (port reuse, multiple VLANs) and an EVPN-based E-LAN service. The current single room has 1200 VLANs, about 60,000 MAC entries, and the largest broadcast domain holds 400 hosts. 场景 ：某零售企业要做同城双活，两地相距 38km。应用团队提出需求："两个机房必须在同一个二层域里，否则虚拟机迁移会断。"现有条件：运营商可提供 EPL（1G/10G，点对点）、EVPL（端口复用、多 VLAN）、以及基于 EVPN 的 E-LAN 服务。现网单机房有 1200 个 VLAN、MAC 表约 6 万条，广播域最大 400 台主机。 Questions to answer : 1. Does the premise "VM migration requires Layer 2" hold? 2. If Layer 2 extension really is needed, which service should we buy? 3. What new risks does the extension create, and how do we bound them? 要回答的问题 ： 1. "虚拟机迁移必须二层"这个前提成立吗？ 2. 若确实需要二层延伸，选哪种服务？ 3. 二层延伸后新增哪些风险，如何限制？ Reference reasoning : - Challenge the premise first. Modern virtualization platforms can migrate across Layer 3 (changing IP) routinely; if the application tolerates "a brief outage plus an IP change at migration", no Layer 2 extension is needed. "It must be one Layer 2 domain" is often historical habit rather than a hard constraint. - If it really is required (for example to keep IP addresses or avoid renumbering a legacy system) : for point-to-point needs choose EVPL (VLAN reuse, cheaper than EPL, several services on one port); consider E-LAN/EVPN only when multiple sites must share one broadcast domain. Do not buy a multipoint network for two sites. - Extending Layer 2 inevitably enlarges the failure domain : extending all 1200 VLANs means any STP event, broadcast storm or loop on one side hits the other. So the design must extend only the necessary VLANs (typically just the migration segment and a few tightly

Prefer EVPN if the carrier supports it. - Constraints that must be written into the design : a one-way latency budget (active-active write paths usually need 5 ms), the MAC table size limit and aging policy, loop protection (an STP boundary across sites, or disable STP outright), and split-brain handling when a failure occurs (which side wins). - In one sentence : Layer 2 extension buys migration convenience by enlarging the failure domain , so buy it only when the payoff is clear. 参考思路 ： - 先质疑前提。 现代虚拟化平台跨三层迁移（改 IP）已普遍可行；如果应用能接受"迁移时短暂中断 + IP 变更"，就不需要二层延伸。 "必须同二层"往往是历史习惯，而不是硬约束。 - 如果确实需要（例如保留 IP、避免重编号的老系统） ：点对点需求选 EVPL （按 VLAN 复用，成本低于 EPL，且能一端口跑多业务）；多站点共享同一广播域才考虑 E-LAN/EVPN 。 不要为了"两个站点"去买一张多点的网。 - 延伸二层必然放大故障域 ：1200 个 VLAN 全部延伸意味着任何一侧的 STP/广播风暴/环路都会打到对面。所以设计必须 只延伸必要的 VLAN （通常只保留迁移网段与少数紧耦合系统，其余走三层），并限制广播域规模（400 台已接近上限）。 - 控制面与数据面要分离考虑 ：EVPN 用 BGP 控制面学 MAC，比 VPLS 的泛洪+学习更可控，收敛更快、抑制泛洪。若运营商支持，优先 EVPN。 - 必须写入设计的限制项 ：单向时延预算（双活写入路径通常要求 5ms）、MAC 表规模上限与老化策略、环路防护（跨站 STP 边界或直接禁用）、故障时的"脑裂"处理（哪一侧优先）。 - 一句话 ： 二层延伸是"用扩大故障域换取迁移便利"，只有在收益明确时才买。 Scenario 2: The Failure Happened — Whose Problem Is It? · 情景二：故障发生了，责任在谁 Situation : a manufacturer uses a carrier EVPL between the main plant and a branch plant, reusing one physical port for six VLANs (production, office, video, guest, management, backup). x: 性丢包（每小时 2–3 次，每次 10–30 秒），办公 VLAN 正常。运营商称"我们的电路监控正常，端口无告警"；企业认为是运营商问题，双方僵持两周。 Questions to answer : 1. From a design standpoint, why is this dispute so hard to settle? 2. What "determinability" should the design phase have left behind? 3. How should it be changed afterwards to avoid similar disputes? 要回答的问题 ： 1. 从设计角度，这次争议为什么难判定？ 2. 设计阶段本应留下哪些"可判定性"？ 3. 后续怎么改，避免同类争议？ Reference reasoning : - The root of the difficulty: port reuse blurs the boundary of responsibility. With EPL the port is dedicated, so "up or down" is unambiguous; once EVPL shares a port, one VLAN on the same physical link can fail while port-level monitoring on the carrier side sees nothing at all. - Determinability the design phase should have provided : - A demarcation point stated down to specific ports and VLANs and written into the contract annex; - Per-VLAN SLA targets (latency, loss, availability) agreed separately, instead of one figure for the whole port; - Per-VLAN probes or performance measurement on the enterprise side just inside the demarcation (such as Y.1731/CFM or two-way active measurement), able to prove "loss is already present inside my own port"; - A change-notification process and traceable records of the carrier's maintenance windows. - The correct troubleshooting order here : start with continuous per-VLAN measurement just inside the enterprise demarcation → if loss is confirmed inside, the problem is in the carrier domain; if the inside is clean and the application still suffers, the problem is inside the enterprise (queues, policy, uplink congestion). - Design improvements afterwards : stop sharing one port between business-critical VLANs and everything else (or at least give critical traffic its own physical link or sub-port), and treat "fault determinability" as a criterion when selecting a service. - In one sentence : an SLA is not only a set of numbers, it is also "when something breaks, can we say clearly whose problem it is". 参考思路 ： - 难判定的根源：复用端口把"责任边界"变模糊了。 EPL 是独占端口

x: ，故障时"通/不通"很清楚；EVPL 端口复用后，同一物理链路上的一个 VLAN 出问题，运营商侧的端口级监控可能完全看不出异常。 - 设计阶段应留下的可判定性 ： - 维护分界点 (Demarcation) 明确到具体端口与 VLAN，写进合同附件； - 每条 VLAN 的 SLA 指标单独约定 （时延、丢包、可用率），而不是整条端口一个指标； - 企业侧在分界点内侧部署 按 VLAN 的探针/性能测量 （如 Y.1731/CFM 或双向主动测量），能证明"我的设备端口内侧已经收到丢包"； - 变更通知流程 与运营商侧的维护窗口记录可追溯。 - 本次排查的正确顺序 ：先在企业侧分界点内侧做按 VLAN 的连续测量 → 若确认内侧已丢包，问题在运营商域；若内侧正常、应用侧异常，问题在企业内部（队列、策略、上联拥塞）。 - 后续设计改进 ：关键业务 VLAN 不再与其他业务共用同一端口（或至少保证关键业务有独立物理链路/独立子端口），并把"故障可判定性"作为服务选型的一项指标。 - 一句话 ： 服务的 SLA 不只是数值，还包括"出了事能不能说清是谁的问题"。

s: Chapter Summary · 本章小结
x: Chapter Summary · 本章小结 The heart of Chapter 6 is one thread of technology evolution : 第 6 章的核心是 一条技术演进的主线 ： Leased line (physically dedicated, no reuse) ↓ emulate it over MPLS with pseudowires VPWS (point-to-point transparency, no MAC learning) ↓ extend to multipoint VPLS (full-mesh PWs plus data-plane MAC learning → O(n²), flooding, no control plane) ↓ move MACs into BGP EVPN (control-plane learning, native multihoming, ARP proxy) ↓ cope with MAC scale explosion PBB-EVPN (MAC-in-MAC hides customer MACs) 租用线路（物理独占，无复用） ↓ 用伪线在 MPLS 上仿真 VPWS（点到点透传，不学 MAC） ↓ 扩展到多点 VPLS（全互联 PW + 数据面 MAC 学习 → O(n²)、泛洪、无控制平面） ↓ 把 MAC 搬到 BGP EVPN（控制面学习 + 原生多归属 + ARP 代理） ↓ 应对 MAC 规模爆炸 PBB-EVPN（MAC-in-MAC 隐藏客户 MAC） One-line memory hook : VPWS is a cable, VPLS is a switch, EVPN is "a switch managed by a routing protocol", and PBB-EVPN is "a switch wearing two layers of MAC masks". Every step in that evolution solved scalability , and every step added operational complexity — which is exactly why CCDE asks you to trade off "capability" against "manageability". 一句话记忆 ： VPWS 是网线，VPLS 是交换机，EVPN 是"用路由协议管理的交换机"，PBB-EVPN 是"给交换机戴上两层 MAC 面具"。 每一次演进解决的都是 可扩展性 ，而每次演进都增加了 运维复杂度 ——这就是 CCDE 要求你在"能力"与"可管理性"之间做取舍的原因。

s: Chapter Overview: Four Counter-Intuitive Truths About Layer 2 Design · 本章导读：二层设计的四条反直觉认知
x: Chapter Overview: Four Counter-Intuitive Truths About Layer 2 Design · 本章导读：二层设计的四条反直觉认知 Counter-Intuitive Truth 1: Layer 2 Has No Concept of "Destination" · 反直觉一：二层网络没有"目的地"这个概念 In a Layer 3 network, which way a packet goes is decided by the routing table — a converged, predictable structure with an explicit state for "destination unreachable". 三层网络里，包走哪个方向由 路由表 决定。路由表是一个 收敛的、可预测的、有明确状态 的东西：链路坏了，路由重算，路径变了，你在任何一台上都能查出来。 Layer 2 is not like that. Layer 2 forwarding relies on two actions : 二层不是这样。二层的转发靠 两个动作 ： ① Known unicast: look up the MAC table → outbound interface (forward if present, flood if absent) ② Unknown unicast / broadcast / multicast: flood out every port in the VLAN except the ingress one ① 已知单播：查 MAC 表 → 出接口（有就转发，没有就泛洪） ② 未知单播 / 广播 / 组播：泛洪到同一 VLAN 的所有端口 Flooding is the native behaviour of Layer 2, not an error condition. So the moment a loop exists, frames circle forever — and unlike Layer 3, no TTL decrements to kill them. 泛洪是二层的原生行为，不是异常行为。 于是只要有环，帧就会永远转下去 —— 而且 二层帧没有 TTL （三层的 IP 有 TTL，转 255 次就丢；以太网帧没有这个字段），所以环路不会"自己停下"，只会越积越多，直到链路和 CPU 全部瘫掉。 All of STP's work is deliberately cutting some links out of service , trading bandwidth and convergence time for loop-freedom. STP 的全部工作，就是 人为地把一部分链路砍掉 ，用牺牲带宽和收敛时间来换取无环。这是本章所有设计逻辑的起点。 Counter-Intuitive Truth 2: However Well STP Is Configured It Is a Patch — the Goal Is to Leave It Nothing to Do · 反直觉二：STP 配得再好也是"补救"，目标是让它无事可做 Beginners who finish STP's three versions and four guards assume "this chapter is about configuring STP well". That is the direction of travel, not the goal. 初学者学完 STP 的三种版本、四种 Guard，会以为"这一章是学怎么把 STP 配好"。实际上现代二层设计的成就是 让 STP 从转发决策里退出去 ： Generation Technology Role of STP 802.1D Traditional STP Half the links blocked, convergence 30–50 s 802.1w/s RSTP / MST Faster, but blocking still exists mLAG / stacking Switch clustering STP no longer needs to block anything Layer 3 to the access layer Routed access No Layer 2 loop exists at all 世代 技术 STP 的角色 第一代 802.1D 唯一的防环机制 ，收敛 30–50 秒 第二代 RSTP / MST 收敛

s: Chapter Overview: Four Counter-Intuitive Truths About Layer 2 Design · 本章导读：二层设计的四条反直觉认知
x: 快，但仍然 必须阻塞端口 第三代 链路聚合 + 无环 U 型 没有阻塞端口，STP 只做 兜底保护 第四代 mLAG / VSS / vPC / EVPN-MH STP 完全不参与 ，所有链路转发 The test is simple : if ports in your network still sit in BLK / ALTN state wasting links, the design still has room to improve. 判断标准很简单 ：如果你的网络里还有端口处于 BLK / ALTN 状态在被浪费，那么你的设计还在第三代以前。 💡 The one sentence to remember : for every Layer 2 technology you introduce, first ask which blocked port or which convergence delay it eliminates . If it eliminates neither, it is complexity for its own sake. 💡 一句话记住本章 ：每引入一项二层技术，先问它 消灭了哪一个阻塞端口或收敛依赖 。凡是不能回答这个问题的配置，都是运维负担而不是设计。 Counter-Intuitive Truth 3: Layer 2 Failures Are Almost Always Silent · 反直觉三：二层的故障几乎都是"静默"的 This is the cruellest part of Layer 2. Layer 3 problems give you signals: routes vanish, pings fail, neighbours drop, logs fill. 这是二层最要命的地方。三层出问题会给你信号：路由没了、ping 不通、邻居 down、日志报错。 Typical signs of a Layer 2 problem: 二层出问题的典型表现是： Symptom How users describe it Real cause "Everything got slow at 10 a.m." The network is slow A loop or a broadcast storm "Some machines cannot reach some others" Intermittent, not reproducible Asymmetric path, MAC flapping "It was fine, then it was not" Nobody changed anything A one-way fiber failure creating a loop 现象 用户描述 真实原因 变慢 "网有点卡" 流量绕行了一条几乎没带宽的路径 部分不通 "这层楼有的电脑上不了网" ARP 或 MAC 表被污染 时通时不通 "刷新几次就好了" 环路导致 MAC 表翻转（MAC flapping） 大面积断 "整栋楼上不了网" 广播风暴 / 脑裂 Layer 2 does not raise errors; it quietly gets slower, or quietly loops. Acceptance criteria therefore cannot be "it pings" — they have to measure convergence time and prove loop protection. 二层不会报错，它只会安静地变慢，或者安静地环路。 所以二层设计的验收标准不能是"能通"，必须是" 在故障场景下行为符合预期 "。 Counter-Intuitive Truth 4: Redundancy Is Not Reliability Unless the Two Copies Have Independent Failure Domains · 反直觉四：冗余 ≠ 可靠，除非两个副本的失效域是独立的 Two real incidents in this chapter make the point: 本章有两个真实事故能说明这一点： Case 2: peer-link and peer-keepalive share the same conduit → the conduit is damaged and both die at once Case 5: dual uplinks land on two devices in the same cabinet → one PDU failure and both

If the answer is not a definite yes, the availability figure you promise is fiction. ⚠️ 设计评审必问的那句话 ： "这两条路径的失效域是独立的吗？" 如果答不上来，就不要在文档里写"高可用"。

s: Layer 2 Design Methodology: Five Steps in Order · 二层设计方法论：五步定序
x: Layer 2 Design Methodology: Five Steps in Order · 二层设计方法论：五步定序 Nine out of ten Layer 2 design failures come from getting the order wrong . The correct order is a top-down sequence: 二层设计的失败，九成源于 顺序错了 。正确的顺序是自顶向下的五步： Step What gets decided Consequence of getting it wrong 1. Define the Layer 2 domain boundary Which VLANs span which switches; can Layer 3 reach the access layer Too large = one loop takes down everything 2. Choose the topology Looped triangle, loop-free U, switch clustering Redundancy is wasted or fragile 3. Decide the STP root Which switch is root and which gateway it aligns with Path detours, saturated inter-switch links 4. Design FHRP Instances, priorities, tracking Black holes, slow failover 5. Choose aggregation and failover mechanisms LACP mode, min-links, BFD Asymmetric forwarding, slow convergence 步骤 要定的事 定错了的后果 ① 二层域范围 这个二层域要跨几台接入交换机？必须跨吗？ 定大了 → STP 域巨大，一处环路影响全网 ② VLAN / 子网划分 每个 VLAN 对应什么业务/人群？每个子网多大？ 定错了 → VIP 改不了、网关无法优化、地址不够 ③ 二层机制选择 纯 STP / 无环 U 型 / mLAG / 集群？ 定错了 → 后面所有收敛与冗余设计都在补救 ④ 根桥与网关位置 每个 VLAN 的根桥 = 哪台？谁做 FHRP Active？ 定错了 → 流量绕行（案例一） ⑤ 收敛与验证 各段收敛时间预算是多少？怎么测？ 没定 → 验收只能是"能通"，故障时行为不可预测 Why the order cannot be reversed : configure HSRP before deciding the STP root and you get "gateway on DSW2, root bridge on DSW1" — exactly the classic mistake in Case 1. 为什么顺序不能反 ：先配 HSRP 再想 STP，就会出现"网关在 DSW2、根桥在 DSW1"的经典事故。因为 HSRP Active 和 STP 根桥描述的是同一件事 —— 流量该往哪走 。分开决策，必然错位。

Cause : a PC policy of "wake-on-LAN plus network re-detection" woke dozens of laptops at once; each port flap generated a TCN, and every TCN flushed MAC tables building-wide. Fix : PortFast on access ports plus TCN suppression (1 per 10 s) at the distribution layer. Lesson : the damage comes not from the TCN itself but from the "flush everything" reaction it triggers. 🔥 案例：一台笔记本的休眠唤醒让整栋楼变慢 现象 ：某写字楼每天早上 9:00–9:30，整栋楼的网络"发虚"——网页打开慢，但 ping 正常、带宽测试正常。10 点后自动好转。 排查 ：核心交换机 CPU 从 15% 升到 60%， show spanning-tree detail 显示 TC（topology change）计数每分钟数百次 。 根因 ：接入层 没有全局开 PortFast ，只有零星几个"按需配置"的端口开了。每天早上员工陆续到岗，接通扩展坞 → 端口 up → 每个 up 都触发 TCN → 全网 MAC 表 15 秒老化一次 → 核心到汇聚的链路全是未知单播泛洪 → 但带宽测试（单流）不受影响，因为带宽本身没被占满，是 MAC 表频繁失效导致的转发效率下降 。 修复 ： cfg spanning-tree portfast default spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default 核心 CPU 回落到 18%，TC 计数降到个位数/天。 教训 ： PortFast 不是"快 30 秒"的优化，而是"隔离拓扑变更域"的架构手段。 一个没开 PortFast 的接入端口，就是一颗随时引爆全网的 TCN 炸弹。而没有 BPDU Guard 兜底的 PortFast，是环路风险。 两者必须成对。 STP Enhancement Features · STP 增强特性 Feature Function Where to deploy Failure it prevents PortFast Edge port skips listening/learning Access ports facing hosts Slow host connectivity, TC storms BPDU Guard Shuts the port if a BPDU arrives Access ports facing hosts Rogue switches, loops Root Guard Blocks superior BPDUs, pins the root Ports facing the access layer Root hijacking, path detours Loop Guard Blocks a port that stops receiving BPDUs Root/alternate ports, fiber uplinks One-way failures creating loops UDLD Detects one-way links at Layer 1 Fiber interconnects Unidirectional fiber causing loops BPDU Filter Stops sending/receiving BPDUs Edge ports only (with care) Loop-free access segments 特性 功能 部署位置 防的是什么故障 Loop Guard 防止备用端口或根端口在没有 BPDU 的情况下被选举 分布层

x: the VLANs had twice the latency of the rest. Cause : a trailing space in the region name on two distribution switches → digest mismatch → region split → each side elected its own root. Fix : standardise the name through a template and verify the digest in every change window. Lesson : "consistent configuration" in MST is not advice, it is a precondition. 🔥 案例：MST 区域不一致，一半 VLAN 走了远路 背景 ：某园区 60 台交换机配置 MST，两个实例：实例 1 走 VLAN 10–99，实例 2 走 VLAN 100–199。DSW1 是实例 1 的根，DSW2 是实例 2 的根。 现象 ：VLAN 10–99 的流量正常； VLAN 100–199 的流量全部绕行 DSW1 ，DSW1 与 DSW2 之间链路利用率 80%，用户感觉"财务系统（VLAN 120）特别慢"。 排查 ： - show spanning-tree mst 2 在 DSW2 上显示 自己不是根桥 ，根桥是 DSW1 - 但配置上 DSW2 明明是 spanning-tree mst 2 priority 4096 - show spanning-tree mst configuration 对比两端 digest 不一致 根因 ：半年前新增 3 台接入交换机，实施人员用旧模板配置，模板里 instance 2 vlan 40,50,60 （旧规划），而现网是 instance 2 vlan 100-199 。这三台设备自成一个 MST 区域，边界处所有流量退化到 CIST（实例 0）—— 结果是 VLAN 100–199 在这些边界上跟随实例 0 的根桥（DSW1）。 为什么"只是一部分慢"而不是"完全不通" ：MST 区域边界是 互通的 （通过 CIST），所以业务正常，只是路径错了。这类问题永远不会触发告警。 修复与防复发 ： 1. 修正三台设备的 MST 配置 2. 把 digest 纳入每日巡检 ： show spanning-tree mst configuration digest 全网比对，不一致即告警 3. 配置模板纳入版本控制，禁止"复制粘贴旧模板" 教训 ： MST 的一致性是"隐式契约"，没有任何告警会告诉你它被破坏了。 只有主动比对 digest 才能发现。凡是"全网必须完全一致"的配置（MST region、VTP domain、聚合参数），都必须有自动化一致性校验。 VLANs and Trunking · VLAN 和 Trunking VLAN is a network virtualization technology that provides logical separation of broadcast domains and policy control. VLANs also bound Layer 2 failure domains: one VLAN's loop or storm does not automatically affect another. VLAN 是一种网络虚拟化技术，提供广播域的逻辑分离和策略控制。VLAN 还在二层提供一定程度的故障隔离。 Trunking is the protocol that lets one physical link carry multiple VLANs, so VLANs can span switches (802.1Q tagging; ISL is deprecated). Trunking 是允许在单条物理链路上承载多个 VLAN 的协议，使 VLAN 可以跨交换机扩展。 ⚠️ Design best practice : a VLAN should not span multiple access switches. Which leads to a chain of reasoning: 它成立的前提是"VLAN 不跨交换机" ——也就是本地 VLAN 模型。于是形成一个漂亮的闭环： VLANs do not span switches → no Layer 2 loop → STP has nothing to do → every link forwards → bandwidth doubles + convergence becomes link state rather than timers VLAN 不跨交换机 → 二层无环 → STP 无事可做 → 所有链路转发 → 收敛只靠链路检测 ↑ ↓ └──── 代价：需要三层路由到接入，IP 规划要更细 ←────────────┘ 💡 This is the design paradigm most worth taking away from this chapter : trade "limiting the Layer 2 scope" for "removing Layer 2 complexity" . Reduce the problem instead of optimizing the solution to a bad problem. 💡 这是本章最值得带走的设计范式 ：用 "限制二层范围" 换 "消除二层协议的不确定性" 。同一思路在第 9 章（虚拟化）和第 15 章（园区）会反复出现—— 现代网络设计的通用手法，是把问题从二层移到三层，因为在三层你能用可见、可预测的路由控制它。 A Common Misunderstanding: Loop-Free U "Has No Redundancy" · 一个常见误解：无环 U 型"没有冗余" Many assume that "U-shape has only one logical uplink path, so it is unreliable". x: the Layer 2 design model between the access and distribution layers. 交换机集群显著改变了接入层和分布层之间的二层设计模型。 Core idea : a pair of upstream distribution switches appears to the access switch as one logical (virtual) switch . 核心思想 ：一对上游分布交换机从接入交换机角度看是一台逻辑（虚拟）交换机。 Advantages : - No dependence on STP or FHRP , and therefore no associated convergence delay - Every uplink forwards, so there are no blocked ports - The access switch uses a port-channel to two devices at once, getting link and device redundancy together - Failover is a link-state change measured in seconds or less 优势 ： - 消除对 STP 和 FHRP 的依赖 ，消除相关收敛延迟 - 所有上行链路处于转发状态 - 一个虚拟 IP 网关，两台交换机都转发流量（Active-Active） - 最大化带宽容量 ，利用所有上行链路 - 支持跨接入交换机安全扩展二层 VLAN，无需担心二层环路 - 比传统 STP 设计更简单、可靠、易管理、可扩展 Limitations — brain split : - Two or more cluster members both believe they are active (because the peer-link has failed) - Both keep forwarding, addresses duplicate, and the result is a loop or inconsistent forwarding - Detection and suppression mechanisms are mandatory 局限性 — 脑裂 (Split-Brain) ： - 两台或更多集群设备同时充当主设备 - 通常由集群链路故障引起 - 使用 双活检测 (Dual Active Detection) 机制来缓解 ⚠️ Brain split is the only fatal weakness of this family of technologies, and it is a configuration problem rather than a technology problem : dual-active detection must be configured explicitly (ePAgP, fast-hello, BFD, PAgP), and the peer-link and keepalive must never share a physical path . ⚠️ 脑裂是这类技术唯一的"致命伤"，而且它是配置问题、不是技术问题 ：双活检测链路必须与 peer-link 物理路径分离 （不同光缆、不同路由、不同机房入口）。如果两者走同一根光缆，施工挖断时你会同时失去 peer-link 和检测能力——两台设备都认为对方死了，都成为主设备，全网 ARP 冲突、MAC 抖动。下面的案例二就是这个事故的完整复盘。 The Four-Layer Defence of Dual-Active Detection (Ordered by Detection Speed) · 双活检测的四层防线（按检测速度排序） Layer Mechanism Detection speed Dependency ① Fast-hello over a direct link Milliseconds A dedicated link between the two chassis ② ePAgP / PAgP dual-active detection Sub-second Requires PAgP-capable downstream devices ③ BFD over an out-of-band path Sub-second A separate management or routed path ④ Automation: SNMP/syslog t

Automation is the last line of defence for availability. 💡 最实用的一条是 ④ ：即使前三条全失效，只要有一个自动化脚本在检测到"两台设备同时是 primary"时 强制隔离一侧的 vPC 端口 ，就能把脑裂的爆炸半径从"全网"缩小到"部分"。这是很多生产网络的实际兜底。 Switch Stacking · 交换机堆叠 Switch stacking is another form of clustering: - Multiple physical switches connected by StackWise cables form one logical switch - One control plane, one configuration, one management address - Members can be added or replaced without redesigning the network 交换机堆叠是集群的另一种形式： - 多台物理交换机通过 StackWise 互联电缆连接 - 选举主交换机 - 作为单一对象管理，使用单一 IP 管理地址和单一配置文件 - 可创建 EtherChannel 连接和 MEC（多机箱 EtherChannel） 💡 Stacking versus vPC : stacking is a "true single control plane", simple to configure and free of brain split (though a ring stack's cable is a risk). vPC keeps two independent control planes, raising operational complexity but avoiding "one reboot takes down half the building". Small networks tolerate stacking; core layers usually choose vPC. 💡 堆叠与 vPC 的取舍 ：堆叠是"真单控制面"，配置简单、无脑裂（环状堆叠线缆断裂会分裂成两个 stack，但检测机制成熟）；代价是 控制面共命运 ——主交换机重启可能导致整个 stack 重启，逻辑上是一台设备也就没有"分布层分离"的可维护性。vPC 保持双控制面，可独立升级维护，代价是配置一致性要求高、需要防脑裂。 核心层选 vPC/M-LAG，接入层可以选堆叠。 Daisy-Chained Access Switches · 菊花链接入交换机 ⚠️ Usually a temporary workaround, and it can introduce the following problems: - Dual-active HSRP (brain split) - A single point of failure in the middle of the chain - 50% loss of return traffic - A much longer convergence path ⚠️ 通常作为临时解决方案使用，可能引入以下问题： - 双活 HSRP（脑裂情况） - 使用分布交换机 1 作为活动 FHRP 网关的设备可能丢失 50% 的返回流量 💡 当建议替代方案时，必须确保新设计不会在故障场景中引入新的问题。否则新引入的问题将超过方案的好处。 Why a "temporary" solution tends to become

x: permanent : a daisy chain saves uplink ports and fiber (N switches need only one uplink and one fiber pair), so it is the cheapest way to close out an acceptance deadline — and once the paperwork is signed, nobody revisits it. 为什么"临时方案"往往永久留下来 ：菊花链节省了上行端口和光纤（N 台交换机只需要 1 组上联而不是 N 组），在预算紧张时非常有吸引力。它的真实代价要到故障时才暴露： Failure Consequence A switch in the middle loses power Every downstream switch is isolated A link in the middle fails Every downstream switch is isolated A loop occurs The whole chain floods An upgrade is needed Several switches must go down together 故障 后果 链中间某台交换机断电 下游全部失联 （链式无环，没有备用路径） 环状菊花链（首尾相接） STP 收敛要跨越多台设备，收敛时间线性增加 中间设备被误配 HSRP 出现第二个网关，部分主机网关指向错误设备 广播/组播泛洪 泛洪必须逐跳穿越整条链，链路带宽被无谓消耗 The mechanism behind "50% loss of return traffic" (expanding that line from the book): "丢失 50% 返回流量"的机制 （书里那句话的展开）： Chain: DSW1 ── ASW-A ── ASW-B ── ASW-C Host on ASW-A, gateway on DSW1 forward path: ASW-A → DSW1 (direct) return path: DSW1 → ASW-A (direct) — fine Host on ASW-C: forward: ASW-C → ASW-B → ASW-A → DSW1 return: DSW1 → ASW-A → ASW-B → ASW-C If the ASW-A–ASW-B link fails, ASW-B and ASW-C lose the gateway entirely, while the forward and return paths may still differ (asymmetry, STP reconvergence) 链：DSW1 ── ASW-A ── ASW-B ── ASW-C 主机的网关是 DSW1（HSRP Active） 去程：主机 → ASW-C → ASW-B → ASW-A → DSW1 ✅ 正常 回程：DSW1 → ASW-A → ASW-B → ASW-C → 主机 如果中间某台（如 ASW-B）也被误配为同一 HSRP 组的 Active， 且它的优先级更低没抢到 —— 但它的 MAC 表里学到了 DSW1 的虚拟 MAC 在 两个方向上都有 → MAC 表翻转 → 回程流量可能只走一侧 → 丢 50% 💡 If a daisy chain is unavoidable : restrict it to non-critical areas, keep it to 3–4 switches, and state explicitly in the design document that "this segment has no redundancy". Hiding the risk is worse than the risk. 💡 如果必须用菊花链 ：仅限非关键区域，设备数控制在 3–4 台以内，并明确"下游整体作为单一故障域"的可用性预期——写进设计文档，而不是默认它不会出问题。
