x: Extended: Layer 2 Design Decision Tree · 扩展：二层设计决策树 Compressing this chapter into a tree you can walk through in a design review: 把本章内容压缩成一棵可以在设计评审时直接走一遍的树： ① Must this Layer 2 domain span more than one access switch? ├─ No → local VLAN, one access switch, done └─ Yes → ② go to the next question ② Does it genuinely need Layer 2 (non-IP protocol, one subnet, legacy system)? ├─ No → Layer 3 to the access layer (routed access) └─ Yes → ③ ③ Can the two uplinks go to two devices? ├─ No → accept single-point risk, document it explicitly └─ Yes → ④ ④ Do the two devices support clustering (vPC/VSS/stacking)? ├─ Yes → clustering model, no STP blocking └─ No → STP-based U-shape with root/gateway alignment ⑤ Are there more than 3 chained switches, or any single-homed access switch? └─ Yes → eliminate orphans/chains first, then optimize ① 这个二层域需要跨两台以上的接入交换机吗？ ├─ 不需要 → 本地 VLAN + 三层到接入 │ → 二层无环，STP 只做保护，收敛不依赖 STP └─ 需要 → ② 有跨设备二层扩展的硬需求吗？（虚拟机迁移/集群心跳/私有协议） ├─ 没有 → 说明这是 习惯 而不是需求 → 回到本地 VLAN └─ 有 → ③ 上游设备支持集群吗？ ├─ 支持 → mLAG / vPC / VSS / EVPN-MH │ → 上行全转发，STP 与 FHRP 都不参与决策 │ → 必须做：双活检测路径与 peer-link 物理分离 └─ 不支持 → 只能用 STP 四拓扑 → 优先 无环 U 型 （VLAN 不跨交换机） → 必须做：根桥 = FHRP Active，且两侧成对配置 💡 The value of the decision tree : it turns arguments such as "should we deploy mLAG" into two verifiable questions — does Layer 2 really need to span switches, and do the uplinks really go to independent devices . Once those are answered, the technology choice follows almost automatically. 💡 决策树的价值 ：它把"要不要上 mLAG"这类争论变成两个可验证的问题—— 二层域多大、硬需求有没有 。技术选型之争，八成是因为没先问清这两个问题。 Post-decision checklist (each item can kill a proposal): 决策树走完之后的检查清单 （每一条都能否掉一个方案）： # Check If it fails 1 Is the failure-domain boundary explicit (which cabinet, which conduit, which carrier)? Redo the physical topology 2 Is the STP root aligned with the FHRP active? Re-plan root and gateways 3 Is the tracking decrement large enough to actually fail over? Recalculate priorities 4 Are the orphans and chains inventoried? Document or eliminate them

x: Extended: What Convergence Time Is Really Made Of · 扩展：收敛时间的真实构成 The "STP converges in 3 seconds" in a configuration document is only a small part of the story. What the user experiences is several timers stacked on top of each other: 配置里写的"STP 收敛 3 秒"只是故事的一小部分。用户感知到的中断，是多个定时器叠加的结果： Link or node failure ↓ ① Physical detection: fiber cut = milliseconds; copper/peer down = milliseconds to one second ↓ ② Failure notification: STP/RSTP or routing protocol propagation, milliseconds to seconds ↓ ③ Data-plane repair: MAC table flush and relearn, ARP re-resolution, 0.1–5 s ↓ ④ Gateway failover: FHRP timer or BFD, 1–10 s (with defaults, up to 10 s) ↓ ⑤ Application layer: TCP retransmission, session re-establishment, 1–30 s 链路/节点故障 ↓ ① 物理检测：光纤断 = 毫秒；铜缆/对端断电 = 依赖链路 keepalive ↓ ② STP/RSTP 收敛：1–3 秒（若规则是 三层到接入 ，这一步不存在） ↓ ③ FHRP 切换：Hello 3s + Hold 10s，或 BFD 数百毫秒 ↓ ④ 上游路由收敛：OSPF/EIGRP/BGP，秒级到数十秒 ↓ ⑤ ARP/MAC 表重建：主机重新 ARP，网关重新学习 MAC，几十毫秒到秒级 ↓ 业务恢复 Design measure Which segment it compresses BFD ② and ④ RSTP or clustering ② and ③ HSRP millisecond timers, preempt delay tuning ④ Application-side keepalives, load balancers ⑤ Eliminating Layer 2 spanning altogether ②③④ almost entirely 设计手段 主要压缩哪一段 三层到接入（VLAN 不跨交换机） ②③ 直接消除 mLAG / 交换机集群 ②③ 直接消除 BFD（替代调小计时器） ③ 从 10 秒到亚秒 上行 port-channel 跨板卡 ① 避免单板故障导致整链路 down 网关 ARP 抑制 / 提前下发 ⑤ 减少主机重新 ARP 的等待 路由协议快速收敛（LSA 洪泛优化、BFD） ④ 秒级到亚秒 ⚠️ A common misjudgement : assuming "tuning STP timers faster" improves the experience. x: d the Line · 案例七：菊花链"临时"用了三年，一次断电全厂停线 Background : a factory workshop has 6 access switches; to save fiber and uplink ports they were connected in a daisy chain , with only SW1 uplinked to the distribution layer. 背景 ：某工厂车间有 6 台接入交换机，为了省光纤和上联端口，采用 链状菊花链 ： 核心 → SW1 → SW2 → SW3 → SW4 → SW5 → SW6 。项目文档写"临时方案，二期改造"。 Three years later : phase two was never approved. One day SW3's power supply failed (no redundant PSU in the device). 三年后 ：二期一直没批。某天 SW3 的电源模块故障（设备没有任何冗余电源）。 Chain of consequences : 后果链 ： SW3 loses power → SW4/SW5/SW6 all lose connectivity → the workshop's terminals and scanners go offline → the production line stops for 4 hours SW3 断电 → SW4/SW5/SW6 全部失联 → 车间 3 条产线的工控终端离线 → 产线停线 4 小时（重启后还要重新初始化设备） → 直接损失远大于当初省下的光纤成本 Why the "temporary" lasted three years : no budget line, no owner, no risk register. A temporary solution has no expiry mechanism, so it becomes the permanent design. 为什么"临时"用了三年 ：因为没有预算项、没有负责人、没有风险台账。 临时方案的真正成本不是建设成本，是"它会在你最不希望的时候按它的真实可靠性工作"。 Structural comparison : 结构性对比 ： Option Uplink ports Fiber pairs Impact of one failure Convergence Daisy chain (6 switches) 1 1 4 switches lost Minutes Star (each to distribution) 12 12 1 switch Seconds Ring plus RSTP 2 6 None (protected) Seconds Clustered pairs 6 6 1 pair Sub-second 方案 上联端口数 光纤对数 单点故障影响 收敛 链状菊花链（6 台） 1 组 5 对 中间设备故障 → 下游全断 STP 跨 6 台 环形菊花链（6 台） 1 组 6 对 单点故障有备份，但收敛慢 STP 跨 6 台 每台双归到核心（mLAG） 6 组 12 对 无单点 毫秒级 💡 Lesson : "temporary" must come with an expiry date. Whenever the words "temporary" appear in a design document, add an owner, a deadline and a written risk acceptance — otherwise they are permanent. 💡 教训 ： "临时"必须有到期机制。 设计文档里出现"临时"两个字时，必须同时写清：谁负责、什么时候消除、消除前接受什么风险。否则它就是一个 写在纸上但没人认领的风险 ，会一直在生产上运行，直到某次故障把它变成事故。

s: Lessons Learned · 实战经验总结
x: Lessons Learned · 实战经验总结 Lesson Explanation Ask first "how large must the Layer 2 domain be" Every extra switch a VLAN spans is extra failure domain The root bridge and the gateway must be the same device Otherwise traffic always takes one extra hop Redundancy requires independent failure domains Cabinet, power, conduit and carrier all count "Interface up" does not mean "link usable" One-way fiber creates loops silently — use Loop Guard and UDLD A TCN storm is a design problem, not a protocol problem PortFast plus TCN suppression Aggregate bandwidth is not single-flow bandwidth Explain the difference to the business side in writing Convergence must be measured, not assumed Accept with long pings and record the numbers "Temporary" needs an expiry date Owner, deadline, written risk acceptance 经验 说明 先问"二层域要多大" 二层域的范围就是故障域的范围。跨交换机二层是最后手段 让 STP 无事可做 三层到接入、mLAG 集群、无环 U 型——三个手段都指向同一目标：无阻塞端口 根桥与网关成对设计 它们描述同一件事，分开配迟早会错位 冗余要检查失效域独立性 同管道、同桥架、同机柜、同运营商的两个"副本"仍然是一个单点 聚合带宽 ≠ 单流速率 按流哈希是物理规律；需要单流快就提速率，不是加条数 "接口 up"≠"链路可用" 光纤单通时接口仍 up；必须监控 Rx 光功率 + Loop Guard/UDLD 边缘保护要成对 PortFast（防 TCN）+ BPDU Guard（防环路），缺一不可 收敛时间要分段测量 STP、FHRP、路由、ARP 各占一段，优化占比最大的那段 "全网必须一致"的配置要有自动校验 MST digest、聚合参数、VLAN 列表——靠人眼比对必然腐坏 别只测通断，要测行为 拔一条线、关一台设备，看流量是否按设计改道——演练比配置更有价值 "临时"必须有到期机制 没写负责人和消除时间的临时方案，会一直运行到出事故那天

x: Chapter Summary · 本章小结 The thread of Chapter 7 is a history of "removing dependencies" : 第 7 章的主线是一条 "减少依赖"的演进史 ： 802.1D: relies on timers to converge (30–50 s) — a dependency on time ↓ change the mechanism RSTP: relies on neighbours to agree (seconds) — a dependency on protocol ↓ remove the need to block mLAG / clustering: relies on the peer-link — a dependency on one link ↓ remove Layer 2 spanning altogether Routed access: relies on routing — no need for STP at all 802.1D：靠计时器收敛（30–50 秒）——依赖时间 ↓ 换成协商 RSTP/MST：靠邻居握手收敛（1–3 秒）——依赖邻居，不依赖规模 ↓ 但仍有端口被阻塞 链路聚合 + 无环 U 型：没有阻塞端口了，但仍依赖 STP 兜底 ↓ 把聚合跨到两台设备 mLAG / VSS / vPC / EVPN-MH：STP 与 FHRP 退出决策路径 ↓ 代价转移到 防脑裂 （第 9 章）EVPN Multihoming：用控制面替代 peer-link Three sentences summarise the design judgements in this chapter: 三句话概括本章的设计判断： The size of the Layer 2 domain equals the size of the failure domain — use Layer 3 wherever possible The root bridge and the gateway must be the same device , otherwise traffic always detours Redundancy only counts when the failure domains are independent — otherwise it is decoration 二层域的范围 = 故障域的范围 ，能三层就三层 根桥与网关是同一件事的两个配置面 ，必须成对 每项冗余都要验证失效域是否独立 ——否则冗余只是心理安慰 Two engineering habits to add: 再加两句工程习惯： "Interface up" does not mean "link usable" (one-way fiber), and "it pings" does not mean "the design is right" (path quality, convergence, broadcast scope are all unverified) Every "temporary" needs an expiry date and an owner , and every availability number needs a failure-domain inventory behind it "接口 up"不等于"链路可用" （光纤单通）， "能 ping 通"不等于"设计对了" （路径可能绕行） 凡"全网必须一致"的配置，必须有自动校验 ；凡"临时"的方案，必须有到期机制 The next chapter (Chapter 8, Layer 3 Technologies) picks up where this one leaves off: once Layer 2 has been compressed to its minimum, how does Layer 3 take over the redundancy, path selection and failure recovery that Layer 2 used to struggle with? 下一章（第 8 章 三层技术）会接着回答本章留下的问题：当二层被压缩到最小之后，三层如何承担起路径控制、故障收敛和可预测性的全部责任。

Engineers usually build a complete design on those six, then discover during acceptance testing that " nothing I change makes any difference ". BGP 选路有 13 条判据，前 6 条看起来已经足够精细——Weight、Local Preference、本地起源、AS_PATH、Origin、MED。工程师通常在这六条上做完整设计，然后在验收时发现" 改了什么都没用 "。 The reason is usually criterion 8: 原因往往在第 8 条： Criterion 8: lowest IGP metric to the NEXT_HOP 第 8 条：到 NEXT_HOP 的 IGP metric 最小 It sits after MED , which means that when the first seven are all tied, the decision is handed to the IGP topology . And the IGP metric is usually something nobody ever designed on purpose — a pile of default numbers derived from bandwidth. 它 排在 MED 之后 ，意味着前面七条全平局时， 决定权交给 IGP 拓扑 。而 IGP 度量往往是谁也没特意设计过的东西——一堆默认按带宽算出来的数字。 The control chain you think you have The actual decision chain LP/MED decides the egress LP ties → MED may be incomparable across ASes → the IGP decides according to wherever it points "Paths inside one AS must be consistent" Different border routers have different IGP costs → one AS exits through different doors "Changing a BGP attribute takes effect" show ip bgp shows a new best path, but the FIB does not change (recursion/multipath) 你以为的控制链 实际的决策链 LP/MED 决定出口 LP 平局 → MED 可能跨 AS 不可比 → IGP 说到哪就去哪 "同一个 AS 内路径一定一致" 不同边界路由器上的 IGP 开销不同 → 同一个 AS 内走出不同的口 "改了 BGP 属性就生效" show ip bgp 显示 best 变了，但 FIB 没变（递归/多路径） 💡 Working principle number one in this chapter : When designing Layer 3 paths, you must look at BGP attributes and IGP metrics at the same time. Look at only one of them and you will never be able to explain "why it won't move". 💡 本章第一条工作原则 ： 做三层路径设计时，必须同时看 BGP 属性和 IGP 度量。 只看其中一个，你永远解释不了"为什么改不动"。 Count

Beginners answer in terms of "which one is faster/better". The answer in a real project depends on what you can maintain : CCDE 最爱问"这个场景该选 OSPF 还是 IS-IS 还是 EIGRP"。新手按"哪个更快/更好"回答。真实项目的答案取决于 你能维护什么 ： Decision factor Real weight Which protocol the team knows Highest (being able to troubleshoot beats theoretical optimality) Whether the network is multivendor High (EIGRP is now open but is still mostly Cisco) What kind of path control is needed Medium (fine-grained control → BGP) Convergence speed Medium (all of them can do sub-second, the difference is small) Theoretical scalability of the protocol Low (enterprise networks rarely actually hit protocol limits) 决策因素 真实权重 团队熟悉哪个协议 最高 （能排障比理论最优更重要） 是否有多厂商 高（EIGRP 已开放但仍以 Cisco 为主） 需要什么样的路径控制 中（要精细控制 → BGP） 收敛速度 中（都能做到亚秒，差异不大） 协议的理论可扩展性 低 （企业网很少真的撞到协议上限） A harsh but true judgment : a network where the team has truly mastered OSPF troubleshooting but can only configure EIGRP without being able to debug it will be far more available than a network that "chose the theoretically better protocol that nobody understands". 一个残酷但真实的判断 ：一个团队能把 OSPF 排障搞透、但 EIGRP 只会配不会查的网络，比一个"选了理论上更优协议但没人懂"的网络可用性高得多。 ⚠️ The design document must state "why this protocol was chosen", and the reasoning must include operational capability . x: Foundation Topics · 基础内容 IP Routing and Forwarding Concepts Review · IP 路由和转发概念回顾 The main goal of a routing protocol is to act as the delivery mechanism that routes packets to their destination. The end-to-end routing process is based on the concept of a distributed database : every Layer 3 node maintains its own copy of the database and, through protocol interaction, converges to a consistent (or consistent enough) state. 路由协议的主要目标是作为交付机制，将数据包路由到目的地。端到端路由过程基于 分布式数据库 的概念：每台三层节点各自维护一份数据库，通过协议交互使其收敛到一致（或足够一致）的状态。 Concept Definition Design implication RIB (Routing Information Base) The IP address database maintained on each Layer 3 node, containing destination IPs and next-hop IPs The "candidate pool" of all protocols; path selection means picking one entry from the results of multiple protocols FIB (Forwarding Information Base) The forwarding table, containing destination addresses and the interfaces needed to reach them The table actually used for forwarding; a RIB change does not always change the FIB immediately (recursion/multipath) 概念 定义 设计含义 RIB（路由信息库） 每个三层节点上维护的 IP 地址数据库，包含目的 IP 和下一跳 IP 所有协议的"候选池"； 选路就是从多个协议的结果里挑一个装表 FIB（转发信息库） 转发表，包含目的地址和到达该目的所需的接口 实际转发用的表； RIB 变了 FIB 不一定马上变 （递归/多路径） From RIB to FIB: Four Mechanisms You Must Understand · 从 RIB 到 FIB：必须理解的四个机制 Mechanism Meaning Design impact Longest match When several entries match, the one with the longest mask wins A summary route always yields to a more specific route; the default route always comes last Administrative distance (AD) For the same prefix from different sources, the smaller AD wins Determines the priority order of "static vs OSPF vs BGP" Metric Compares path quality within the same protocol Metrics are not comparable across protocols (the fundamental problem of redistribution) Recursive lookup The next hop is "another next hop", resolved layer by layer down to a connected network A BGP next hop must be resolvable through the IGP or a connected route before it is installed (case 2) 机制 含义 设计影响 最

EIGRP (internal) 90 OSPF 110 IS-IS 115 RIP 120 EIGRP (external/redistributed) 170 iBGP 200 Worst (worse than RIP) Unknown 255 Not installed 来源 AD 说明 直连 0 最高 静态（指向接口） 1 eBGP 20 比多数 IGP 更优 （重要！） EIGRP（内部） 90 OSPF 110 IS-IS 115 RIP 120 EIGRP（外部/重分发） 170 iBGP 200 最劣 （比 RIP 还差） 未知 255 不装表 ⚠️ Two traps in the AD table : 1. eBGP (20) beats OSPF (110) : a route learned from eBGP overrides the same prefix learned from OSPF. If a BGP neighbor accidentally advertises one of your internal prefixes, the internal route is overwritten. This is why eBGP must always have prefix filtering (not only to protect against others, but also against yourself). 2. iBGP (200) is the worst : routes learned from iBGP have the lowest priority. If the same prefix is also learned from an IGP, the IGP wins. When you design "BGP carries the core", watch out — do not let the IGP and BGP advertise the same prefixes , otherwise what is actually in effect may be the IGP. ⚠️ AD 表的两个陷阱 ： 1. eBGP（20）优于 OSPF（110） ：从 eBGP 学到的路由会 压掉 OSPF 学到的同前缀。如果 BGP 邻居不小心通告了你的内部前缀，内部路由会被覆盖。 这就是 eBGP 必须做前缀过滤的原因 （不只防别人，也防自己）。 2. iBGP（200）最劣 ：iBGP 学到的路由优先级最低。如果同时从 IGP 学到同前缀，IGP 会赢。设计"BGP 承载核心"时要注意—— 不要让 IGP 和 BGP 通告同一批前缀 ，否则实际生效的可能是 IGP。 Classification of Routing Protocols · 路由协议的分类 Category Protocols Mechanism Source of scalability Link state OSPF, IS-IS Flood the topology → each node runs SPF Hierarchy (areas/levels + summarization) Path vector BGP Propagates only paths (AS_PATH), not topology Policy control + trust only your neighbors Distance vector (hybrid) RIP, EIGRP Propagates "my distance to X" Summarization + controlling the query scope 类别 协议 机制 可扩展性

x: 来源 链路状态 OSPF、IS-IS 泛洪拓扑 → 各自算 SPF 分层（区域/层级 + 汇总） 路径矢量 BGP 只传路径（AS_PATH），不传拓扑 策略控制 + 只信邻居 距离矢量 （混合） RIP、EIGRP 传"我到 X 的距离" 汇总 + Query 范围控制 💡 One sentence to tell them apart : in a link-state protocol, every router knows the whole topology and computes paths itself; in a distance-vector protocol, every router only knows the distance its neighbor told it , without asking why. Link state therefore has stronger fault localization (it can see the topology), while distance vector has simpler convergence logic (DUAL guarantees loop freedom). 💡 一句话区分 ：链路状态协议里， 每台路由器都知道全网拓扑 ，自己算路；距离矢量协议里， 每台路由器只知道邻居告诉它的距离 ，不问为什么。所以链路状态的故障定位能力强（能看到拓扑），距离矢量的收敛逻辑简单（DUAL 保证无环）。

x: n only use NSSA , not Stub. 🔥 Case: a branch was configured as Stub, and the branch's local Internet egress stopped working entirely Background : a retail enterprise with 800 stores, one router per store, running OSPF with headquarters. An optimization project configured area 10 stub on every store, which cut the branch routing table from 3,000 entries to 20 and clearly improved convergence. Failure : after the 30 "flagship stores" (which have a local Internet backup link plus a local firewall) went live, the backup egress did not work at all . When the primary link failed, the store simply went dark instead of switching to its local Internet. Root cause : the flagship store's local Internet egress requires redistributing a static default route on the store router ( redistribute static subnets ), but a stub area does not allow an ASBR : - After stub was configured, redistribute static was silently ignored (some platforms only print a warning) - The backup path's default route never entered OSPF - Primary link fails → the store only has the headquarters default route learned through OSPF → headquarters unreachable → the whole store goes dark Why testing missed it : acceptance testing only checked "does it work while the primary link is up" and "did the routing table get smaller". Nobody tested "does it switch to the backup when the primary link fails" . Fix : cfg ! Store (flagship): change to Totally NSSA to allow redistributing the local default route router ospf 1 area 10 nssa no-summary ! Totally NSSA redistribute static subnets route-map LOCAL-EXIT ! route-map LOCAL-EXIT permit 10 match ip address prefix-list PL-DEFAULT Non-flagship stores keep Totally Stub (no ASBR needed). Three lessons : 1. The area type must match the number of exits at the site : a single exit → Stub; multiple exits (including local Internet) → NSSA. 2. Silently ignored configuration is the most dangerous kind : redistribute does not take effect in a stub area and produces almost no warning.

Totally NSSA redistribute static subnets route-map LOCAL-EXIT ! route-map LOCAL-EXIT permit 10 match ip address prefix-list PL-DEFAULT 非旗舰店保持 Totally Stub（不需要 ASBR）。 教训（三条） ： 1. 区域类型要和站点的"出口数量"匹配 ：单出口 → Stub；多出口（含本地 Internet）→ NSSA。 2. 配置被静默忽略是最危险的 ： redistribute 在 stub 区域不生效且几乎无告警。验收必须查 实际路由表 ，不能只看配置命令在不在。 3. The result: an optic flap → neighbor down → SPF run → neighbor back → another SPF run → repeat. The CPU is saturated by SPF and everything gets slower. Fast detection must be paired with flap suppression, otherwise you are just amplifying noise. ⚠️ 一个常见错误组合 ：把 Hello 调到 1s、Dead 调到 3s， 同时 没配 SPF 节流。结果是：光模块抖动 → 邻居断 → SPF 重算 → 邻居恢复 → SPF 再重算 → 反复。CPU 被 SPF 吃满，反而更慢。 快检测必须配抖动抑制，否则是把噪声放大。 OSPF Metric Design: auto-cost Must Be a Network-Wide Decision · OSPF 度量设计： auto-cost 必须是全网一致的决策 OSPF's default cost is reference bandwidth / interface bandwidth , with the reference bandwidth defaulting to 100 Mbps . That creates a serious historical problem: OSPF 的默认 cost 计算是 参考带宽 / 接口带宽 ，参考带宽默认 100 Mbps 。这带来一个历史上的严重问题： Interface bandwidth Default cost (100M reference) Consequence 100M 1 Baseline 1G 1 Same as 100M! 10G 1 Still the same! 100G 1 Still the same! 接口带宽 默认 cost（参考 100M） 后果 100M 1 基准 1G 1 与 100M 相同！ 10G 1 仍然相同！ 100G 1 仍然相同！ This means that under the default configuration, a 100M link and a 100G link have exactly the same cost (both 1), and SPF treats them as equal-cost paths for load sharing — this is almost always a serious design error . 这意味着在默认配置下，一条 100M 链路和一条 100G 链路的 cost 完全一样 （都是 1），SPF 会把它们当作等价的等开销路径做负载分担 —— 这几乎总是一个严重的设计错误 。 ! The reference bandwidth must be changed consistently across the entire network (100G recommended, or at least 10G) router ospf 1 auto-cost reference-bandwidth 100000 ! in Mbps, 100000 = 100G ! ! x: 100000（注意：低速链路 cost 会很大，仍可接受） ⚠️ The reference bandwidth must be identical network-wide . If half the devices use the default and half use 100G, the same pair of links gets different costs on each end — the result is directional suboptimal routing (or even transient loops). This is the classic case of "changing one optimization parameter actually created an asymmetric network". Changing the reference bandwidth is a network-wide change and must go through the change process. ⚠️ 参考带宽必须全网一致 。如果一半设备用默认值、一半用 100G， 同一对链路在两端算出不同 cost —— 结果是有方向性的次优路径（甚至短暂环路）。这是"看起来改了一个优化参数，实际制造了不对称网络"的典型。 修改参考带宽属于全网变更，要走变更流程。 Manual cost design (when automatic calculation does not match your intent): cost 的手工设计 （当自动计算不符合意图时）： Intent Approach Define clear primary/backup paths Small cost on the primary, large on the backup (e.g. primary 10 / backup 100) Base cost on business importance instead of bandwidth Assign manually, e.g. cost 1 on core interconnects and cost 100 on edge links Exclude a link from forwarding Set the cost very high (65535) — but do not use this instead of shutdown Make a link backup-only Use cost plus routing policy, or simply do not include the interface in OSPF 意图 做法 明确主备路径 主路径 cost 小，备路径 cost 大（如主 10 / 备 100） 按业务重要性而非带宽 手工指定，如核心互联 cost 1，边缘链路 cost 100 排除某条链路转发 把 cost 设到极大（65535）——但 不要用这个代替 shutdown 让某条链路只做备份 用 cost + 路由策略，或直接不把该接口放进 OSPF 💡 A practical design habit : write an explicit cost table for every link in the documentation (instead of "auto-cost computes it"). Once someone changes an interface bandwidth or the reference bandwidth, paths change silently, and only a table in the documentation lets you spot the deviation. 💡 一个实用的设计习惯 ：在文档里显式写出 每条链路的 cost 表格 （而不是"由 auto-cost 自动算"）。因为一旦有人改了接口带宽或参考带宽，路径会静默改变，而文档里有表格才能发现偏离。 OSPF Summarization · OSPF 汇总 Summary type Where it is configured Command Description Inter-area summary ABR area X range prefix mask Summarizes the details of an area before advertising them to other areas External route summary ASBR summary-addres

x: IS-IS Design Considerations · IS-IS 设计考量 IS-IS is another link-state protocol. It is conceptually very similar to OSPF but differs noticeably in scalability, encapsulation layer, and vendor ecosystem . IS-IS 是另一个链路状态协议，与 OSPF 在概念上高度相似，但在 扩展性、封装层级、厂商生态 上有明显差异。 OSPF vs IS-IS · OSPF 与 IS-IS 的对比 Dimension OSPF IS-IS Design implication Encapsulation layer Above IP (protocol number 89) Runs directly on Layer 2 (CLNS) IS-IS can form neighbors without IP reachability ( it may survive while IP is under attack ); but it is also harder to run across non-transparent networks Hierarchy Areas (Area 0 must be contiguous) Level 1 / Level 2 (the backbone is a contiguous L2) The IS-IS backbone is formed naturally by L2 routers, no special "Area 0 must be contiguous" rule Area boundaries ABRs have interfaces both inside and between areas An L1/L2 router can have a single interface (one device belongs to both L1 and L2) IS-IS boundaries are more flexible Extensibility Fixed LSA types (Type 1–11) TLV structure , easy to extend IS-IS is the first choice for large SP backbones (it carries TE, SR, and IPv6 without protocol changes) Metric 16 bits by default (24-bit extension) 6 bits by default ( wide metrics must be enabled ) IS-IS absolutely requires metric-style wide Multi-topology (MT) No native support (IPv6 and IPv4 share a topology) Supports multiple topologies (IPv4/IPv6 can take different paths) Only IS-IS allows separate IPv4/IPv6 paths DR concept DR/BDR (elected, with a waiting time) DIS (no backup, preemptive, faster convergence) The IS-IS DIS has no BDR, so failover is faster but re-floods 维度 OSPF IS-IS 设计含义 封装层次 IP 之上（协议号 89） 直接跑在二层 （CLNS） IS-IS 不依赖 IP 可达即可建邻居（ IP 被攻击时 IS-IS 可能仍存活 ）；但也更难跨非透传网络 层级 区域（Area 0 必须连续） Level 1 / Level 2 （骨干是连续的 L2） IS-IS 的骨干由 L2 路由器自然形成， 不需要"区域 0 连续"的特殊规则 区域边界 ABR 在 区域内+区域间 都有接口 L1/L2 路由器 可以只有一个接口 （一台设备同时属于 L1 和 L2） IS-IS 的边界更灵活 可扩展性 LSA 类型固定（Type 1–11） TLV 结构 ，易扩展 IS-IS 是大型 SP 骨干的首选（能承载 TE、SR、IPv6 而不改协议） 度量 默认 16 位（可扩展 24 位） 默认 6 位（ 必须开宽度量 ） IS-IS 一

That means: - IS-IS adjacencies can come up even when no IP reachability exists yet ( very useful during initial configuration and disaster recovery ) - IP-targeted DoS attacks (ICMP floods, IP fragment attacks) do not affect IS-IS adjacencies - But it also means: you cannot form IS-IS neighbors directly across a Layer 3 network (such as a carrier IP network) — you need a tunnel 💡 IS-IS 的最大隐性优势 ：它跑在二层， 没有 IP 头 。这意味着： - 即使设备上还没有任何 IP 可达性，IS-IS 邻居也能建立（ 首次配置/灾后重建时非常有用 ） - 针对 IP 的 DoS 攻击（如 ICMP 洪泛、IP 分片攻击） 不影响 IS-IS 的邻居关系 - 但也意味着： 跨三层网络（如跨运营商的 IP 网）无法直接建 IS-IS 邻居 ，必须靠隧道 Selection guidance : 选型建议 ： Scenario Choose Enterprise campus/branches (possibly multivendor) OSPF (broad ecosystem, many engineers, plenty of troubleshooting material) Carrier backbones, very large cores IS-IS (TLV extensibility, multi-topology, no IP dependency) Need separate IPv4/IPv6 paths (e.g. v6 over different links) IS-IS multi-topology The team only knows OSPF OSPF (see counter-intuitive truth #2 in the introduction) 场景 选 企业园区/分支（多厂商可能） OSPF （生态广、工程师多、排障资料多） 运营商骨干、超大规模核心 IS-IS （TLV 扩展性、多拓扑、无 IP 依赖） 需要 IPv4/IPv6 分离路径（如 v6 走不同链路） IS-IS 多拓扑 团队只熟悉 OSPF OSPF （见导读反直觉二）

x: EIGRP Design Considerations · EIGRP 设计考量 EIGRP is Cisco's advanced distance-vector (hybrid) protocol, built around DUAL (Diffusing Update Algorithm) . Its fundamental difference from link-state protocols is that it does not build a topology map; it maintains a "set of feasible paths to each destination" and relies on the feasibility condition to guarantee loop freedom. EIGRP 是 Cisco 的高级距离矢量（混合型）协议，核心是 DUAL（扩散更新算法） 。它与链路状态协议的根本差异在于： 它不构建拓扑图，而是维护"到每个目的地的可行路径集合"，靠可行性条件保证无环。 The Four Tables and Three Terms of EIGRP · EIGRP 的四张表与三个术语 Table Contents Neighbor table Who my EIGRP neighbors are, their state, and hold time Topology table All learned paths per destination, with metrics, successors, and feasible successors Routing table The best paths selected from the topology table (implicit) Send/receive buffers Internal mechanism 表 内容 邻居表 谁是我的 EIGRP 邻居、状态、保持时间 拓扑表 每个目的地 所有 学到的路径及其度量、后继、可行后继 路由表 从拓扑表优选出来的最佳路径 （隐含） 发送/接收缓存 内部机制 Term Meaning Design significance Feasible distance (FD) The shortest metric to the destination (through the best neighbor) The entry that appears in the routing table Reported distance / advertised distance (RD/AD) The metric the neighbor claims it has to that destination Used only for the feasibility test, not directly for path selection Feasible successor (FS) A backup neighbor satisfying the feasibility condition (RD current FD) With an FS, repair is local and the network is not disturbed — this is the root of fast EIGRP convergence 术语 含义 设计意义 可行距离 (FD) 到目的地的最短度量（经最优邻居） 出现在路由表里的那条 报告距离 / 通告距离 (RD/AD) 邻居声称"我到该目的地的度量" 只用于可行性判断，不直接用于选路 可行后继 (FS) 满足 可行性条件 （RD 当前 FD）的备用邻居 有 FS 时本地修复，不惊动全网 ——这是 EIGRP 收敛快的根源 The meaning of the feasibility condition (in one sentence): the next-hop neighbor of the backup path must be closer to the destination than I am . If that holds, it is proven that "going through it cannot loop back to me", so the path is loop-free. 可行性条件的含义 （用一句话记住）： 备用路径的下一跳邻居，必须比我自己离目的地更近 。满足这个条件，就证明"走它不会绕回我这里"，因此无环。 FD = 1000 (via A) me ──┤ └─ metric

x: by Bandwidth" · EIGRP 度量与"为什么它不按带宽选路" The classic EIGRP composite metric: EIGRP 的经典复合度量： metric = 256 × ( 10^7 / minimum bandwidth (kbps) + accumulated delay (10μs) / 10 ) ↑ ↑ only the smallest bandwidth the sum of delays of all links along the path metric = 256 × ( 10^7 / 最小带宽(kbps) + 累计延迟(10μs) / 10 ) ↑ ↑ 只看路径上最小带宽 所有链路延迟之和 Characteristic Design implication Only the minimum bandwidth counts If one link in the path is 10M and the rest are 100G, the path is computed as 10M → the "leaky bucket" effect Delay accumulates More links significantly increase the metric Load/reliability are excluded by default The K values enable only bandwidth and delay by default (K1=1, K3=1, the rest 0) — changing K values requires network-wide consistency, otherwise adjacencies fail 特性 设计含义 只看最小带宽 路径上有一条 10M，后面全是 100G，也按 10M 算 → "木桶效应" 延迟累加 链路数量多会显著增加度量 默认不算负载/可靠性 K 值默认只启用带宽和延迟（K1=1, K3=1，其余 0）—— 改 K 值必须全网一致，否则邻居起不来 💡 EIGRP metrics compared with OSPF cost : OSPF is hop-by-hop additive , EIGRP is "minimum bandwidth + delay sum". That leads to a counter-intuitive effect: in a network with widely varying bandwidths, the two can produce completely opposite path selections . This is also one of the sources of suboptimal paths in mixed deployments. 💡 EIGRP 的度量与 OSPF cost 相比 ：OSPF 是 逐跳相加 ，EIGRP 是"最小带宽 + 延迟和"。这导致一个反直觉的现象： 在带宽差异大的网络中，两者的选路结果可能完全相反 。混合部署时这也是次优路径的来源之一。 Choosing Between EIGRP and OSPF · EIGRP 与 OSPF 的选择 Dimension OSPF EIGRP Vendor support All vendors Mostly Cisco (partially opened) Fault localization Strong (the LSDB shows the topology) Medium (only the path set in the topology table) Convergence Fast (SPF + BFD) Fast (local repair with an FS, the fastest) Design complexity Many area, LSA type, and area type choices Relatively simple (no areas, rely on AS + summarization + stub) Large-scale flooding Yes (full flooding within an area) No (only distances are propagated) Typical fit Multivendor, needs a clear topology view Cisco-only, hub-and-spoke branches, simplicity 维度 OSPF EIGRP

The classic 10:1 bandwidth mismatch : IGP 的 SPF 只看 拓扑和度量 ，不看带宽利用率、不看业务重要性。经典的 10:1 带宽不匹配 ： ┌──── 1G link (same cost) ────┐ R1 ──┤ ├── R2 └──── 10G link (same cost) ───┘ SPF considers them equal → 50/50 load sharing → the 1G link is instantly congested while the 10G link runs at 5% → what users feel: the network is slow overall , but neither link shows an obvious alarm ┌──── 1G 链路（cost 相同）────┐ R1 ──┤ ├── R2 └──── 10G 链路（cost 相同）───┘ SPF 认为等价 → 负载分担 50/50 → 1G 链路瞬间拥塞，10G 链路只用 5% → 用户感知：整体 网络慢 ，但两条链路的告警都不明显 Every designer reading this book must remember : the default IGP metric is almost never equivalent to "real available bandwidth" . s: Lessons from Practice · 实战经验总结
x: Lessons from Practice · 实战经验总结 Lesson Description Reference bandwidth is a network-wide consistency parameter auto-cost reference-bandwidth must be identical network-wide ; changing only half is worse than not changing it (asymmetric paths) Ask the business about tolerance before targeting convergence If the business cannot perceive one second, do not add BFD plus aggressive timers for 200 ms; the cost of flap-driven false failover is usually higher A summary must be paired with Null0 The lifetime of the summary and of the details must be decoupled, otherwise the summary becomes a black hole when the details disappear RRs in pairs, unique cluster-ids, clients dual-homed These three are the minimum configuration for iBGP scalability; miss any one and the symptom is "routes are occasionally incomplete" The redistribution triad: tag + route-map + AD planning Miss any one and failures inevitably produce loops or suboptimal routing, and it is invisible in normal operation Control tools must point in the right direction Egress uses LP/Weight (decided locally), ingress uses MED/prepend (decided by the peer). Get the direction wrong and no tuning helps In the long run, unifying protocols is cheaper than maintaining two Dual-point, dual-direction redistribution is a "temporary bridge" that should be removed once migration is done; organizations that treat it as a long-term solution all pay a larger troubleshooting bill within three years Templated configuration must include variable validation Router ID, cluster-id, NET, and interface addresses "differ per device"; templating must validate uniqueness automatically, otherwise duplicate IDs silently drop routes When troubleshooting, first check whether the control and data planes agree " show ip bgp has a best path but the RIB has no entry" almost always points at next-hop reachability ( next-hop-self ) 经验 说明 参考带宽是全网一致性参数 auto-cost reference-bandwidth 必须 全网同值 ，只改一半比不改更糟（不对称路径） 收敛目标先问业务容忍度 业务感知不到 1 秒，就别为 200ms 上 BFD + 激进计时器；抖动导

x: Chapter Summary · 本章小结 The main thread of Chapter 8 is the layers of "control" : 第 8 章的主线是 "控制"的层次 ： ① Topology layer: areas/hierarchy/flooding domain → sets the scale limit ② Metric layer: cost / metric / auto-cost → sets the default path (easiest to lose control of) ③ Summarization layer: range / summary-address → trades scale for visibility ④ Attribute layer: LP / MED / AS_PATH / Weight → sets the policy path ⑤ Translation layer: redistribution / tag / seed metric → sets the boundary between heterogeneous domains ① 拓扑层：区域/层级/泛洪域 → 决定规模上限 ② 度量层：cost / metric / auto-cost → 决定默认路径（最容易失控） ③ 汇总层：range / summary-address → 决定规模与可见性的交换 ④ 属性层：LP / MED / AS_PATH / Weight → 决定策略路径 ⑤ 翻译层：重分发 / tag / seed metric → 决定异构域的边界 Five conclusions worth taking away : 五条可以带走的结论 ： The defaults are the design. auto-cost reference-bandwidth 100 , default local-preference 100 , and MED being compared only within the same AS — these defaults determine the network's real behavior. Not designing explicitly means accepting "a network nobody ever designed". Egress is controllable; ingress can only be requested. Any promise of "bidirectional load sharing" is empty unless you control the far end. The number of protocols must match operational capability. The complexity of dual-point, dual-direction redistribution almost always exceeds the problem it solves; unify wherever you can. Summarization = trading visibility for scale. Once you summarize, you must accept that "the summary address still works during a failure" and write the troubleshooting method (look inside the area) into the operations manual. Verify with the FIB and with traffic data, not with configuration and the BGP table. * in show ip bgp does not mean packets can be forwarded; a successful traceroute does not mean the path matches the design. x: Chapter Introduction: What Exactly Is Being Virtualized · 本章导读：虚拟化到底在虚拟化什么 Many people memorize "network virtualization" as a string of acronyms (MPLS, VRF, VXLAN, SD-WAN) and end up more confused the more they study. In reality there are only three main threads , and every technology is a different implementation of those three: 很多人把"网络虚拟化"记成一串缩写（MPLS、VRF、VXLAN、SD-WAN），结果越背越乱。它其实只有 三条主线 ，所有技术都是这三条主线的不同实现： Main thread Problem it solves Representative technologies Address space reuse (isolation) Different customers/businesses all use 10.0.0.0/8 — how can they coexist on one physical network VRF + RD/RT (MPLS L3VPN), VXLAN VNI, SD-WAN VPN Separation of identity and location A VM or container keeps its IP after migration, but its physical location changes LISP, EVPN, SD-Access fabric Separation of control and forwarding Every device computes paths and is configured on its own, so policy cannot be delivered end to end SDN controllers, SD-WAN vSmart, SD-Access DNA Center 主线 要解决的问题 代表技术 地址空间复用 （隔离） 不同客户/业务用了同样的 10.0.0.0/8 ，如何在同一张物理网上共存 VRF + RD/RT（MPLS L3VPN）、VXLAN VNI、SD-WAN VPN 标识与位置分离 虚拟机/容器迁移后 IP 不变，但物理位置变了 LISP、EVPN、SD-Access fabric 控制与转发分离 每台设备单独算路、单独配置，策略无法端到端下发 SDN 控制器、SD-WAN vSmart、SD-Access DNA Center Remember this one sentence from a design perspective : virtualization decouples the physical topology from the service topology . The price is more encapsulation (MTU, overhead), more control plane (protocols, convergence), and more operational layers (controllers, orchestration) . What CCDE tests is not "can you configure it" but " when you should not deploy it ". 设计视角记住这一句 ：虚拟化把"物理拓扑"和"业务拓扑"解耦了。代价是 多了封装（MTU、开销）、多了控制平面（协议、收敛）、多了运维层（控制器、编排） 。CCDE 考的不是"会不会配"，而是" 什么时候不该上 "。

x: Foundation Topics · 基础内容 MPLS Overview · MPLS 概述 MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) is becoming increasingly popular in large enterprises. MPLS（多协议标签交换）在大型企业中越来越受欢迎。 MPLS design goals : - Support a large number of customer groups, each with many sites (scalability) - Provide value-added services that create new revenue streams (flexible and reliable) - Support every kind of service for enterprise customers on a unified infrastructure - Provide flexible service provisioning across many access media types MPLS 设计目标 ： - 支持大量客户组和每组大量站点（可扩展） - 提供增值服务，创建新收入来源（灵活可靠） - 在统一基础设施上支持所有企业客户的各种服务 - 在各种介质接入方式上提供灵活的服务配置 For the enterprise side , the value of MPLS is not "label forwarding is faster than IP" (that claim stopped being true long ago), but rather: 对 企业侧 而言，MPLS 的价值不是"标签转发比 IP 快"（这个说法早就不成立），而是： The carrier manages the complexity of full-mesh connectivity for you (all you see is a VRF interface on the PE) Any-to-any site connectivity comes for free (the carrier core is a full-mesh P network, so you do not have to build tunnels yourself) A contractual SLA (latency, jitter, loss — traffic runs on a dedicated forwarding plane) 运营商帮你去管理全网连通的复杂度 （你只看到 PE 上那个 VRF 接口） 天然的任意站点间连通 （运营商核心是 full mesh 的 P 网，你不需要自己建隧道） 可承诺的 SLA （时延、抖动、丢包，走的是专用转发面） MPLS Architecture Components · MPLS 架构组件 Component Definition Function CE (customer edge) Customer-side device Connects to the PE and exchanges routes PE (provider edge) Carrier-side edge device Maintains VRFs, exchanges VPN routes, pushes and pops labels P (provider node) Core device Switches labels, maintains no VPN routes 组件 定义 功能 CE (客户边缘) 客户侧设备 连接到 PE，交换路由 PE (提供商边缘) 运营商侧边缘设备 维护 VRF，交换 VPN 路由，压入/弹出标签 P (提供商节点) 核心设备 标签交换，不维护 VPN 路由 Key insight : a P router never sees customer IP routes ; it only swaps transport labels. That has an important design consequence — all of your routing policy, ACLs, and QoS classification must be completed at the PE boundary , because once traffic is inside the core there is nothing of yours to anchor on. 关

x: MPLS Control Plane Components · MPLS 控制平面组件 1. VRF (Virtual Routing and Forwarding) · VRF (虚拟路由转发) A VRF is the primary mechanism for maintaining routing isolation at Layer 3 device level. Each PE maintains a separate routing and forwarding instance for every VRF of every customer. VRF 是在三层设备级别维护路由隔离的主要机制。每个 PE 为每个客户的每个 VRF 维护独立的路由和转发实例。 A VRF actually contains four things: its own routing table, its own forwarding table (CEF), its own set of interfaces, and its own routing protocol processes . 一个 VRF 里实际包含四样东西： 独立的路由表、独立的转发表（CEF）、独立的接口集合、独立的路由协议进程 。 The most easily overlooked design point: a VRF is a per-hop concept, not an end-to-end concept . VRFs exist only on PEs — a CE has no VRF at all (it only knows it is that device). Therefore: 设计上最容易忽视的一点： VRF 是"每跳"的概念，不是"端到端"的概念 。VRF 只存在于 PE 上，CE 上根本没有 VRF（CE 只知道自己是那台设备）。所以： Isolation on the CE side relies on physical interfaces or subinterfaces (or VRF-Lite on the CE itself) Isolation on the PE side relies on VRF + RT Isolation in the middle P network relies on nothing (the P routers do not even know VRFs exist) CE 侧的隔离靠 物理接口或子接口 （或 CE 自己的 VRF-Lite） PE 侧的隔离靠 VRF + RT 中间 P 网侧什么都不靠（P 根本不知道有 VRF） 2. Because when the same site advertises the same prefix from two PEs, if both PEs use the same RD the resulting VPNv4 prefixes are identical, so BGP treats them as two copies of the same route and can select only one (and by default does not install two paths to the same neighbor). With different RDs, two distinct VPNv4 prefixes are generated and the PE can keep both paths in the VRF for ECMP or fast switching. 为什么多归属需要"每 PE 唯一 RD"？因为同一个站点从两个 PE 通告同一前缀时，如果两个 PE 用 同一个 RD ，生成的 VPNv4 前缀完全一样，BGP 会认为是 同一条路由的两个副本 ，只能选一条（且默认不装两条到同一邻居）。用不同 RD 后生成两条不同的 VPNv4 前缀，PE 才能在 VRF 里保留两条路径做 ECMP 或快速切换。 3. Two-way import merges two organizations' routing domains and multiplies the risk of routing loops and policy leakage. 💡 设计原则 ：Extranet 一律 单向 。双向 import 等于把两个组织的路由域合并，路由环路和策略泄露风险成倍增加。 Route Summarization Is the Key to L3VPN Scalability · 路由汇总是 L3VPN 可扩展性的关键 Every VRF on a PE must hold a complete routing table. Number of sites × routes per site = FIB pressure on the PE. PE 上每个 VRF 都要保存一份完整路由表。站点数 × 每站点路由数 = PE 的 FIB 压力。 Approach Effect Cautions Summarize on the hub and then advertise The PE routing table shrinks dramatically Spokes lose detailed reachability, which makes fault localization harder Summarize on the CE (do the summary on the CE) Optimal; invisible to the carrier Requires customer cooperation and contiguous addressing Per-VRF summarization on the PE A compromise Summary black holes: when the details disappear there is no fallback, so null0 is mandatory 做法 效果 注意 Hub 侧汇总后再通告 PE 路由表大幅缩小 Spoke 之间失去明细可达性，故障定位变难 CE 侧汇总 （在 CE 上做 summary） 最优，运营商无感 需要客户配合，且要求地址规划连续 PE 上 per-VRF 汇总 折中 汇总黑洞：明细消失时无兜底，必须配 null0

virtual switch EVPN The next-generation BGP-based L2VPN, with MAC learning in the control plane 技术 特点 VPWS 点对点二层伪线（E-Line），等同于一根"虚拟网线" VPLS 多点到多点二层服务（E-LAN），等价于一台虚拟交换机 EVPN 基于 BGP 的下一代 L2VPN，控制平面学习 MAC The Three Structural Flaws of VPLS (Why It Is Not Recommended for New Builds) · VPLS 的三个结构性缺陷（为什么不推荐新建） MAC learning relies on data-plane flooding : unknown unicast, broadcast, and multicast (BUM) are all flooded, so at scale the core bandwidth is eaten by flooding Full-mesh pseudowires : N sites require N(N−1)/2 PWs, so the number of PWs on a PE grows with the square of the site count Multihoming is difficult : when a site is dual-homed to two PEs, one link must be blocked (loop prevention), so active/active is impossible and convergence depends on STP timers MAC 学习靠数据面泛洪 ：未知单播、广播、组播（BUM）全部泛洪，规模一大，核心带宽被泛洪吃掉 全连接伪线 ：N 个站点需要 N(N-1)/2 条 PW，PE 的 PW 数量随站点数平方增长 多归属困难 ：一个站点双归到两个 PE 时， 必须阻塞一条链路 （防环），无法做 Active/Active，收敛靠 STP 计时器 Why EVPN Replaces VPLS · EVPN 为什么取代 VPLS plus preferred forwarding) Multihoming One link must be blocked ESI all-active , with DF election deciding the BUM forwarder ARP/ND Flooded across the whole network ARP suppression (answered directly （RT-2），不泛洪 BUM 流量 全站点泛洪 按需（RT-3 IMET 建立组播树 + 优选转发） 多归属 必须阻塞一条 ESI 多活 （All-Active），DF 选举决定 BUM 转发者 ARP/ND 全网泛洪 ARP 抑制 （控制面已知 MAC/IP 时直接代答） 扩展性 站点数平方级 PW 每 PE 只与 RR 建会话 EVPN route types (remembering 2, s: MPLS L2VPN
x: PN 的路由类型（记住 2、3、5 就够日常用） ： Type Name Function 1 Ethernet A-D Advertises reachability per ESI, used for fast multihoming convergence and aliasing 2 MAC/IP advertisement Advertises MAC (optionally with IP), enabling control-plane learning and ARP suppression 3 Inclusive multicast Ethernet tag Advertises the replication list for BUM traffic 4 Ethernet segment DF election for multihoming 5 IP prefix Advertises IP prefix routes, used in L3 scenarios (symmetric IRB) 类型 名称 作用 1 Ethernet A-D 按 ESI 通告可达性，用于多归属快速收敛与别名（Aliasing） 2 MAC/IP Advertisement 通告 MAC（可选带 IP），控制面学习 + ARP 抑制 3 Inclusive Multicast Ethernet Tag 通告 BUM 流量的复制列表 4 Ethernet Segment 多归属的 DF 选举 5 IP Prefix 通告 IP 前缀路由，用于 L3 场景（对称 IRB） 💡 Design choice : inside a data center (leaf-spine) it is almost always EVPN + VXLAN ; for enterprise WAN Layer 2 interconnect requirements (cross-site vMotion, cross-site cluster heartbeats) use EVPN + MPLS or EVPN over SR. Pure VPLS should only appear in existing brownfield networks. 💡 设计选择 ：数据中心内部（leaf-spine）几乎一律用 EVPN + VXLAN ；企业 WAN 二层互联需求（如跨站点 vMotion、跨站点集群心跳）用 EVPN + MPLS 或 EVPN over SR。纯 VPLS 只应出现在存量网络里。

s: MPLS Traffic Engineering (MPLS TE) and Alternatives · MPLS 流量工程 (MPLS TE) 与替代路线
x: MPLS Traffic Engineering (MPLS TE) and Alternatives · MPLS 流量工程 (MPLS TE) 与替代路线 Why TE Is Needed · 为什么需要 TE The IGP's shortest path algorithm (SPF) looks only at topology, never at bandwidth. The classic 10:1 bandwidth mismatch : a 1G link and a 10G link are equal (same cost), so SPF splits traffic 50/50 — the 1G link is instantly congested while the 10G link sits empty. IGP 的最短路径算法（SPF）只看拓扑，不看带宽。经典的 10:1 带宽不匹配 ：一条 1G 链路和一条 10G 链路等价（cost 相同），SPF 把流量对半分 —— 1G 那条瞬间拥塞，10G 那条空着。 The MPLS TE approach : use RSVP-TE to specify the path explicitly and reserve bandwidth along it. MPLS TE 的解决思路 ：用 RSVP-TE 显式指定路径，并在沿途预留带宽。 Capability Mechanism Value Constraint-based routing CSPF: prune the IGP topology by bandwidth/affinity (admin group) and then compute the shortest path Moves traffic off congested links Bandwidth reservation RSVP PATH/RESV reserves along the path Deterministic bandwidth for voice/video Fast reroute FRR (link/node protection) with a pre-built backup LSP Convergence 50 ms, better than IGP's seconds Auto-bandwidth Auto-bandwidth periodically adjusts LSP bandwidth according to measured traffic No manual tuning 能力 机制 价值 约束路由 CSPF：在 IGP 拓扑上按带宽/亲和属性（admin group）剪枝后再算最短路 把流量从拥塞链路挪开 带宽预留 RSVP PATH/RESV 沿路径预留 语音/视频有确定性带宽 快速重路由 FRR（链路/节点保护），预先建好备份 LSP 收敛 50ms，优于 IGP 的秒级 自动带宽 Auto-Bandwidth 定期按实测流量调整 LSP 带宽 免人工调参 The Cost of TE (Why Many Enterprises Skip It) · TE 的代价（为什么很多企业不上） Cost How it shows up Complexity RSVP is yet another independent signaling protocol; paths, affinity, and tunnel policy all need maintenance State volume Every LSP has state on every device along the path, so P routers hold a large amount of soft state Larger failure domain If the RSVP-IGP interaction is designed badly you get "the tunnel is up but traffic does not use it" Vendor differences Affinity, bandwidth units, and FRR modes differ between vendors 代价 具体表现 复杂度 RSVP 是又一个独立信令协议，路径、亲和属性、隧道策略都要维护 状态量 每个 LSP 在每台沿途设备上都有状态，P 设备要保存大量软状态 故障域扩大 RSVP 与 IGP 的联动一旦设计不当，会出现"隧道起来了但流量不走" 厂商差异 亲和属性、带宽单位、FRR 模

x: 式各家不一致 The Three Current Alternatives · 现在的三种替代路线 Route Mechanism Where it fits SR-MPLS + SR-TE Source routing using IGP-distributed SIDs, with a controller computing explicit paths Greenfield service provider or large enterprise cores SD-WAN application-aware routing Multiple links plus per-application SLA path selection, with policy pushed by a controller Enterprise WAN (replaces most of the MPLS TE use cases) Scale out and tune IGP metrics auto-cost reference-bandwidth plus multipath Small and medium networks; lowest cost 路线 机制 适用 SR-MPLS + SR-TE 用 IGP 分发的 SID 做源路由，控制器算显式路径 新建 SP/大型企业核心 SD-WAN 应用感知路由 多链路 + 逐应用 SLA 选路，由控制器下发策略 企业 WAN（替代 MPLS TE 的大部分诉求） 靠扩容与 IGP 度量调整 auto-cost reference-bandwidth + 多路径 中小型网络，成本最低 ⚠️ A decision reminder : if the customer's real requirement is " critical applications must not be affected by link degradation ", then SD-WAN's multiple links + BFD + application awareness is more direct and cheaper than MPLS TE. MPLS TE's strength is " bandwidth optimization inside a single carrier core "; it cannot solve business continuity requirements. ⚠️ 决策提醒 ：如果客户的真实需求是" 重要应用不能受链路劣化影响 "，那 SD-WAN 的多链路 + BFD + 应用感知比 MPLS TE 更直接、更便宜。MPLS TE 的强项是" 在单一运营商核心内做带宽优化 "，业务连续性诉求它解决不了。

s: Encapsulation Overhead and MTU: The First Hurdle in Virtualization Design · 封装开销与 MTU：虚拟化设计的第一道坎
x: Encapsulation Overhead and MTU: The First Hurdle in Virtualization Design · 封装开销与 MTU：虚拟化设计的第一道坎 Every virtualization technology adds encapsulation headers. If the MTU is not planned for at design time, you will inevitably hit the bizarre failure after go-live of "ping works, web pages load, but large file transfers fail and SSH hangs" — because PMTUD depends on ICMP, and ICMP is permanently blocked by ACLs in production networks. 所有虚拟化技术都会加封包头。 设计时如果不预留 MTU，上线后必然出现"能 ping 通、能打开网页、但传大文件失败/SSH 卡死"的诡异故障 —— 因为 PMTUD 依赖 ICMP，而 ICMP 在生产网里常年被 ACL 拦掉。 Extra Overhead of Common Encapsulations · 常见封装的额外开销 Encapsulation Extra overhead (bytes) Notes MPLS, 2 labels 8 4B per label; 3 labels = 12B GRE 24 4B GRE header + 20B outer IP IPsec transport mode (ESP/AH) ~30–60 Depends on the algorithm and IV length IPsec tunnel mode ~50–73 Outer IP + ESP + IV + padding VXLAN 50 14B inner Ethernet + 8B VXLAN + 8B UDP + 20B outer IP VXLAN + IPsec (tunnel mode) ~100–120 A common SD-WAN combination DMVPN (mGRE + IPsec) ~70–90 Depends on the encryption algorithm 封装 额外开销（字节） 备注 MPLS 2 层标签 8 每标签 4B；3 层标签 = 12B GRE 24 4B GRE 头 + 20B 外层 IP IPsec 传输模式（ESP/AH） ~30–60 取决于算法与 IV 长度 IPsec 隧道模式 ~50–73 外层 IP + ESP + IV + padding VXLAN 50 14B 内层以太 + 8B VXLAN + 8B UDP + 20B 外层 IP VXLAN + IPsec（隧道模式） ~100–120 SD-WAN 常见组合 DMVPN（mGRE + IPsec） ~70–90 视加密算法 The calculated conclusions (two numbers you must memorize) : 换算结论（必须背下来的两个数） ： MPLS : the underlay MTU must be ≥ 1508 (two labels); three labels require 1512 VXLAN : to support 1500 on the inner side, the underlay MTU must be ≥ 1550 ; if the underlay is only 1500, then the usable inner MTU is only 1450 MPLS ：underlay MTU 要 ≥ 1508 （两个标签）；三个标签要 1512 VXLAN ：若内层要支持 1500，underlay MTU 要 ≥ 1550 ；如果 underlay 只有 1500，则 内层可用 MTU 只有 1450 Three Ways to Handle It and Their Trade-offs · 三种处理方式与取舍 Approach Method Cost Increase the underlay MTU (recommended) Set 1550 or 9216 (jumbo) on the core/backbone Must be uniform end to end; carrier links may not allow it MSS clamping

x: Software-Defined Networks (SDN) · 软件定义网络 The SDN Layered Model · SDN 的分层模型 Component Definition Underlay The LAN infrastructure made up of physical switches and routers SDN controller The centralized control plane that manages network devices Overlay The virtual network built on top of the underlay VN (virtual network) The SD-WAN overlay mechanism providing VRF-like segmentation 组件 定义 Underlay（底层网络） 物理交换机和路由器组成的局域网基础设施 SDN 控制器 集中式控制平面，管理网络设备 Overlay（覆盖网络） 在 Underlay 之上构建的虚拟网络 VN（虚拟网络） SD-WAN 覆盖机制，提供类似 VRF 的分段 The standard three-plane split (use this table when writing design documents): 标准三层划分（写设计文档时用这张表）： Plane Responsibility Traditional network SDN Management plane Configuration, monitoring, orchestration CLI / SNMP / script hell Controller GUI/API (vManage, DNA Center) Control plane Path computation, topology, policy Every device runs IGP/BGP Centralized controller (vSmart, LISP map server) Data plane Forwarding Distributed hardware forwarding Unchanged (hardware forwarding is still distributed) 平面 职责 传统网络 SDN 管理面 配置、监控、编排 CLI / SNMP / 脚本地狱 控制器 GUI/API（vManage、DNA Center） 控制面 算路、拓扑、策略 每台设备跑 IGP/BGP 集中控制器（vSmart、LISP Map-Server） 数据面 转发 分布式硬件转发 保持不变（硬件转发仍是分布式） 💡 A commonly misunderstood point : SDN does not mean "forwarding has been centralized too". The data plane is still independent hardware forwarding on each device; what SDN centralizes is the control-plane policy and configuration . So-called "centralized forwarding" (e.g. traffic steering through a central firewall) is an additional service-chaining design, not an inherent property of SDN. 💡 一个常被误解的点 ：SDN 不等于 "转发也集中了"。数据面仍然是每台设备独立硬件转发，SDN 集中的是 控制面策略与配置 。所谓"集中转发"（如某些防火墙集中引流）是额外的服务链设计，不是 SDN 的必然属性。 The Design Boundary Between Underlay and Overlay · Underlay 与 Overlay 的设计边界 Item How the underlay should be designed What it should not do Topology Simple, symmetric, ECMP Do not implement complex policy in the underlay Protocols A single IGP (IS-IS/OSPF) or eBGP Do not run multiple routing protocols, do not redistr

Stuffing policy into the underlay is the number one cause of failed SDN projects. 核心原则 ： Overlay 承担业务与变更，Underlay 保持稳定与简单 。把策略塞进 underlay 是 SDN 项目失败的头号原因。 VXLAN Data Plane · VXLAN 数据平面 Element Description VTEP The VXLAN tunnel endpoint, responsible for encapsulation/decapsulation VNI 24 bit, about 16 million segments (versus 4,094 VLANs) Encapsulation MAC-in-UDP, destination port 4789 BUM handling Multicast (older approach) or ingress replication (current mainstream) Control plane Flood-and-learn (older approach) or EVPN (current mainstream, BGP advertising MAC/IP) 要素 说明 VTEP VXLAN 隧道端点，负责封装/解封装 VNI 24 bit，约 1600 万个段（对比 VLAN 的 4094） 封装 MAC-in-UDP，目的端口 4789 BUM 处理 组播（老方案）或 头端复制 （Ingress Replication，现主流） 控制面 泛洪学习（老方案）或 EVPN （现主流，BGP 通告 MAC/IP） VXLAN's ECMP friendliness : the outer UDP source port is generated by hashing the inner flow, so ECMP in the underlay can spread different sessions across different paths — this is VXLAN's real advantage over GRE (which has no port entropy). VXLAN 的 ECMP 友好性 ：外层 UDP 源端口由内层流的哈希生成，因此 underlay 的 ECMP 能把不同会话分散到不同路径 —— 这是 VXLAN 相比 GRE（无端口熵）的实质优势。

x: SD-Access (Enterprise Campus Fabric) · SD-Access（园区 fabric） Cisco's SD-Access is a campus implementation of " LISP control plane + VXLAN data plane ". Cisco 的 SD-Access 是" LISP 控制面 + VXLAN 数据面 "的园区实现。 The Four Fabric Roles · 四种 fabric 角色 Role Responsibility Key reminder Control plane node LISP map server/map resolver, maintaining EID→RLOC mappings Must be redundant (usually two nodes); if it fails, new endpoints cannot come online Border node The boundary between the fabric and outside networks (legacy campus, DC, Internet), and a LISP proxy tunnel router Separate internal and external borders (internal border / default border) Edge node The access layer, VTEP plus anycast gateway Endpoints get the same gateway MAC/IP wherever they are Fusion router Performs inter-VRF leaking/shared services outside the border Mandatory during legacy migration, but becomes a single point and a bottleneck 角色 职责 关键提醒 Control Plane Node LISP Map-Server/Map-Resolver，维护 EID→RLOC 映射 必须冗余（通常 2 台），它挂了新终端就上不了线 Border Node fabric 与外部网络（传统园区、DC、互联网）的边界，LISP Proxy Tunnel Router 内部/外部边界分开（Internal Border / Default Border） Edge Node 接入层，VTEP + Anycast Gateway 终端在哪都能拿到同一个网关 MAC/IP Fusion Router 在 Border 之外做 VRF 间泄露/共享服务 遗留网络过渡期必须，但会成为单点与瓶颈 Key Differences from a Traditional Campus · 与传统园区的关键差异 Dimension Traditional campus SD-Access Gateway location VRRP/HSRP on distribution/core Anycast gateway distributed on every edge node ; roaming endpoints need no gateway recomputation Segmentation VLAN + ACL SGT (scalable group tag) plus a group policy matrix , which can cross VRFs Mobility Roaming across subnets requires a new DHCP lease LISP mapping follows the endpoint, so the IP stays the same Policy location ACLs on each device Defined centrally in the controller and delivered with the SGT Underlay STP + VLAN Routed underlay (IS-IS is common), no STP 维度 传统园区 SD-Access 网关位置 汇聚/核心上的 VRRP/HSRP Anycast Gateway 分布在每台 Edge ，终端漫游无需重算网关 分段 VLAN + ACL SGT（Scalable Group Tag）+ 组策略矩阵 ，可跨 VRF 移动性 漫游跨子网要重新 DHCP LISP

x: 映射跟随终端，IP 保持不变 策略位置 每台设备的 ACL 控制器统一定义，随 SGT 下发 Underlay STP + VLAN 路由式 underlay（IS-IS 常用），无 STP ⚠️ SGT deployment limits : SGT requires hardware support for inline tagging (adding the CMD field to the Ethernet header). Where legacy devices do not support it, the only option is SXP (the SGT exchange protocol) to "carry" the tag to the peer; as links multiply, managing SXP connections becomes an operational burden. A hardware compatibility list must be produced before design — this is the most commonly underestimated item in SD-Access projects. ⚠️ SGT 的落地限制 ：SGT 需要 硬件支持 inline tagging （在以太头里加 CMD 字段）。老设备不支持时只能靠 SXP （SGT 交换协议）把标签"传"给对端，链路一多 SXP 的连接管理就成了运维负担。设计前必须做 硬件兼容性清单 ，这是 SD-Access 项目最常见的低估项。

x: Policy Structure (Configuration Order Matters) · 策略的四层结构（配置顺序不能乱） Layer Function Example Topology The inter-site connectivity model (full mesh / hub-spoke / partial mesh) Spokes build tunnels only with hubs Traffic rules / control policy Which routes may be advertised (OMP-layer filtering) Do not leak the headquarters default route to outsourced sites Application-aware routing The SLA and path preference per application Voice prefers mpls , and switches to biz-internet only when the SLA is violated Data policy The data plane: QoS, redirect, service chaining, encryption Guest traffic breaks out locally 层次 作用 例子 Topology 站点间连通模型（full mesh / hub-spoke / partial mesh） Spoke 只与 Hub 建隧道 Traffic Rules / Control Policy 哪些路由可以被通告（OMP 层过滤） 不把总部默认路由泄露给外包站点 Application-Aware Routing 每个应用的 SLA 与选路偏好 语音优先 mpls ，超 SLA 才切 biz-internet Data Policy 数据面：QoS、重定向、服务链、加密 访客流量直接本地 breakout ⚠️ Getting the order wrong makes policies overwrite each other : topology decides "can it reach", control policy decides "which routes are learned", AAR decides "which path is taken", and data policy decides "how it is handled". Writing AAR before topology means the policy will not take effect — this is the most common "configuration all looks correct but nothing works" situation in SD-WAN troubleshooting. ⚠️ 顺序错了会互相覆盖 ：Topology 决定"能不能通"，Control Policy 决定"能学到什么路由"，AAR 决定"走哪条"，Data Policy 决定"怎么处理"。把 AAR 写在 Topology 之前，策略不会生效 —— 这是 SD-WAN 排障中最常见的"配置看起来全对但不生效"。 SD-WAN vs DMVPN (the Traditional Approach) · SD-WAN vs DMVPN（传统方案） Dimension DMVPN SD-WAN Topology mGRE + NHRP, with hubs usually relaying The overlay builds full connectivity automatically, controlled by policy Control plane Distributed (NHRP + routing protocol) Centralized (OMP + vSmart) Multi-link path selection Manual PBR / IP SLA / EEM Native AAR + BFD Deployment On-site configuration or scripts ZTP Operational visibility Per-device CLI A centralized controller view Cost Cheaper hardware, more expensive labor Expensive subscriptions, less labor

x: Case Studies · 实战案例 Case 1: VXLAN Tunnels Ping Fine, but File Transfers and SSH Logins Hang · 案例一：VXLAN 隧道能 ping 通，但传文件、SSH 登录全卡死 Scenario : two data centers were connected with a VXLAN Layer 2 extension. During go-live testing everything worked: ping succeeded, web pages loaded, database connections were normal. But operations reported that "after logging in over SSH, commands hang for a few seconds before echoing, and large file transfers break halfway through". 场景 ：双数据中心通过 VXLAN 打通二层延伸。上线测试：ping 通、网页能打开、数据库连接正常。但运维反馈"SSH 登录后敲命令会卡住几秒才回显，传大文件到一半就断"。 Troubleshooting : 排查过程 ： Small packets all pass → routing, ACL, and ARP problems are ruled out ping -s 1450 -M do works, -s 1473 -M do fails → the MTU boundary is around 1450 Calculate the overhead: VXLAN adds 50 bytes, underlay MTU 1500 → 1450 usable on the inner side But the server NIC is still at the default 1500, so large packets with DF set are dropped in the underlay, and the required ICMP "fragmentation needed" (Type 3 Code 4) is blocked by a core ACL → a PMTUD black hole Explaining the SSH hangs: after login the server sends large packets (banner/keys) that are dropped, and the client only lowers its MSS after retransmission timeouts 小包全通 → 排除路由、ACL、ARP 问题 ping -s 1450 -M do 通， -s 1473 -M do 不通 → MTU 边界在 1450 附近 算开销：VXLAN 额外 50 字节，underlay MTU 1500 → 内层可用 1450 但服务器网卡仍是默认 1500，DF 位置位的大包在 underlay 被丢弃，需要的 ICMP "fragmentation needed"（Type 3 Code 4）被核心 ACL 拦掉 → PMTUD 黑洞 SSH 卡顿的解释：登录成功后服务端发大包（banner/密钥）被丢，客户端重传超时后才降 MSS Fixes (choose one; real projects usually do 1 + 2 together) : 修复（三选一，实际项目通常 1 + 2 一起做） ： Option Configuration Cost Increase the underlay MTU (preferred) Set 1550 (or 9216) on everything in the core/interconnects Must be uniform end to end; carrier segments are out of your control MSS clamping ip tcp adjust-mss 1400 on the VTEP or gateway Saves TCP only; UDP (video, DNS, VoIP) still drops Lower the inner interface MTU Set the VM/host NIC MTU to 1450 Requires host changes and does not help other sites 方

x: 3 LSAs received over MP-BGP as routes from "another OSPF domain", regenerated them, and redistributed them back into BGP That produced a BGP → OSPF → BGP feedback loop, and the DN bit mechanism stopped working The microwave link had a low OSPF cost and was always preferred, while the MPLS path kept overwriting it — the two sides fought each other 两端 PE 的 show ip ospf vrf 显示 Domain ID 不一致 （一侧是默认 0.0.0.1 ，另一侧手工配了别的） 因为 Domain ID 不一致，PE 把对方通过 MP-BGP 传来的 Type 3 LSA 当作"另一个 OSPF 域"的路由， 重新生成 LSA 并重分发回 BGP 于是形成 BGP → OSPF → BGP 的回流，DN 位机制失效 微波链路的 OSPF cost 低，一直优选；MPLS 路径的路由又不断把微波路径覆盖，两头互搏 Fix (a three-part set; all are required) : 修复（三件套，缺一不可） ： ! 1. Align the Domain ID on both ends router ospf 1 vrf CUSTOMER domain-id 0.0.0.1 ! 2. Use a sham link to disguise MPLS as intra-area, so the backdoor link is not higher class interface Loopback 100 ip address 10.255.0.1 255.255.255.255 router ospf 1 vrf CUSTOMER area 0 sham-link 10.255.0.1 10.255.0.2 cost 10 ! 3. Raise the cost of the backup link explicitly and use BFD for fast detection interface GigabitEthernet0/2 ip ospf cost 65535 ! 1. 两端 Domain ID 统一 router ospf 1 vrf CUSTOMER domain-id 0.0.0.1 ! 2. 用 sham-link 把 MPLS 伪装成 intra-area，避免后门链路 级别更高 interface Loopback 100 ip address 10.255.0.1 255.255.255.255 router ospf 1 vrf CUSTOMER area 0 sham-link 10.255.0.1 10.255.0.2 cost 10 ! 3. 备份链路明确抬高 cost，并用 BFD 做快速探测 interface GigabitEthernet0/2 ip ospf cost 65535 Lesson : if there is a backdoor link you must handle the "protocol preference" problem . OSPF relies on a sham link (promoting MPLS to intra-area) plus a consistent Domain ID; EIGRP relies on SoO plus cost community; BGP relies on SoO plus LP. A backdoor link is not merely a standby — it actively steals traffic. 教训 ： 有后门链路就必须处理"协议优先级"问题 。OSPF 靠 sham-link（把 MPLS 提升为 intra-area）+ Domain ID 一致；EIGRP 靠 SoO + cost community；BGP 靠 SoO + LP。 后门链路不只是备用，它会主动抢流量 。 Case 4: Voice Calls Drop Once an Hour After SD-WAN Go-Live · 案例四：SD-WAN 上线后语音每小时断一次 Scenario : SD-WAN with two transports

After go-live voice dropped for a few seconds every hour, and switches happened frequently. 场景 ：SD-WAN 双传输（MPLS 主 + 互联网备），语音走 AAR，"丢包 1% 或时延 150ms 切到备链路"。上线后语音每小时断几秒，且切换频繁。 Troubleshooting : 排查过程 ： The AAR logs in vManage showed 20–40 switches back and forth between the two TLOCs every hour BFD probes: MPLS latency occasionally jumped to 160 ms (jitter on the carrier side), just crossing the 150 ms threshold AAR's hold-down / backoff times were at very short defaults, so the path switched back the moment the link recovered — creating a ping-pong The root cause was a threshold sitting right inside the real fluctuation band : measured latency was 130–165 ms, and the 150 ms threshold was in the middle of that band vManage 的 AAR 日志显示 每小时在两个 TLOC 之间来回切 20~40 次 BFD 探测：MPLS 链路时延偶发跳到 160ms（运营商侧抖动），刚好越过 150ms 阈值 AAR 的 hold-down / backoff 时间 默认为很短，链路一恢复立刻切回，形成"乒乓" 根因是 阈值贴着实际波动区间 ：实测时延 130–165ms，阈值 150ms 正好在波动带中间 Fix : 修复 ： Action Explanation Set the threshold from P95, not the mean Measured P95 was 168 ms → set the threshold to 200 ms so switching happens only on genuine degradation Stretch the hold-down Switch away quickly (seconds), switch back slowly (minutes) to avoid ping-pong Prefer loss/jitter over latency as the primary criterion Voice is more sensitive to loss/jitter and tolerates latency better Keep voice on dedicated MPLS circuits at critical sites AAR should be a safety net, not the primary path selector 动作 说明 阈值按 P95 而非均值设定 实测 P95 为 168ms → 阈值设 200ms，只有真正劣化才切 拉开 hold-down 切走要快（几秒），切回要慢（几分钟），避免来回 优先用丢包/抖动而非时延做主判据 语音对丢包/抖动更敏感，时延容忍度更高 关键站点保留 MPLS 专线承载语音 AAR 只做兜底，不承担主选路 Lesson : AAR is not "smart once configured" . SLA thresholds must be set from measured distributions , and the two asymmetric parameters "conditions for switching away" and "conditions for switching back" must be designed explicitly. s: Lessons from Practice · 实战经验总结
x: Lessons from Practice · 实战经验总结 Ask "what must be isolated" before asking "which tunnel". The first question in technology selection is not MPLS versus SD-WAN but "to what degree must services be isolated, and where are the isolation boundaries". Get the isolation model wrong and every later configuration is wasted. RT is policy, RD is a number. When "routes do not get through", compare export/import RTs first; when "routes are duplicated", check RD uniqueness first. Confusing these two costs a full day of troubleshooting. Encapsulation always creates two debts: MTU and QoS. Every tunnel or label stack must answer two questions: what is the underlay MTU and what about UDP; and how are EXP/DSCP mapped and is EXP preserved on the last hop. If these are not written into the design document, they will come back as "some applications are occasionally slow". A backdoor link actively steals traffic; it will not sit quietly as a backup. If a backdoor exists you must handle protocol preference explicitly (sham link / SoO), otherwise the convergence window becomes a loop window. Once the control plane is centralized, the controller itself becomes the new single point. vSmart, control plane nodes, and DNA Center must all be made redundant, backed up, and version- and certificate-managed to "core infrastructure" standards. SDN moves the failure from "one device" to "one cluster". Do not adopt new technology for its own sake. VPLS and MPLS TE can keep running fine in brownfield networks; the reason to choose EVPN/SR/SD-WAN for new builds should be operational cost or business agility , not "the vendor says it is the trend". 先问"要不要隔离"，再问"用什么隧道"。 虚拟化技术选型的第一问不是 MPLS 还是 SD-WAN，而是"业务之间必须隔离到什么程度、隔离边界在哪"。隔离模型定错，后面所有配置都白做。 RT 是策略，RD 是编号。 见到"路由不通"先比 export/import RT，见到"路由重复"先查 RD 唯一性。这两件事混淆，排障会走一整天弯路。 封装必然带来 MTU 与 QoS 两个债。 每个隧道/标签都要回答两个问题：underlay MTU 多少、UDP 怎么办；EXP/DSCP 怎么映射、最后一跳是否保留。这两个问题不写进设计文档，上线后一定会以"某些应用偶尔慢"的形式回来。 后门链路会主动抢流量，不会乖乖当备份。 有后门就必须显式处理协议优先级（sham-link / SoO），否则收敛期就是环路期。 控制面集

s: Chapter Summary · 本章小结
x: Chapter Summary · 本章小结 The three main threads of network virtualization — isolation (VRF/RT, VNI) , separation of identity from location (LISP/EVPN) , and separation of control from forwarding (SDN controllers) — recur throughout MPLS, VXLAN, SD-Access, and SD-WAN. In design you really only have to answer four questions: 网络虚拟化的三条主线 —— 隔离（VRF/RT、VNI） 、 标识与位置分离（LISP/EVPN） 、 控制转发分离（SDN 控制器） —— 在 MPLS、VXLAN、SD-Access、SD-WAN 里反复出现。设计时真正要回答的四个问题： Where is the isolation boundary? — determines the split of VRFs/RTs and service VPNs How is encapsulation overhead absorbed? — determines the MTU plan and the MSS/QoS policy Who owns the control plane? — determines whether to use RRs, vSmart, or distributed protocols, and how to make them redundant How does it converge on failure? — determines BFD parameters, AAR thresholds, FRR, and hold-down 隔离边界在哪？ —— 决定 VRF/RT 与 Service VPN 的划分 封装开销怎么消化？ —— 决定 MTU 规划与 MSS/QoS 策略 控制面谁负责？ —— 决定用 RR、vSmart 还是分布式协议，以及冗余方式 失效时怎么收敛？ —— 决定 BFD 参数、AAR 阈值、FRR 与 hold-down Answer these four questions clearly and which vendor feature you use becomes an implementation detail. 这四个问题答清楚，具体用哪家厂商的哪项特性只是实现细节。

In an enterprise that fully interconnects every branch with IPsec, if one PC inside a branch is compromised, the attacker can still use those encrypted tunnels to move laterally across the whole network — and it is even harder for you to notice, because all traffic looks like legitimate encrypted sessions. 这就是"加密隧道 ≠ 安全架构"的根本原因 。一个把所有分支用 IPsec 全互连的企业，如果分支里有一台被入侵的 PC，攻击者照样可以借助这些加密隧道横向移动到全网 —— 你甚至更难发现，因为流量看起来都是合法的加密会话。 Counter-Intuitive Truth #3: The Cost of Security Is Not in "Buying", It Is in "Changing Processes" · 反直觉三：安全的成本不在"买",在"改流程" In an 802.1X project, procurement and configuration take about 30% of the effort; the other 70% goes into: what to do about this printer that does not support 802.1X, what to do when the medical device vendor refuses to cooperate, how visitors get on, how to fall back when the authentication server dies, and who is on duty when things break . 一个 802.1X 项目，设备采购和配置大概占 30% 的精力；剩下 70% 花在： 这台打印机不支持 802.1X 怎么办、医疗设备厂商拒绝配合怎么办、访客怎么走、认证服务器挂了怎么降级、出问题谁值班 。 That 70% is what CCDE tests. However elegant the technical design, without a fallback path, an exception process, and a clear operational owner , it will be rolled back in its entirety on day one because of one old device. x: onstraints you must remember : 三个必须记住的设计约束 ： The management module must be able to survive independently : the management network must not depend on the network it manages. When the managed network is down you still have to be able to get in and fix it — that is exactly why OOB management is worth more than "a management VLAN inside the production network". The core module carries no policy : the core is about forwarding capacity and stability, and nothing requiring per-packet inspection should be pushed onto it. Inserting a firewall in the middle of the core makes core availability equal to firewall availability. Within a module there is no mutual inspection by default : the price of modularity is that "lateral traffic inside a module is uncontrolled". Every real project therefore needs micro-segmentation inside the module (east-west firewalls in the data center, SGT in the campus). 管理模块必须可独立存活 ：管理网不能依赖它管理的被管网络。被管网络断了，你还要能上去修 —— 这就是为什么 OOB 管理比"在业务网里开个管理 VLAN"值钱。 核心模块不放策略 ：核心追求的是转发能力和稳定性，任何需要逐包检查的东西都不该压在这里。把防火墙插在核心中间，等于让核心的可用性等于防火墙的可用性。 同一模块内默认不互相检查 ：模块化的代价是"模块内横向流量不受控"。所以真实项目里都需要在模块内部再做 微分段 （如数据中心内的东西向防火墙、园区内的 SGT）。

x: minutes after the tunnels were restarted. Business between headquarters and the branches was widely interrupted. Troubleshooting : IKE debugging showed phase 1 failed: certificate validation failed . The certificate validity periods were fine. Comparing the time at headquarters with the branches revealed that the branches' NTP server address pointed at an old IP that had been decommissioned long ago , so the devices fell back to their local clocks and had drifted 40 minutes over a few months. Why they failed "one after another" : there were multiple certificates (headquarters CA, third-party CA), and each branch certificate had different notBefore/notAfter values, so failure only triggered when the drift crossed a particular certificate boundary. That is why it looked like "one device at a time", resembling a hardware problem. Why "a restart fixed it for a while" : when renegotiating, if it happened to hit another certificate or fell back to the PSK configuration, it worked temporarily; the next rekey failed again. Root cause : during a data center relocation two years earlier the NTP server IP changed, the configuration template was never updated, and the branch devices used an unauthenticated NTP client with a single upstream ; when the upstream became unreachable they silently used the local clock (the default ntp server produces no alarm at all). Fix : cfg ntp authentication-key 1 sha1 key ntp authenticate ntp trusted-key 1 ntp server 10.1.1.10 key 1 prefer ntp server 10.1.1.11 key 1 ntp access-group peer 20 ! The key part: monitoring ! Collect "clock offset" and "NTP stratum"; alarm when offset 1 s and when stratum is 16 (unreachable) Three design lessons : 1. NTP needs at least two upstreams, and they must cross different network paths (two addresses on the same core switch do not count). 2. The command differs by platform, e.g.: platform security secure-boot enable ! 开启镜像完整性校验（平台支持时） verify /md5 flash:image.bin 已知官方哈希 ! 开启 Secure Boot（阻止未签名镜像启动） ! 平台命令不同，如： platform security secure-boot enable 🔥 Case: "compliance drift" across a device fleet A retail enterprise had 1,800 store switches. The security team produced a complete hardening baseline (Telnet off, strong passwords, SSH only, unused ports disabled). One year later a compliance audit sampled 50 devices: 31 failed the baseline . The root cause was not that someone deliberately reverted them : - When a store device was replaced, the spares in the depot were factory default , and the installer only followed a paper procedure of "make it work" — nobody ran the baseline script - The configuration template existed in three versions from three different periods, and legacy store configurations were never upgraded - There was no configuration backup, so nobody could compare "where the current state differs from the baseline" The fix (this is what real "device hardening" means) : 1. Version the configuration templates (Git management plus change review) 2. Automate hardening at deployment (ZTP + template push; humans cannot skip it) 3. Automated daily baseline comparison with drift alerts (the only way to stop drift) 4. Pre-configure depot spares and do not allow "bare metal" onto a site Lesson : hardening is not a one-off project, it is a continuously verified pipeli

Without a "detect deviation" mechanism, any baseline degrades into a formality within 12 months. 🔥 案例：批量设备的"合规漂移" 一家零售企业有 1,800 台门店交换机。安全团队做了完整的加固基线（关 Telnet、强密码、SSH only、关闭未用端口）。一年后合规审计抽检 50 台， 31 台不满足基线 。 根因不是有人故意改回去 ，而是： - 门店故障更换设备时，备件库的设备是 出厂配置 ，装机人员只按照"能通就行"的纸质流程配置，没人跑基线脚本 - 配置模板在三个不同时期有过三个版本，老门店的存量配置从未升级 - 没有配置备份，无法比对"现在跟基线差在哪" 修复 （这才是真正的"设备加固"）： 1. 配置模板版本化 （Git 管理 + 变更评审） 2. 上线即自动化加固 （零接触部署 ZTP + 模板下发，人不能跳过） 3. 每日自动基线比对 ，差异告警（这是唯一能防住漂移的手段） 4. 备件库设备预配置 ，不允许"裸机"进入现场 教训 ：加固不是一次性的项目，是一条 持续校验的流水线 。没有"检测偏离"的机制，任何基线都会在 12 个月内衰减到形同虚设。 Management Plane Security · 管理平面安全 The core design question for the management plane is: how far does an attacker have to go before touching the management path? 管理平面的核心设计问题是： 攻击者要走到多远才能碰到管理通路？ Architecture Topology Security Cost Fit In-band management Management traffic uses production interfaces and shares links with business traffic Low Lowest Small networks, temporary environments Management VLAN A separate VLAN, but on the same physical link Medium (depends on VLAN isolation quality) Low Small and medium campuses Management VRF A separate routing table with interfaces assigned to a VRF Medium–high (routing domain isolation) Medium Medium enterprises Out-of-band management (OOB) Separate physical network + separate devices + separate links Highest High (needs separate switches, dedicated lines, terminal servers) Large enterprises, finance, industrial 架构 拓扑 安全性 成本 适用 带内管理 (In-Band) 管理流量走业务接口，与业务共用链路 低 最低 小型网络、临时环境 管理 VLAN 独立 VLAN，但在同一物理链路上 中（依赖 VLAN 隔离质量） 低 中小型园区 管理 VRF 独立路由表，接口划分到 VRF 中-高（路由域隔离） 中 中型企业 带外管理 (OOB) 独立物理网络 + 独立设备 + 独立链路 最高 高（需独立交换机、专线、终端服务器） 大型企业、金融、工业 The key judgment : if the failure scenario is "the production network is down and you need to get in and fix it", then in-band management fails at exactly that moment . That is the value of OOB — it is not "more secure", it is "still available when production has failed" . 关键判断 ：如果故障场景是"业务网瘫痪，你需要进去修"，那么 带内管理在那一刻同时失效 。这就是 OOB 的价值 —— 它不是"更安全"，而是 "在业务故障时仍然可用" 。 Layered

x: 所有登录、命令、屏幕录像集中在堡垒机 人员离职要改上百台设备的密码 只禁用堡垒机上一个账号 无法做命令级审批和高危命令拦截 可以拦截 no router bgp 、 reload 等 🔥 Case: one "temporary" management interface left open Background : to let an external integrator debug a newly deployed WLC, a manufacturing enterprise opened an any → public-IP:8443 rule on the egress firewall, with a promise to "close it in two weeks". What happened : the rule was forgotten for 14 months. The WLC's management page had an unpatched vulnerability, was hit by an automated scanner, and the attacker gained WLC administrative access — and from there the RADIUS shared key and SNMP community strings stored on the device. The attacker then used SNMP RW to change the configuration of several switches and planted a TCL script as a persistence backdoor. Why it went unnoticed : device logs only went to the local buffer (4 KB by default, rolling), with no centralized logging, and the SNMP configuration changes raised no alerts. The fundamental problems exposed (more memorable than the vulnerability itself) : 1. Temporary rules had no expiry mechanism — the firewall has no "rule validity" field, so it relies on human memory 2. The management plane was exposed to the Internet — debugging should have gone through a bastion/VPN jump host, not an open port 3. Credential management had failed — the RADIUS shared key was identical network-wide and had never been rotated, so one leak broke everything 4. No configuration change detection — SNMP RW should be disabled in production ( no snmp-server community x RW ) 5. Local-only logging — no forensics, no way to determine the blast radius The right approach at the design level : Requirement Wrong approach Right approach External vendor debugging Open a port on the egress A temporary VPN account (auto-expiring) + bastion + session recording Remote management Expose device management ports to the Internet Reverse proxy/gateway + strong authentication ; never expose the management plane directly Temporary policy Add a rule by hand R

CoPP 的思路是： 在数据平面到控制平面的入口处，对"上送 CPU 的流量"做分类限速 ，保证重要的协议流量不被垃圾流量淹没。 data plane ──→ [CoPP policy] ──→ control plane (CPU) │ └──→ excess dropped (handled per class) 数据平面 ──→ [CoPP 策略] ──→ 控制平面 (CPU) │ └──→ 超速部分丢弃（按类分别处理） The core difficulty of CoPP is not configuration but "how fast to set it" . This is a classic CCDE exam point: CoPP 的核心难点不是配置，是"速率定多少" 。这是 CCDE 的典型考点： Traffic class Typical rate reference Consequence of setting it too low Consequence of setting it too high Routing protocols (OSPF/IS-IS/BGP) Hundreds of kbps to a few Mbps (depends on neighbor count and route volume) Neighbors time out and routes flap Protocol floods pass through Management protocols (SSH/SNMP/Syslog) Hundreds of kbps Operations cannot log in CPU saturated during brute-force attacks ICMP Low (tens of kbps), but leave headroom for TTL exceeded traceroute breaks, PMTUD black holes ICMP floods ARP Depends on VLAN size, usually tens to hundreds of kbps ARP resolution fails, hosts unreachable ARP broadcast storms Non-IP / abnormal traffic Extremely low, or drop outright — Unknown attack surface 流量类别 典型速率参考 定太低的后果 定太高的后果 路由协议 （OSPF/IS-IS/BGP） 数百 kbps ~ 数 Mbps（视邻居数与路由量） 邻居超时断开，路由震荡 允许协议洪泛穿透 管理协议 （SSH/SNMP/Syslog） 数百 kbps 运维登不上设备 被爆破时 CPU 被吃满 ICMP 低（几十 kbps），但要给 TTL 超时留余量 traceroute 失效、PMTUD 黑洞 ICMP 洪泛 ARP 视 VLAN 规模，通常 数十~数百 kbps ARP 解析失败，主机不通 ARP 广播风暴 非 IP / 异常流量 极低或直接丢弃 — 未知攻击面 The right way to design the rates (three steps) : 速率设计的正确方法（三步） ： Measure

With CoPP's single bucket, the two compete with each other. 价值 ：攻击者用"大量发往设备本机的流量"打 CPU 时，host 子接口的策略可以精确限速，而不影响 transit 的处理。CoPP 只有一个策略桶时，两者会互相挤占。 Protection Mechanism 3: rACL / iACL (Receive ACL / Infrastructure ACL) 保护机制三：rACL / iACL（接收 ACL / 基础设施 ACL） An ACL is a "whitelist"; CoPP is "rate limiting". They are the "last line", but also the only means that covers "traffic the device does not participate in deciding". 数据平面的安全手段，本质上只有两类： 过滤（ACL）+ 反欺骗（uRPF / Source Guard） 。它们是"最后一道"，但也是唯一能覆盖"设备不参与决策的流量"的手段。 uRPF: Unicast Reverse Path Forwarding uRPF：单播反向路径转发 Principle : on receiving a packet, check whether the source IP "should" arrive through this interface . If not, drop it — because the source address is spoofed. 原理 ：收到一个包，检查 源 IP 是否"应该"从这个人来的接口到达 。如果不是，就丢弃 —— 因为源地址是伪造的。 Mode Decision rule What it stops What it can wrongly drop Where to apply Strict The source IP's optimal route outgoing interface must equal the incoming interface Strong — blocks the vast majority of source address spoofing Asymmetric routing (different forward/return paths), multihomed access, policy-routing scenarios Single-egress access layer, stub network edges Loose It is enough that any reachable route exists for the source IP (the outgoing interface is not checked) Weak — only blocks "completely unroutable" sources (e.g. private addresses arriving from the Internet) Almost never wrongly drops Multi-egress networks, backbones, peering Feasible (VRF-aware) A route to the source IP exists within a specified VRF/interface group Medium — and it handles MPLS/VPN multi-instance Relatively complex to configure VRF environments, MPLS VPNs 模式 判定规则 能防什么 会误杀什么 适用位置 Strict（严格） 源 IP 的 最优路由出接口 必须等于入接口 强 — 拦掉绝大多数源地址伪造 非对称路由 （去回路径不同）、多宿接入、策略路由场景 单出口的接入层、Stub 网络边缘 Loose（松散） 源 IP 的 路由表中存在任意一条可达路由 即可（不检查出接口） 弱 — 只能拦"完全不可路由"的源（如私网地址从公网进来） 基本不误杀 多出口网络、骨干、对等互联 Feasible（可行，VRF 感知） 在 指定 VRF/接口组 内存在到源 IP 的路由 中 — 且能处理 MPLS/VPN 多实例 配置相对复杂 VRF

The core switch uplinked to two egress routers. The change : a security baseline upgrade required "uRPF strict enabled network-wide" for compliance. The branch applied ip verify unicast source reachable-via rx from the template. The failure : heavy packet loss on video conferencing and occasional business interruptions. ping worked (small packets, following the primary path), but large-volume, long-lived sessions failed. Root cause : - After PBR the video traffic left through the Internet egress, but the return path came over MPLS (the far end does not follow your PBR) - When return packets entered the MPLS interface, the optimal outgoing interface for that source IP was the Internet interface → strict uRPF judged "abnormal source address" → packet dropped - Small packets and short connections sometimes got through (hitting connected routes or cache), which made it "look like a performance problem" Why it took so long to find : ping worked, traceroute worked, interfaces showed no errors; only the server side could see "some connections time out".
