The right approach : Branch uplinks (multiple egresses) → loose or feasible, never strict Pure stub access layer (single egress) → strict (no asymmetry possible there) Backbone/peering → loose The more fundamental lesson : the correctness of a uRPF mode depends on whether routing is symmetric, and whether routing is symmetric depends on your design. A compliance requirement to "configure strict everywhere" is guaranteed to break multi-egress networks. Compliance must be translated at the design level into "the right mode at each location plus a verification method", not a template pushed network-wide. 🔥 真实事故：strict uRPF 打死了双出口分支 背景 ：某零售企业分支有两条出口（MPLS 专线为主、Internet 备份），部署了 PBR 让"视频会议走 Internet，业务走 MPLS"。核心交换机上行接两台出口路由器。 变更 ：安全基线升级，全网"必须开启 uRPF strict"（合规要求）。分支按模板配了 ip verify unicast source reachable-via rx 。 故障 ：视频会议大量丢包，业务偶发中断。 ping 正常（小包、走主路径），但大流量、长时间会话失败。 根因 ： - 视频流量经 PBR 决策后从 Internet 出口出去，但 回程走 MPLS （对端不遵循你的 PBR） - 回程包进入 MPLS 接口时，源 IP 查表的最优出接口是 Internet 接口 （因为 PBR 只影响转发而不影响 RIB，但此处实际是 RIB 里该源的返回路径更优） → strict uRPF 判定"源地址异常" → 丢包 - 小包/短连接因为可能命中了直连路由或缓存，偶尔能通，导致"看起来是性能问题" 为什么排查慢 ： ping 通、 traceroute 通、接口无错包；只有服务器侧能看到"部分连接超时"。 uRPF 丢弃计数是唯一线索 ： show ip interface | include verify 里的 suppressed 计数在飙升。 正确做法 ： 分支上联口（多出口） → loose 或 feasible，不用 strict 纯 Stub 接入层（单出口）→ strict（此时不会有非对称） 主干/对等互联 → loose 更本质的教训 ： uRPF 模式的正确性取决于"路由是否对称"，而路由是否对称取决于你的设计。 一个"全网统一配 strict"的合规要求，在多出口网络里必然出事。合规要求应该在设计层面翻译成"每个位置用合适的模式 + 有验证方法"，而不是一条模板刷全网。 IP Source Guard and DHCP Snooping IP Source Guard 与 DHCP Snooping These are access-layer binding table mechanisms, complementary to uRPF: uRPF is based on the routing table (coarse), while Source Guard is based on the DHCP Snooping binding table (precise down to MAC-IP-port). 这两个是 接入层 的绑定表机制，与 uRPF 互补：uRPF 基于路由表（粗粒度），Source Guard 基于 DHCP Snooping 绑定表（精确到 MAC-IP-端口）。 Mechanism What table it builds What it blocks DHCP Snooping A port ↔ MAC ↔ IP ↔ VLAN ↔ lease binding table DHCP server responses on unt

The Layer 2 problem is exactly that traffic within the same VLAN never passes through any Layer 3 device at all . 三层的安全体系（防火墙、路由策略、网段隔离）有一个共同前提： 流量必须经过你部署策略的那个设备 。而二层的问题在于 —— 同一个 VLAN 内的流量，压根不经过任何三层设备 。 [PC-A] ──┐ ├── L2 Switch ── (default gateway / firewall) ← policy lives here [PC-B] ──┘ PC-A → PC-B traffic: forwarded only inside the switch, never traversing the firewall [PC-A] ──┐ ├── L2 Switch ── (默认网关 / 防火墙) ← 策略在这里 [PC-B] ──┘ PC-A → PC-B 的流量：只在交换机内部转发，永远不经过防火墙 This is the physical basis for lateral movement. After an attacker gets onto one PC, they can ARP-spoof to capture traffic on the same subnet, scan the internal network, and reach servers in the same VLAN directly. Every Layer 3 policy is bypassed. 这就是"横向移动"的物理基础 。攻击者进入一台 PC 之后，可以：ARP 欺骗拿到同网段流量、扫内网、直接访问同 VLAN 的服务器。所有三层策略全部失效。 The design-level conclusion : the VLAN boundary is the smallest security domain boundary . If a VLAN holds 500 devices and 499 of them do not trust each other, that design has failed security-wise — you have effectively put 500 devices in one "trust domain". 设计层面的结论 ： VLAN 的划分就是最小的安全域边界 。如果一个 VLAN 里有 500 台设备，其中 499 台互不信任，那这个设计在安全上是失败的 —— 你等于把 500 台设备放在同

Outcome : on the night of go-live, two anesthesia monitors in the operating rooms and three infusion pumps in the ICU went offline. The vendor's engineers arrived and said "it is a network problem, not our responsibility". Root cause : these medical devices use static IPs and the vendor does not allow configuration changes (some are fixed at the factory; changing the IP requires vendor authorization). They were therefore not in the DHCP Snooping binding table, and DAI/Source Guard treated their traffic as illegal and dropped it. Why testing missed it : the pilot was in the administration building (a DHCP environment of PCs and printers) and did not cover any medical devices . Remediation (three options in theory; a combination was used in practice) : 1. Static binding : ip source binding 0011.2233.4455 10.20.30.40 vlan 20 interface Gi1/0/12 (must be entered one by one, unmaintainable when there are many devices) 2. Exempt the port : no ip arp inspection or set the port as trusted (minimize the scope and accept the residual risk) 3. Give static devices their own VLAN (recommended): one VLAN for medical devices without DAI, with PVLAN/ACLs as compensating isolation The real lessons (from a CCDE perspective) : - The scope of a network security measure must be produced together with a "business device compatibility list" . You cannot deliver only the "technical design"; you must also deliver "which devices are not supported and what to do about them". - The peculiarities of IoT/medica

All an attacker has to do is send an RA and the entire VLAN's IPv6 default route points at them — many attack tools use exactly this for man-in-the-middle attacks (because IPv6 takes precedence over IPv4). The right approach (in a pure IPv4 network): cfg ! Switch/router side: do not send RAs, do not route IPv6 no ipv6 unicast-routing interface range GigabitEthernet1/0/1-48 ipv6 nd ra suppress all ! RA Guard on the access layer (where the switch supports it) ipv6 nd raguard policy HOST device-role host At the same time disable IPv6 or RA acceptance at the host image level (Group Policy / sysctl). ⚠️ 最容易被忽略的一条 ：企业网"只用 IPv4"，于是 没有任何 IPv6 安全策略 。而 Windows/Linux/macOS 默认开启 IPv6 且接受 RA 。攻击者只要发 RA，就能把整个 VLAN 的 IPv6 默认路由指向自己 —— 很多攻击工具正是利用这一点做中间人（因为 IPv6 优先于 IPv4）。 正确做法 （在纯 IPv4 网络中）： cfg ! 交换机/路由器侧：不发 RA、不路由 IPv6 no ipv6 unicast-routing interface range GigabitEthernet1/0/1-48 ipv6 nd ra suppress all ! 接入层用 RA Guard（交换机支持时） ipv6 nd raguard policy HOST device-role host 同时在主机镜像层面禁用 IPv6 或禁用 RA 接受（组策略 / sysctl）。 6. 802.1X: Port-Level Admission Control 6. 802.1X：端口级准入 802.1X is the only mechanism that raises "can I connect" from the physical layer to the identity layer . The ordering problem : with authentication order dot1x mab the switch tries dot1x first (waiting up to 30 seconds before falling back to MAB), and the printer had already given up and reported "network unavailable" within those 30 seconds — so the user assumed it was broken and called the helpdesk Fix : - For printer-only ports use authentication order mab ( MAB before dot1x ), cutting authentication time from 30 s to 3 s - Give printers DHCP static reservations plus automatic synchronization of the MAB whitelist (generated from IPAM/DHCP tables instead of being maintained by hand) - Old devices that cannot do MAB go into a "restricted VLAN" (print server + DHCP/DNS only) Four design-level lessons : 1. The MAC whitelist must be synchronized automatically (a manually maintained whitelist always rots within six months) 2. Authentication latency must be tested , not just "whether it connects". A 30-second authentication wait looks like "the network is broken" from the user's point of view 3. Design the fallback path first : what happens when RADIUS is unavailable ( authentication critical , or temporarily authentication open ), otherwise a RADIUS outage takes the whole network down 4. Exceptional devices need a home : not "whitelist" and not "do nothing", but "put it in a restricted VLAN" so it can only do what it should 🔥 案例：802.1X 上线把 300 台打印机打成"砖" 背景 ：某 5,000 人企业做准入项目，经过 3 个月 monitor mode 收集，发现 1,200 台设备不支持 802.1X。方案定为：支持者走 PEAP-MSCHAPv2，不支持的走 MAB（MAC 白名单）。 上线第一天 ：约 300 台打印机离线。MAB 白名单里 明明有它们的 MAC 。 根因（三个叠加） ： 1. 打印机的 MAC 白名单是从老的 DHCP Snooping 表导出的 ，其中有一部分打印机 换过网卡 （维修时更换主板），MAC 已变 2. 部分打印机的 MAB 请求 根本不发 （某些型号在链路 up 后不发 EAPOL-Start，需要交换机主动 dot1x tx-period 触发，而某些老型号对主动请求不回） 3. Private VLAN（端口隔离） Principle : split one primary VLAN into multiple secondary VLANs, where roles decide whether ports can talk to each other. 原理 ：在一个主 VLAN 内划分多个子 VLAN，端口之间按角色决定能否互通。 Port type Can communicate with Promiscuous All ports (usually the gateway/server port) Isolated Only promiscuous ; isolated ports cannot reach each other at all Community Ports in the same community plus promiscuous 端口类型 能与谁通信 Promiscuous（混杂） 与所有端口（通常是网关/服务器口） Isolated（隔离） 只能与 promiscuous ，隔离口之间完全不通 Community（团体） 与同 community 的端口 + promiscuous Where it fits : 适用场景 ： Scenario Configuration Benefit Hotels/dormitories/apartments Every room isolated Residents cannot reach each other while sharing one subnet and gateway Multiple web servers in a DMZ isolated + one promiscuous as LB/gateway A compromised server cannot move laterally Carrier access isolated Natural customer isolation 场景 配置 收益 酒店/宿舍/公寓 每房间 isolated 住户之间不能互访，共享一个网段和网关 DMZ 多台 Web 服务器 isolated + 一台 promiscuous 做 LB/网关 一台被攻破不能横向到其他 运营商接入 isolated 天然的客户隔离 Limitations (why it is not widespread) : 局限（为什么不普及） ： Complex configuration , with significant behavioral differences between vendors Difficult across switches (requires VTPv3 or manual synchronization, which easily drifts) Incompatible with VXLAN/EVPN (there is no PVLAN concept in an overlay) Hard to troubleshoot : when it does not work you cannot quickly tell whether PVLAN, an ACL, or routing is at fault 配置复杂 ，且各厂商行为差异大 跨交换机难做 （需 VTPv3 或手工同步，容易不一致） 与 VXLAN/EVPN 环境不兼容 （overlay 里没有 PVLAN 概念）

An endpoint tagged "employee" that has already been compromised still accesses everything employees can access — SGT cannot help with that. The correct relationship is layered : 802.1X → confirm identity (who you are) ↓ SGT → grant permission (where you may go) ← authorization layer ↓ Firewall/IPS → inspect content (what you bring in) ← inspection layer ↓ Micro-segmentation/host protection → prevent lateral movement (where you spread) ← isolation layer No layer can replace another. Compressing all four into "we deployed SGT, so we are secure" means only authorization was done and inspection was skipped. ⚠️ "SGT 能替代防火墙"是最常见的误解 SGT 只做 授权 （允许/拒绝）， 不做威胁检查 。一个被授予"员工"标签但已被入侵的终端，仍然会以"员工"权限访问所有员工可访问的资源 —— SGT 对此无能为力。 正确的关系是 分层 ： 802.1X → 确认身份（你是谁） ↓ SGT → 授予权限（你能到哪） ← 授权层 ↓ 防火墙/IPS → 检查内容（你带进来什么） ← 检查层 ↓ 微分段/主机防护 → 防止横向（你扩散到哪）← 隔离层 任何一层都不能替代其他层 。把四层压成"上了 SGT 就安全了"，就等于只做了授权没做检查。 The Three Routes to Data Center Micro-Segmentation · 数据中心微分段的三条路线 Route Mechanism When it fits Cost Network side (EPG/ACI, VXLAN + security groups) Policy enforced in the fabric New DCs, private cloud Strongly tied to a vendor architecture; high migration cost Host side (agent / eBPF / container CNI) Policy enforced in the OS kernel Virtualization/container-heavy, hybrid cloud Requires agents; does not cover bare metal or network devices Hybrid (coarse in the network, fine on hosts) East-west entry coarsely segmented in the fabric, finely segmented inside the host Most realistic Requires a mapping between two policy systems 路线 机制 适用 代价 网络侧（EPG/ACI、VXLAN + 安全组） 策

Many designs treat "putting businesses in different VRFs" as a security measure, but if the VRFs exchange route-target s or point static routes at each other on the core, the isolation does not exist. Security is about "policy" (who is allowed where), not about "partitioning" (how the tables are split). 关键区分 ： VRF 是路由隔离，不是安全隔离 。很多设计把"业务放不同 VRF"当成安全措施，但如果 VRF 之间在核心上做了 route-target 互导或静态路由互指，隔离就等于不存在。 安全的本质是"策略"（谁被允许到哪里），不是"分区"（怎么划表）。 🔥 Case: the "fake security" of VRF isolation Scenario : a bank split its network into "office VRF", "production VRF", and "partner VRF" and claimed "the three domains are fully isolated". The login page worked, the list pages worked, but clicking Submit spun forever and eventually timed out . The same laptop over 4G (without IPsec) worked fine. Troubleshooting : ping -l 1400 failed and ping -l 1200 succeeded → an MTU problem. But ip mtu 1400 was already in the configuration. Root cause : ip mtu applies to the outbound direction of the tunnel interface and only affects "packets the router itself emits". Here the traffic was PC (1500) → branch router → tunnel , so the branch router needed to fragment during encapsulation because of the MTU limit — but crypto ipsec df-bit clear was not enabled, and a device in the path was dropping ICMP, so PMTUD was broken and the large packets were silently dropped. Why "login works but submit fails" : the login request parameters are small (a few hundred bytes); the submit form contains attachments/long text (several KB), which exceed the MSS and need fragmentation. TCP had already negotiated its segment size based on 1500, and the intermediate device dropped rather than fragmented. The final fix : cfg interface Tunnel0 ip mtu 1400 ip tcp adjust-mss 1360 ! this line is the real fix At the same time net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1 was enabled on the headquarters servers as a fallback. Design-level lessons : 1. Any technology that introduces encapsulation (IPsec, GRE, VXLAN, MPLS, PPPoE) requires the MTU/MSS calculation to be written explicitly into the design document — "it pings after configuration" is not acceptance. 2. Acceptance testing must include large-packet tests ( ping -l 1400 -f , large file uploads, long SQL queries). Testing only ping and the HTTP home page misses 90% of MTU problems. 3. PMTUD generally fails in real net

Their common trait: nothing was technically misconfigured — the design assumptions were wrong. 以下三个案例是"设计级"的，覆盖控制平面、远程访问、整体架构重构三条主线。它们共同的特点是： 技术上都没有配错，错在设计假设 。 Case 1: CoPP Rate Limiting Broke a Full BGP Table Update · 案例一：CoPP 限速把 BGP 全表更新打掉 Background : at a service provider edge network, one border router had two eBGP sessions upstream and received about 950,000 IPv4 routes. To pass a compliance assessment the security team deployed CoPP from a "standard template". 背景 ：某运营商边缘网络，一台边界路由器与上游有两条 eBGP 会话，接收 约 95 万条 IPv4 路由。安全团队为通过等保测评，按"标准模板"部署了 CoPP。 Template content (excerpt) : 模板内容（节选） ： class-map match-all CM-BGP match access-group name CPP-BGP policy-map PM-COPP class CM-BGP police rate 500000 bps ! 500 kbps conform-action transmit exceed-action drop class-map match-all CM-BGP match access-group name CPP-BGP policy-map PM-COPP class CM-BGP police rate 500000 bps ! 500 kbps conform-action transmit exceed-action drop The failure : 故障现象 ： Time Symptom Daytime on the deployment day Everything normal , CPU stable 02:10 that night Upstream maintenance reset the BGP session 02:10 – 02:40 Router CPU hit 90%, some prefixes were missing, some users could not reach specific sites After 02:40 Recovered on its own 时间点 现象 部署当天白天 一切正常 ，CPU 平稳 当天凌晨 02:10 上游做维护，BGP 会话复位 02:10 ~ 02:40 路由器 CPU 冲到 90%，部分前缀缺失， 部分用户访问特定站点不通 02:40 后 自行恢复 Root cause analysis : 根因分析 ： Steady state vs burst : in steady state BGP only sends keepalives (tens of bytes per second), so 500 kbps is plenty. But a session rebuild requires the full table : 950,000 routes at roughly 50–100 bytes per UPDATE, plus TCP retransmissions, needs 30–80 Mbps at peak (depending on the upstream send rate and the TCP window). Why "some prefixes were missing" yet it "looked usable" : the default route arrived first so most traffic was fine; only traffic toward specific prefixes took a wrong path or was black-holed — and this class of failure is extremely hard for users to describe accurately ("some websites will not open"). Why the CPU spiked : heavy route computation during BGP convergence plus processing of retransmitted messages after drops. CoPP only limits the inbound rate; it cannot reduce the CPU's computational load. 稳态 vs 突发 ：BGP 稳态下只有 keepalive（几十字节/秒），500 kbps 绰绰有余。但 会话重建时要接收全表 ：95 万条路由，每条 UPDATE 报文约 50~100 字节，加上 TCP 重传， 峰值需要 30~80 Mbps （取决于上游发送速率和 TCP 窗口）。 CoPP 丢弃导致 TCP 重传风暴 ：被丢的 BGP 报文触发 TCP 重传，重传又占用更多带宽，更多被丢 → 收敛时间从正常 2 分钟拉长到 30 分钟以上。 为什么"部分前缀缺失"却"看起来能用" ：默认路由先到了，大部分流量正常；只有去往特定前缀的流量走错或黑洞 —— 这类故障 极难被用户准确描述 （"某些网站打不开"）。 为什么 CPU 冲高 ：BGP 收敛过程中大量路由计算 + 大量被丢弃后重传的报文处理。CoPP 只限制入向速率，不能减少 CPU 的计算负担。 The correct approach : 正确做法 ： Measure Description Set the rate from measured capacity The measured full-table convergence peak on this device was ~60 Mbps, so CoPP should be set to 100–200 Mbps (with headroom), not 500 kbps Separate "control plane protection" from "routing protocol protection" The BGP rate limit must be generous enough to carry the full table ; real DoS protection comes from the upstream, uRPF, and prefix filtering Use class-default as the backstop instead of strangling key classes Give key protocol classes generous quotas and the default class a strict quota (to stop real junk) Validation must include the "session rebuild" scenario Testing only steady state is not testing. The acceptance case: clear ip bgp * and observe convergence time and packet loss Alert before dropping Start with exceed-action transmit plus monitoring; only change to drop once long-term data confirms no anomalies 措施 说明 按实测容量设定 该设备实测全表收敛峰值 ~60 Mbps，CoPP 应设为 100~200 Mbps （留余量），而不是 500 kbps 区分"控制平面保护"与"路由协议

The reasonable value for a core border router and for an access switch differs by three orders of magnitude. The correct goal of "protecting the control plane" is "guarantee that legitimate protocol traffic gets through", not "limit it to some number". Get the order wrong and the protection itself becomes the source of the outage. Every security measure needs an emergency path for "when it fails itself" : can CoPP be bypassed quickly if misconfigured? There must be explicit rollback commands and an authorized person. CoPP 的速率必须从"该设备实际承载的协议负载"推导，不能套模板。 一台核心边界路由器和一台接入交换机的合理值差了三个数量级。 "保护控制平面"的正确目标是"保证合法协议流量能过"，而不是"限制到某个数字"。 顺序搞反了，保护措施本身就变成故障源。 所有安全措施都要有"它自己失效"的应急路径 ：CoPP 配错时能否快速旁路？要有明确的回退命令与授权人。 Case 2: Split Tunneling + One Compromised Laptop Took Down Headquarters · 案例二：分离隧道 + 一台被入侵的笔记本，导致总部沦陷 Background : an enterprise had 3,000 remote employees on SSL VPN with split tunneling (only 10.0.0.0/8 went over the VPN; everything else went over local broadband). Every security control can be bypassed, but offline immutable backup is the only means of recovery after "everything has fallen". Many projects spend all their money on firewalls while backups still run on a visible NAS with domain-account credentials — which is the first thing ransomware encrypts. OT and IT have different security goals : IT prioritizes "confidentiality", OT prioritizes " availability and human safety ". Managing OT with IT methods (patching, installing agents, frequent changes) directly causes production stoppages. Physical isolation plus a one-way gateway is mandatory. Migration order matters more than technology selection. With the same technical solution, doing egress before access versus access before egress carries completely different risk. s: Common Security Design Trade-offs · 安全设计的常见取舍
x: Common Security Design Trade-offs · 安全设计的常见取舍 The core CCDE exam point is "making trade-offs under given constraints". The following are the six most frequent trade-offs in the security domain: CCDE 的核心考点是"给定约束下做取舍"。以下是安全领域最高频的六组取舍： Trade-off Option A Option B How to decide Security vs availability Stricter controls (default deny, closed mode) Looser (monitor mode, whitelists) Which costs more: a business outage or a breach? Centralized vs distributed Centralized firewall (easy to manage, becomes a bottleneck) Distributed policy (no bottleneck, hard to keep consistent) Traffic volume and tolerance for failure domains Encryption overhead vs confidentiality need MACsec/IPsec everywhere Encrypt only sensitive links Physical exposure of the link + hardware acceleration capability Visibility vs performance Full NetFlow + per-packet IPS Sampling + inspect only critical paths Traffic volume + compliance requirements User experience vs control strength Full tunnel + endpoint checks Split tunnel + lightweight checks Sensitivity of the role + endpoint management capability (is there EDR) One-shot rework vs incremental migration Get it right in one go (clean architecture) Batch it (controllable risk) Almost always choose incremental , but with a clearly defined target architecture 取舍 选项 A 选项 B 判断依据 安全 vs 可用性 更严格的控制（默认拒绝、Closed Mode） 更宽松（Monitor Mode、白名单） 业务中断的代价 vs 被攻破的代价，哪个更大？ 集中 vs 分布 集中防火墙（好管理、是瓶颈） 分布式策略（无瓶颈、难一致） 流量规模与故障域容忍度 加密开销 vs 保密需求 MACsec/IPsec 全线加密 只加密敏感链路 链路的物理暴露程度 + 硬件加速能力 可见性 vs 性能 全量 NetFlow + IPS 逐包检查 采样 + 只查关键路径 流量规模 + 合规要求 用户体验 vs 控制强度 Full Tunnel + 终端检查 Split Tunnel + 轻量检查 岗位敏感度 + 终端管控能力（是否有 EDR） 一次性重构 vs 渐进迁移 一次到位（架构干净） 分批（风险可控） 几乎总是选渐进 ，但要有明确的终点架构

s: Lessons from Practice · 实战经验总结
x: Lessons from Practice · 实战经验总结 Lesson Description Defend each of the three planes separately Management plane (who can log in), control plane (who can punt to the CPU), data plane (who can pass through). Discussing "security" as one lump always leaves one side out Admission control must be phased Monitor → low-impact → closed, with quantified exit criteria per phase (failure rate, ticket volume). Going to closed in one step always ends in rollback Isolation must survive a "routing check" As long as a direct route exists between VRFs/VLANs, the isolation is a configuration illusion. Always cross domains through a stateful device Encryption and visibility require an explicit trade Wherever there is IPsec, there is no IPS. Write it into the document and compensate with endpoint-side means (EDR/log correlation) Security architectures have hidden single points NTP, AAA/RADIUS, certificates/PKI, the log server, the policy center. If any one fails, authentication and auditing across the network fail together Measure control plane rates CoPP, CPPr, and BFD timers must be set from measured peaks; template defaults regularly strangle protocols under real traffic Think about the "degraded mode" before changing anything Before admission/encryption/segmentation go live, you must have ready "how to let a specific business through without disabling the global policy" Every policy needs an owner Rules with no owner never expire and never get cleaned up. Rules must carry an expiry date and a review cycle 经验 说明 三个平面分别设防 管理平面（谁能登录）、控制平面（谁能上送 CPU）、数据平面（谁能穿过）。混在一起谈"安全"必然漏掉一边 准入必须分阶段 Monitor → Low-Impact → Closed，每阶段都有量化退出条件（失败率、工单量），一步到 Closed 必然回退 隔离要经得起"路由检查" VRF/VLAN 之间只要存在直达路由，隔离就是配置上的假象。跨域一律过有状态设备 加密与可见性必须显式取舍 哪里有 IPsec，哪里就没有 IPS。写进文档，用终端侧手段（EDR/日志关联）补偿 安全体系有隐性单点 NTP、AAA/RADIUS、证书/PKI、日志服务器、策略中心。任何一个挂了，全网认证与审计一起失效 控制面速率要实测 CoPP、CPPr、BFD 计时器都按实测峰值配，模板默认值在真实流量下经常掐死协议 变更前先想"降级模式" 准入/加密/分段上线前，必须准备好"如何在不关掉全局策略的情况下放行个别业务" 每条策略要有人负责 没有责任人的规则不会过期，也不会被清理。规则带到期时间与复核周期

x: Chapter Introduction: Twelve Counter-Intuitive Truths About Wireless · 本章导读：无线的十二个反直觉认知 The mistake a wired engineer makes most often when moving into wireless is carrying wired thinking over unchanged: assuming that adding APs adds bandwidth, that "the signal associates" means "the coverage is done", and that 5 GHz is automatically better than 2.4 GHz because it is newer. The twelve truths below are the underlying logic behind every technical detail in this chapter. 有线工程师转做无线，最容易犯的错是把"有线思维"直接搬过来：以为加了 AP 就有带宽、以为信号能连上就算覆盖、以为 5 GHz 比 2.4 GHz"高级所以更好"。以下七条是本章所有技术细节的底层逻辑。 1. Wireless "Bandwidth" Is Not a Bit Rate, It Is Airtime · 无线的"带宽"不是比特率，是介质时间 Wired is full duplex with a dedicated medium; wireless is half duplex with a shared medium . A single radio can serve exactly one client in any given millisecond. So a "1.2 Gbps" AP does not hand out 1200 Mbps of bandwidth — it hands out 1,000,000 microseconds of airtime per second . Client count, frame size, signal quality and management-frame overhead all consume that same pool of airtime. 有线是全双工、独享介质；无线是 半双工、共享介质 。一块射频在同一毫秒只能服务一个客户端。所以一台标称 1.2 Gbps 的 AP，真实可分配的不是"1200 Mbps 带宽"，而是"每秒 1,000,000 微秒的 airtime"。 客户端数量、帧大小、信号质量、管理帧开销，全部在消耗同一份 airtime。 💡 In one sentence : the scarce resource in wired networks is bandwidth ; the scarce resource in wireless is time . If you cannot make that mental switch, every capacity calculation that follows will be wrong. 💡 一句话 ：有线的稀缺资源是 带宽 ，无线的稀缺资源是 时间 。这个思维切换不过来，后面所有容量计算都会算错。 2. "It Associates" and "It Works" Are Two Different Things · 信号"能连上"和"能用"是两件事 802.11 modulation and coding is adaptive: weak signal means a lower rate. A client at −85 dBm can still associate, but it transmits at the lowest basic rate (say 6 Mbps), so a single 1500-byte packet consumes more than 100× the airtime of the same packet from a −55 dBm client (866 Mbps). 802.11 的调制编码是自适应的：信号弱就降速率。一个 -85 dBm 的客户端仍然能连上，但它用最低速率（如 6 Mbps）发送，发一个 1500 字节的包要占用比 -55 dBm 客户端（866 Mbps） 长 100 倍以上的 airtime 。 Conclusion: a weak client does not

x: just make itself slow, it makes the whole AP slow. That is why enterprise designs must specify a −67 dBm cell-edge design value (voice −65 dBm, SNR ≥ 25 dB) instead of "as long as it associates". 结论：弱信号客户端不是"自己慢"，而是"拖慢整个 AP"。 这就是为什么企业设计必须定 -67 dBm 边界设计值 （语音 -65 dBm、SNR ≥ 25 dB），而不是"能连上就行"。 3. Wider Channels Are Not Automatically Better · 信道宽度越大不等于越好 Turning 80 MHz into 160 MHz doubles the theoretical rate, but: - the number of usable channels drops from 14 (6 GHz at 80 MHz) to 7 (at 160 MHz), so co-channel reuse distance shrinks ; - each channel occupies twice the spectrum, so the probability of co-channel interference (CCI) doubles ; - in dense deployments, real throughput often decreases . 把 80 MHz 改成 160 MHz，理论速率翻倍，但： - 可用信道数从 14 个（6 GHz 80 MHz）降到 7 个（160 MHz）， 同频复用距离缩短 ； - 每个信道占用的频谱翻倍， 同频干扰（CCI）概率翻倍 ； - 在密集部署里，实际吞吐往往 下降 。 The standard answer for high-density is 20 MHz (in 5 GHz, sometimes 20 MHz only) . Channel width is a spectrum-budget decision, not a performance decision. 高密度场景的标准答案是 20 MHz（甚至 5 GHz 只用 20 MHz） 。信道宽度是"频谱预算"问题，不是"性能"问题。 4. The Bottleneck Is the Client, Not the AP · 客户端才是短板，不是 AP An AP can do 4x4 MIMO, 160 MHz and MU-MIMO, but the phone in the user's hand is typically 2x2, 80 MHz . Link rate is always set by the weaker of the two ends. Buying a more expensive AP does not give users a faster network ; the value of the AP is the number of clients it can serve and its uplink/multi-gigabit ports . AP 可以 4x4 MIMO、160 MHz、MU-MIMO，但用户手上的手机通常是 2x2、80 MHz 。链路速率永远由双方较差的一方决定。 买更贵的 AP 不等于给用户更快的网 ，AP 的价值在于 服务的客户端数量 与 上行链路/多千兆口 。 5. Management Frames and Overhead Are Not Rounding Errors · 管理帧和开销不是"零头" The real cost of one data frame includes DIFS + random backoff + preamble (20–40 µs) + MAC header + interframe space + ACK. At 1500 bytes, overhead is roughly 20–30%; at 150 bytes (VoIP, POS, IoT heartbeats) overhead can exceed 80% . So the "voice only needs 100 kbps" calculation is completely invalid in wireless — what matters is how many frames per second . 一

Roaming Is Not a Protocol Feature, It Is a Coverage Design Result · 漫游不是"协议特性"，是"覆盖设计的结果" Even a perfect 802.11r implementation cannot rescue a bad coverage plan. Roaming must happen where the two APs have similar signal strength (difference 5 dB) and both are strong enough ( −67 dBm) . If APs are configured for "maximum power, farthest reach", the client is forced to switch only after the signal is already bad, and every roam becomes a service interruption. 再好的 802.11r 也救不了覆盖规划错误。漫游发生的位置必须是 两个 AP 信号强度接近（差值 5 dB）且都足够强（ -67 dBm）的地方 。如果 AP 按"最大功率、最远覆盖"配，客户端会在信号已经很差时才被迫切换，每次漫游都是一次业务中断。 7. Seventy Percent of Wireless Faults Are Not on Wireless Equipment · 无线故障 70% 不在无线设备上 DHCP pool exhaustion, RADIUS timeouts, CAPWAP tunnel MTU, DNS failing to resolve the controller, upstream switch ports missing trunk VLANs, multicast/broadcast suppression — all of these "wired-side" problems surface in wireless as "the Wi-Fi is broken". Wireless troubleshooting must watch four layers at once: RF, controller, wired side and authentication side. DHCP 池耗尽、RADIUS 超时、CAPWAP 隧道 MTU、DNS 解析不到控制器、上游交换机端口没有 trunk 全部 VLAN、组播/广播抑制——这些"有线侧"问题在无线里表现为"Wi-Fi 有问题"。 无线排障必须同时看 RF、控制器、有线侧、认证侧四层。 8. Up/Downlink Asymmetry Is Physics, Not Configuration · 无线的"上下行不对称"是物理事实，不是配置问题 Phones are limited by SAR regulations to roughly 14–15 dBm of transmit power, and some models reduce power further when the hand covers the antenna; the AP can transmit at 20 dBm . That means: 手机受 SAR 法规限制，发射功率通常 14–15 dBm ，且部分机型在天线被手握遮挡时还会降功率；AP 可以打 20 dBm 。这意味着： Good downlink coverage does not mean the uplink gets through. A client showing "full bars" can still lose packets when it transmits; the symptom is "it associates, but pages spin and uploads crawl". What defines the cell boundary is not the AP's power but whether the client can shout back . The design conse

x: quence is to turn AP power down to match the client (5–14 dBm) so that coverage is symmetric and the cell edge becomes controllable. 下行覆盖好 ≠ 上行能通 。客户端"看到满格"却在发送时丢包，表现是"能连上、网页转圈、上传极慢" 决定蜂窝边界的不是 AP 的功率，而是 客户端能不能喊回来 设计上必须把 AP 功率 压到与客户端相当的水平 （5–14 dBm），让两端覆盖对称，蜂窝边界才可控 💡 A field rule of thumb: if downlink RSSI is −60 dBm but the retry rate exceeds 30% , nine times out of ten it is fake coverage caused by AP power set too high and an uplink that cannot keep up. 💡 一条现场经验： 下行 RSSI -60 dBm 但重传率 30% 的场景，九成是 AP 功率过高、上行不足造成的假覆盖。 9. Management Frames Are Fixed Cost, Independent of Traffic · 管理帧是"固定成本"，跟有没有流量无关 Even with nobody online, a radio keeps burning airtime: 即使没有一个人上网，一块射频也在持续消耗 airtime： Fixed overhead Default Airtime share Beacon One frame per SSID every 102.4 ms Single SSID at 20 MHz lowest rate ≈ 3%–5% ; four SSIDs can reach 15%+ Probe Response One frame per probe request 10%–20% in dense client populations Management/control frames (ACK, BA, CTS) One per data frame The shorter the data frame, the higher the share 固定开销 默认值 折算 airtime Beacon 每 SSID 每 102.4 ms 一帧 单 SSID 20 MHz 最低速率 ≈ 3%–5% ；4 个 SSID 可到 15%+ 探测响应（Probe Response） 每个探测请求回一帧 客户端密集时可达 10%–20% 管理/控制帧（ACK、BA、CTS） 每数据帧必带 数据帧越短，占比越高 Conclusion: multiple SSIDs are not free. Every additional SSID adds another Beacon (broadcast frames go out at the lowest mandatory rate and therefore occupy the most time). "One SSID per department" is a textbook design error — the correct approach is one SSID plus dynamic VLAN/role assignment . 结论 ： 多 SSID 是有成本的 。每加一个 SSID，Beacon 就多一份（广播帧以最低强制速率发送，占用时间最长）。所以"按部门开 SSID"是典型的错误设计——正确做法是 一个 SSID + 动态 VLAN/角色下发 。 10. Multicast on Wireless Means "Sent to Everyone at the Slowest Speed" · 无线上的组播，是"用最慢的速度发给所有人" 802.11 multicast/broadcast frames have no ACK, no rate adaptation and no aggregation ; they can only be sent at the BSS's lowest mandatory rate (6 Mbps in common configurations, 1 Mbps when low rates have not been disabled). 802.11 的组播/广播帧 没有 ACK、没有速率自适应、不能聚合 ，只能以 该 BSS 的最低强制速率 发送（常见配

Three such streams on one AP and the radio is full. 换算一下：一段 2 Mbps 的组播视频流，在有线侧只占 2 Mbps；在无线侧以 6 Mbps 的 PHY 速率发送， 消耗掉该射频 33% 以上的 airtime （还不算前导码与帧间隔）。一个 AP 上有 3 路这样的流，射频就满了。 This explains the most counter-intuitive rule in wireless design : "multicast bandwidth requirement" is not a bandwidth problem at all on the wireless side, it is an airtime problem . The countermeasure is always the same trio: access-layer IGMP Snooping (stop the flooding) → controller multicast-to-unicast (send at unicast rates) → where needed, multicast direct/local switching so the AP replicates locally. 这解释了无线设计里最反直觉的一条 ： "组播带宽需求"在无线侧根本不是带宽问题，是 airtime 问题 。对策永远是三件套：接入层 IGMP Snooping（不让它泛洪）→ 控制器 组播转单播 （用单播速率发）→ 必要时用组播直通/Direct 模式在 AP 本地复制。 11. You Cannot Design Client Behaviour, You Can Only Steer It · 客户端行为你设计不了，只能"引导" Half of the control in wireless sits in the endpoint: roaming decisions, band preference, power-save strategy, probe frequency, private MAC randomization — all decided by the handset vendor's algorithms, and wildly different between vendors . 无线的另一半控制权在终端手里：漫游决策、频段选择、省电策略、探测频率、私有 MAC 随机化，全部由终端厂商的算法决定，且 不同品牌差异巨大 。 Client behaviour What design can do Sticky client (refuses to leave) MIN RSSI forced disassociation + 802.11v BTM steering 2.4 GHz addiction Band steering (some clients refuse) + simply do not broadcast a 2.4 GHz SSID Private MAC randomization Use 802.1X instead of MAC authentication; shorten DHCP leases; drop MAC-binding policies Aggressive power save (PSM/U-APSD) Tune DTIM interval; support WMM-PS for voice Probe storms Disable low rates, enable probe suppression, reduce SSID count 终端行为 设计上能做的 Sticky Client（赖着不走） MIN RSSI 强制断开 + 802.11v BTM 引导 只爱 2.4 GHz Band Steering（部分终端拒绝）+ 干脆不广播 2.4 GHz SSID 私有 MAC 随机化

With one client efficiency is close to theoretical; with 30 clients contending at once, collisions and backoff eat 20%–40% of airtime . Small-frame workloads are inherently inefficient — because DIFS + backoff + preamble + SIFS + ACK is a fixed per-frame cost (see the worked example above). Three structural reasons: 有线网络里，交换机的控制面是分布式的（每台自己跑 STP、自己学 MAC）。无线为什么不能照做？三个结构性原因： Reason Explanation RF is a global resource Channels, power and client load must be coordinated with a global view . Two neighbouring APs each "cleverly" choosing maximum power simply jam each other Authentication state must be shared A roaming client must reuse the PMK (key cache); otherwise every AP change means a fresh 802.1X run (hundreds of milliseconds to seconds) Policy must be pushed consistently SSIDs, ACLs, QoS and VLAN mappings configured box by box cannot be kept consistent across thousands of APs 原因 说明 RF 是全局资源 信道、功率、客户端负载必须在 全局视野 下协调。两台相邻 AP 各自"聪明地"选最强功率，结果就是互相干扰 认证状态需要共享 客户端漫游时必须复用 PMK（密钥缓存），否则每次换 AP 都要重新做 802.1X（几百毫秒到数秒） 策略需要统一下发 SSID、ACL、QoS、VLAN 映射若逐台配置，几千台 AP 的配置漂移无法管理 So the controller owns three things: RF coordination, authentication/key-state sync, and consistent policy distribution. x: n the WAN drops, existing clients keep working (they are already associated), but next morning when everyone comes back nobody can connect — and that failure always lands at the worst possible time. ⚠️ 分支设计最常见的错误 ：只配了 FlexConnect 但没配本地认证与本地 DHCP。WAN 一断，老客户端还能用（因为已关联），但 第二天早上所有人重新上班时全部连不上 —— 这个故障总是在最糟的时间出现。 The CAPWAP Tunnel Bandwidth Ledger (an unavoidable calculation for Local Mode) · CAPWAP 隧道的带宽账（Local Mode 必须算的一笔） In Local Mode all client data is encapsulated into CAPWAP and sent back to the WLC . That bandwidth must be calculated in the design document, otherwise the first bottleneck after go-live is the WAN or the aggregation link. Local Mode 下 客户端的所有数据都要封装进 CAPWAP 回到 WLC ，这笔带宽必须在设计文档里算清，否则上线后第一个瓶颈就是 WAN/汇聚链路。 Per-frame overhead (IPv4, unencrypted) : 单帧开销（IPv4，未加密） ： Layer Bytes Original 802.11 data frame (including 24–36 B of 802.11 header) 1500 CAPWAP data header 8 UDP (5247) 8 Outer IP 20 Total (DTLS disabled) ≈ 1536 With DTLS (data-plane encryption) ≈ 1560–1580 层 字节 原始 802.11 数据帧（含 802.11 头 24–36 B） 1500 CAPWAP 数据头 8 UDP (5247) 8 外层 IP 20 合计（DTLS 未启用） ≈ 1536 启用 DTLS（数据面加密） ≈ 1560–1580 Worked example: one floor with 40 Wi-Fi 6 APs, 300 Mbps of peak user traffic each 算例：一个 40 台 Wi-Fi 6 AP 的楼层，每 AP 峰值 300 Mbps 用户流量 ① Bandwidth inflation after tunnelling ≈ 1536/1500 ≈ 1.024 → about +2.4% (negligible without DTLS) ② The real problem is aggregation: 40 × 300 Mbps = 12 Gbps of tunnel traffic all rushing at the WLC ③ The WLC-side attach capacity must be ≥ 12 Gbps (a WLC with only 10G uplinks is an immediate bottleneck) ④ The link from the aggregation switch to the WLC needs 2×10G LAG or 100G ⑤ If you switch to FlexConnect local forwarding: only control plane plus a little management traffic remains ( 200 Mbps) ① 隧道化后带宽膨胀 ≈ 1536/1500 ≈ 1.024 → 约 +2.4%（不含 DTLS 时几乎可忽略） ② 真正的问题是 汇聚 ： 40 × 300 Mbps = 12 Gbps 隧道流量全部涌向 WLC ③ WLC 侧接入能力必须 ≥ 12 Gbps（若 WLC 只有 10G 上行 → 直接瓶颈） ④ 汇聚交换机到 WLC 的链路需要 2×10G LAG 或 100G ⑤ 若改用 FlexConnect 本地转发：WLC 侧只剩控制面 + 少量管理流量（ 200 Mbps） Run this led

If the AP–WLC path MTU is 1500 you get fragmentation or silent drops , which shows up as "small packets fine, large packets stuck" (the login page opens, video freezes). Standard practice: set the AP–WLC path MTU to ≥ 1550 (1600 recommended with DTLS), or enable fragmentation on the WLC (sacrificing performance). This belongs in the implementation checklist. ⚠️ MTU 的第二层坑 ：隧道化后 1536 B 1500 B。如果 AP–WLC 路径 MTU 是 1500，会出现 分片或静默丢包 ，表现为"小包正常、大包卡住"（登录界面能开、视频卡死）。标准做法： AP–WLC 路径 MTU 调到 ≥ 1550 （含 DTLS 建议 1600），或在 WLC 侧启用分片（牺牲性能）。这条必须写进实施检查表。 Software Versions, Lifecycle and Upgrade Strategy · 软件版本、生命周期与升级策略 Wireless is the most version-coupled area in the whole book: AP firmware, WLC release, endpoint capability, authentication server and licences must all be compatible. 无线是全书里 版本耦合度最高 的领域：AP 固件、WLC 版本、终端能力、认证服务器、许可证，五者必须兼容。 Concern Explanation Design action APSP (AP Service Pack) Cisco AP firmware must match the WLC release Check the compatibility matrix before upgrading the WLC; reserve a window for the APSP download AP image distribution APs download images from the WLC they last joined; cross-site downloads consume WAN bandwidth Pre-stage with a master AP or a local image server before major upgrades EOL / EoS Last

x: s: the client associates on the Foreign controller, which "hangs" it off the original Anchor , and all traffic hairpins through a tunnel back to the anchor's gateway . 三层漫游的机制是：客户端在 Foreign 控制器上关联，但控制器把它"挂"在原来的 Anchor 上， 所有流量经隧道折返 Anchor 的网关 。 Advantage Cost Client IP is preserved, sessions survive (VoIP, video, database connections) Traffic hairpinning : longer physical path, higher latency No client-side Mobile IP support needed The anchor becomes a bandwidth and failure single point Decouples from existing subnet planning Complex troubleshooting ( show client detail to inspect the anchor relationship) At scale, tunnel count and state pressure are significant 优点 代价 客户端 IP 不变，会话不断（VoIP、视频、数据库连接） 流量折返 ：物理路径变长，时延增加 无需客户端支持移动 IP Anchor 成为带宽与故障单点 与现有子网规划解耦 排障复杂（ show client detail 要看 anchor 关系） 大规模漫游时隧道数量与状态压力大 💡 Modern design advice : if a single Layer 2 mobility domain (one large VLAN or a unified subnet) can solve it, do not use Layer 3 roaming. Layer 3 roaming fits "across buildings or campuses where a single large Layer 2 domain is impossible" and where the application genuinely cannot tolerate an IP change. With Wi-Fi 7 MLO and 802.11r, "fast reconnect + session re-establishment" has become acceptable for some applications, so Layer 3 roaming is becoming less necessary. 💡 现代设计建议 ：能用 单一二层漫游域（大 VLAN 或统一子网） 解决的，就不要用三层漫游。三层漫游的适用场景通常是"跨楼栋/跨园区，无法统一大二层"，且业务确实不能容忍 IP 变化。Wi-Fi 7 的 MLO 与 802.11r 使"快速重连 + 重建会话"在某些应用上已可接受，三层漫游的必要性在下降。 Comparing Four Key Caching Mechanisms · 四种密钥缓存机制对比 Mechanism Standardisation Who caches Principle Compatibility OKC (Opportunistic Key Caching) Vendor consensus (not an 802.11 standard) Client + controller Derives PMK-R0/R1 from the PMK; the client reuses it Widely supported by 802.11i-capable endpoints PKC (Proactive Key Caching, Cisco 802.11i) Cisco extension Controller Proactively distributes the PMK to neighbour controllers via RADIUS Needs RADIUS support (Cisco ACS/ISE) CCKM (Cisco Centralized Key Management) Cisco proprietary Controller T

The AP does not understand the credentials. The key is generated in RADIUS : Access-Accept carries MS-MPPE-Recv-Key / Send-Key (the PMK material), and that is the root of the four-way handshake. This is the basis of PMK caching : once derived, the PMK can be cached (OKC/PKC/802.11r), so roaming no longer touches RADIUS. RADIUS down = every new user down : associated clients are unaffected, but any new association or roam to an AP with no cached PMK fails. This is the number one single point of failure in wireless authentication. AP 是"二传手" ：EAP 报文由客户端封装在 802.11 帧里，AP 用 RADIUS 封装 转给服务器。AP 不理解凭据内容。 密钥在 RADIUS 里生成 ：Access-Accept 会带 MS-MPPE-Recv-Key / Send-Key （即 PMK 材料），这才是 4 次握手的根。 PMK 缓存的基础就在这 ：PMK 一旦算出，可以被缓存（OKC/PKC/802.11r），漫游时不再访问 RADIUS。 RADIUS 挂了 = 新用户全挂 ：已关联客户端不受影响，但任何新关联/漫游到未缓存 AP 都会失败。这是无线认证的 头号单点 。 EAP Method Selection · EAP 方法选型 Method Credential Server certificate Client certificate MitM resistance Where it fits EAP-TLS Mutual certificates Required Required Strongest Corporate devices (domain PCs, managed mobile devices) PEAP-MSCHAPv2

That threshold is both a design red line and an acceptance metric. ⚠️ airtime 利用率一旦稳定超过 60%，用户体验会非线性下降 —— 因为重传率上升会进一步消耗 airtime，形成正反馈。这个阈值是设计红线，也是验收指标。 The Quantitative High-Density Workflow (with a worked example) · 高密度设计的量化流程（带算例） Scenario : a 300-seat lecture theatre, students mostly on laptops/phones watching courseware and video, 80% peak concurrency, 3 Mbps required per client. 场景 ：一个 300 人的阶梯教室，学生普遍用笔记本/手机看课件与视频，峰值并发率 80%，每客户端需求 3 Mbps。 ① Concurrent clients = 300 × 80% = 240 ② Total throughput demand = 240 × 3 Mbps = 720 Mbps ③ Effective throughput per AP (5 GHz 20 MHz, 2SS, 11ax) = about 160 Mbps ④ Conservatively 70% of airtime usable = 112 Mbps ⑤ APs needed = 720 / 112 ≈ 6.4 → round up to 7 ⑥ Load per AP ≈ 34 clients → inside the healthy 30–40 range ⑦ Spectrum check: 5 GHz 20 MHz offers 25 channels, 7 APs need no reuse → safe ① 并发客户端 = 300 × 80% = 240 ② 总吞吐需求 = 240 × 3 Mbps = 720 Mbps ③ 单 AP 有效吞吐（5 GHz 20 MHz, 2SS, 11ax）= 约 160 Mbps ④ 保守按 70% airtime 可用 = 112 Mbps ⑤ 需要的 AP 数 = 720 / 112 ≈ 6.4 → 取 7 台 ⑥ 每 AP 承载 ≈ 34 客户端 → 在 30–40 的健康区间内 ⑦ 频谱检查：5 GHz

Coverage holes, excessive power, CCI, slow-rate black holes, multicast flooding ② Control layer (WLC/AP state) Is the AP online? Client table? Is configuration being pushed? Look at the timeline first : "when did it start" often hands you the root cause directly (just upgraded? just changed policy? just finished renovation? certificate just expired?). Never "try it and see" in production : wireless parameters (power/channel/11r) have an enormous blast radius — validate on a small AP Group first. Packet capture beats speculation : an over-the-air capture plus a switch-side capture distinguishes "lost on air" from "lost on wire" in one shot. Write every fix back into the baseline : put root causes into monitoring alarms and acceptance cases, otherwise the same fault replays at the next site. 先确认影响面 ：一个人 / 一层楼 / 全园区 —— 影响面对应层次（个人 → 终端/凭据；一层 → AP/交换机；全园区 → WLC/RADIUS/DHCP）。 先看时间线 ："什么时候开始的" 往往直接给出根因（刚升级？刚改策略？刚装修？证书刚过期？）。 不要在生产上做"试试看" ：无线参数（功率/信道/11r）的改动影响面极大，先在小范围 AP Group 验证。 抓包胜过猜测 ：空口抓包 + 交换机侧抓包，能一次性区分"空口丢"还是"有线丢"。 修完要写进基线 ：把根因写进监控告警与验收用例，否则同一个故障会在下一个站点重演。

x: Real-World Case Studies (Twelve Real Scenarios) · 实战案例（12 个真实场景） The twelve cases below cover the six typical battlefields of wireless design: high-density capacity (1, 11), mobility and roaming (2, 8, 9), availability and degradation (3), engineering and go-live (4, 10), security and compatibility (5, 12), multicast and special loads (6), client behaviour (7) . The way to read each case is: look at "scenario and symptoms", decide the root cause yourself, then check whether "the investigation" matches yours — that is the core training method of scenario drills. 以下 12 个案例覆盖无线设计的六类典型战场： 高密度容量（一、十一）、移动性与漫游（二、八、九）、可用性与降级（三）、工程与上线（四、十）、安全与兼容（五、十二）、组播与特殊负载（六）、终端行为（七） 。每个案例的读法是：先看"场景与现象"，自己判断根因，再看"排查过程"对不对得上 —— 这是情景演练的核心训练方式。 Case 1: A Thousand-Person Launch Event — "We Installed Enough Wi-Fi 6 APs, But Everyone Is Spinning" · 🔥 案例一：千人发布会，"Wi-Fi 6 AP 装够了，但所有人都在转圈" Scenario : a 1,200 m² venue, 24 dual-band Wi-Fi 6 APs, 800 people on site. During testing it was "20 Mbps per person"; once the event started nobody could open a web page and the live streams froze. 场景 ：会场 1,200 m²，部署 24 台 Wi-Fi 6 AP，双频。现场 800 人。测试时"每人 20 Mbps"，实际开始后所有人网页打不开、直播卡死。 Investigation : 排查过程 ： The controller showed airtime utilisation above 95% , with 33 clients per AP on average (which looks unremarkable) Channel plan check: everything at 80 MHz → only 6 usable channels in 5 GHz, so 24 APs reuse heavily Power check: automatic RRM had pushed power to the 20 dBm maximum → each AP covered 40 m+, so the entire venue could hear every AP Low-rate check: 1/2/5.5/11 Mbps not disabled → some old and weak-signal endpoints transmitted at 6 Mbps, and one small frame consumed 20× the airtime of a high-rate frame Multicast/broadcast: iPads were mirroring (mDNS/Bonjour), flooding multicast at the lowest rate 控制器显示 airtime 利用率 95%+ ，每 AP 平均 33 客户端（看似不高） 信道规划检查： 全部 80 MHz → 5 GHz 只有 6 个可用信道，24 台 AP 严重复用 功率检查： 自动 RRM 把功率拉到最大 20 dBm → 每台 AP 覆盖半径 40 m+，整个会场互相听得见 低速检查：1/2/5.5/11 Mbps 未禁用 → 部分老终端与弱信号终端以 6 Mbps 发送，单个小包占用 air

The RF is usually the healthiest part because it was designed carefully, while DHCP/RADIUS are treated as "configure it in passing". A complete high-density design checklist must include: DHCP scale, authentication throughput, egress bandwidth, NAT/session tables and DNS performance — any omission is a break point. One more frequently ignored point: private MAC randomisation means "people → leases" is no longer 1:1. That is the main reason DHCP pools have "somehow not been enough" in recent years. 大型活动的失败点几乎总在"外围系统"：DHCP、RADIUS、出口带宽。 无线 RF 往往是最健康的一环，因为它被认真设计过；而 DHCP/RADIUS 通常被当作"顺手配一下"的配套。 高密度设计的完整清单必须包含：DHCP 规模、认证吞吐、出口带宽、NAT/会话表、DNS 性能 —— 少一项就是一个断点。 还有一条常被忽略的： 私有 MAC 随机化让"人数 → 租约数"不再是 1:1 。这是近几年 DHCP 池"明明够却不够"的最主要原因。 Case 12: Hospital Telemetry — "Every Monitor Drops Together for 30 Seconds at 2 a.m." · 🔥 案例十二：医院医疗遥测——"监护仪每天凌晨 2 点集体掉线 30 秒" Scenario : a tertiary hospital's inpatient building, 12 floors, 40 wireless monitors per floor (2.4 GHz single-band, WPA2-PSK, static IPs, no 11r/11kv support), plus a staff SSID (5 GHz) and a guest SSID. 场景 ：三甲医院住院部 12 层，每层 40 台无线监护仪（2.4 GHz 单频，WPA2-PSK，固定 IP，不支持 11r/11kv），另有员工 SSID（5 GHz）与访客 SSID。 Symptoms : 现象 ： Around 2 a.m. every day , monitors across multiple floors drop together for 20–40 s and then recover on their own Occasional single-monitor drops during the day (the nurses' station "cannot see the waveform") The staff SSID is largely normal; guests complain more 每天凌晨 2 点左右 ，多楼层监护仪集体掉线 20–40 s，随后自动恢复 白天偶发单个监护仪掉线（护士站"看不到波形"） 员工 SSID 基本正

pool utilisation sat at 92% long term Layer 4, authentication : 02:00 was also ISE's certificate/CRL refresh task ; although PSK is unaffected, the WLC performs a full client policy re-push → amplifying the momentary instability 第 1 层 RF ：凌晨 airtime 曲线无异常，信道也无切换记录 → 排除拥塞与 DFS 第 2 层控制器 ：发现凌晨 2:00 有一条 定时任务 记录 —— 全院 AP 组每日执行"自动信道优化（RRM DCA）"，且配置为 full 模式（全信道重算） 第 2 层控制器 （第二条线索）：监护仪所在的 IoT WLAN 开启了 802.11r 与 11k/v ，而多数监护仪固件不支持 FT → 白天单个掉线由此解释 第 3 层网络 ：DHCP 池按"床位数"配置，未考虑监护仪 + 平板 + 输液泵，池利用率长期 92% 第 4 层认证 ：凌晨 2:00 同时是 ISE 的证书/CRL 更新任务 ，PSK 虽不受影响，但 WLC 会做一次全量客户端策略重下发 → 加剧瞬时抖动 Root cause : the 02:00 DCA full-channel recompute changed the channels of entire floors of APs at the same moment , forcing every 2.4 GHz monitor to re-associate; and those devices reconnect slowly (15–30 s) and do not support fast roaming , so the result was a collective dropout. 根因 ： 凌晨 2 点的 DCA 全信道重算，把整层 AP 的信道同时改掉 ，所有 2.4 GHz 监护仪被迫重新关联；而这些设备 重连慢（15–30 s）且不支持快速漫游 ，所以表现为"集体掉线"。 Fixes : 修复 ： Action Explanation Move RRM DCA to off-hours with limited amplitude Only in maintenance windows, at most one channel change at a time , avoiding the 00:00–06:00 nursing peak Disable 11r and 11k/v on the IoT WLAN Old firmware does not support them, and enabling them actually causes association failures Separate IoT SSID + iPSK A unique key per device, simpli

x: fying single-device revocation and auditing Grow DHCP pools to "beds × 3" Covering monitors/infusion pumps/tablets/staff phones; 8 h leases for fixed devices IoT on a dedicated 2.4 GHz SSID + client isolation + egress whitelist Allow access only to the central monitoring station and the vendor cloud Disable multicast flooding on that VLAN The monitors do not use multicast; suppressing it cut airtime by 6% Add two monitoring alarms "single-AP client count drops 30%" and "IoT SSID association failure rate 1%" 动作 说明 RRM DCA 改为 off-hours + 限制幅度 只在维护窗口做，且 每次最多移动 1 个信道 、避开 00:00–06:00 的护理高峰 IoT WLAN 关闭 11r、11k/v 老固件不支持，开启反而导致关联失败 IoT 独立 SSID + iPSK 每台设备独立密钥，便于单台回收与审计 DHCP 池扩到"床位数 × 3" 含监护仪/输液泵/平板/员工手机；租期 8 h（固定设备） IoT 走 2.4 GHz 专用 + 客户端隔离 + 出口白名单 只允许访问监护中央站与厂商云 关闭该 VLAN 的组播泛洪 监护仪不用组播，抑制后 airtime 降 6% 监控加两条告警 "单 AP 客户端数骤降 30%" 与 "IoT SSID 关联失败率 1%" Result : the 2 a.m. collective dropout disappeared; daytime single drops fell from 5–8 per day to about once a week (mostly genuine device faults); 2.4 GHz peak airtime fell from 62% to 48%. 结果 ：凌晨集体掉线消失；白天单个掉线从每天 5–8 次降到每周 1 次（多为设备自身故障）；2.4 GHz airtime 峰值从 62% 降到 48%。 Lessons : 教训 ： Medical/IoT wireless fears "well-intentioned automation" most of all : automatic channel optimisation, automatic power adjustment and automatic policy re-pushes are optimisations for staff endpoints and disasters for old devices that do not support fast roaming . Design must do two things: ① "Freeze" the SSIDs of critical IoT (disable 11r/11kv and any automatic optimisation of that VLAN); ② Every automated action needs a "time window + amplitude limit + rollback" . One more universal point: the time pattern of a fault (2 a.m. every day) points at the root cause faster than any command — first ask "what scheduled task runs at that time". 医疗/IoT 无线最怕"善意的自动化" ：自动信道优化、自动功率调整、自动策略重下发，对员工终端是优化，对 不支持快速漫游的老设备是灾难 。设计上必须做到两点： ① 关键 IoT 的 SSID 要"冻结" （关闭 11r/11kv、关闭对该 VLAN 的自动优化）； ② 所有自动化动作都要有"时间窗 + 幅度限制 + 可回退" 。 另一条更普适的： 故障的时间规律（每天凌晨 2 点）比任何命令都更快指向根因 —— 先问"这个时间

s: Practical Experience Summary · 实战经验总结
x: Practical Experience Summary · 实战经验总结 The first principle of wireless design is airtime, not coverage area. First compute "how many microseconds per second can be shared out", then compute how many APs are needed. Any design that skips airtime and starts drawing coverage maps will be reworked in high-density scenarios. Power, channel width, MIN RSSI and disabled low rates must be tuned together. Changing any one of them alone produces almost no effect, while changing all four together can double the capacity of the same hardware. This is the highest return-on-effort set of actions available. Roaming experience is a product of coverage design; protocols are only an accelerator. 802.11r/k/v can save a few hundred milliseconds, but if the signal at the switch point is only −80 dBm, being faster still means disconnecting. Fix coverage overlap first, then talk about fast roaming. Branch wireless must assume "the WAN can drop at any moment". FlexConnect only solves data backhaul; local DHCP + local authentication are what determine "whether people can work after the link drops". Redundancy that has never been drilled is no redundancy at all. Security upgrades must be staged by endpoint capability, never cut over in one step. WPA3 is the direction, but existing endpoints, IoT and medical devices will not upgrade on the same day. Split SSIDs + transition mode + a rollback plan is the only executable path. Wireless faults must always be examined across four layers : RF (signal/interference/airtime), controller (AP state/configuration), wired (DHCP/VLAN/MTU/multicast) and authentication (RADIUS/certificates/policy). Hunting for causes only on wireless gear misses most real root causes. Acceptance must happen at the worst moment, and metrics must be quantifiable. "−67 dBm / SNR 25 dB / airtime 60% / roaming 50 ms / retries 10%" — writing those five numbers into the delivery document is ten thousand times more useful than "the user experience is good". Bandwidth math systematic

s: Practical Experience Summary · 实战经验总结
x: ally underestimates AP requirements; always verify with pps. For small-frame workloads (voice, scanning, IoT, live comments, interactive teaching) the cost sits in per-frame fixed overhead , not in the number of bits. Whenever a scenario involves "many people + small frames", add 20%–40% to the AP count computed from bandwidth. The capacity of peripheral systems matters as much as the wireless itself. DHCP (people × 2.5), RADIUS (peak authentication rate), egress bandwidth (0.8 Mbps per person) and NAT session tables — if any one of those is short, perfect wireless design is still useless. That is exactly where large events fail. Automation must leave an escape route for fragile devices. RRM/DCA, automatic policy re-push and scheduled optimisation are improvements for staff endpoints and potentially catastrophic for old IoT and medical devices. The rule: freeze automation for critical SSIDs; give automation an amplitude ceiling, a time window and a rollback. Layer 3 roaming is a last resort, not an advanced option. When faced with "the IP cannot change", ask three questions first: can the application tolerate a reconnect? can the same subnet be used? can the application layer preserve the session? Only when all three fail should you use an Anchor — and be prepared to carry the hairpinned bandwidth and single-point risk. Endpoint capability must be locked down at procurement. Dual/tri-band, 11ax/6E support, 11k/v/r support, reliability of the roaming implementation, 802.1X support — those attributes determine how many cards the wireless design has to play. Changing the design after the devices are bought costs you the whole solution. The time pattern of a fault is worth more than any command. "2 a.m. every day", "Monday morning", "whenever it rains" — those patterns point directly at scheduled tasks, backup windows and environmental factors. The first step of troubleshooting should be asking about the timeline , not logging into devices. 无线设计的第一性原理是 airtime，不是覆盖面积。 先

x: 算"每秒有多少微秒可以分"，再算需要多少 AP。任何跳过 airtime 直接画覆盖图的设计，都会在高密度场景返工。 功率、信道宽度、MIN RSSI、禁用低速率，这四项必须一起调。 单独改任何一项都几乎没有效果，四项同调能让同一套硬件容量翻倍。这是投入产出比最高的一组动作。 漫游体验是覆盖设计的产物，协议只是加速器。 802.11r/k/v 能省下几百毫秒，但如果切换点信号只有 -80 dBm，再快也是断。先修覆盖重叠，再谈快速漫游。 分支无线必须假设"WAN 随时会断"。 FlexConnect 只解决数据回传，本地 DHCP + 本地认证才解决"断链后还能不能上班"。冗余没演练过，等于没有。 安全升级要按终端能力分批，不要一刀切。 WPA3 是方向，但存量终端、IoT、医疗设备不会同一天升级。分 SSID + 过渡模式 + 回滚方案，是唯一可执行路径。 无线故障永远要跨四层看 ：RF（信号/干扰/airtime）、控制器（AP 状态/配置）、有线（DHCP/VLAN/MTU/组播）、认证（RADIUS/证书/策略）。只在无线设备上找原因，会错过大部分真实根因。 验收必须在最坏时刻做，指标必须可量化。 "-67 dBm / SNR 25 dB / airtime 60% / 漫游 50 ms / 重传 10%"，这五个数字写进交付文档，比"用户体验良好"有用一万倍。 带宽算法会系统性低估 AP 需求，必须用 pps 校核。 小包业务（语音、扫码、IoT、弹幕、互动教学）的成本在"每帧固定开销"，不在比特数。凡是"人多 + 小包"的场景，按带宽算出的 AP 数通常要再加 20%–40%。 外围系统的容量与无线同等重要。 DHCP（按人数 ×2.5）、RADIUS（按峰值认证速率）、出口带宽（按人均 0.8 Mbps）、NAT 会话表 —— 这四项任何一个不够，无线做得再好也白搭。大型活动的失败点几乎都在这里。 自动化要为"脆弱设备"留退路。 RRM/DCA、自动重下发、定时优化，对员工终端是优化，对老 IoT 与医疗设备可能是灾难。规则： 关键 SSID 冻结自动优化、自动化有幅度上限、有时间窗、有回滚 。 三层漫游是最后手段，不是高级选项。 遇到"IP 不能变"的需求，先问三问：业务能否容忍重连？能否用同子网？应用层能否保持会话？三条都走不通，才用 Anchor，并准备好承担折返带宽与单点风险。 终端能力要在采购阶段就锁定。 双频/三频、是否支持 11ax/6E、是否支持 11k/v/r、漫游实现是否可靠、是否支持 802.1X —— 这些属性决定了无线设计有多少牌可打。 设备买回来之后再改设计，代价是重构整个方案。 故障时间规律比任何命令都值钱。 "每天凌晨 2 点""每周一早上""每次下雨"——这些规律直接指向定时任务、备份窗口、环境因素。排障第一步应该是 问时间线 ，而不是登设备。

Stores use MPLS plus an internet backup path; some stores have only 20 Mbps of WAN bandwidth and average two outages per month (1–4 hours each). Stores run wireless POS terminals, electronic shelf labels (2.4 GHz), customer Wi-Fi and inventory scanners. The IT team has 5 people covering the whole country. 背景 ：连锁零售企业 400 家门店（每店 2–8 台 AP）+ 1 个总部（300 台 AP）。门店使用 MPLS + 互联网双出口，部分门店 WAN 带宽 20 Mbps 且月均中断 2 次（每次 1–4 小时）。门店有 POS 收银（无线）、电子价签（2.4 GHz）、顾客 Wi-Fi、库存扫码枪。IT 团队 5 人，覆盖全国。 Question : propose the wireless architecture (controller deployment, forwarding mode, authentication, redundancy) and explain the cost of every choice you give up. 问题 ：给出无线架构（控制器部署、转发模式、认证、冗余），并说明每个选择放弃的代价。 Reference analysis (write yours first) 参考解析（先自己写完再看） Constraint identification (list them before answering) : 1. 400 sites with a 5-person IT team → per-site operational cost must be extremely low 2. 20 Mbps WAN that breaks often → cannot depend on tunnelled backhaul or centralized authentication 3. POS is the revenue system → the business must not stop when the network drops 4. Electronic shelf labels are 2.4 GHz → 2.4 GHz must be retained and supported long term 5. Customer Wi-Fi → needs isolation, rate limiting and compliant logging 约束识别（先列，再答） ： 1. 400 个站点、5 人 IT 团队 → 单站点运维成本必须极低 2. WAN 20 Mbps 且经常中断 → 不能依赖隧道回传与集中认证 3. POS 是收银业务 → 断网不能停止营业 4. 电子价签 2.4 GHz → 必须保留 2.4 GHz 且需长期支持 5. 顾客 Wi-Fi → 需要隔离、限速、合规日志 R

x: Scenario Analysis Framework: The Generic Pattern for Wireless Scenarios · 情景分析框架：无线类场景的通用套路 ① Write the constraints first site count, WAN quality, endpoint capability, compliance, staffing, budget ② Then write the invariants can the business run when the link drops, roaming latency, isolation requirements ③ Answer in layers RF → architecture → security → mobility → operations ④ State the cost of every choice this is the dividing line between CCDE and CCIE ⑤ List the open issues endpoint capability unconfirmed, AFC not approved, WAN SLA unsigned ⑥ Give acceptance and degradation metrics + failure behaviour, proving the design is operable ① 先写约束（Constraint） 站点数、WAN 质量、终端能力、合规、人力、预算 ② 再写不变量（What must hold） 断链能否营业、漫游时延、隔离要求 ③ 分层作答 RF → 架构 → 安全 → 移动性 → 运维 ④ 每个选择都写代价（Trade-off） 这是 CCDE 与 CCIE 的分水岭 ⑤ 写清未决项（Open issues） 终端能力未确认、AFC 未批、WAN SLA 待签 ⑥ 给出验收与降级 指标 + 故障行为，证明方案 可运营 In one sentence : a wireless scenario question does not test "can you configure 802.11r", it tests "can you identify which three constraints in this scenario are non-negotiable and satisfy them at the lowest cost". 一句话总结 ： 无线情景题考的不是"你会不会配 802.11r"，而是"你能不能识别出这个场景里哪三个约束是不可让步的，并用最小代价满足它们"。

x: Chapter Summary · 本章小结 Wireless looks like "a pile of protocols and standards", but its essence is the engineering of three physical constraints : 无线看起来是"一堆协议和标准"，本质却是 三个物理约束的工程化 ： Constraint Manifestation Design response Shared medium (half duplex) Capacity is determined by airtime, not by PHY rate 20 MHz, low power, disabled low rates, multicast suppression, OFDMA The wireless link is probabilistic The rate varies with SNR; weak signals drag down the whole network Cell-edge RSSI, MIN RSSI, coverage overlap, rate floor Mobility implies state migration Roaming must migrate keys, IP and QoS state PMK caching, 802.11k/v/r, mobility domains, Layer 2 domains preferred 约束 表现 设计应对 共享介质（半双工） 容量由 airtime 决定，不由 PHY 速率决定 20 MHz、低功率、禁低速、组播抑制、OFDMA 无线链路是概率性的 速率随 SNR 变化，弱信号拖累全网 边界 RSSI、MIN RSSI、覆盖重叠、速率下限 移动性带来状态迁移 漫游要迁移密钥、IP、QoS 状态 PMK 缓存、802.11k/v/r、移动域、二层域优先 From the CCDE perspective, wireless design really has to answer six questions: CCDE 视角下，无线设计真正要回答的六个问题： Is the airtime budget in each zone sufficient? (Capacity — verify with pps, not just bandwidth) Do the coverage boundary and overlap support "roaming only when it is time to roam"? (RF — −67 dBm boundary + 15%–20% overlap) Can this site still do business when the WAN or the controller fails? (Availability — local forwarding + local authentication/DHCP) Does the endpoint capability matrix support the chosen encryption and roaming features? (Security and compatibility — the entry conditions for 6 GHz/WPA3/11r) Is the capacity of peripheral systems (DHCP/RADIUS/egress) matched to the wireless? (Operability — the real break point of large events) Can the acceptance metrics be reproduced and signed at the worst moment? (Verifiability — the 15 test cases + stress-test method) 每个区域的 airtime 预算够不够？ （容量 —— 用 pps 校核，不只用带宽） 覆盖边界与重叠是否支撑"该漫游时才漫游"？ （RF —— -67 dBm 边界 + 15%–20% 重叠） WAN/控制器故障时，这个站点还能不能营业？ （可用性 —— 本地转发 + 本地认证/DHCP） 终端能力矩阵是否支撑所选的加密与漫游特性？ （安全与兼容 —— 6 GHz/WPA3/11r 的准入） 外围系统（DHCP/RADIUS/出口）的容量是否与无线匹配？ （可运营性 —— 大型活动的真正断点） 验收指标

The Goal of Automation Is Not Speed — It Is Repeatability + Verifiability · 自动化的目标不是"快"，是"可重复 + 可验证" If a manual configuration takes 10 minutes and the automated one takes 10 seconds, but the automated version has a 3% chance of misconfiguring the whole network, it is more dangerous than doing it by hand. The real value of automation is: 如果手工配置 10 分钟、自动化配置 10 秒，但自动化版本有 3% 概率配错全网，那它比手工 更危险 。自动化的真实价值是： Repeatable : the same input always produces the same output (idempotency) Verifiable : you can predict the result before the change and confirm it automatically afterwards Traceable : every change records who, why, what changed, and how to roll back 可重复 ：同样的输入永远得到同样的输出（幂等） 可验证 ：变更前能预测结果，变更后能自动确认 可追溯 ：每一次变更都有谁、为什么、改了什么、如何回滚 Speed is a by-product. A script that cannot be rolled back and cannot be verified is, in essence, a batch incident generator. 速度只是副产品。 一个不能回滚、不能验证的自动化脚本，本质上是"批量事故生成器"。 2. Declarative Does Not Mean You Stop Caring About Details · 声明式不等于"不用管细节" state: present looks far more elegant than a pile of CLI, but declarative automation assumes that the data model can express your intent . When your intent is "the OSPF cost on this link must be 10 higher than on that one", either the declarative model can express it, or you go back to imperative. state: present 看起来比一堆 CLI 优雅，但声明式的前提是 数据模型能把意图表达清楚 。当你的意图是"这条链路上 OSPF cost 必须比那条高 10"时，声明式模型要么能表达它，要么你就得回到命令式。 Real-world network automation is almost always hybrid : templates plus variables (declarative) generate the configuration, CLI/API (imperative) pushes and verifies it, and a test framework (declarative assertions) confirms the outcome. 现实中的网络自动化几乎都是混合的 ：用模板 + 变量（声明式）生成配置，用 CLI/API（命令式）下发并验证，用测试框架（声明式断言）确认结果。 4. The Biggest Cost Is Not Code, It Is Data · 最大的成本不是写代码，是"数据" In a real campus automation project, the effort distribution looks approximately like this: 一个真实的园区自动化项目里，工作量的分布大致是： Work Share Building the single source of truth (SoT) : sites, devices, interfaces, IPs, VLANs, routing policies 50%–60% Writing templates and playbooks 20% Building CI/CD and tests 15% Process and training 10% 工作 占比 建立 单一数据源（SoT） ：站点、设备、接口、IP、VLAN、路由策略 50%–60% 写模板与 playbook 20% 搭建 CI/CD 与测试 15% 组织流程与培训 10% Automation without structured data is just CLI replaced by Python string concatenation — the error rate will not fall, because the data itself is wrong (IP conflicts, undefined VLANs, misspelled device names). 没有结构化数据的自动化，等于把 CLI 换成 Python 字符串拼接 —— 错误率不会下降，因为数据本身是错的（IP 冲突、VLAN 未定义、设备名拼错）。 5. Automation Amplifies Process, Not Capability · 自动化放大的是流程，不是能力 Chaotic process + automation = automated chaos. If approvals are verbal, rollback is from memory, and testing means "I think it's fine", automation only makes the mistakes happen faster and more consistently. 流程混乱 + 自动化 = 混乱的自动化 。如果变更审批靠口头、回滚靠记忆、测试靠"我觉得没问题"，那么自动化只会让错误发生得更快、更一致。 The correct order is always: standardize the process first, then automate the standardized process. Define change tiers, test requirements and rollback plans before writing a single line of code. 正确的顺序永远是：先把流程标准化，再把标准流程自动化。 先有"变更分级 + 测试要求 + 回滚方案"的定义，再写代码。 7. The Real Bottleneck Is Usually Authority and Approval, Not Technology · 真正的瓶颈通常不是技术，是"权限与审批" Once you can technically "push to 500 devices in 5 minutes", you discover that changes are stuck in process: approval takes three days, the change window is monthly, the automation account has no TACACS authorization, and the firewall policy does not let the orchestration platform reach port 830 on the devices. 技术上"5 分钟能推完 500 台"之后，你会发现变更卡在流程里：审批要走 3 天、变更窗口每月一次、自动化账号没有 TACACS 授权、防火墙策略不让编排平台访问设备的 830 端口。 To judge the real maturity of enterprise automation, ask three questions : 判断一个企业自动化的真实成熟度，问三个问题 ： Does the automation platform's service account have its own least-privilege AAA authorization (can change configuration but cannot change local accounts or erase the device)? How long does it take on average from "code merged" to "effective in production"? If it is three days, your bottleneck is process, not tooling. Can the change approval process recognize the shape of "automated bulk change" (or is it still one ticket per device)? 自动化平台的服务账号有 独立的、最小权限的 AAA 授权吗（能改配置但不能改本地账号/不能 erase）？ 从"代码合并"到"生产生效"平均需要多久？ 如果是 3 天，那你的瓶颈是流程，不是工具。 变更审批能识别"自动化批量变更"这种形态吗（还是一条一条审批）？ ⚠️ Optimizing technology without optimizing process gives you "5-minute deployment plus 3-day queueing" — end-to-end time improves almost not at all. ⚠️ 只优化技术、不优化流程，会得到"5 分钟完成的下发 + 3 天的排队"——端到端时间改善几乎为零。 9. The Orchestration Platform Is Itself a Production System · 编排平台本身是生产系统，也需要设计可用性 What happens when the controller or orchestration platform dies? This is a mandatory CCDE question. There are three possibilities: 控制器/编排平台挂了会怎样？这是 CCDE 必问的问题。三种可能： Shape of the failure Consequence Design action Only affects change, not forwarding (configuration already on the devices) Acceptable: operations degrade to manual CLI CLI access must be preserved, plus a manual runbook Affects service turn-up (e.g. an SD-WAN controller that cannot push policy) Acceptable but uncomfortable Controller HA, configuration cache, local policy fallback Affects forwarding (e.g. centralized control plane or a cloud gateway in the data path) Unacceptable design Decouple data plane from control plane; forwarding must survive cloud loss 平台故障时的形态 后果 设计动作 只影响"改"，不影响"转发" （配置已下发到设备） 可接受：运维降级到 CLI 手工 必须保留 CLI 能力 + 手工 Runbook 影响"业务上线" （如 SD-WAN 控制器挂了下发不了策略） 可接受但不舒服 控制器 HA、配置缓存、本地策略兜底 影响"转发" （如集中式控制面、云管理网关在数据路径上） 不可接受的设计 数据面与控制面解耦，断云可转发 The test question : "If the orchestration platform is down for four hours, does the business still run?" "Yes, but nobody can change anything" = acceptable. "Forwarding stopped too" = architectural defect. 判断句 ： "编排平台宕机 4 小时，业务还转不转？" 答"转，但没人能改配置"= 可接受；答"转发也停了"= 架构设计缺陷。 11. 80% Tem

x: plate Coverage ≈ No Automation at All · 模板覆盖率 80% ≈ 没做自动化（长尾会吃掉收益） The classic trap: 80% of standard switches go through templates, and the remaining 20% are "special" (old models, stacks, dedicated WAN egress, security zones, legacy VLANs). The result: 最典型的困局：80% 的标准交换机走模板，剩下 20% 是"特殊的"（老型号、堆叠、专线出口、安全区、历史遗留 VLAN）。结果是： Two processes to maintain : template and manual, which increases cognitive load Drift detection covers only 80%, and the remaining 20% is exactly where incidents happen Newcomers do not know why a given device is not templated, so they keep configuring by hand 维护 两套流程 ：模板流程 + 手工流程，反而增加认知负担 漂移检测只覆盖 80%，剩下的 20% 恰恰是出事最多的 新人不知道"为什么这台不用模板"，只能继续手工 The value of automation is a step function, not a line : below 95% coverage the team is still running dual tracks and the benefit is largely cancelled out. So a design must state an explicit long-tail strategy : 自动化的价值是阶跃的，不是线性的 ：覆盖率 95% 时，团队仍在双轨运行，收益基本被抵消。 所以设计时必须明确处理长尾的策略 ： Long-tail type How to handle it Functional difference (different VLANs/routing) Data-driven (variables), bring it into the template Model difference (old hardware lacks a feature) {% if %} branches inside the template plus an explicit version matrix Genuinely one-off devices An exemption list naming the reason, owner and review date Operations that cannot be automated (console rescue, ROMMON) Documented in the runbook, out of automation scope, but with a fallback 长尾类型 处理方式 功能差异 （VLAN/路由不同） 数据驱动（变量），进模板 型号差异 （老设备不支持某特性） 模板内 {% if %} 分支 + 明确的版本矩阵 真的一次性设备 明确豁免清单 （Exemption List），列明原因、责任人和复审日期 无法自动化的操作 （Console 救援、ROMmon） 写进 Runbook，不算自动化范围，但要有替代手段 12. AI Made Writing Code Cheap; It Did Not Make Changes Safe · AI 让"写代码"变便宜，但没有让"变更"变安全 Generating Jinja2 templates, Ansible playbooks and regex parsers with a large model does save time. But it redistributes risk: 用大模型生成 Jinja2 模板、Ansible playbook、正则解析器确实能省时间。但它改变了风险分布： Step Change Risk Writing code 5–10× faster More code to review, heavier review load Understanding code Slower (you did not write it)

Everything it produces must land behind the existing defenses (schema validation, diff review, Batfish, canary, assertions). Using AI to skip review means manufacturing bigger incidents faster. 结论：AI 是"生成器"，不是"验证器"。 它产出的一切都必须落在已有的防线后面（schema 校验、diff 评审、Batfish、灰度、断言）。 用 AI 跳过评审，等于用更快的速度制造更大的事故。

x: Automation Maturity Model (for Assessing Current State and Target) · 自动化成熟度模型（用来评估现状与目标） Level Name Characteristics Typical problems Key transition action L0 Pure manual CLI onto each device, records in Excel Severe drift, no audit trail Establish configuration templates and naming conventions L1 Scripts Scattered Python/Shell scripts maintained by individuals Only the author can run them, no version control Put scripts in Git, establish review L2 Templated Unified templates plus variables (Jinja2/Ansible) Human-triggered, no automated verification Wire into CI, add syntax and compliance checks L3 Pipeline Git commit → CI validation → automated push → automated verification Manual rollback, insufficient test environment Build a digital twin/lab, add canary rollout L4 Closed-loop self-healing Telemetry-driven, automatic remediation or reconfiguration Hard to define policy boundaries, risk of wrong actions Define a self-healing allowlist and circuit breakers L5 Intent-driven Business intent → controller generates and validates configuration Vendor ecosystem dependency, poor explainability Narrow the scope (start with one or two high-value scenarios) 级别 名称 特征 典型问题 关键跃迁动作 L0 纯手工 CLI 逐台配置、Excel 记录 配置漂移严重、无审计 建立配置模板与命名规范 L1 有脚本 零散 Python/Shell 脚本，个人维护 脚本只有作者会跑、无版本控制 脚本进 Git、建立评审 L2 模板化 统一配置模板 + 变量（Jinja2/Ansible） 靠人触发、无自动验证 接入 CI，做语法与合规检查 L3 流水线 Git 提交 → CI 验证 → 自动下发 → 自动验证 回滚靠人工、测试环境不足 建数字孪生/实验室、加灰度 L4 闭环自愈 遥测驱动，异常自动修复/重配置 策略边界难界定、误动作风险 明确"可自愈"的白名单与熔断 L5 意图驱动 业务意图 → 控制器自动生成并验证配置 依赖厂商生态、可解释性差 场景收敛（先做 1–2 个高价值场景） The key CCDE judgement : do not jump straight to L4/L5 . Most enterprises are stuck between L0 and L2; making data standardization, templating and Git solid returns far more than buying an intent-based controller. CCDE 视角的关键判断 ： 不要一步跳到 L4/L5 。绝大多数企业的问题在 L0–L2 之间，把"数据标准化 + 模板化 + Git"做扎实，收益远大于上一个意图驱动控制器。

s: The Four Layers of Automation (Know What You Are Automating) · 自动化的四个层次（分清你在自动化什么）
x: The Four Layers of Automation (Know What You Are Automating) · 自动化的四个层次（分清你在自动化什么） Layer Object of automation Techniques Value ① Deployment automation (Day 0/1) Power-on → bring-up → baseline configuration ZTP/PnP, bootstrap scripts Deployment time drops from weeks to hours ② Configuration automation (Day 2) Service changes (VLAN/route/ACL/policy) IaC, templates, CI/CD Consistency and auditability ③ Verification automation Fact-checking before and after a change pyATS, Batfish, telemetry, compliance scans Turns "I think it is fine" into "I can prove it is fine" ④ Operations automation (AIOps) Fault detection, isolation, remediation Telemetry + event correlation + automated action Shorter MTTR 层次 自动化对象 技术手段 价值 ① 部署自动化（Day 0/1） 设备上电 → 上线 → 基础配置 ZTP/PnP、引导脚本 部署时间从周到小时 ② 配置自动化（Day 2） 业务变更（VLAN/路由/ACL/策略） IaC、模板、CI/CD 一致性与可审计 ③ 验证自动化 变更前后的事实核查 pyATS、Batfish、遥测、合规扫描 把"以为没问题"变成"证明没问题" ④ 运维自动化（AIOps） 故障检测、定位、修复 遥测 + 事件关联 + 自动动作 缩短 MTTR ⚠️ The most common failure mode : doing only ② (configuration automation) and skipping ③ (verification automation). The result is "changes are pushed fast and uniformly, but nobody knows whether they are correct" — and when it goes wrong, the blast radius is larger than manual configuration. ⚠️ 最常见的失败模式 ：只做 ②（配置自动化），不做 ③（验证自动化）。结果是"变更下发得又快又整齐，但没人知道它是否正确" —— 一旦出错，爆炸半径比手工更大。

Over a three-year lifecycle, replacement of failed units (RMA) typically runs at 3%–10% per year. 方案评审时常忽略这一点： 设备不是只上线一次 。三年生命周期里，坏件更换（RMA）的比例通常 3%–10%/年。 Process Without ZTP With ZTP New unit arrives Field engineer brings the old configuration template Plug it in Configuration restore Copy the old configuration by hand (possibly stale) Profile matches automatically → latest standard configuration Consistency Restored to "the configuration from three years ago" Restored to "today's standard configuration" Duration Half a day to two days (including travel) 30 minutes Hidden risk Old configuration carries deprecated VLANs/ACLs Legacy issues corrected automatically 流程 无 ZTP 有 ZTP 新机到货 现场工程师

x: CI/CD and the Network Change Pipeline · CI/CD 与网络变更流水线 CI/CD is a way to build, test and deploy changes through automation. In networking it solves one very concrete problem: how to make "changing configuration" have review, tests and rollback, just like committing code. CI/CD 是一种通过自动化来构建、测试和部署变更的方法。在网络里，它解决的是一个非常具体的问题： 如何让"改配置"这件事像"提交代码"一样有评审、有测试、有回滚。 Why Networks Need Pipelines More Than Software Does · 网络为什么比软件更需要流水线 Comparison Application software Network configuration Recovery after a mistake Redeploy (minutes) Possibly hours (protocol convergence, session loss, loops) Test environment Easy to duplicate (containers) Hard to duplicate (needs hardware or a virtualization platform) Blast radius One service Possibly the whole network or an entire site Observability Complete logs/APM Distributed and fragmented (needs telemetry to fill the gaps) Change frequency Many times a day Weekly/monthly, but each change is enormous 对比项 应用软件 网络配置 出错后的恢复 重新部署（分钟级） 可能几小时（协议收敛、会话中断、环路） 测试环境 容易复制（容器） 难复制（需要硬件或虚拟化平台） 影响范围 单服务 可能是全网或整个站点 可观测性 日志/APM 完整 分布式、碎片化（需要遥测补齐） 变更频率 每天多次 每周/每月，但每次影响巨大 So the point of CI/CD in networking is not speed — it is eliminating uncertainty before the change. 因此网络的 CI/CD 重点不是"快"，而是"在变更前把不确定性消灭掉"。 The Seven Stages of the Pipeline · 流水线的七个阶段 1. Commit Engineer edits YAML/template - push branch - open a PR ↓ 2. Static checks (lint schema) yamllint / ansible-lint / JSON Schema / YANG validation ↓ 3. Render and preview (diff) Template + data - generated config - diff against the running config - what will change ↓ 4. Static analysis (policy and reachability) Batfish: reachability, shadowed ACL entries, whether a routing policy breaks a path ↓ 5. Digital twin / lab validation Bring up an equivalent topology in CML / containerlab, run the real config plus automated tests ↓ 6. Canary rollout (rings) Ring 0 (1 device) - Ring 1 (1 non-critical site) - Ring 2 (batches) - Ring 3 (everything) ↓ 7. Post-change verification and monitoring pyATS assertions + telemetry

Lab testing passed, the first two sites succeeded, and from the third site on every AP and switch sat at "waiting for bootstrap". 场景 ：连锁企业 200 个门店，用 PnP + 云控制器做 ZTP。实验室测试通过，前 2 个站点成功，第 3 个站点起 AP 与交换机全部停在"等待引导"。 Investigation : 排查过程 ： The failing sites were all routed (Layer 3) segments (each store has its own router/firewall), while the two successful sites were flat Layer 2 DHCP capture: Option 43 was not configured , and the PnP broadcast could not cross Layer 3 → the PnP server was never found After adding Option 43 some devices still failed: their serial numbers were not registered in the PnP database (the procurement batch was late and the data had not been synced) Three more devices rebooted repeatedly: the bootstrap pointed NTP at a headquarters-internal address unreachable from the stores → clock skew → HTTPS certificate validation failure 失败站点都是 跨三层网段 （门店有独立的路由器/防火墙），而成功的两个站点是扁平二层 抓 DHCP 包： Option 43 未配置 ，PnP 广播跨不过三层 → 找不到 PnP 服务器 补上 Option 43 后，部分设备仍失败： 序列号未在 PnP 数据库登记 （采购批次晚了，数据没同步） 还有 3 台设备反复重启： 引导配置里 NTP 指向总部内网地址 ，门店无法访问 → 时间不同步 → HTTPS 证书校验失败 Root cause : ZTP depends on four preconditions holding simultaneously — network reachability (Option 43/DNS), device registration, time synchronization, and certificate trust. The network team has four people. Compliance requires "all changes auditable and reversible, and configuration compliance provable within six months". The number of sites will double in two years. 背景 ：制造企业，1200 台设备分布在 60 个站点（含 300 台只支持 SSH CLI 的老设备）。IT 网络团队 4 人。合规要求"所有变更可审计、可回滚、半年内可证明配置合规"。两年内站点数将翻倍。 Question : design the phased automation roadmap and target architecture, and explain why you would not go straight to "intent-driven" automation. 问题 ：设计自动化的分期路线与目标架构，并说明为什么不做"一步到位的意图驱动"。 Reference analysis (write yours first) 参考解析 Core idea: solve "auditable + verifiable" first, then "fast changes". So the automation architecture must assume heterogeneity is permanent and absorb the differences in an adapter layer. 最容易被追问的一点 ：为什么不干脆"全部标准化成一套厂商"？—— 因为并购带来的存量设备有折旧周期， 技术标准化要 3–5 年，而并购每季度都在发生 。所以自动化架构必须 默认异构长期存在 ，用适配层吸收差异。

s: Scenario Framework: The Generic Recipe for Automation Questions · 情景分析框架：自动化类场景的通用套路
x: Scenario Framework: The Generic Recipe for Automation Questions · 情景分析框架：自动化类场景的通用套路 1. Write the constraints first: device count, vendor/version capability, team size and skills, compliance, budget, change frequency 2. Write the invariants: can it be rolled back, can it be audited, blast-radius ceiling, degraded mode when the platform fails 3. Answer in layers: data - template - pipeline - verification - governance (the order cannot be reversed) 4. State the cost of every choice: this is the watershed between CCDE and CCIE 5. State the open issues: legacy capability unconfirmed, SoT disambiguation pending, AAA authorization pending approval 6. Give acceptance and degradation: metrics (failure rate/lead time/coverage) plus break-glass behaviour when the platform fails ① 先写约束（Constraint）： 设备数、厂商/版本能力、团队人数与技能、合规、预算、变更频率 ② 再写不变量（What must hold）： 能否回滚、能否审计、爆炸半径上限、平台故障时的降级形态 ③ 分层作答： 数据 → 模板 → 流水线 → 验证 → 治理（顺序不能颠倒） ④ 每个选择都写代价（Trade-off）： 这是 CCDE 与 CCIE 的分水岭 ⑤ 写清未决项（Open issues）： 老设备能力未确认、SoT 消歧待完成、AAA 授权待批 ⑥ 给出验收与降级： 指标（失败率/前置时间/覆盖率）+ 平台故障时的 break-glass One-sentence summary : an automation scenario question is not testing whether you can write a playbook; it is testing whether you can reduce the uncertainty of change step by step under the constraints of a limited team and limited device capability. 一句话总结 ： 自动化情景题考的不是"你会不会写 playbook"，而是"你能不能在有限的团队与设备能力约束下，把变更的不确定性一步步降下来"。

s: Practical Experience Summary · 实战经验总结
x: Practical Experience Summary · 实战经验总结 The acceptance criterion for automation is "on site, only power and cabling". As long as an engineer still has to travel and type commands, it is semi-automatic. The value of ZTP is compressing human action to the physical layer. Data matters an order of magnitude more than code. Real projects are almost always blocked by "no trustworthy SoT": an IP inconsistent in three places, VLANs with no authoritative definition, device roles remembered by people. Standardize the data first, then talk about automation. Idempotency is a safety floor, not elegance. A large share of network automation incidents are caused by "the second execution". Making "run twice, second run changes nothing" a hard CI gate eliminates a whole class of incidents. Syntax checks solve almost nothing; intent verification solves the problem. Passing yamllint does not mean the network works. You need at least Batfish-level reachability/ACL analysis, and ideally the real-traffic validation of a canary. A canary is the only way to catch an error before it costs 1%. A full rollout is not "efficient"; it is "skipping testing". Ring 1 must be a site with low business impact, on-site support and a representative topology. Rollback must be designed in advance, and it must account for "state that cannot be rolled back". Configuration can be restored, but BGP sessions have already rebuilt, OSPF has reconverged and TCP connections have already dropped. So change incrementally where possible, and never push without a timed rollback. Automation amplifies process, not capability. Chaotic process plus automation equals automated chaos. Standardize first (change tiers, approval, test requirements, rollback plan), then write code. Automation without telemetry is driving with your eyes closed. Configuration automation only solves "can I change it"; telemetry plus assertions solve "did I change it correctly". The order is: observability → configuration automation → closed-loop self

s: Practical Experience Summary · 实战经验总结
x: -healing. Read-only first is the only viable starting point for brownfield. Collection → baseline → compliance report is zero risk, immediately valuable, and it is the shared prerequisite for drift detection, the SoT and the verification layer. Skipping "read" and going straight to "write" is driving through a minefield without a map. Derived values must be computed by code, never filled in by hand. Gateway = subnet + 1, routing metric derived from bandwidth, ACL entries derived from policy. Once a derived value is written into the SoT, changing one prefix means hundreds of edits — and people always miss some. The enemy of coverage is the long tail, and there are only three ways to handle it: data-driven, conditional branches, exemption list. When coverage is stuck at 80% the team runs two tracks and the benefit is essentially cancelled — and "those special devices" are exactly where incidents cluster. The orchestration platform is itself a production system. The design must state "if the platform is down for four hours, does forwarding continue, how do we make changes", and the break-glass manual path must be rehearsed . "Controller HA" alone is not enough. Credential governance must land before automation. Automation multiplies the exposure surface (scripts, CI logs, artifacts, caches, AI context). A shared account, a static password and clear-text logs together mean the network's control plane is hanging on the intranet. A template engine's fault-tolerant defaults are the most insidious killer. Jinja2 renders undefined variables as empty, producing "syntactically legal but semantically loosened" configuration (the permit ip any any class of incident). Strict mode + rendered-structure assertions + negative testing must be standard equipment. In deterministic engineering there is no "it should be fine".
