Using AI to skip review means manufacturing bigger incidents faster. 自动化的验收标准是"现场只做上电和插线"。 只要还需要工程师到现场敲命令，就还是"半自动"。ZTP 的价值在于把人的动作压缩到物理层面。 数据比代码重要一个数量级。 现实项目的瓶颈几乎总是"没有可信的 SoT"：IP 在三处不一致、VLAN 没有权威定义、设备角色靠人记。 先把数据标准化，再谈自动化。 幂等性是安全底线，不是优雅。 网络自动化事故里，有相当比例是"第二次执行"造成的。把"连续执行两次，第二次零变更"作为 CI 硬门槛，能消掉一大类事故。 语法检查几乎不解决问题，意图验证才解决问题。 yamllint 通过不代表网络能通。至少要有 Batfish 这一层的可达性/ACL 分析，最好再加灰度这一层真实流量验证。 灰度是唯一能在"损失 1% 前"发现错误的手段。 全量下发不是"效率高"，是"把测试省掉"。Ring 1 一定要选"业务影响小、有现场支持、拓扑有代表性"的站点。 回滚要提前设计，而且要考虑"状态不可回滚"。 配置可以恢复，但 BGP 会话重建、OSPF 重收敛、TCP 连接中断已经发生了。所以能增量就别整体替换，能给超时回滚就别裸奔。 自动化放大的是流程，不是能力。 流程混乱 + 自动化 = 混乱的自动化。先标准化（变更分级、审批、测试要求、回滚方案），再写代码。 没有遥测的自动化是闭眼开车。 配置自动化只解决"改得动"，遥测 + 断言才解决"改得对"。顺序是：可观测性 → 配置自动化 → 闭环自愈。 只读先行，是存量网络唯一可行的起点。 采集 → 基线 → 合规报告，风险为零、立刻产出价值，而且它是漂移检测、SoT、验证层的共同前提。 跳过"读"直接"写"，等于在没有地图的雷区里开车。 派生值必须由代码算，不能由人填。 网关 = 子网 +1、路由度量 = 带宽派生、ACL 条目由策略派生。一旦把派生值写进 SoT，改一个前缀就要改几百处，而人一定会漏。 覆盖率的敌人是长尾，处理长尾只有三条路：数据驱动、条件分支、豁免清单。 覆盖率卡在 80% 时，团队是双轨运行，收益基本被抵消；而"特殊的那些设备"恰恰是出事最多的。 编排平台本身是生产系统。 方案里必须写明"平台宕机 4 小时，业务是否照常转发、变更怎么做"，并且 演练过 break-glass 手工路径 。只写"控制器 HA"是不够的。 凭据治理必须先于自动化落地。 自动化会成倍放大凭据暴露面（脚本、CI 日志、制品、缓存、AI 上下文）。共享账号 + 静态密码 + 明文日志三项共存，等于把设备控制权挂在内部网。 模板引擎的"容错默认值"是最隐蔽的杀手。 Jinja2 未定义变量默认为空，会生成"语法合法但语义放宽"的配置（ permit ip any any 级别的事故）。 严格模式 + 渲染结构断言 + 负向测试 三件套必须标配。 确定性工程里没有"应该没事"。 断言要能被证明"坏的时候会红"（注入故障验证），遥测管道要有自监控（丢样率），回滚要演练过（不只是写在 Runbook 里）。 没验证过的能力，等于不存在的能力。 AI 只让"生成"变便宜，没有让"变更"变安全。 它产出的一切仍然要过同一条防线：评审 → lint → schema → 意图验证 → 灰度 → 断言。用 AI 跳过评审，就是用更快的速度制造更大的事故。

x: Chapter Introduction: Fifteen Counterintuitive Truths About Multicast Design · 本章导读：组播设计的十五个反直觉认知 Multicast is the field where "the shortest configuration produces the longest outage". One line of ip pim sparse-mode plus one RP address makes it "run", yet production incidents routinely last hours, because multicast forwarding does not follow unicast intuition . 组播是网络设计里"配置最短、事故最长"的领域。一条 ip pim sparse-mode 加一个 RP 地址就能"跑起来"，但生产事故往往持续数小时，因为组播的转发路径 不遵循单播直觉 。 1. Multicast has no "destination-based routing", only "reverse check of the source" · 组播没有"目的地址选路"，只有"源的反向检查" Unicast forwarding looks at the destination and takes the longest match. Multicast forwarding looks at the source : the router checks "did this packet arrive on the optimal interface toward the source ?" — that is RPF (Reverse Path Forwarding) . 单播转发看 目的地址 ，走最长匹配。组播转发看 源地址 ：路由器检查"这个组播包是从 通向源的最优接口 进来的吗？"—— 这就是 RPF（Reverse Path Forwarding） 。 Three consequences follow necessarily : 由此推出三个必然结果 ： Multicast trees are pulled by receivers (except PIM-DM), not pushed by sources Unicast routing determines the multicast path . Change the unicast route and the tree is rebuilt When unicast and multicast paths diverge (asymmetric routing, policy routing, multiple exits), multicast simply breaks while unicast stays perfectly healthy 组播树是 由接收者"拉"出来的 （除 PIM-DM 外），不是由源"推"出来的 单播路由决定组播路径 。单播路由一变，组播树跟着重建 单播与组播路径不一致（非对称路由、策略路由、多出口）时， 组播直接断 ，而单播一切正常 💡 The first question in any multicast troubleshooting is always: "which interface does show ip rpf source use, and is it the interface the packet arrived on?" 90% of "multicast does not work" cases die at this step. 💡 组播排障第一问永远是：" show ip rpf 源 走哪个接口？和进来的接口一致吗？" 90% 的"组播不通"死在这一步。 2. Multicast is a "broadcast domain problem", not just a "routing problem" · 组播是"广播域问题"，不只是"路由问题" Multicast frames are sent at Layer 2 using multicast MAC addresses. Without IGMP Snooping , a switch treats them as broadcast and floods them across the whole VLAN — a 4 Mbps video stream gets pushed to 500 ports.

x: 组播帧在二层用组播 MAC 发送。如果交换机没有 IGMP Snooping ，它会把组播帧当成广播 泛洪到整个 VLAN —— 一个 4 Mbps 的视频流会推给 500 个端口。 Conversely, if Snooping is enabled but there is no Querier (no PIM router in the VLAN), the snooping entries age out and multicast becomes "works intermittently". 反过来，如果 Snooping 开了但 没有 Querier （VLAN 内没有 PIM 路由器），Snooping 表会被老化掉，组播又变成"时通时断"。 Conclusion: a multicast design must design Layer 3 (PIM/RP) and Layer 2 (Snooping/Querier/Mrouter) at the same time. Do only Layer 3 and the incidents happen in the access layer. 结论：组播设计必须同时设计三层（PIM/RP）和二层（Snooping/Querier/Mrouter）。 只做三层，事故在接入层。 3. The RP is not an "optional component"; in PIM-SM it is "a single point plus the state centre" · RP 不是"可选组件"，在 PIM-SM 里它是"单点 + 状态中心" In PIM-SM every (*,G) state converges toward the RP. When the RP dies: - Established (S,G) shortest-path trees keep forwarding (because they already switched to the SPT) - But new receivers cannot join and new sources cannot register PIM-SM 里所有（*，G）状态都要往 RP 汇聚。RP 挂了： - 已建立的（S，G）最短路径树 还能继续转发 （因为已切到 SPT） - 但 新的接收者无法加入 、 新的源无法注册 So "the RP died and nothing broke" is a dangerous illusion — it only proves the current session survives. The next person who changes channel gets nothing. The RP must be made redundant (Anycast-RP + MSDP, or BSR with multiple C-RPs). 所以 "RP 挂了业务没断"是一个危险的假象 —— 它只说明当前会话还在，下一次有人打开频道就全断。RP 必须做冗余（Anycast-RP + MSDP，或 BSR + 多 C-RP）。 4. The default SPT switchover is not always a good thing · 默认的 SPT 切换不总是好事 PIM-SM by default switches from the shared tree (RPT) to the shortest-path tree (SPT) once a receiver gets the first packet. Latency is optimal, at the cost of: - N copies of (S,G) state at the source side (one path per receiver branch) - Source-side links possibly carrying multiple copies (if the RP sits badly) - Exploding router state counts in large multi-channel deployments PIM-SM 默认在接收者收到第一个包后，从共享树（RPT）切到 最短路径树（SPT） 。这样时延最优，但代价是： - 源侧要维护 N 份（S，G）状态 （每接收者一份路径） - 源侧链路可能承载多份流量（如果 RP 位置不好） - 大规模多频道场景下， 路由器状态数暴增 In some scenarios (source close to

This is a genuine trade-off, not a case of "the default is best". 某些场景（如源与 RP 很近、频道极多）应保留共享树，用 ip pim spt-threshold infinity 。 这是一个真实的取舍，不是"默认最好"。 5. SSM is the modern default answer · SSM 才是现代组播的默认答案 Almost all of PIM-SM's complexity (RP, registration, shared tree, SPT switchover, MSDP) comes from " not knowing where the source is ". Yet in reality the vast majority of enterprise multicast (IPTV, video conferencing, market-data push, CCTV) has known, fixed sources . PIM-SM 的复杂性（RP、注册、共享树、SPT 切换、MSDP）几乎全部来自" 不知道源在哪 "。而现实中绝大多数企业组播（IPTV、视频会议、行情推送、监控） 源是已知的、固定的 。 SSM (232.0.0.0/8 + IGMPv3) removes the RP entirely : receivers join (S,G) directly and follow the shortest-path tree to the source. If SSM can do the job, do not use PIM-SM — that is the biggest conceptual shift in multicast design of the past decade. SSM（232.0.0.0/8 + IGMPv3）把 RP 整个去掉了 ：接收者直接 (S,G) 加入，沿最短路径树到源。 能用 SSM 就不要用 PIM-SM ，这是过去十年组播设计最大的理念变化。 6. Multicast has no retransmission and no congestion control · 组播没有重传，也没有拥塞控制 Unicast has TCP retransmission and window control; multicast (usually UDP) loses a packet permanently . So multicast quality depends entirely on: - A congestion-free path (QoS reservation or bandwidth planning) - A stable tree structure (switchover means packet loss) - No Layer 2 flooding (flooding causes transient congestion, hence wide-scale loss) 单播有 TCP 重传与窗口控制；组播（通常 UDP） 丢一个包就永久丢了 。所以组播的质量完全依赖： - 路径无拥塞 （需要 QoS 预留或带宽规划） - 树的结构稳定 （切换 = 丢包） - 二层不泛洪 （泛洪导致瞬时拥塞 = 大面积丢包） Design implication: multicast must be treated as a real-time service (QoS, bandwidth reservation, fast convergence), never as best-effort data. 设计含义：组播必须按"实时业务"对待（QoS、带宽预留、快速收敛），而不是当"尽力而为的数据"。 7. DR, Querier, Assert Winner and DF are four different roles · DR、Querier、Assert Winner、DF 是四个 不同 的角色 This is the favourite confusion of CCDE multiple-choice questions and a frequent source of real outages: 这是 CCDE 选择题最爱混淆的点，也是真实故障的高发点： Role Scope Election rule Which mode only Consequence of failure IGMP Querier one Layer 2 segment (VLAN) lowest IP (can be overridden; a switch with querier enabled competes with routers) all modes (wherever IGMP exists) group membership ages out → periodic multicast interruption PIM DR one Layer 2 segment (with PIM neighbours) highest DR priority → highest IP SM/SSM/Bidir (DM does not need it but still has a DR concept for IGMP) nobody sends Join/Register on that segment → multicast never goes upstream Assert Winner one Layer 2 segment , per (S,G) best RPF metric → if equal, highest IP all modes (DM/SM/SSM) duplicate forwarding on the same LAN → duplicate packets BiDir DF one segment + per group , and directional (toward the RP) best unicast metric to the RP BiDir only traffic cannot go upstream to the RP, or several routers forward upstream at once 角色 作用范围 选举规则 只在哪个模式存在 失效后果 IGMP Querier 一个 二层网段 （VLAN） 最低 IP （可被显式配置覆盖；交换机启用 querier 后与路由器竞争） 所有模式（只要有 IGMP） 组成员老化 → 组播周期性中断 PIM DR 一个 二层网段 （有 PIM 邻居） 最高 DR 优先级 → 最高 I

x: P SM/SSM/Bidir（DM 不需要，但仍有 DR 概念用于 IGMP） 该网段无人发 Join/Register → 组播不上行 Assert Winner 一个 二层网段 、 每个 (S,G) RPF 度量最优 → 度量相同比 IP 所有模式（DM/SM/SSM） 同一 LAN 上重复转发 → 重复包 BiDir DF 一个 网段 + 每个组 ，且 有方向性 （朝 RP） 到 RP 的单播度量最优 只有 BiDir 流量无法上行到 RP，或多台同时上行 Four real traps : 四个真实陷阱 ： Querier and DR can be different boxes : very common (Querier picks the lowest IP, DR the highest, i.e. opposite directions). If Querier is on A and DR on B, the Join is sent by B while membership maintenance is done by A — it works, but troubleshooting requires looking at both. A switch Querier can steal the role from the router : if the access switch SVI is lower than the gateway address, the switch becomes Querier. Harmless in itself, but if the switch does not run PIM it only sends queries and never joins PIM ; snooping's mrouter still points at the router, so it works. However, if the switch's query-interval differs from the router's, the group table jitters briefly. Assert only solves "duplicate forwarding on one LAN", not "duplicate paths" : path redundancy across different LANs must be solved by IGP metrics, or by making the RPF choice unique. BiDir DF is per-group : the same interface may be DF for one group and not for another. BiDir troubleshooting must always name the group ; interface-level conclusions are invalid. Querier 与 DR 是两台不同设备 ：很常见（Querier 选最低 IP，DR 选最高 IP，方向相反）。如果 Querier 在 A、DR 在 B， Join 由 B 发 ，而 成员维持由 A 做 —— 功能上可以工作，但排障时"看表"要两台都看。 交换机 Querier 抢走了路由器 Querier ：接入交换机 SVI 地址比网关低时，交换机会成为 Querier。这本身无害，但如果交换机没开 PIM， 它只发查询、不参与 PIM ，Snooping 的 mrouter 仍指向路由器，功能正常。但如果交换机 Querier 的 query-interval 与路由器不同，会出现短暂的组表抖动。 Assert 只解决"同一 LAN 重复转发"，不解决"两条路径重复" ：不同 LAN 的路径冗余要靠 IGP 度量或 PIM 的 RPF 唯一性解决。 BiDir 的 DF 是 per-group 的 ：同一个接口对不同组可能是 DF 也可能不是。所以 BiDir 的排障必须带组名 ，不能用接口级结论。 ⚠️ The most common class of "mystery failure" : two Layer 3 switches act as HSRP gateways, both run PIM, both connect to the same access VLAN. HSRP Active on A, PIM DR on B, IGMP Querier on B . Result: the Join is sent by B (correct),

The design must state explicitly whether the multicast forwarding point and the default gateway are the same device . ⚠️ 最常见的一类"神秘故障" ：两台三层交换机做 HSRP 网关，都跑 PIM，都连同一个接入 VLAN。 HSRP Active 在 A、PIM DR 在 B、IGMP Querier 在 B 。结果：Join 由 B 发（正确），流量由 B 转给接入层（正确），但 返回的单播（如监控的回看请求）走 HSRP 虚拟 MAC 到 A —— A 上没有任何组播状态，业务偶发失败。设计时要明确"组播转发点与默认网关是否为同一台"。 11. Multicast "bandwidth" is not "stream bandwidth" but "stream bandwidth × number of branches × (1 + redundancy factor)" · 组播的"带宽"不是"流带宽"，而是"流带宽 × 分支数 × (1 + 冗余系数)" This is where capacity planning is most often miscalculated. Unicast bandwidth is one end-to-end path; multicast bandwidth must be counted on every edge of the tree. 这是容量规划里最容易算错的地方。单播的带宽是"端到端一条"，组播的带宽是"树边上每一段都要算"。 An 8 Mbps multicast stream with 3 fork points in the tree: source ──── 8 Mbps ──── R1 ──┬── 8 Mbps ── R2 ── 8 Mbps ── receiver group A (10 hosts) └── 8 Mbps ── R3 ── 8 Mbps ── receiver group B (20 hosts) Link load: source→R1 8 Mbps R1→R2 8 Mbps (not 8×10! replication to ports happens after R2) R2→access 8 Mbps (with correct snooping, only to ports with subscribers) R1→R3 8 Mbps But without IGMP Snooping: R2→access 8 Mbps × 24 ports = 192 Mbps ← replication amplification happens here 一条 8 Mbps 的组播流，树有 3 个分叉点： 源 ──── 8 Mbps ──── R1 ──┬── 8 Mbps ── R2 ── 8 Mbps ── 接收者组A(10台) └── 8 Mbps ── R3 ── 8 Mbps ── 接收者组B(20台) 链路负载： 源→R1 8 Mbps R1→R2 8 Mbps（不是 8×10！组播在 R2 之后才复制到端口） R2→接入 8 Mbps（若接入交换机 Snooping 正常，只到有订阅者的端口） R1→R3 8 Mbps 但如果没有 IGMP Snooping： R2→接入 8 Mbps × 24 端口 = 192 Mbps ← 复制放大发生在这里 Layer 3 replicates along the tree; Layer 2 replicates per port. The real bottleneck in multicast design is state count, not bandwidth · 组播设计真正的瓶颈是"状态数量"，不是"带宽" This determines the shape of every large-scale multicast design. Router and switch multicast state capacity is a hard limit , and it is limited in three resource dimensions at once : 这一点决定了所有大规模组播设计的形态。 路由器/交换机的组播状态容量是硬上限 ，而且是 三类资源同时受限 ： Resource Unit Typical limit Consequence of exceeding it * (S,G) / ( ,G) entries entries hardware TCAM / software hash table new groups cannot be created (symptom: "new channels will not open, old ones are fine") Outgoing interface list (OIL) length interfaces/entries multicast replication engine excess interfaces are dropped (one branch silently missing, very hard to spot) Multicast replication bandwidth (fabric) bps switch fabric / backplane replication capability drops, packet loss 资源 单位 典型受限点 超限后果 * (S,G) / ( ,G) 表项数 条 硬件 TCAM / 软件 hash 表 新组无法建立 （表现为"新频道打不开，老频道正常"） 出接口列表（OIL）长度 接口/条 组播复制引擎（replication engine） 超限接口被丢弃（组播少送一路，很难发现） 组播复制带宽（fabric） bps 交换网/背板 复制能力下降、丢包 Estimating state count (must go into the design) : 状态数量的估算（必须写进设计） ： PIM-SM with SPT switchover (default): state ≈ number of (*,G) (= groups that have receivers) + number of (S,G) (≈ groups × how many separate receiver subtrees pull distinct paths) i.e. state grows with the number of receiver branches, not linearly with receivers (100 receivers on the same LAN produce exactly 1 (S,G)) PIM-SSM: state ≈ number of (S,G) (= groups × sources), no (*,G) key advantage: unaffected by RP state or registration state BiDir: state ≈ number of (*,G) (= groups), independent of the number of sources key advantage: constant state in many-to-many scenarios PIM-SM + SPT 切换（默认）: 状态 ≈ (*,G) 数（= 有接收者的组数） + (S,G) 数（≈ 组数 × 每个组被多少个 接收者子树 拉出独立路径） 即：状态随 接收者分布的分支数 增长，而不是随接收者数量线性增长 （同一个 LAN 上的 100 个接收者只产生 1 条 (S,G)） PIM-SSM: 状态 ≈ (S,G) 数（= 组数 × 源数），无 (*,G) 关键优势：不受 RP 状态、不受注册状态影响 BiDir: 状态 ≈ (*,G) 数（= 组数），与源数量无关 关键优势：多源场景下状态恒定 💡 A real capacity judgement : a platform

The only correct answer is not "optimise" but change the architecture : MVR aggregation + per-region channel partitioning + SSM to remove (*,G) + BiDir where necessary. 💡 一个真实的容量判断 ：某平台最多 32K 条 mroute、每表项最多 32 个出接口。如果业务是 2000 个组 × 平均 40 个分支 ，就是 80K 条 —— 已经超了 2.5 倍 。这时唯一正确的解法不是"优化"，而是 改架构 ：MVR 收敛 + 按区域分频道 + SSM 减少 (*,G) + 必要时 BiDir。 14. "It plays" and "it plays over the right path" are two different things: the design must define the correct tree shape · "能看"和"看对"是两件事：设计必须定义"树的正确形状" Multicast has an acceptance difficulty shared by no other technology: a wrong tree still works . 组播有一个和所有其他技术都不同的验收难点： 错误的树也能工作 。 Wrong tree Symptom Why nobody notices Traffic hairpins through the RP (should have switched to the SPT) 20 ms extra latency, high RP bandwidth video still plays Traffic takes the backup path (RPF points at a suboptimal route) wasted bandwidth, higher latency usually imperceptible Two groups share one link (should be separated) they interfere at peak only breaks when busy Live-Live carried only one leg availability is actually single-path discovered only when that leg fails Multicast tunnelled over unicast MTU and latency problems surface late normal most of the time 错误的树 现象 为什么不报警 流量绕经 RP（本该切 SPT） 时延多 20 ms、RP 带宽高 视频照样播 走了备用路径（RPF 指向次优） 带宽浪费、时延上升 一般无感知 两组流量共用一条链路（本该分离） 峰值时互相影响 只在忙时出问题 Live-Live 只走了一路 可用性实际是单路 直到那一路断了才发现 组播走单播隧道绕行 MTU/时延问题延迟暴露 平时正常 So acceptance must verify the shape, not merely reachability : 所以验收必须"验证形状"，而不是"验证通" ： ! Decide at design time: is mtrace allowed? If not, what replaces it (static baselines plus NetFlow path analysis)? A multicast network without path verification is "doing redundancy with your eyes closed". ⚠️ mtrace 是组播唯一的"路径证明工具" ，但它本身是组播/单播混合的探测协议，很多网络为了"安全"全禁了。 设计阶段就要决定：是否允许 mtrace？如果不允许，用什么替代（静态基线 + NetFlow 路径分析）？ 没有路径验证能力的组播网络，等于"闭着眼睛做冗余"。 15. The last line of defence for multicast is rate limiting and boundaries, not trust · 组播的最后一道防线是"限速与边界"，不是"信任" Multicast is a natural amplifier: a 1 Mbps source can saturate 100 gigabit links , because: 组播天生是"放大器"： 一个 1 Mbps 的源可以打满 100 条千兆链路 。因为： one packet can be replicated to N interfaces (router replication) one Join can pull the whole tree's traffic (receivers are not authenticated) one SA can make your RP join an arbitrary source (MSDP injection when unauthenticated) one host's IGMP Report can make a switch deliver multicast to it (unless an IGMP profile exists) 一个包可以被复制到 N 个接口（路由器复制） 一个 Join 可以拉出整棵树的流量（接收者无需认证） 一个 SA 可以让你的 RP 去加入任意源（MSDP 无认证时的注入） 一台主机的 IGMP Report 可以让交换机把组播送到它（除非做 IGMP profile） So every multicast design must include the four-piece set of "rate limiting and boundaries" : 所以所有的组播设计都必须包含"限速与边界"四件套 ： Measure Location What it prevents Multicast boundary ( ip multicast boundary ) all domain edges, access-layer uplinks group leakage (groups that should not spread, spreading) Per-group / per-interface IGMP limits access layer one host joining thousands of groups (blowing up the snooping table) PIM neighbour authentication (MD5) all PIM neighbours forged PIM Hellos stealing DR, or flooding MSDP SA filtering + sa-limit between RPs SA injection, memory exhaustion Multicast rate limiting ( ip multicast rate-limit / MQC policer) source-side FHR, domain edges a single source saturating a link 措施 位置 防的是 组播边界（ ip multicast boundary ） 所有域边界、接

If the business complains that "bandwidth is still consumed after the player was closed", the answer is not "the network is broken" but "this is IGMP default behaviour". There are only two ways to speed it up: make the application send a Leave (most players do) or shorten the timers (a network-wide risk). 💡 一个可直接用于设计的推导 ：默认参数下， 从"主机停止收流"到"网络停止送流"最长需要 260 s （不显式 Leave 时）。如果业务方抱怨"关了播放器还在耗带宽"，答案不是"网络有问题"，而是"IGMP 默认行为如此"。要加快只有两条路： 让应用发 Leave （绝大多数播放器会发）或 缩短定时器 （有全网风险）。 IGMPv3 source-filtering modes (the core of SSM) : IGMPv3 的源过滤模式（SSM 的核心） ： Mode Meaning What the host expresses Network behaviour INCLUDE receive only the listed sources "G, sources {S1,S2}" build trees only to S1 and S2, reject all other sources EXCLUDE receive all sources except those listed "G, everything except {S3}" build trees to all sources except S3 (ASM semantics, requires an RP) CHANGE_TO_INCLUDE / EXCLUDE state transition incremental update triggers the corresponding Join/Prune ALLOW / BLOCK (legacy notation) allow/block one source in the list — converted internally to INCLUDE/EXCLUDE 模式 含义 主机表达 网络行为 INCLUDE 只接收列出的源 "G，源 {S1,S2}" 只对 S1、S2 建树，其他源一律拒绝 EXCLUDE 接收除列出的源之外的所有源 "G，除 {S3} 都收" 对除 S3 的源建树（ASM 语义，需要 RP） CHANGE_TO_INCLUDE / EXCLUDE 状态切换 增量更新 触发对应的 Join/Prune ALLOW / BLOCK（旧写法） 源列表中某源允许/阻止 — 内部转换为 INCLUDE/EXCLUDE The key point: INCLUDE mode is a built-in source whitelist. On receiving a multicast packet, the router checks the source address — it forwards only if the incoming interface is the "optimal path interface toward the source", otherwise it drops the packet silently . RPF 是组播路由的核心概念。路由器收到组播包后， 检查源地址 —— 只有当入接口是"到达源地址的最优路径接口"时，才转发该包；否则 静默丢弃 。 unicast routing table (toward source 10.1.1.1 via Gi0/1) ↓ source 10.1.1.1 → R1 ──Gi0/1──→ R2 ──→ receivers │ RPF check: incoming interface == Gi0/1 ? ├─ yes → forward and create (S,G) state └─ no → drop (RPF Failure) 单播路由表（到源 10.1.1.1 走 Gi0/1） ↓ 源 10.1.1.1 → R1 ──Gi0/1──→ R2 ──→ 接收者 │ RPF 检查：包的入接口 == Gi0/1 ? ├─ 是 → 转发，并建立 (S,G) 状态 └─ 否 → 丢弃（RPF Failure） Three key facts about RPF : RPF 的三个关键事实 ： Fact Meaning RPF uses the unicast routing table change unicast routing and the multicast tree follows; unicast/multicast path mismatch = multicast broken RPF failures are silent no ICMP error, no log (only debug /mroute counters); the symptom is "the source is sending, nothing arrives" RPF is checked on ingress egress is decided by the multicast routing table (mroute)/OIL, the opposite of unicast 事实 含义 RPF 用的是单播路由表 单播路由一变，组播树跟着变；单播/组播路径不一致 = 组播断 RPF 失败是静默的 没有 ICMP 错误、没有日志（除 debug / mroute 计数），表现为"源在发，收不到" RPF 检查在入方向 出口由组播路由表（mroute）/出接口列表决定，与单播相反 The four sources of the RPF check (highest priority first) · RPF 检查的四种来源（优先级从高到低） Source Command Purpose Static mroute ip mroute 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.255 Gi0/1 override the unicast path (the most common emergency tool) MBGP (multicast BGP, SAFI 2) address-family ipv4 multicast provides a separate RPF table for multicast (common across domains) Multitopology routing (MTR) a separate topology complete separation of multicast and unicast (complex, rarely used) Unicast RIB show ip route the default source 来源 命令 用途 静态 mroute ip mroute 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.255 Gi0/1 覆盖单播路径（最常用的应急手段） MBG

The mechanism: Prune Override（剪枝否决） ：同一 LAN 上有两台下游路由器，A 想 Prune、B 还想收。机制： A sends Prune → B hears the Prune and immediately sends a Join to override it (within about 3 s) → upstream sees Prune then Join and keeps forwarding A 发 Prune → B 听到 Prune → 立即发 Join 覆盖（Prune Override，约 3 秒内） → 上游看到 先 Prune 后 Join ，最终保留转发 Design implication : a Prune is not effective immediately ; there is an "override window". So "closing a channel" may take a few seconds to actually save bandwidth. In high-churn scenarios (IPTV zapping) that window leaves upstream briefly holding the old group — harmless, but on devices close to their state limit it amplifies state pressure. 设计含义 ： Prune 不是立即生效的 ，它有"被否决窗口"。因此"关闭一个频道"可能延迟几秒才真正省带宽。在高频切换场景（IPTV 换台），这个窗口会让上游短暂维持旧组 —— 影响不大，但在 状态数接近上限 的设备上，会放大状态压力。 PIM Join Suppression · PIM 的"Join 抑制" The problem : 10 routers on the same LAN each forward downstream and each sends a Join upstream for the same (S,G) → upstream receives 10 Joins. 问题 ：同一 LAN 上 10 台路由器都往下游转发，都要向上游发 Join（同一个 (S,G)）→ 上游收到 10 份 Join。 The mechanism : when a router hears another router on the same LAN send the same (S,G) Join ( if that router's RPF neighbour is the same as its own ), it suppresses its own Join . This is what the "join suppression capable" bit in Hello is for. 机制 ：路由器听到同 LAN 其他路由器发出同一条 (S,G) Join 后， 抑制自己的 Join （如果对端的 RPF 邻居与自己的相同）。这是 Hello 中"Join Suppression 能力位"的作用。 Symptom Explanation upstream sees only one Join normal (suppression working) upstream sees several Joins suppression disabled, or unsupported on the platform suppression vs DR

every 60 s it unicasts a Candidate-RP-Advertisement to the BSR - contents: RP address, served group range (group-list), priority, holdtime (150 s default) [2] BSR election - all BSR candidates send Bootstrap messages to each other (224.0.0.13 multicast) - A BSR filter ( ip pim bsr-border ) or an ACL is mandatory at domain edges. Multiple BSR candidates cause "partitioning" : if two BSR candidates cannot reach each other (ACL blocking 224.0.0.13) they each become the BSR and the network splits into two RP views → some receivers join the wrong RP . Propagation delay of RP-Set changes : BSR propagation is "hop-by-hop flooding at 60 s intervals", so in large networks a new RP may take minutes to take effect network-wide . This is where BSR is worse than Anycast-RP (which is routing-convergence grade, i.e. seconds). The reason: Registers are a continuous, per-source cost, whereas shared-tree traffic stops passing through the RP once the SPT is built. Many designs put the RP "in the middle of the users" (because it feels "close to the users"), which actually increases cross-WAN registration traffic. 结论（可量化的设计原则） ： RP 应放在"源最集中"的一侧，而不是"接收者最多"的一侧。 原因：Register 是 持续的、按源计 的开销，而共享树流量在 SPT 切换后就不再经过 RP。很多设计把 RP 放在"用户中心"（因为直觉上"离用户近"），实际增加了跨 WAN 的注册流量。 If sources are spread across sites : 如果源分散在多个站点 ： Option Explanation RP on the same side as LHR/FHR (one Anycast pair per site) the most thorough: Registers never leave the site; cross-site via MSDP SA Single RP near the main source simple, but secondary sources register across the WAN Switch to SSM no RP needed at all (recommended) 方案 说明 LHR/FHR 同侧 RP（每站点一对 Anycast） 最彻底：Register 不出站点，跨站点靠 MSDP SA 单 RP + 靠近主源 简单，但次要源跨 WAN 注册 改 SSM 根本不需要 RP（推荐） RP Capacity Baseline (the four things you must monitor) · RP 容量基线（必须监控的四项） Metric Meaning Alert threshold (rule of thumb) * ( ,G) count number of groups the RP carries alert above 60% of platform capability Register rate Register messages received per second a 5× spike → look for a new source / Register storm CPU (the RP process) multicast process utilisation sustained 50% → optimise or scale MSDP SA count source-active entries received a spike → look for SA injection / new services 指标 含义 告警阈值（经验） * ( ,G) 数 RP 承载的组数 平台能力 60% 告警 Register 速率 每秒收到的 Register 报文 突增 5 倍 → 查新源/Register 风暴 CPU（RP 进程） 组播进程占用 50% 持续 → 需优化/扩容 MSDP SA 数 收到的源活跃条目 突增 → 查 SA 注入 / 新业务

MSDP 基础配置 + 限制（生产必备） ip msdp peer 203.0.113.1 connect-source Loopback0 ip msdp cache-sa-state ip msdp sa-filter in 203.0.113.1 list 10 ! 只接受指定源的 SA（防注入） ip msdp sa-filter out 203.0.113.1 list 20 ! 只通告自己的源 ip msdp sa-limit 203.0.113.1 5000 ! 防 SA 泛洪打爆内存 ⚠️ The MSDP security risk : anything that can open TCP 639 to your RP can advertise arbitrary (S,G) pairs, making your network join a non-existent or malicious source (resource consumption). In production you must configure sa-filter + sa-limit + peer authentication (MD5/TCP-AO) + an ACL restricting the source of port 639. ⚠️ MSDP 的安全风险 ：任何能与你的 RP 建立 TCP 639 的设备都可以 通告任意 (S,G) ，让你的网络去加入一个不存在的源（资源消耗）或恶意源。 生产上必须配 sa-filter + sa-limit + peer 认证（MD5/TCP-AO）+ ACL 限制 639 端口来源。 MBGP (Multicast BGP, SAFI 2) The problem : the unicast best path and the multicast best path may differ. For example: - unicast via carrier A (cheaper), multicast required via carrier B (better multicast quality) - unicast uses a default route, multicast needs exact source prefixes 问题 ：单播最优路径与组播最优路径可能不同。例如： - 单播走运营商 A（便宜），组播要求走运营商 B（组播质量好） - 单播用默认路由，组播需要精确的源前缀 What MBGP does : BGP maintains a separate address family for multicast ( address-family ipv4 multicast , SAFI 2) , and routers prefer the MBGP table when performing the RPF check. x: Advanced Multicast Design · 高级组播设计 Live-Live (Dual-Active Multicast) · Live-Live（双活组播） Goal : when one path fails the receiver notices nothing (no dropped frames, no re-join). 目标 ：一条路径故障时，接收者 无感知 （不丢帧、不重新加入）。 Mechanism : the source sends the same content on two independent paths, on two different group addresses ; the receiver joins both groups , receives both streams, and the application (or decoder) selects or merges them. 机制 ：源同时通过 两条独立路径 发送 同一内容但不同组地址 的流；接收者 同时加入两个组 ，两个流都收到，由应用层（或解码器）选择/合并。 Requirement Explanation Two paths two physically non-overlapping paths (different fibre, different devices, different carriers) Independent RPs (when SM is used) a separate RP per path, avoiding a shared single point Unique group addresses one group per leg (e.g. 239.10.1.1 and 239.10.1.2) Multi-join receivers terminals must join both groups simultaneously (or use two NICs) Clock/sequence alignment the two streams must be comparable (RTP sequence numbers/timestamps) 要求 说明 双路径 两条 物理不重叠 的路径（不同光纤、不同设备、不同运营商） 独立 RP （若用 SM） 每条路径独立 RP，避免共享单点 唯一组地址 每路一个组（如 239.10.1.1 与 239.10.1.2） 接收者多加入 终端必须支持同时加入两个组（或双网卡） 时钟/序列对齐 两路流需可比较（RTP 序列号/时间戳） The biggest failure mode : two paths that are "logically independent but physically shared" . For example both links run through the same cable, the same duct, the same optical transport device — one digger cuts both. The value of Live-Live depends 100% on physical path independence , and this must be drawn in the design document as a physical route (not a logical topology). 最大的失败模式 ： 两条路径"逻辑上独立、物理上共享" 。例如两条链路走同一根光缆、同一个管道、同一台传输设备 —— 挖断一次两根全断。 Live-Live 的价值 100% 取决于路径的物理独立性 ，这一点必须在设计文档里画出物理路由（而不是逻辑拓扑）。 Scenario Is Live-Live a fit Financial market-data distribution (millisecond, zero loss) ★★★★★ Broadcast TV / live sports ★★★★☆ Ordinary enterprise video conferencing ★★☆☆☆ (too expensive; SSM + QoS is enough) CCTV video ★☆☆☆☆ (recording can backfill) 场景 是否适合 Live-Live 金融行情分发（毫秒级、不能丢） ★★★★★ 广播电视/赛事直播 ★★★★☆ 普通企业视频会议 ★★☆☆☆（成本过高，用 SSM + QoS 即可） 监控视频 ★☆☆☆☆（可用

One day the meeting-room TV started showing an "uninvited" surveillance picture, and bandwidth behaved abnormally. 场景 ：企业部署 IPTV 与视频监控，均使用 239.0.0.0/8 私有组播地址，未做统一规划。某天会议室的电视出现"不请自来"的监控画面，且带宽异常。 Investigation : 排查过程 ： IPTV used 239.10.1.1 , surveillance used 239.138.1.1 (each taken at random by its own team) Compute the MAC: - 239.10.1.1 → keep the low 23 bits → 0A:01:01 → MAC 01:00:5E:0A:01:01 - 239.138.1.1 → keep the low 23 bits → 0A:01:01 → MAC 01:00:5E:0A:01:01 - the two are identical (the second octets 10 and 138 differ by 128, and the top bit of the second octet is exactly one of the five discarded bits) The access VLAN had both IPTV and surveillance subscribers → the switch forwarded by MAC → the two groups leaked into each other IPTV 用 239.10.1.1 ，监控用 239.138.1.1 （两个业务各自随手取了一段） 计算 MAC： - 239.10.1.1 → 保留后 23 位 → 0A:01:01 → MAC 01:00:5E:0A:01:01 - 239.138.1.1 → 保留后 23 位 → 0A:01:01 → MAC 01:00:5E:0A:01:01 - 两者完全相同 （第二段 10 与 138 只差 128，而第二段的最高位正是被丢弃的 5 位之一） 接入层 VLAN 内既有 IPTV 又有监控订阅者 → 交换机按 MAC 转发 → 两个组互相串流 Quick collision test : the mapping discards "the low 4 bits of the first octet" plus "the top bit (128) of the second octet". A static mroute takes precedence over unicast routes , so the RPF check failed consistently. 真实原因 ： show ip rpf 显示的是 Gi0/2 ，但设备上配置了 ip mroute 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.255 Gi0/1 （历史遗留，为旧拓扑加的静态 mroute）。 静态 mroute 优先级高于单播路由 ，于是 RPF 检查恒定失败。 Fixes : 修复 ： ! remove the incorrect static mroute no ip mroute 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.255 Gi0/1 ! if a fixed RPF path is genuinely needed (e.g. multicast must use a separate exit) ip mroute 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.255 10.0.0.1 ! pointing at a next hop is safer than an interface ! enable multicast multipath where multiple paths exist ip multicast multipath ! 删除错误的静态 mroute no ip mroute 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.255 Gi0/1 ! 若确实需要固定 RPF 路径（例如组播要走独立出口） ip mroute 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.255 10.0.0.1 ! 指向下一跳而非接口更稳妥 ! 多路径场景开启组播多路径 ip multicast multipath Checklist (the standard RPF troubleshooting procedure) : 排查清单（RPF 类故障的标准流程） ： Step Command What to look at 1 show ip rpf source RPF interface and its source (unicast/static/mbgp) 2 show ip route source the unicast best path 3 show ip mroute group whether the incoming interface is Null , and the flags

Troubleshooting must compare three things — "unicast route + actual ingress interface + mroute state" — and in particular must check for legacy static mroutes. 教训 ： RPF 是组播的"隐形门卫"，失败时不报警、不记录（除计数器） 。排障必须"单播路由 + 实际入接口 + mroute 状态"三者对照，尤其要检查历史遗留的静态 mroute。 🔥 Case 3: The Monitoring Wall "Went Black Every Few Minutes", and Re-opening the Channel Fixed It · 🔥 案例三：监控大屏"每隔几分钟黑一下"，重新打开频道又好了 Scenario : 200 CCTV cameras on a campus, with a pure Layer 2 access VLAN (no Layer 3 multicast router). Operations reported that the wall picture stalled or went black roughly every 3–5 minutes, and recovered after switching channels. 场景 ：园区 200 个监控摄像头，接入层为纯二层 VLAN（无三层组播路由器）。运维反馈：大屏画面大约每 3–5 分钟卡顿/黑屏一次，重新切换频道后恢复。 Investigation : 排查过程 ： The switch's show ip igmp snooping groups → entries appeared and disappeared The VLAN's SVI was on the core, but no PIM router interface existed in that VLAN (PIM was not enabled on the core SVI) Therefore there was no IGMP Querier → nobody sent queries → snooping entries aged out after the default 260 s → multicast stopped being forwarded The user switched channels → a new IGMP Report was sent → entries rebuilt → temporary recovery 交换机 show ip igmp snooping groups → 组表项 时有时无 该 VLAN 的 SVI 在核心上，但 该 VLAN 内没有 PIM 路由器接口 （核心 SVI 未开 PIM） 因此 没有 IGMP Querier → 无人发查询 → 交换机 Snooping 表项在老化时间（默认 260 s）后删除 → 组播停止转发 用户重新切频道 → 发出新的 IGMP Report → 表项重建 → 短暂恢复 Root cause : IGMP Snooping depends on a Querier to maintain group membership . A Layer 3 multicast router sends queries, but a pure Layer 2 VLAN has none, so entries periodically expire.

Option 1 (recommended): let the core SVI be the multicast router interface Vlan200 ip address 10.20.0.1 255.255.255.0 ip pim sparse-mode ! enabling PIM makes it the Querier naturally ! Option 2: enable the Snooping Querier on the switch (when there is no Layer 3 multicast) ip igmp snooping querier ip igmp snooping querier address 10.20.0.254 ip igmp snooping querier query-interval 60 ! Option 3: static mrouter (only in very few scenarios) ip igmp snooping vlan 200 mrouter interface Gi1/0/1 ! 方案 1（推荐）：让核心 SVI 成为组播路由器 interface Vlan200 ip address 10.20.0.1 255.255.255.0 ip pim sparse-mode ! 开启 PIM，自然成为 Querier ! 方案 2：交换机启用 Snooping Querier（无三层组播时） ip igmp snooping querier ip igmp snooping querier address 10.20.0.254 ip igmp snooping querier query-interval 60 ! 方案 3：静态 mrouter（极少数场景） ip igmp snooping vlan 200 mrouter interface Gi1/0/1 Lesson : whenever IGMP Snooping is enabled, there must be a Querier in the VLAN . This is a classic "if you configure A you must also configure B" dependency, and many networks miss exactly this link when they "migrate Layer 3 into a Layer 2 extension". 教训 ： 只要开了 IGMP Snooping，就必须保证 VLAN 内有 Querier 。这是一个"配置了 A 就必须配套 B"的典型依赖，很多网络在"三层迁移到二层延伸"时正好漏掉这一环。 🔥 Case 4: After the RP Crashed, "Old Channels Fine, New Channels Would Not Open at All" · 🔥 案例四：RP 宕机后，"老频道正常、新频道全打不开" Scenario : a single-RP design (PIM-SM). The RP device rebooted for 20 minutes after a power supply failure. During the outage: - the 20 channels already playing kept working - switching channels or joining anew failed for everyone 场景 ：单 RP 设计（PIM-SM），RP 所在设备因电源故障重启 20 分钟。故障期间： - 已经在播放的 20 个频道 一直正常 - 任何人 切换频道/新加入 都失败 Root cause (textbook PIM-SM behaviour) : 根因（教科书级的 PIM-SM 行为） ： Symptom Cause old channels fine already switched to the SPT ; (S,G) state exists independently on each router and does not depend on the RP new channels will not open

If any one of them is the same, MSDP "comes up but does nothing" — the most insidious failure in any anycast-RP deployment. 教训 ： Anycast-RP 的三个"必须不同" ：①router-id 必须不同；②MSDP peer 地址必须用唯一 loopback；③ originator-id 必须指向唯一地址。任何一项相同，MSDP 就"通了但没用"——这是任何cast-RP 部署最隐蔽的故障。 🔥 Case 5: Multicast State Explosion — Core CPU at 60% and 10-Second Channel Zapping · 🔥 案例五：组播状态爆炸，核心路由器 CPU 60% 且频道切换要 10 秒 Scenario : hotel IPTV, 600 channels at 3–8 Mbps each, 2,000 rooms. PIM-SM with a single RP, SPT switchover left at the default. After six months the core CPU sat at 50%–60%, channel zapping was slow (8–12 s) with occasional pixellation. 场景 ：酒店 IPTV，600 个频道，每频道 3–8 Mbps，2,000 个房间。用 PIM-SM + 单 RP，默认开启 SPT 切换。运行半年后核心 CPU 持续 50%–60%，频道切换慢（8–12 秒），偶发花屏。 Root cause : 根因 ： State count = channels × receiver distribution : 600 channels × multiple (S,G) branches, tens of thousands of mroutes on the core Every channel change : IGMP Leave → group-specific query → Prune → new group Join → (*,G) to the RP → SPT switchover → several state changes Default SPT switchover meant every receiver created its own (S,G) on the core, so state grew linearly with the number of receivers The RP carried the initial traffic of every channel , becoming a bandwidth hotspot 状态数量 = 频道数 × 接收者分布 ：600 频道 × 多个 (S,G) 分支，核心维护数万条 mroute 每次频道切换 ：IGMP Leave → 组特定查询 → Prune → 新组 Join → (*,G) 到 RP → SPT 切换 → 多次状态变更 默认 SPT 切换 导致每个接收者都在核心建立独立 (S,G)，状态量随"接收者数"线性增长 RP 承载了全部频道的初始流量 ，形成带宽热点 Optimisation plan (ordered by benefit) : 优化方案（按收益排序） ： Action Effect Move to SSM (232/8 + IGMPv3 or SSM Mapping) **no RP, no (*,G), no SPT switchover**; state is only (S,G) and zapping is a single Join Converge multicast into VLANs (MVR) multicast no longer enters every user VLAN; Layer 2 flooding

x: falls sharply ip pim spt-threshold infinity (if SM is kept) a large reduction in state (shared tree kept), at the cost of higher latency Channel pre-join (Fast Channel Change) join the target group in advance when zapping, reducing black time PIM Snooping / multicast boundaries on the core restrict multicast to the links that need it 动作 效果 改为 SSM（232/8 + IGMPv3 或 SSM Mapping） **去掉 RP、去掉 (*,G)、去掉 SPT 切换**，状态只有 (S,G)，切换只发生一次 Join 组播 VLAN 收敛（MVR） 组播不再进每个用户 VLAN，二层泛洪大幅减少 ip pim spt-threshold infinity （若保留 SM） 大幅减少状态（保留共享树），代价是时延上升 频道预加入（Fast Channel Change） 切换时提前加入目标组，减少黑屏 核心开启 PIM Snooping / 组播边界 限制组播只在必要链路 Result : after moving to SSM the core mroute count fell 70%, CPU dropped to 15%, and zapping time went from 10 s to 1.5 s. 结果 ：改 SSM 后核心 mroute 条目下降 70%，CPU 降到 15%，频道切换时间从 10 秒降到 1.5 秒。 Lesson : PIM-SM's complexity is a tax paid for "unknown sources", while IPTV sources are known — for this class of scenario SSM is a "dimension reduction", not an "optimisation". The question to ask during design is: "is the source fixed?" If it is, SSM is the default answer. 教训 ： PIM-SM 的复杂度是为"未知源"付的税，而 IPTV 的源是已知的 —— 这类场景用 SSM 是"降维"而不是"优化"。设计阶段就该问："源固定吗？"如果固定，SSM 是默认答案。 🔥 Case 6: Cross-Domain Multicast — "Ping Works, PIM Neighbours Are Up, but No Stream" · 🔥 案例六：跨域组播"能 ping 通、PIM 邻居也在，但收不到流" Scenario : headquarters and a new campus interconnected through a third-party carrier MPLS VPN. The source is at headquarters (239.10.1.1) and campus receivers got nothing. PIM neighbours came up normally between PE and CE, and unicast connectivity was fine. 场景 ：总部与新建园区之间通过第三方运营商 MPLS VPN 互联。总部有组播源（239.10.1.1），园区接收者收不到。PIM 邻居在 PE-CE 之间正常建立，单播互通正常。 Investigation and root cause (several problems stacked) : 排查与根因（多个问题叠加） ： # Problem Symptom 1 the carrier had not enabled MVPN (unicast VPN only) PIM Hellos only between CE and PE; PEs did not forward multicast to each other 2 after temporarily using a GRE tunnel , the MTU was not adjusted large packets dropped; picture pixellated while small packets

GRE 隧道承载组播的关键配置 interface Tunnel0 ip address 172.16.0.1 255.255.255.252 ip pim sparse-mode ip mtu 1400 ! 关键：为 GRE 头预留，避免分片 tunnel source 203.0.113.1 tunnel destination 198.51.100.1 tunnel mode gre ip ! RPF 指向隧道（若单播路由不经隧道） ip mroute 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.255 Tunnel0 Acceptance checklist (always check these for cross-domain multicast) : 验收清单（跨域组播必查） ： Check item Method Is multicast carried by the intermediate network show ip mroute on the PE/CE shows whether multicast is forwarded Is the MTU sufficient large-packet ping ( ping 239.10.1.1 size 1400 df-bit ) Is RPF correct show ip rpf source matches the tunnel/ac

Verifying each item beats guessing where it broke. 教训 ： 组播跨域失败往往是"四件事同时不成立" ：承载（MVPN/隧道）、MTU、RPF、RP 可达。逐项验证比"猜哪里断了"快得多。 🔥 Case 7: Live-Live Dual Paths, and One Construction Job Cut Both Fibres · 🔥 案例七：Live-Live 双路设计，一次施工挖断两根光纤 Scenario : a stock exchange's market-data multicast used Live-Live: two sources, two paths, two group addresses, and dual-leg reception. The design document said "physically separated paths, 99.999% availability". 场景 ：证券交易所的行情组播采用 Live-Live：两个源、两条路径、两个组地址，接收端双路接收。设计文档写着"路径物理分离，可用性 99.999%"。 The event : municipal construction cut a fibre cable and both paths went down for 40 minutes ; market data stopped completely. 事件 ：市政施工挖断光缆， 两条路径同时中断 40 分钟 ，行情完全中断。 Root cause (the step the design review skipped) : 根因（设计评审没做的那一步） ： The logical topology of the two paths was indeed separate (different routers, different carriers) But the physical route shared one section of the same duct (both cables ran through the same trench) The design document had only a logical diagram, no physical route diagram No single-point-of-failure (SPOF) analysis was done — i.e. "which physical facilities do both paths share" 两条路径的 逻辑拓扑 确实分离（不同路由器、不同运营商） 但 物理路由 共用同一个管道井的一段（两条光缆走同一沟） 设计文档只有逻辑图， 没有物理路由图 也没有做"单点故障分析（SPOF）"—— 即"哪些物理设施被两条路径共享" Fixes : 修复 ： Action Explanation Draw the physical route diagram duct, manhole, entry room and power for each path, annotated segment by segment SPOF

This applies to Live-Live multicast, dual-active data centres and dual-carrier egress alike — logical redundancy is not physical redundancy . 教训 ： 冗余设计的有效性只取决于"共享点的数量"，不取决于"路径的条数" 。这一条对 Live-Live 组播、双活数据中心、双运营商出口全部适用 —— 逻辑冗余不等于物理冗余 。 🔥 Case 8: SSM Was Configured Correctly, yet the "TV in the Old Meeting Room" Showed Nothing · 🔥 案例八：SSM 明明配好了，但"老会议室的电视"就是看不了 Scenario : the campus migrated its video service to SSM (232.10.1.0/24, source 10.1.1.1) and configured ip pim ssm default everywhere. Most meeting rooms worked. VXLAN is not "the default answer for all traffic" — ultra-low-latency services (market data, HPC) may need to bypass the overlay. Multicast design must distinguish "service classes" instead of "one transport for everything". x: nation : a high-rate source plus an RPF failure . Because Registers encapsulate "per packet", a 40 Mbps source with a failed RPF keeps encapsulating 40 Mbps of data into unicast towards the RP — the RP's ingress bandwidth is consumed , and then all multicast suffers. This is the scale effect of "one source crippling the whole network" , and it is exactly why "rate-limiting at the source" has to be part of the design. ⚠️ 最危险的组合 ： 高码率源 + RPF 失败 。因为 Register 是"按包封装"，40 Mbps 的源在 RPF 失败时会持续把 40 Mbps 的数据封装成单播打给 RP —— RP 的入方向带宽被吃满 ，然后所有组播都受影响。 这是"一个源拖垮全网"的规模效应 ，也是为什么"源侧限速"必须作为设计的一部分。 Lessons : 教训 ： The root cause of a Register storm is almost always RPF ; register-rate-limit is only a tourniquet. The RP is the "control-plane single point" of the whole PIM-SM domain — when its CPU is slowed, the impact is not limited to new groups but hits processing for every group. Bringing a high-rate source online requires an "RP-perspective RPF pre-check" : confirm the route at the source, confirm show ip rpf on the RP, then turn the service up. Register 风暴的根因几乎总是 RPF ， register-rate-limit 只是止血带。 RP 是整个 PIM-SM 域的"控制面单点" —— 它的 CPU 被拖慢，影响的不只是新组播，而是所有组的处理。 高码率源上线必须做"RP 视角的 RPF 预检" ：源侧确认路由、RP 上确认 show ip rpf ，再开通业务。 🔥 Case 14: After an "All-Hands Webcast", a Whole Floor's Wi-Fi Was Down for Two Hours · 🔥 案例十四：开完一场"全网直播"，整个楼层的 Wi-Fi 瘫了两小时 Scenario : an all-hands meeting at headquarters (mostly wireless) was streamed internally over multicast (239.10.5.1, 4 Mbps). x: 180 clients on that floor 5 Airtime calculation a 4 Mbps stream at the lowest rate consumes about 60–70% of the airtime 步骤 检查 结果 1 WLC 的组播配置 未启用组播转单播（Multicast Direct） 2 AP 的信道利用率 95%+ 3 空口分析 大量 以最低基础速率（1 Mbps/6 Mbps）发送的组播帧 4 客户端数量 该楼层 180 个客户端 5 airtime 计算 4 Mbps 流 × 最低速率开销 → 吃掉约 60–70% 的 airtime Root cause (airtime maths) : 根因（airtime 数学） ： How multicast behaves on Wi-Fi: ① it is sent at the 【lowest basic rate】 (so that every client can demodulate it), e.g. 6 Mbps ② no ACK, no retransmission, no rate adaptation ③ one multicast frame is received (and must be decoded) by 【every associated client】 ④ the airtime a multicast frame occupies = frame length / lowest rate + overhead Calculation (4 Mbps stream, 1500-byte packets): packets per second ≈ 4 Mbps / 12,000 bit ≈ 333 pps airtime per packet (6 Mbps) ≈ 12,000/6,000,000 ≈ 2 ms + overhead ≈ 2.5 ms total airtime ≈ 333 x 2.5 ms = 833 ms per second ≈ 【83% of the airtime】 - only 17% is left for unicast; the normal traffic of 180 clients all queues - the symptom is Wi-Fi is down 组播在 Wi-Fi 上的特性： ① 以【最低基础速率】发送（为保证所有客户端都能解调），如 6 Mbps ② 无 ACK、无重传、无速率自适应 ③ 一个组播帧被【所有关联客户端】接收（都要解码） ④ 组播帧占用 airtime = 帧长 / 最低速率 + 开销 计算（4 Mbps 流，1500 字节包）： 每秒包数 ≈ 4 Mbps / 12,000 bit ≈ 333 包/秒 每包 airtime（6 Mbps）≈ 12,000/6,000,000 ≈ 2 ms + 开销 ≈ 2.5 ms 总 airtime ≈ 333 × 2.5 ms = 833 ms/秒 ≈ 【83% 的 airtime】 → 只剩 17% 给单播，180 个客户端的正常业务全部排队 → 表现为 Wi-Fi 瘫了 Fix (the complete set is mandatory) : 修复（必须做完整的一套） ： ! This is not a "configuration problem" but a medium characteristic (shared medium + lowest rate + no ACK). For every "watch the webcast over wireless" requirement, the correct answer is: distribute the multicast on the wired side to the APs nearest the users → convert to unicast at the AP → or simply use unicast (application-layer distribution/CDN) . Wi-Fi 不适合承载"大流量、长时间、多客户端"的组播。 这不是"配置问题"，是 介质特性问题 （共享介质 + 最低速率 + 无 ACK）。所有"无线看直播"的需求，正确方案是： 组播在有线侧分发到 AP 附近 → AP 上转单播 → 或者干脆用单播（应用层分发/CDN） 。 Lessons : 教训 ： The cost of multicast on wireless is "airtime", not "bandwidth" — a 4 Mbps stream can consume 83% of the air. x: treams (frame numbers are discontinuous) - the decoder cannot merge them - double image / artefacts This is not a network failure; it is dual-active sources without mutual exclusion . 源双活的 应用层语义 与 网络层语义 不一致： 网络层：两个源 = 两条独立的 (S,G) 树 → 只要源在发，两条树都存在 → LHR 会把两条树的流量都转给接收者 应用层：期望 只有一路是活的 → 但接收端拿到两路不同的编码数据（帧序号不连续） → 解码器无法合并 → 叠影 / 花屏 这不是网络故障，而是 双活源没有做互斥 。 Three correct approaches : 三种正确的做法 ： Option Mechanism Applicable to ① Source-side mutual exclusion (recommended) the backup only starts streaming after the primary is confirmed dead (heartbeat/arbitration) the vast majority of cases ② Different group addresses (Live-Live semantics) the two sources send to two groups (239.10.5.1 / 239.10.5.2) and the receivers de-duplicate with ST 2022-7 when "hitless switching" is required ③ Source filtering on the network allow only one source's (S,G) on the LHR (ACL / static mroute / SSM joining only the primary) a transition measure; switching is manual 方案 机制 适用 ① 源侧互斥（推荐） 备源只在主源确认失效后才开始推流（心跳/仲裁） 绝大多数场景 ② 不同组地址（Live-Live 语义） 两源发到两个组（239.10.5.1 / 239.10.5.2）， 接收端做 ST 2022-7 去重 需要"无感切换" ③ 网络侧源过滤 LHR 上只允许一个源的 (S,G)（ACL / 静态 mroute / SSM 只加入主源） 过渡方案，切换需人工 ! Option ③: accept only the primary on the LHR (change manually when switching over) interface Gi0/1 ip multicast boundary 40 ip access-list standard 40 permit 10.1.1.1 ! allow only the primary ! 方案③：LHR 上只接受主源（切换时人工改） interface Gi0/1 ip multicast boundary 40 ip access-list standard 40 permit 10.1.1.1 ! 只允许主源 ⚠️ "Two sources sending to the same group" is a design red line : it makes the network build two parallel trees, every "per-group" policy (QoS, rate limiting, monitoring) double-counts, and receivers get mixed data. Either "source mutual exclusion" or "two groups plus application-layer merging"; never "one group, two sources". ⚠️ "两个源发同一个组"是设计上的红线 ：它会让网络层产生两条并行的树，任何"按组"的策略（QoS、限速、监控）都会重复计算，而接收端会拿到混杂的数据。 要么"源互斥"，要么"两个组 + 应用层合并"，不要"同一组两个源"。 Lessons : 教训 ： Source redundancy is an application-layer problem, not a network-layer problem .

(very likely) 3 Unify the SSM range otherwise one side's 232/8 is treated as ASM 4 Configure scope/boundaries isolate during the merger, then open up service by service 5 Compare RP mappings network-wide collect show ip pim rp mapping from every device with a script and diff them 6 Use SSM to reduce dependencies move every service that can to SSM (the complexity of RP mappings drops sharply) 步骤 动作 说明 1 选定一种 RP 发现方式 跨厂商 → BSR；全 Cisco → Auto-RP；要求高可用 → Anycast-RP + 静态 RP 地址 2 统一地址规划 两侧的 239.10/239.20 是否冲突？（很可能冲突） 3 统一 SSM range 否则一侧的 232/8 被当 ASM 4 配 scope/边界 合并期先隔离，再按业务逐步放通 5 全网比对 RP 映射 用脚本从所有设备采集 show ip pim rp mapping 做 diff 6 用 SSM 减少依赖 能改 SSM 的业务全部改掉（合并后 RP 映射的复杂度大幅下降） ! Example unified design: move the whole network to Anycast-RP + a static RP address (most controllable) ! On all devices (domain A and domain B): ip pim rp-address 10.0.0.1 10 ! one anycast address ip pim ssm default access-list 10 permit 239.0.0.

x: ks". "One-way visibility" almost always means "inconsistent RP mappings" — because tree building is symmetric (A reaching B proves the path works), so the difference can only be in the control plane. A merger project should prioritise "moving to SSM" : once every "fixed-source" service is on SSM, what needs unifying drops from "RP mapping/discovery/MSDP/scope" to "just the address plan". 组播没有"自动融合"能力 —— 两套独立的组播域合并，本质是"重新设计一套"，不是"打通两条链路"。 "单向可见"几乎总是"RP 映射不一致" —— 因为建树是双向对称的（A 能到 B 说明路径通），差异只能在控制面。 合并项目应该优先"改 SSM" ：把所有"源固定"的业务改成 SSM 后，需要统一的东西从"RP 映射/发现方式/MSDP/scope"降到"只是地址规划"。

x: Key Terms · 本章关键术语 Term Meaning Multicast one-to-many delivery: a single stream reaches many receivers IGMP Internet Group Management Protocol (host-to-router membership signalling) IGMP Snooping L2 switch listens to IGMP to build per-port multicast forwarding entries PIM Protocol Independent Multicast (uses the unicast RIB for RPF) PIM-DM PIM Dense Mode (flood and prune) PIM-SM PIM Sparse Mode (explicit joins, RP-based shared tree) PIM-SSM PIM Source-Specific Multicast (no RP, channel = (S,G)) BiDir-PIM Bidirectional PIM (a single (*,G) tree shared in both directions) RPF Reverse Path Forwarding (the only forwarding criterion for multicast) RP Rendezvous Point (the shared-tree root in PIM-SM) Auto-RP Cisco-proprietary automatic RP discovery (224.0.1.39/40) BSR Bootstrap Router (standards-based RP discovery, RFC 5059) Anycast-RP several RPs sharing one address, synchronised via MSDP (RFC 4610) SPT Shortest Path Tree (the source-based tree) RPT Rendezvous Point Tree (the shared tree, (*,G)) MSDP Multicast Source Discovery Protocol (TCP 639, SA messages) MBGP Multiprotocol BGP (SAFI 2; supplies the multicast RPF table only) Phantom RP an RP address that does not exist as a host; routing picks the physical RP Live-Live dual-active multicast (two sources, two paths, de-duplicated at the receiver) FHRP-Aware PIM PIM that follows the FHRP active/standby state ASM Any-Source Multicast SFM Single-source multicast (an early name for source-specific multicast) LHR / FHR Last Hop Router / First Hop Router DR PIM Designated Router (sends Joins/Registers on a LAN) DF Designated Forwarder in BiDir PIM Join / Prune PIM join / prune messages Register / Register-Stop PIM-SM source registration / stop registration Assert PIM assertion (elects a single forwarder on a LAN) Join Suppression suppressing duplicate Joins on a multi-access LAN State Refresh PIM-DM state refresh message Graft PIM-DM message that re-attaches a pruned branch SPT / RPT shortest path tree / shared tree (RP tree)

x: Lessons from the Field · 实战经验总结 The first question in troubleshooting is always RPF. In "the source is sending but nothing arrives" scenarios, show ip rpf plus show ip mroute solves 80% of cases. Most of the remaining 20% are Layer 2 (Snooping/Querier). If SSM is possible, do not use PIM-SM. Every bit of PIM-SM's complexity (RP, Register, shared tree, SPT switchover, MSDP) is the price of "not knowing the source". A fixed source = use SSM; this is the single decision that most reduces long-term operational cost. Multicast addresses must be planned. The 32:1 mapping overlap is not a theoretical problem; it appears reliably in networks that "just pick addresses", and it gets misdiagnosed as a security incident. Blocking per service + writing it into the SoT + CI validation is the only reliable approach. Layer 2 is multicast's "last-mile trap". Designing only Layer 3 and ignoring IGMP Snooping and the Querier produces two classic failures: "flooding saturates the access layer" and "it breaks every few minutes". The RP must be redundant, and Anycast-RP has three "must be different" rules. router-id, MSDP peer address and originator-id must all be unique — these details determine the insidious "MSDP is up but the SA count is 0" failure. SPT switchover is a trade-off, not a default optimum. A few high-rate channels should switch; thousands of small channels save far more state by staying on the shared tree. Compute the state count and RP bandwidth first. The effectiveness of redundancy depends only on the number of shared points. Live-Live, dual carriers and dual-active data centres are all the same: logical topology separation is not physical path separation . You must draw the physical route diagram and do a SPOF analysis. Acceptance must verify the "tree", not just "it can be watched". mrinfo / mtrace show the tree structure, NetFlow shows replication amplification, probes show real loss — only all three together prove that "the multicast path matches the design". x: Querier, HSRP Active, Assert Winner and DF are five independent roles. "Identical configuration" does not mean "identical behaviour"; mis-placed roles inside one VLAN produce the hardest class of failure to diagnose — "periodic outages". They must be specified explicitly ( dr-priority , querier address ); never let the protocols choose. The precondition for SSM is "every terminal in the Layer 2 domain is IGMPv3". A single legacy device's v2 Report downgrades the whole VLAN, and it looks like "flaky". The antidote is "VLAN isolation + SSM Mapping", not "change the network configuration". The access layer's two seat belts: a group-count limit and a group whitelist. One buggy player can make a single port join thousands of groups and take down the entire network. ip igmp limit stops the "volume", ip igmp profile stops "out-of-bounds"; you need both. Micro-bursts are the hidden killer behind multicast loss. "60% average utilisation yet dropping" is its fingerprint. Multicast must have its own queue, and capacity planning must use "peak packet rate", not "average bandwidth". The root cause of a Register storm is almost always RPF; register-rate-limit is only a tourniquet. Before a high-rate source goes live, do a show ip rpf source pre-check on the RP — this single step prevents 90% of "the new service took down the network" incidents. The cost of multicast on wireless is airtime, not bandwidth. A 4 Mbps stream can consume more than 80% of the air on an AP with 180 clients. Multicast-to-unicast is mandatory, but you must also estimate "client count × bitrate". Source redundancy is an application-layer problem. The network can only forward what it sees; two sources on one group inevitably create two trees, and receivers get mixed data (ghosting). The design must state: who is primary, what the switch-over criterion is, and how the receiver tells them apart. x: Chapter Summary · 本章小结 The complexity of multicast can be reduced to one thread: "how to deliver one copy of the traffic to many receivers without broadcasting" . Every protocol mechanism is a branch of that thread: 组播的复杂度可以归纳成一条主线： "如何在不广播的前提下，把同一份流量送到多个接收者" 。所有协议机制都是这条主线的分支： Question Mechanism Design judgement How do receivers express "I want it"? IGMP/MLD (v1/v2/v3) SSM requires v3; mixed environments downgrade How do we avoid Layer 2 flooding? IGMP/PIM Snooping + Querier mandatory, and mind the Querier dependency How do we prevent loops and duplicates? RPF check + Assert the unicast routing table decides the multicast path Where is the source? RP (PIM-SM) or "already known" (SSM) fixed source → SSM; many-to-many → BiDir How does it scale? shared tree/source tree, SPT threshold, state optimisation trade off against the traffic model How does it cross domains? MSDP + MBGP, or SSM new deployments prefer SSM How do we guarantee continuity? Anycast-RP, Live-Live, FHRP-Aware PIM redundancy must be physically separated How do we stop one bug taking down the network? group-count limits, group whitelists, source-side rate limiting, register-rate-limit the access layer needs both seat belts How do we avoid packet loss? dedicated queues, deep queue-limit, micro-burst assessment, FEC average bandwidth is not a capacity basis How do we guarantee "hitless"? Live-Live (ST 2022-7) + physical path separation fast convergence ≠ hitless How do we go inter-company/inter-domain? SSM + boundaries + SA filtering + RP scope + authentication isolate on four layers; one missing layer means none How do we keep it operable? four layers of monitoring + tree baselines + acceptance cases observability is part of the design 问题 机制 设计判断 接收者怎么表达"我要"？ IGMP/MLD（v1/v2/v3） 要 SSM 必须 v3；混跑会降级 二层怎么不泛洪？ IGMP/PIM Snooping + Querier 必配，且注意 Querier 依赖 怎么防止环路与重复？ RPF 检查 + Assert 单播路由决定组播路径 源在哪？ RP（PIM-SM）或"已知"（SSM） 源固定 → SSM；多对多 → BiDir 怎么扩展？ 共享树/源树、SPT 阈值、状态优化 按流量模型取舍 怎么跨域？ MSDP + MBGP，或 SSM 新建优先 SSM 怎么保证不中

(decides the PIM mode) Where does the RP live, how is it made redundant, how is mapping consistency guaranteed? (decides availability) How does Layer 2 deliver multicast only where it is needed? (decides whether the access layer is overwhelmed) Across domains or firewalls, how do transport, RPF and RP reachability all hold at the same time? (decides whether the project ships) 应用是"一对多"、"多对多"还是"源已知"？ （决定 PIM 模式） RP 放在哪里、怎么冗余、映射怎么保证一致？ （决定可用性） 二层如何只把组播送到需要的地方？ （决定接入层是否被打爆） 跨域/跨防火墙时，承载、RPF、RP 可达三件事怎么同时成立？ （决定项目能否上线） Once these four are answered, ip pim sparse-mode is just the last line of configuration. 这四问答清楚， ip pim sparse-mode 只是最后一行配置。 📌 The next chapter (Chapter 14, QoS Design) discusses another class of "end-to-end consistency" problem: multicast cares about "one copy of traffic reaching many receivers", while QoS cares about "in what order many flows are served". They share one property — if one segment of the path is not configured to match, the end-to-end design fails . 📌 下一章（第 14 章 QoS 设计） 会讨论另一类"端到端一致性"问题：组播关心"一份流量到多个接收者"，QoS 关心"多份流量按什么顺序被服务"。两者有个共同点 —— 只要链路上有一段没配对，端到端的设计就失效 。

The consequences are (1) the egress is abused for NTP amplification attacks; (2) when the egress fails, every clock drifts; (3) there is no authentication, so the source can be spoofed. The right approach is an internal stratum-2 hierarchy plus NTP authentication plus device-side ACLs. ⚠️ 反模式 ：全网设备指向公网 pool.ntp.org 。后果是（1）出口被 NTP 放大攻击滥用；（2）出口断时全体时钟漂移；（3）没有认证，可被伪造。 正确做法是内部 stratum-2 层级 + NTP 认证 + 设备侧 ACL。 11. "Network Services" Are Shared Dependencies: When They Fail, the Blast Radius Is Global · "网络服务"是共享依赖：服务挂了，故障半径是全域 Dependency Who uses it When it fails DNS every terminal, every application, every device (name resolution) presents as "the network is sometimes slow" when in fact the whole estate is unusable DHCP every access terminal new attachments fail, existing terminals drop off when their leases expire NTP every device plus every authentication system appears gradually (certificate failures an hour later) AAA wireless, VPN, device login cannot authenticate and cannot operate (a double hit) Logging/monitoring the operations team you fly blind during the incident IPAM change process, automation address conflicts and automation failures 依赖 谁在用 挂了以后 DNS 所有终端、所有应用、所有设备（域名解析） 表现为"网络时快时慢"，实际是全域不可用 DHCP 所有接入终端 新接入失败，老终端续租到期后掉线 NTP 所有设备 + 所有认证 逐步显现（1 小时后证书失败） AAA 无线、VPN、设备登录 无法认证 + 无法运维（双重打击） 日志/监控 运维团队 故障时变成"盲飞" IPAM 变更流程、自动化 地址冲突与自动化失败 So these services carry stricter design requirements than the core network: they must be highly available, must have local fallback, and must keep working while the "main network" is down. And they cost very little — this is the class of design improvement with the best return on investment in the whole book. 所以这些服务的设计要求，本质上比核心网络更严：必须 HA、必须有本地回退、必须能在"主网故障"时继续工作。 而它们的成本又极低 —— 这是全书里"投入产出比最高"的一类设计改进。

x: The Four-Layer Model of Network Services (First Decide Which Layer You Are Designing) · 网络服务的四层模型（先分清你在设计哪一层） Many proposals discuss IPv6, QoS and management together, which blurs responsibilities. Use this four-layer framework: 很多方案把 IPv6、QoS、管理混在一起讲，导致职责不清。用一个四层框架来看： Layer What it provides Composition Design focus Symptom when it fails ① Foundational services "the network can be used" DHCP/DHCPv6, DNS, NTP, AAA, PKI, IPAM, image servers high availability, capacity, security, does it still work when the network is down terminals cannot get addresses / resolve names / authenticate ② Policy control "who gets priority when congested, who is allowed" classification and marking, queueing and scheduling, policing and shaping, ACLs, CoPP trust boundaries, number of classes, end-to-end consistency, verifiability voice stutters, critical applications starved by bulk traffic ③ Observability "knowing what the network is doing" SNMP, Syslog, NetFlow/IPFIX, gNMI telemetry, IP SLA, alerting collection scale, retention, alert governance, clock flying blind during incidents, longer MTTR ④ Management "able to change it, able to change it correctly" NMS/orchestration, configuration backup, SoT, ITSM, change pipeline authorisation, audit, availability, automation (see Chapter 12) slow changes, configuration drift, no audit trail 层 提供什么 组成 设计关注 失效表现 ① 基础服务层 "网络能被使用" DHCP/DHCPv6、DNS、NTP、AAA、PKI、IPAM、镜像服务器 高可用、容量、安全、 断网时是否还工作 终端拿不到地址/解析不了/认证失败 ② 策略控制层 "拥塞时谁优先、谁被允许" 分类标记、排队调度、限速整形、ACL、CoPP 信任边界、类数、端到端一致性、可验证 语音卡顿、关键业务被批量流量挤死 ③ 可观测层 "知道网络在发生什么" SNMP、Syslog、NetFlow/IPFIX、gNMI 遥测、IP SLA、告警 采集规模、保留期、告警治理、时钟 故障时盲飞、MTTR 变长 ④ 管理层 "改得动、改得对" NMS/编排、配置备份、SoT、ITSM、变更流水线 权限、审计、可用性、自动化（见第 12 章） 变更慢、配置漂移、无法审计 Recommended design order (which is also the order of a scenario analysis) : 设计顺序建议（也是情景分析的顺序） ： first ① without foundational services the network is simply unusable (and the blast radius is the largest) then ③ without observability you cannot prove whether ① and ② hold then ② only with a baseline

The result: QoS is changed with nobody verifying it, automation goes live with nobody watching it — every change is a change in the dark . ⚠️ 现实中企业常按"①→②→④→③"建，把可观测性放最后。结果 QoS 改了没人验证、自动化上线没人监控 —— 每次变更都是盲改 。

Windows got an address over DHCPv6 (M=1); Android supports only SLAAC → no address; IoT devices used SLAAC + EUI-64 → generating a 64-bit IID while the prefix left only 8 usable bits of the 72 → the stack assembled an invalid address and discarded it. 排查 ：抓 RA 发现前缀 /72 ；Windows 用 DHCPv6 拿到了地址（M=1），Android 只支持 SLAAC → 无地址；IoT 用 SLAAC + EUI-64 → 生成 64 位 IID，但前缀只有 72 位中的 8 位可用 → 实际拼出非法地址被丢弃。 Root cause : SLAAC and ND both assume a /64 subnet ; a non-/64 prefix simply fails on most terminal stacks. 根因 ： SLAAC 与 ND 都假设子网为 /64 ，非 /64 前缀在多数终端栈上直接失效。 What to do instead : - Pin every "user/VLAN segment" at /64; never subdivide the subnet - Any "saving" must happen at the upstream aggregation layer (/48 → /56 allocation granularity) - Make " every LAN prefix length = 64 " a checklist item in design reviews 正确做法 ： - 任何"用户/VLAN 网段"固定 /64， 不做子网切分 - 需要"节省"只能节省在 上游汇总层 （/48 → /56 分配粒度） - 设计评审时把" 所有 LAN 前缀长度 = 64 "写成检查项 🔥 Case 2: The Security Policy "Blocks Ping", So IPv6 Can Log In but Cannot Transfer Files · 🔥 案例二：安全策略"禁止 ping"，结果 IPv6 能登录不能传文件 Symptom : after the IPv6 rollout SSH connected, but scp , large HTTPS downloads and database queries returning large result sets all hung; IPv4 was perfectly fine. 现象 ：IPv6 上线后 SSH 能连上，但 scp 、HTTPS 大文件、数据库查询大结果集全部卡死；IPv4 完全正常。 Investigation : ping -6 -s 1452 failed while ping -6 -s 1200 succeeded → an MTU problem. x: al policy blocked all ICMP , so the source never received the PTB and kept retransmitting 1500-byte packets. 排查 ： ping -6 -s 1452 失败， ping -6 -s 1200 成功 → MTU 问题；抓包看到中间隧道 MTU 1400，设备回 ICMPv6 Type 2，但 防火墙统一策略把 ICMP 全禁 ，源端收不到 PTB，一直重传 1500 字节包。 Root cause : IPv6 routers do not fragment , so PMTUD is the only mechanism; dropping ICMPv6 Type 2 creates a black hole. 根因 ：IPv6 路由器不分片 ，PMTUD 是唯一机制；ICMPv6 Type 2 被丢 = 黑洞。 What to do instead : - Permit ICMPv6 Types 1/2/3/4 and 133–137 in the firewall (rate limiting is acceptable) - Plan tunnel MTUs consistently (inner 1400/1450) and configure MSS clamping on the server side - Acceptance cases must include "large packets" ( 1400 B), not just a 32-byte ping 正确做法 ： - 防火墙放行 ICMPv6 Type 1/2/3/4 与 133–137 （可限速） - 隧道场景统一规划 MTU（内层 1400/1450），并在服务器侧配 MSS clamping - 验收用例必须包含"大包"（ 1400 B）而非只 ping 32 字节 🔥 Case 3: After Dual Stack, "Web Pages Are Sometimes Fast, Sometimes Slow" — Because IPv6 Goes All the Way Around the World · 🔥 案例三：双栈上线后"网页时快时慢"，原因是 IPv6 绕地球一圈 Symptom : after the dual-stack migration, average load time for internal applications rose from 1.2 s to 3–8 s and was unstable; disabling IPv6 on the terminal restored it immediately. 现象 ：双栈改造后，访问内网应用平均加载时间从 1.2 s 涨到 3–8 s，且不稳定；关掉终端 IPv6 立刻恢复。 Investigation : terminals received a GUA from the RA and preferred IPv6 (RFC 6724); but the only IPv6 route was a tunnel from headquarters down to the branch (RTT 120 ms), while IPv4 was local and direct (RTT 3 ms). One department installed a P2P tool that marks its traffic EF by default; the LLQ priority had no policer → the EF class consumed its full 33% ceiling, voice RTP competed with P2P in the same queue → jitter spiked to 80 ms. 排查 ：接入交换机对所有端口 mls qos trust dscp （含 PC 口）。某部门装了 P2P 工具，默认把 P2P 标为 EF；LLQ 的 priority 没有 policer → EF 类吃满 33% 上限，语音 RTP 与 P2P 在同一队列竞争 → 抖动飙到 80 ms。 Root cause : the trust boundary was placed on user ports , and the LLQ had no policer. 根因 ： 信任边界放在了用户端口 ，且 LLQ 没有限速。 What to do instead : - no mls qos trust on PC ports (re-mark to BE) or classify with NBAR; trust only phone ports - LLQ must carry a police statement (voice bandwidth sized from concurrency, excess downgraded or dropped) - Monitor the "EF class share" and alert on a sudden rise (itself a signal of attack or looping) 正确做法 ： - PC 口 no mls qos trust （重标 BE）或 NBAR 分类；只有话机口 trust - LLQ 必须配 police （如语音按并发算出带宽，超出降级或丢） - 监控"EF 类占比"，突增即告警（这本身就是攻击/环回的信号） 🔥 Case 5: A Layer 2 Loop Killed Voice While "the Queue Configuration Was Correct" · 🔥 案例五：一次二层环回把语音打死，而"队列配置没错" Symptom : a floor's wiring closet was mis-patched into a loop, producing a broadcast storm during STP convergence; voice was down for 3 minutes while other applications we

Did the storm cause phones to re-mark broadcast packets as EF? No — the real cause was that the storm drove the uplink to 100% , LLQ's scheduling opportunities were crowded out by the flood of punted/broadcast traffic, and the policer dropped voice together with the "fake EF". 排查 ： show policy-map interface 显示 EF 类超出 policer 大量丢弃；风暴期间大量广播包被话机重标为 EF？不是 —— 真正原因是 风暴把上行链路打到 100% ，LLQ 的调度机会被海量 punt/广播挤占，加上 policer 把语音和"伪装的 EF"一起丢。 Root cause : QoS has limited effect under sustained overload (see roadmap item 3); the real defence is storm control + loop detection + BPDU Guard . 根因 ： QoS 在持续过载时作用有限 （见导读第 3 条）；真正的防线是 风暴控制 + 环回检测 + BPDU Guard 。 What to do instead : - Enable storm control (broadcast/multicast/unknown unicast) and BPDU Guard at the access layer - QoS guarantees only "relative priority under congestion"; it is not an overload rescue mechanism - Correlate "EF class drops" with "broadcast rate spikes" in alerting to localise Layer 2 problems fast 正确做法 ： - 接入层开启 storm-control（广播/组播/未知单播）与 BPDU Guard - QoS 只保证"拥塞时相对优先"，不作为"过载救援" - 告警把"EF 类丢包"与"广播速率突增"关联，快速定位到二层问题 🔥 Case 6: Voice Degrades Across the WAN Because the Outer IPSec DSCP Is 0 · 🔥 案例六：跨 WAN 语音变差，因为 IPSec 外层 DSCP 是 0 Symptom : HQ–branch voice runs over an IPsec tunnel; the egress LLQ statistics say "the voice queue is almost empty", yet users complain of broken audio. 现象 ：总部—分支语音走 IPsec 隧道，出口 LLQ 统计"语音队列几乎为 0"，但用户投诉语音断续。 Investigation : capturing the outer ESP packets showed a ToS field of 0. The branch egress encrypted the inner EF marking without copying it to the outer header ; the carrier network could not see the priority and treated all ESP as BE; under congestion voice was dropped at random. 排查 ：抓外层 ESP 包，ToS 字段 = 0。分支出口把内层 EF 加密后 没有复制到外层 ；中间运营商网络看不到优先级，把 ESP 全部当 BE；拥塞时语音被随机丢弃。 Root cause : encryption hides the inner marking , so the

x: carrier can only see the outer header. 根因 ： 加密隐藏了内层标记 ，运营商只能看外层。 What to do instead : - Configure outer DSCP copying/mapping at the tunnel endpoints (IPsec qos pre-classify , SD-WAN per-tunnel QoS) - Confirm with the carrier how many classes it recognises (often only 3–6) - Acceptance: capture the outer packet to verify the ToS, and measure MOS under injected congestion 正确做法 ： - 隧道端点配置外层 DSCP 复制/映射（IPsec qos pre-classify 、SD-WAN per-tunnel QoS） - 与运营商确认其能识别的类数（常只有 3–6 类） - 验收：抓外层包验证 ToS；并在拥塞注入下测 MOS 🔥 Case 7: QoS Is Completely Ineffective Because Queues Are Configured Against the Physical Port on a Sub-Rate Link · 🔥 案例七：子速率链路按物理口配队列，QoS 完全失效 Symptom : the branch egress is a 1 Gbps physical port with a 200 Mbps carrier contract. LLQ and bandwidth guarantees were configured against 1 Gbps, yet voice is still poor at busy times and output drops reads 0. 现象 ：分支出口物理 1 Gbps，运营商合同 200 Mbps。分支按 1 Gbps 配了 LLQ + 带宽保证，但忙时语音仍差、 output drops 为 0。 Investigation : the device itself never congests (a 48-hour peak of only 300 Mbps) — the congestion happens carrier-side at the 200 Mbps aggregation point; the device queues never actually queue, so there is no scheduling to speak of. 排查 ：设备侧从不拥塞（48 小时峰值仅 300 Mbps）， 拥塞发生在运营商侧 的 200 Mbps 汇聚点；设备队列没有排队，自然也没有调度。 Root cause : there is no shaping down to the contracted rate , so the queues take effect in the wrong place. 根因 ： 没有整形到合同速率 ，队列在错误的位置生效。 What to do instead : - Use HQoS on the egress: a parent shape 200m (even 190m to leave headroom) with the class queues hanging under it as children - Confirm CIR/PIR and burst parameters with the carrier - Monitor the shaping queue depth and drops inside the port, not just physical interface utilisation 正确做法 ： - 出口做 HQoS ：父层 shape 200m （甚至 190m 留余量），子层再挂各类队列 - 与运营商确认 CIR/PIR 与突发参数 - 监控口内 shaping 的排队与丢弃，而不是只看物理口利用率 🔥 Case 8: A Full-Table SNMP Walk Makes the Core Router's BGP Flap · 🔥 案例八：SNMP 全表 walk，把核心路由器的 BGP 打抖 Symptom : every Wednesday morning (reporting job) the core's BGP neighbours flap and

x: %OSPF-5-ADJCHG appears occasionally; CPU peaks at 78% while forwarding is unaffected. 现象 ：每周三上午（报表任务）核心 BGP 邻居抖动， %OSPF-5-ADJCHG 也偶发；CPU 峰值 78%，但转发正常。 Investigation : the monitoring platform walks ifTable + ifXTable + ipRouteTable on 500 devices every 5 minutes, and the reporting jobs all land in the same window → the management-plane process occupies the CPU for long stretches, Hello processing is delayed → neighbours time out. 排查 ：监控平台对 500 台设备每 5 分钟 walk ifTable + ifXTable + ipRouteTable ；报表任务集中在同一时段 → 管理面进程长时间占 CPU，路由协议 Hello 处理延迟 → 邻居超时。 Root cause : the collection design treats "full-table walk" as the default and has no partitioning or phase staggering. 根因 ： 采集设计把"全表 walk"当成了默认做法 ，且没有分区与错峰。 What to do instead : - Fetch only the columns you need ( ifHCInOctets , ifHCOutOctets , ifOperStatus ); never walk the routing or ARP tables - Partition collectors by site and stagger phases (different devices at different offsets, never all on the hour) - Rate-limit SNMP on the device and protect the management plane with CoPP - Use Trap/telemetry ON_CHANGE for routing-table changes instead of polling 正确做法 ： - 只取需要的列（ ifHCInOctets 、 ifHCOutOctets 、 ifOperStatus ），禁止 walk 路由表/ARP 表 - 采集器分区（按站点），错峰（不同设备不同相位，不要整点齐发） - 设备侧 SNMP 限速 + CoPP 保护管理面 - 路由表变化用 Trap/遥测 ON_CHANGE，不用轮询 🔥 Case 9: One Flapping Port Takes Down the Log Server and the Switch Together · 🔥 案例九：一个端口 flapping，把日志服务器和交换机一起拖垮 Symptom : overnight a port on an access switch goes up/down 200 times per second; switch CPU hits 95%, the log server's disk I/O saturates, the NMS loses alerts for 30 minutes, and every user on that switch is disconnected. 现象 ：凌晨某接入交换机端口以 200 次/秒 up/down，交换机 CPU 95%，日志服务器磁盘 IO 打满，NMS 丢告警 30 分钟；同时该交换机上的用户全部掉线。 Investigation : every port event triggers one syslog message plus one SNMP trap, and logging console / logging monitor were left at high severity → the management plane is crushed by its own logging. 排查 ：端口日志每条触发一次 syslog + SNMP trap，且配置了 logging console / logging monitor 高等级 → 管理面被日志本身

x: 压死。 Root cause : logging has no rate limiting or suppression , so the log channel becomes a fault amplifier. 根因 ： 日志没有限速与抑制 ，日志通道成了故障放大器。 What to do instead : - Device side: logging rate-limit (messages per second per category) plus a bounded logging buffered - Disable high-severity console/monitor logging in production (keep only critical) - Do flap detection in the NMS (N times within M minutes); a single down does not alert - Rate-limit the log server per source (so one device cannot flood it) 正确做法 ： - 设备侧 logging rate-limit （每类每秒条数）+ logging buffered 限制 - 关闭 console/monitor 的高等级日志（生产环境只留 critical） - flap 检测在 NMS 侧做（N 次/M 分钟），单次 down 不告警 - 日志服务器按来源限速（防单设备刷爆） 🔥 Case 10: NTP Pointed at the Public Internet — One Egress Outage Sends the Whole Network Time-Travelling · 🔥 案例十：NTP 指向公网，出口一断全网"时间旅行" Symptom : after two hours of egress maintenance, 802.1X fails en masse on wireless, log timestamps jump back and forth, and troubleshooting is misdirected (everyone suspects the recent change). 现象 ：出口链路维护 2 小时后，无线 802.1X 大量失败、日志时间戳前后乱跳，排障方向被误导（以为是新变更导致）。 Investigation : every device points NTP at pool.ntp.org ; with the egress down the devices free-run their own clocks (roughly 1–5 s of drift per hour), and after recovery certificate validation windows are misaligned and logs cannot be correlated across devices. 排查 ：所有设备 NTP 指向 pool.ntp.org ；出口断后设备靠自身时钟漂移（每小时约 1–5 s），恢复后证书校验窗口错位、日志跨设备无法对齐。 Root cause : a foundational service depends on the external network , with no internal hierarchy and no alerting. 根因 ： 基础服务依赖了外部网络 ，且没有内部分层与告警。 What to do instead : - Build an internal Stratum-1/2 hierarchy with at least two sources; devices point only at internal servers - NTP authentication plus device-side ACLs (against amplification and spoofing) - Alert on offset 1 s; confirm network-wide clock consistency before any change - Put egress maintenance windows on the "affects foundational services" risk list 正确做法 ： - 内部 Stratum-1/2 层级 + 至少 2 个源，设备只指向内网 - NTP 认证 + 设备侧 ACL（防放大与伪造） - 偏移 1 s 告

x: starts to flap. 现象 ：为做流量分析在核心出口开启 NetFlow，10 分钟后采集器 CPU 100%、丢数据；30 分钟后核心路由器管理面 CPU 85%，出现路由抖动。 Investigation : 60 Gbps peak at the egress with a 400 B average packet → about 18 Mpps → roughly 18M flows/s; at 80–120 B per export record that is about 15 Gbps of export traffic , all of it generated by the management plane. 排查 ：出口峰值 60 Gbps、平均包长 400 B → 约 18 Mpps → 约 18M 流/秒；每条 80–120 B 导出记录 → 约 15 Gbps 导出流量 ，且全部由管理面生成。 Root cause : no sampling and no capacity accounting . 根因 ： 没有采样，也没有容量账 。 What to do instead : - Set the sampling ratio from interface bandwidth (1:1000–1:4000 at 40G/100G) and record the ratio on the collector side - Two export targets on a separate management segment, with rate limiting - Compute "export bandwidth = flow rate × record size" first; if it exceeds 20% of the management link, adjust sampling - For high-volume scenarios prefer aggregated flows plus telemetry counters over per-flow export 正确做法 ： - 采样比按接口带宽设定（40G/100G 用 1:1000–1:4000），并在采集器侧记录采样比 - 导出目标 2 个、独立管理网段、限速 - 先算"导出带宽 = 流速率 × 记录大小"，超过管理链路 20% 就必须调采样 - 高流量场景优先用 聚合流 + 遥测计数器 ，而不是逐流导出

x: Field-Proven Lessons · 实战经验总结 The first rule of IPv6 is not "how to configure it" but "every LAN prefix must be /64" ; any design that breaks it will be overturned by IoT and Android within three months. ICMPv6 is not optional : block it and ND dies together with PMTUD. The correct security policy is "permit the essential types + rate-limit", not "deny everything". The cost of dual stack is not in the protocol stack but in "two troubleshooting skill sets" : the team must be able to walk the whole chain — address → gateway → DNS → MTU → application binding — in v6 alone. Ask three questions before any QoS review : who may mark? how many classes? who is dropped first under congestion? If you cannot answer, the prettiest queue configuration is meaningless. QoS only matters under congestion. So "do we need QoS" is equivalent to "will this link congest", not "is voice important". The trust boundary must be drawn on a diagram , annotated "DSCP is trustworthy from here on". Without that diagram, QoS will be broken by some future change. Every bandwidth promise must become a number : concurrency × per-call bandwidth × 1.2, plus "LLQ ≤ 33%, the sum of guarantees ≤ 80%". Sub-rate links must be shaped , otherwise your queues do unpaid work on behalf of the carrier. Always verify the outer DSCP inside a tunnel : one packet capture beats ten design principles. Acceptance on an idle network is not acceptance : QoS, redundancy and failover must all be validated under bad conditions. Design the management plane as a network in its own right : a dedicated VRF, OOB, jump hosts, tiered AAA and a bandwidth budget — none of them optional. Three hard constraints on collection design : fetch only the columns you need, record the sampling ratio, partition and stagger the collectors. Logging must have a ceiling : rate limiting on the device, per-source limiting on the server, flap detection in alerting. Otherwise logging becomes a fault amplifier. x: internal hierarchy + authentication + offset alerting costs almost nothing and buys you "correlated timelines during troubleshooting". Foundational services (DHCP/DNS/NTP/AAA) must be more available than the core network , because their blast radius is the whole estate. The value of an alert = somebody acts on it : every alert needs a severity, a Runbook and suppression rules, or it will be muted within six months. Size observability capacity in advance (metrics × frequency × retention), or the platform dies slowly under a chorus of "add more monitoring". Certificates and licences are predictable failures : an expiry alert is cheaper than any drill. In a CCDE answer, "how to prove it" matters as much as "how to design it" : QoS without a measurement plan and management without OOB are both incomplete designs. The design philosophy of supporting systems : least visible in normal times, most critical during a failure . Hence their first priority is always "still works when broken". IPv6 的第一条规则不是"怎么配"，而是"所有 LAN 前缀必须是 /64" ；违反它的方案会在三个月后被 IoT 和 Android 推翻。 ICMPv6 不是可选项 ：禁了它，ND 与 PMTUD 一起死。安全策略的正确写法是"放行关键类型 + 限速"，不是"一律拒绝"。 双栈的成本不在协议栈，在"两套排障能力" ：团队必须能独立用 v6 走完 地址 → 网关 → DNS → MTU → 应用绑定 这条链。 QoS 评审先问三个问题 ：谁有权标记？几类？拥塞时谁先丢？答不上来，队列配置再漂亮也没意义。 QoS 只在拥塞时起作用 。所以"要不要上 QoS"等价于"这条链路会不会拥塞"，而不是"语音重不重要"。 信任边界必须画在图上 ，并且标注"这里之后 DSCP 可信"。没有这张图，QoS 一定会在某次变更中被破坏。 所有带宽承诺都要落成数字 ：并发数 × 单路带宽 × 1.2，以及"LLQ ≤ 33%、保证总和 ≤ 80%"。 子速率链路必须整形 ，否则你的队列在替运营商做无用功。 隧道里必须验证外层 DSCP ：抓一次包，比讨论十条设计原则有用。 空载验收等于没验 ：QoS、冗余、故障切换都必须在"坏工况"下验证。 管理平面要按一张网来设计 ：独立 VRF、OOB、跳板机、AAA 分级、带宽账，一个都不能省。 采集设计的三条硬约束 ：只取需要的列、采样比要记录、采集器要分区并错峰。 日志必须有上限 ：设备侧限速、服务器侧按来源限速、告警侧做 flap 检测。否则日志会成为故障放大器。 NTP 是所有数据的坐标系 ：内部分层 + 认证 + 偏移告警，成本极低，收益是"排障时能对齐时序"。 基础服务（DHCP/DNS/NTP/AAA）的可用性要求应高于核心网络 ，因为它们的影响面是全域。 告警的价值 = 有人会动作 ：每条告警都要有分级、Runbook、抑制规则，否则半年后一定被静音。 可观测性的容量账要提前算 （指标×频率×保留期），否则平台会在"多加点监控"的呼声中慢慢死掉。 证书与许可是可预测的故障 ：到期告警比任何故障演练都便宜。 CCDE 的答案里，"如何证明"和"如何设计"同等重要 ：没有测量方案的 QoS 与没有 OOB 的管理设计，都不算完成。 支撑系统的设计哲学 ： 平时最不显眼，故障时最关键 。所以它们的第一优先级永远是"故障时还能工作"。

IPv6、QoS、网络管理看似三个专题，本质上都是 支撑系统 ：它们不转发包，但决定了网络 能不能被使用、能不能被表达优先级、能不能被运维 。 Topic Essence Three questions you must answer Test of success IPv6 a different set of operating rules plus planning discipline are all subnets /64? is ICMPv6 permitted? is dual-stack path quality at parity? endpoints get online by themselves and the troubleshooting chain is complete QoS the ordering right under congestion who may mark? how many classes? who is dropped first? voice MOS ≥4.0 under injected congestion Management and services a second network that must be designed can you log in when the service is down? where does the data come from and how long is it kept? does anybody act on the alerts? observable, operable and provable during an outage 主题 本质 三个必答问题 成败判据 IPv6 一套不同的运行规则 + 规划纪律 子网是否全 /64？ICMPv6 是否放行？双栈路径是否对等？ 终端自己就能上网，且排障链完整 QoS 拥塞时的排序权 谁有权标记？几类？拥塞时谁先丢？ 拥塞注入下语音 MOS ≥4.0 管理与服务 一张必须设计的第二网络 业务断时能否登录？数据从哪来、留多久？告警有人动作吗？ 故障时仍可观测、可运维、可证明 Four judgements that run through the whole chapter : 四条贯穿全章的判断 ： The first priority of a supporting system is "still works when broken" — OOB, local fallback and an independent collection tier are all corollaries of this. Do the capacity arithmetic in advance : SNMP polling, flow export, telemetry, logs, storage and OOB bandwidth are all multiplication, not addition. The trust boundary decides whether QoS succeeds , just as data quality decides whether automation succeeds (Chapter 12) — both are garbage in, garbage out. A design without measurement is not finished : QoS needs congestion injection, dual stack needs path-parity verification, observability must prove that it can see failures when they happen. 支撑系统的第一优先级是"故障时还能工作" —— OOB、本地回退、独立采集层，都是这一条的推论。 容量账要提前算 ：SNMP 轮询、流导出、遥测、日志、存储、OOB 带宽，全部是"乘法"而不是"加法"。 信任边界决定 QoS 的成败

A typical legacy path (multitier STP + FHRP + OSPF): 园区中断几乎从来不是转发性能问题，而是 检测 + 通知 + 重算 + 主机刷新 的叠加。一条典型的老式路径（多层 STP + FHRP + OSPF）： Link down → STP detection (BPDU ageing / loss) 1–20 s → topology change and reconvergence 1–30 s → FHRP detection (HSRP hello 3 s × 3) 9–10 s → IGP recomputation (SPF + summarisation) 0.1–5 s → host ARP cache invalidation (uncontrolled) 0–300 s 链路断 → STP 检测（BPDU 老化/丢失） 1–20 s → 拓扑变化、重新收敛 1–30 s → FHRP 检测（HSRP hello 3 s × 3） 9–10 s → IGP 重算（SPF + 汇总） 0.1–5 s → 主机 ARP 缓存失效（不可控） 0–300 s 🎯 Design conclusion : to reach "sub-second switchover", tuning timers only fixes the first two items. The last mile (host cache, application reconnect) is not yours to control. The correct campus target is therefore " ≤1 s network convergence + applications that can retry ", not a marketing claim of "50 ms". 🎯 设计结论 ：想做到"秒级切换"，调小定时器只能解决前两项， 最后一公里（主机缓存、应用重连）你控制不了 。所以园区的正确目标是" ≤1 s 的网络收敛 + 应用可重试 "，而不是"宣称 50 ms"。 5.
