Service Virtualisation · 六、服务虚拟化 Path isolation solves "services cannot reach each other"; service virtualisation solves " how several business domains share the same set of services " (internet exit, file servers, DNS, AD, printing, monitoring). 路径隔离解决"业务之间不互通"，服务虚拟化解决" 多个业务域如何共享同一批服务 "（互联网出口、文件服务器、DNS、AD、打印、监控）。 The Three Service-Access Models · 服务访问的三种模型 Model A: independent services per domain Model B: shared services + service edge +-------+ +-------+ +-------+ +-------+ |DomainA| |DomainB| |DomainA| |DomainB| | vFW-A | | vFW-B | +---+---+ +---+---+ | own exit| |own exit| +----+-------+ +-------+ +-------+ +----+-------+ Simple, expensive, best isolation | Shared edge | (vFW + NAT + LB) +----+-------+ Shared services (internet/DC) 模型 A：每域独立服务 模型 B：共享服务 + 服务边界 ┌───────┐ ┌───────┐ ┌───────┐ ┌───────┐ │域 A │ │域 B │ │域 A │ │域 B │ │ vFW-A │ │ vFW-B │ └───┬───┘ └───┬───┘ │ 独立出口│ │ 独立出口│ └────┬──────┘ └───────┘ └───────┘ ┌──────┴──────┐ 简单、贵、隔离最好 │ 共享服务边界 │（vFW + NAT + LB） └──────┬──────┘ 共享服务（互联网/DC） Model CAPEX Isolation Complexity Where it fits A: per-domain High Highest Low Strict compliance, few domains B: shared edge Low Policy-dependent Medium Many domains sharing an internet exit C: service chaining (SFC) Medium Policy-dependent High Per-flow insertion of several services 模型 CAPEX 隔离度 复杂度 适用 A 每域独立 高 最高 低 强合规、少量域 B 共享边界 低 依赖策略 中 多域、共享互联网出口 C 服务链（SFC） 中 依赖策略 高 需要"按流"插入多种服务 Firewall Virtualisation (the Classic One-to-Many) · 防火墙虚拟化（一对多的典型） Physical firewall pair (HA) +---------------------------+ | +----------+ +----------+ | One context per tenant/domain | | vFW-A | | vFW-B | | Separate policy, routing table, management | +----------+ +----------+ | +---------------------------+ 物理防火墙对（HA） ┌───────────────────────────┐ │ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │ 每租户/每域一个上下文（context） │ │ vFW-A │ │ vFW-B │ │ 独立策略、独立路由表、独立管理 │ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ │ └───────────────────────────┘ Advantage Watch out for One hardware pair serves several domains, lower CAPEX No hard resour

Production designs should apply per-context resource limits (sessions, throughput) and monitor them. ⚠️ 最常见设计缺陷 ：把"上下文"当成"独立防火墙"，忘记它 共享同一份 CPU/内存/会话表 。生产上应配置 每上下文资源限额 （会话数、吞吐）并监控。 VRF-Aware NAT and the Fusion Router · VRF-Aware NAT 与 Fusion Router A universal reality in multi-tenant scenarios: different domains use overlapping private addresses (all of them use 10.0.0.0/8). 多租户场景的普遍现实： 不同域使用重叠的私有地址 （都用 10.0.0.0/8）。 Tenant A (10.0.0.0/8 -- VRF-A) --+ +-- VRF-Aware NAT -- internet / shared services Tenant B (10.0.0.0/8 -- VRF-B) --+ 租户 A（10.0.0.0/8 ── VRF-A）──┐ ├── VRF-Aware NAT ──→ 互联网 / 共享服务 租户 B（10.0.0.0/8 ── VRF-B）──┘ Each VRF has its own NAT pool and translation table → overlapping addresses do not conflict, and path isolation is preserved When several routing instances are merged into a single instance on the same device (to reach shared services or the internet), that device is called a fusion router A fusion router is a natural leak point : it is attached to every VRF at once 每个 VRF 独立 NAT 池与转换表 → 重叠地址不冲突，且 不破坏路径隔离 当多个路由实例在 同一台设备 上合并到单一实例（用于访问共享服务/互联网）时，该设备称为 fusion router fusion router 是 天然的泄漏点 ：它同时连着所有 VRF 🔥 Three design constraints for a fusion router : 1. Capacity and Scalability Models (Extended in These Notes) · 七、容量与可扩展性模型（本笔记延伸） The book focuses on architectural decisions; this section adds the part where the architecture is turned into numbers — the most frequently mis-calculated and most often skipped content in architecture work. 原书侧重架构决策，本章补上"把架构算成数字"的部分 —— 这是架构设计里最容易算错、也最容易被忽略的内容。 Endpoint Density and Access Switch Count · 终端密度与接入交换机数量 Area Endpoints per port Port utilisation Notes Standard workstation 1.0–1.3 80% One port per person plus 20% headroom Meeting room 0.2–0.5 — Mostly wireless; wired only for casting or phones Classroom / training room 0.5–1.0 — One port per two seats Printers / IoT / cameras Fixed count — Separate VLAN, include in PoE calculation 场所 每端口终端数 端口利用率 说明 标准工位 1.0–1.3 80% 一人一端口 + 预留 20% 会议室 0.2–0.5 — 主要靠无线，有线仅投屏/话机 教室/培训室 0.5–1.0 — 每 2 座 1 口 打印机/IoT/摄像头 固定数 — 单独 VLAN，PoE 计算 Access switches = ceil( wired port demand / (24 or 48 x port utilisation) ) x (1 + 15% spare) 接入交换机数 = ⌈ 有线端口需求 / (24 或 48 × 端口利用率) ⌉ × (1 + 15% 备用量) 💡 Closet constraints often become the bottleneck before port count does : an IDF rack typically holds 4–6 1RU switches plus 2 distribution switches, and is limited by PoE power and heat . Design the rack first, then the ports. 💡 配线间约束常比端口数更早成为瓶颈 ：一个 IDF 机柜通常只能放 4–6 台 1RU 交换机 + 2 台分布交换机， 且受 PoE 电源与散热限制 。设计时先算机柜，再算端口。 Wireless and PoE Budget · 无线与 PoE 预算 Standard Power available per port Typical use 802.3af (Type 1) 15.4 W Phones, ordinary APs 802.3at (Type 2) 30 W Wi-Fi 6 APs (typically 802.3at) 802.3bt (Type 3/4) 60 W / 90 W Wi-Fi 6E/7 APs, high-power IoT 标准 每端口可用功率 典型用途 802.3af (Type 1) 15.4 W 话机、普通 AP 802.3at (Type 2) 30 W Wi-Fi 6 AP（典型 802.3at） 802.3bt (Type 3/4) 60 W / 90 W Wi-Fi 6E/7 AP、高功率 IoT PoE budget = sum( max power per port x probability that port draws power ) x (1 + 20% headroom) PoE 预算 = Σ(每口最大功率 × 该口供电概率) × (1 + 20% 余量) Example: a 48-port access switch, expected 20 × 802.3at APs (30 W) plus 20 phones (7 W): 实例：48 口接入交换机，预计 20 个 802.3at AP（30 W）+ 20

x: 台话机（7 W）： APs: 20 x 30 = 600 W; phones: 20 x 7 = 140 W; total 740 W +20% headroom - 890 W - two 740 W+ power supplies (or a 1100 W supply) AP: 20 × 30 = 600 W；话机: 20 × 7 = 140 W；合计 740 W 含 20% 余量 → 890 W → 需配 2 个 740 W 以上电源（或选 1100 W 电源） ⚠️ A common incident : the PoE budget is designed against af (15.4 W) but the APs negotiate at (30 W) → the switch power supply is oversubscribed → APs that come up later reboot repeatedly , and the log only says "power denied". ⚠️ 常见事故 ：AP 按 af 预算（15.4 W）设计，实际 AP 协商成 at（30 W）→ 交换机电源超额 → 后上线的 AP 反复重启 ，且日志只显示"power denied"。 Bandwidth Oversubscription · 带宽收敛比 Layer Typical oversubscription Notes Access → distribution 20:1 ~ 48:1 (1G access / 10G uplink) Acceptable in a campus because peaks do not coincide Distribution → core 2:1 ~ 4:1 Must leave headroom for east-west traffic (DC access, servers) Core → exit Depends on WAN/internet bandwidth The exit is the only point that must be designed to the contracted bandwidth 层级 常见收敛比 说明 接入 → 分布 20:1 ~ 48:1（1G 接入 / 10G 上行） 园区可接受，因为峰值不同时 分布 → 核心 2:1 ~ 4:1 需要为东西向流量（DC 访问、服务器）留余量 核心 → 出口 视 WAN/互联网带宽 出口是唯一必须"按合同带宽"设计的点 🎯 The correct order for campus bandwidth design : size the exit first (contracted bandwidth + peak), then the core (east-west + north-south), and only then the access uplinks. Doing it the other way round gives you "10G everywhere at the access layer and a 100M exit that makes everything look like a slideshow". 🎯 园区带宽设计的正确顺序 ：先算 出口 （合同带宽 + 峰值），再算 核心 （东西向 + 南北向），最后才是接入上行。反着算的结果是"接入全是 10G，出口 100M 卡成 PPT"。 VLAN / Subnet / Broadcast-Domain Scale · VLAN / 子网 / 广播域规模 Item Practical upper bound Why Endpoints per VLAN/subnet ≤ 500 (recommended ≤ 250) ARP/ND table, broadcast, DHCP scope VLANs per closet ≤ 8 Trunk pruning complexity, STP instances VLANs per campus ≤ 200 (much more means the boundary is wrong) Management complexity, IP planning Spanning-Tree diameter ≤ 7 hops RSTP convergence and stability ARP/ND entries per distribution switch ≤ 8,000 (platform dependent) Control-plane memory

x: 8. From Design to Delivery: The Nine Tables This Chapter Must Produce · 八、从设计到交付：本章必须的 9 张表 A campus design that is "only a topology diagram" cannot be reviewed or accepted. The book implies, and this note makes explicit, nine tables a campus design deliverable must contain: 设计文档不是散文。以下九张表是园区方案的"可评审载体"，缺一张就有一类决策没有被固化。 # Table Key columns Who uses it 1 Functional-block table Block name, endpoints, bandwidth, availability class, exit point Design review, capacity 2 Tier-selection table Two-tier or three-tier, justification (business dimension) Business and design review 3 Access-model selection table Model, convergence, failure behaviour, limitation Design review 4 L2/L3 boundary table Which closets are L2, which are L3, gateway location Implementation 5 Routing design table IGP, areas/queries, summary points, FHRP/BFD Implementation, operations 6 Addressing table Subnets, VLANs, pools, summary boundaries Implementation, IPAM 7 Virtualisation table VRF/VN, RT/RD, isolation technique, fusion point Security, implementation 8 Capacity and convergence table Ports, bandwidth, PoE, RIB, convergence budget Acceptance, operations 9 Acceptance case table Fault scenarios, expected behaviour, measured value Acceptance, operations # 表名 内容 谁看 1 功能块清单 块名/用途/终端数/带宽/可用性等级/所属区域 架构评审 2 楼栋—配线间—设备映射 每 IDF 的交换机型号、端口数、PoE 预算、上联方式 实施与采购 3 接入模型决策表 每块使用的模型（STP/路由接入/集群）+ 理由 + 风险 架构评审 4 地址与 VLAN 规划表 前缀/VLAN ID/网关/VRF/DHCP scope/汇总边界 实施 + IPAM 5 IGP 设计表 协议/进程/区域或 AS/邻居关系/汇总点/Stub 范围 运维 6 路径隔离与服务链表 VRF/VN ↔ 业务 ↔ 服务节点 ↔ 去程/回程路径 安全 + 运维 7 容量与功率表 端口/带宽/收敛比/PoE/机柜 U 位/光模块 采购 + 实施 8 收敛与可用性目标表 场景 → 目标时间 → 检测机制 → 验证方法 评审 + 验收 9 验收用例表 每类故障的注入方式 + 预期 + 实测结果 验收 🎯 A missing table means a design decision has not been made. If a review asks "what happens if the peer-link fails" and there is no answer on paper, that is not bad luck, it is a design defect. 💡 第 9 张表最容易被跳过，也最能救命。 "没演练过的高可用等于不存在" （第 14 章同款结论）。

x: Real-World Case Studies (14 Scenarios) · 实战案例（14 个真实场景） 🔥 Case 1: Six Functional Blocks Crammed Into a Collapsed Core — One Gateway Switchover "Shakes the Whole Network for 40 Seconds" · 🔥 案例一：collapsed core 里硬塞 6 个功能块，一次网关切换"全网抖 40 秒" Symptom : a mid-size campus (4 buildings, 2,800 endpoints) uses the two-tier model. A single collapsed core/distribution pair carries the user block, wireless block, DC block, WAN block, DMZ block and management block at once. When core A's power module fails, the whole network goes down for about 40 seconds, and for ten minutes afterwards some servers are still unreachable. 现象 ：中型园区（4 栋楼、2,800 终端）用二层模型，核心分布合一的一对交换机上同时挂：用户块、无线块、DC 块、WAN 块、DMZ 块、管理块。某次核心 A 电源模块故障，全网中断约 40 秒，恢复后部分服务器访问仍异常 10 分钟。 Investigation : configuration review shows that all six blocks' SVIs live on the same pair ( about 180 VLANs ); the STP root is on A while HSRP active is on B (opposite sides). When A dies, B becomes the STP root and takes over 180 gateways, while OSPF recomputes and a large number of hosts lose their ARP entries. 排查 ：核对配置发现 —— 6 个块的 SVI 全在这对设备上（ 约 180 个 VLAN ），STP 根在 A、HSRP Active 在 B（不同侧）；A 宕机时 B 变 STP 根 + 接管 180 个网关，同时 OSPF 重算、大量主机 ARP 失效。 Root cause : a two-tier model carrying six functional blocks (the book recommends ≤3), plus gateway and root bridge on opposite sides , so a single failure triggers three simultaneous changes: root, gateway and routing. 根因 ： 用二层模型承载了 6 个功能块 （原书建议 ≤3），且 网关与根桥不同侧 ，故障时"根 + 网关 + 路由"三重变化叠加。 What should have been done : - Split: the DC block and WAN block become their own distribution blocks (even if that is only two switches), and introduce a dedicated core layer - Force the root bridge and HSRP active onto the same side, with standby track plus preemption delay - Spread SVIs across different device pairs by block, keeping SVIs per device below 80 - Rehearse "core A power loss", measure the switchover and write the number into the document 正确做法 ： - 拆分：DC 块与 WAN 块独立成分布块（哪怕只有 2 台交换机），核心层独立出来 - 根桥与 HSRP Active 强制同侧

Monitoring shows frequent STP topology changes. 现象 ：新园区宣称"全部路由接入"，但用户投诉"每天总有几次网页卡 10 秒"。监控显示 STP 拓扑变化频繁。 Investigation : the access switches do run OSPF, but every user gateway is still an SVI on the distribution layer — the access switches merely forward Layer 3 point-to-point upward. VLANs still span several access switches, so STP still exists; the only change is one extra hop. 排查 ：接入交换机确实跑了 OSPF，但 所有用户网关仍在分布层的 SVI 上 ，接入交换机只是三层点到点向上转发；VLAN 仍跨多台接入延伸 → STP 依然存在，只是路径变长了一跳。 Root cause : mistaking "the access switch has an IP address" for "routed access". The definition of routed access is the gateway being at the access layer ; otherwise the STP dependency is unchanged. 根因 ：把"接入交换机有 IP 地址"误当成"路由接入"。 路由接入的定义是网关在接入层 ，否则 STP 依赖照旧。 What should have been done : - Move the gateway (SVI) down to the access switch, with /31 routed uplinks or Layer 3 port-channels - Give every wiring closet its own subnet, generated from a DHCP scope template - Add one hard acceptance criterion: "no VLAN may span devices at the access layer" - List the exceptions (wireless, cluster heartbeat) separately with a stated reason 正确做法 ： - 网关（SVI）下移到接入交换机，上行用 /31 路由口或三层聚合 - 每配线间独立子网，DHCP scope 模板化生成 - 检查清单加一条硬指标： "接入层设备上不得出现跨设备的同一 VLAN" - 保留的例外（无线、集群心跳）单独列出并标注原因 🔥 Case 3: vPC peer-link and peer-keepalive on the Same Fibre Pair — Eight Minutes of Dual-Active · 🔥 案例三：vPC 的 peer-link 与 peer-keepalive 走同一条光纤，双主 8 分钟 Symptom : during a rack relocation an engineer pulls one fibre, and both distribution switches become gateways at the same time (dual-active). The whole campus reports IP address conflicts, broadcast volume explodes, and service is only restored after one switch is manually shut down

x: eight minutes later. 现象 ：一次机柜搬迁，运维拔了一根光纤，结果两台分布交换机同时成为网关（双主），全网出现 IP 冲突告警，广播量暴涨，8 分钟后人工关掉一台才恢复。 Investigation : the peer-link is 2×10G fibre, and peer-keepalive is configured on a subinterface of the same fibre pair ("to save a pair of optics"). Pulling that fibre kills both the peer-link and the keepalive, so each switch believes its peer is dead and both become active. 排查 ：peer-link 是 2×10G 光纤；peer-keepalive 恰好配在 同一对光纤上的子接口 （"省一对光模块"）。光纤被拔 → peer-link 和 keepalive 同时断 → 两台都认为对端已死 → 都升为 Active。 Root cause : keepalive and peer-link share a failure domain , which destroys the only thing keepalive provides: independence. 根因 ： keepalive 与 peer-link 共享故障域 ，失去了"独立性"这个唯一价值。 What should have been done : - peer-keepalive must take an independent physical path (management switch, out-of-band, OOB link) - Dual-active protection: auto-recovery reload-delay in addition to peer-gateway , plus a written runbook for "shut one switch down manually" - Change management: any change touching the peer-link or keepalive needs two-person review - Monitoring: alert on peer-keepalive loss and vPC state changes 正确做法 ： - peer-keepalive 必须走 独立物理路径 （管理交换机/带外/OOB 链路） - 双主防护：配置 peer-gateway 之外的 auto-recovery reload-delay ，并准备"手动关一台"的 Runbook - 变更管理：任何涉及 peer-link/keepalive 的变更必须双人复核 - 监控：peer-keepalive 丢包率、vPC 状态变化告警 🔥 Case 4: HSRP Active on A, STP Root on B — the Inter-Switch Link Saturates · 🔥 案例四：HSRP Active 在 A、STP 根在 B，串联链路被打满 Symptom : every working day between 09:00 and 10:30 the office reports "the internet is slow and the shared drive hangs". The link between the core switches runs at 100% while each of the two uplinks is only at 30%. 现象 ：每个工作日 9:00–10:30，办公楼"上网慢、打开共享盘卡"，核心间互联链路利用率 100%，而两条上行各自只有 30%。 Investigation : outbound traffic follows the gateway (HSRP active, switch A) but the return traffic comes back through the STP root on switch B, so traffic crosses the A→B inter-switch link , which becomes the bottleneck. The more users, the worse it gets. 排查 ：去程流量走网关（HSRP Active，A 机），回程从核心

x: 回来时 STP 根在 B，导致流量 经 A→B 的串联链路 再下发，串联链路成为瓶颈。用户越多越明显。 Root cause : the gateway position and the Layer 2 topology root are inconsistent (the classic triangular detour). 根因 ： 网关位置与二层拓扑根位置不一致 （经典"三角绕行"）。 What should have been done : - Force "STP root = HSRP active = IGP best exit" onto the same side (configuration alignment plus a periodic audit script) - Or use vPC so both switches forward, removing the topological basis for the detour altogether - Acceptance before go-live: at peak hours, capture load-interval 30 utilisation on both sides and look for "one side saturated, the other idle" 正确做法 ： - 强制"STP 根 = HSRP Active = IGP 最优出口"同侧（配置对齐 + 定期审计脚本） - 或者干脆用 vPC 让两台都转发（消除绕行的拓扑基础） - 上线前的验收：在高峰时段抓两端接口的 load-interval 30 利用率，看是否出现"单侧满载、对侧空闲" 🔥 Case 5: No EIGRP Stub — One Flapping Link Leaves the Network "Offline for Three Minutes" · 🔥 案例五：EIGRP 没配 stub，一次链路抖动让全网"失联 3 分钟" Symptom : the uplink optic of one floor's access switch flaps (about 2 seconds each time), yet the whole network suffers roughly three minutes of "slow service / some subnets unreachable". show ip eigrp topology active shows a large number of active entries. 现象 ：某楼层接入交换机上行光模块抖动（每次约 2 秒），但全网有 3 分钟左右的"业务缓慢/部分网段不可达"； show ip eigrp topology active 显示大量 active 条目。 Investigation : the access layer has no eigrp stub and no summarisation upward, so one uplink change floods queries across the network. Edge routers and branch devices all have to answer, some neighbours time out, and SIA follows (three minutes by default). 排查 ：接入层没有 eigrp stub ，也没有向上汇总；一次上行变化触发 query 向全网扩散，边缘路由器/分支设备都要应答，部分邻居超时 → SIA（默认 3 分钟）。 Root cause : the query domain is the whole network . A distance-vector protocol's scalability depends entirely on whether queries can be stopped. 根因 ： 查询域 = 全网 。距离矢量协议的可扩展性完全依赖"查询能不能被挡住"。 What should have been done : - On every access switch: eigrp stub connected summary (queries are never forwarded) - Summarise from the distribution layer toward the core ( ip summary-address eigrp as prefix mask ) - Add route-map

x: filters at key boundaries to prevent detail routes leaking - Monitor SIA counts and active entries (both should be zero) 正确做法 ： - 所有接入层： eigrp stub connected summary （禁止转发 query） - 分布层向核心方向做汇总（ ip summary-address eigrp as prefix mask ） - 关键边界加 route-map 过滤明细，防止泄漏 - 监控 SIA 计数与 active 条目数（应为 0） 🔥 Case 6: Both ABRs Summarise — Traffic Detours 200 km After a Failure · 🔥 案例六：两个 ABR 同时汇总，故障后流量绕行 200 公里 Symptom : two campuses (city A and city B) are interconnected by two long-haul links. After an uplink failure in one building in city A, users in that building reach the local server by detouring through city B and back. Latency goes from 3 ms to 60 ms and stays there until the link recovers. 现象 ：双园区（A 市、B 市）通过两条长途链路互连，A 市某栋楼的上行故障后，该楼用户访问本地服务器变成"绕行 B 市再回来"，时延从 3 ms 变 60 ms，持续到链路恢复。 Investigation : the area containing that building is summarised with area range on both ABRs . After the failure, one ABR loses its detail path, but the summary route is still advertised by the other ABR (its summary does not depend on the detail), so traffic is pulled to city B and then returns. 排查 ：该楼所属区域在 两台 ABR 上都做了 area range 汇总 。故障后一台 ABR 的明细路径消失，但汇总路由仍从另一台 ABR 通告（因为它的汇总不依赖明细），于是流量被吸引到 B 市再回程。 Root cause : suboptimal paths created by multi-ABR summarisation — a structural OSPF cost the book calls out explicitly. 根因 ： 多 ABR 汇总产生的次优路径 （原书明确指出的 OSPF 固有代价）。 What should have been done : - For critical areas, summarise on only one ABR (the other advertises details or uses a different metric) - Use area range ... cost to differentiate, so the backup ABR advertises a higher summary metric - Do not summarise latency-sensitive prefixes - Record the "acceptable suboptimality" explicitly in the design document (for example ≤2 hops / ≤10 ms) 正确做法 ： - 关键区域 只在一台 ABR 上汇总 （另一台只通告明细或不同 metric） - 用 area range ... cost 差异化，让备份 ABR 的汇总 metric 更高 - 对时延敏感的前缀不做汇总 - 在设计文档中显式记录"允许的次优程度"（例如 ≤2 跳 / ≤10 ms） 🔥 Case 7: One VLAN Across 3 Buildings and 2,000 Endpoints — One ARP Storm Takes Down the Building · 🔥 案例七：一个 VLA

Packet captures show large volumes of ARP requests and unknown unicast flooding. 现象 ：某"统一办公 VLAN"扩到 2,000 终端后，偶发全楼"网络卡死 30 秒"；抓包显示大量 ARP 请求/未知单播泛洪。 Investigation : the VLAN spans 3 buildings and 12 access switches, with an STP domain diameter of 5 hops. One endpoint with a faulty NIC floods ARP (hundreds per second), and combined with unknown unicast flooding it saturates the uplinks and switch CPUs. 排查 ：该 VLAN 跨 3 栋楼、12 台接入交换机，STP 域直径 5 跳；某台终端的网卡故障持续发 ARP（每秒数百），加上未知单播泛洪，直接打满上行与 CPU。 Root cause : broadcast domain = failure domain , and the scale far exceeds the recommendation (≤500 per VLAN). 根因 ： 广播域 = 故障域 ，且规模远超建议值（单 VLAN ≤500）。 What should have been done : - Split VLANs by building and by floor (≤250–500 endpoints each) and use summarisation to keep routing simple - Enable Storm Control on access ports (separate limits for broadcast / multicast / unknown unicast) - Enable DHCP Snooping + DAI + IP Source Guard (Chapter 10) - Key point: treat "a large Layer 2 domain across buildings" as an exception that requires a business justification — the default is no 正确做法 ： - 按楼/按层拆 VLAN（每 VLAN ≤250–500 终端），用汇总保持路由简洁 - 接入端口开 Storm Control（广播/组播/未知单播分别限速） - 开 DHCP Snooping + DAI + IP Source Guard（第 10 章） - 关键： 把"跨楼大二层"当作需要业务理由的例外 ，默认不允许 🔥 Case 8: End-to-End VLAN+VRF With One Missing Hop — Business "Randomly Unreachable" · 🔥 案例八：端到端 VLAN+VRF 漏配一跳，业务"随机不通" Symptom : two weeks after a new isolation design (end-to-end VLAN + VRF) goes live, the finance system is "sometimes fine, sometimes not" for users; a few retries usually work. 现象 ：新上线的隔离方案（端到端 VLAN + VRF）运行两周后，财务系统的用户"时好时坏"，重试几次又能通。 Investigation : the path crosses 5 devices, and one distribution switch does not have the VLAN in its trunk allowed list . That switch happens to be the backup path for one distribution block, so traffic only breaks when load sharing reaches i

Later, to make troubleshooting easier, somebody adds a permit all entry to the import map. Both VRFs become fully reachable, with no ACL as a backstop . 排查 ：出口设备（fusion router）上为了访问共享 DNS/NTP，配置了 VRF 之间的路由导入（ import map ）；后来为方便排障，有人在 import map 里加了一条 permit all ，两端 VRF 全部互通，且 没有任何 ACL 兜底 。 Root cause : no default deny at the leak point , and changes went unreviewed. 根因 ： 泄漏点没有默认拒绝 ，且变更无复核。 What should have been done : - Use an explicit allow list at the leak point (prefix level plus port level) with default deny - Route all inter-VRF access through the firewall or a policy device on the fusion router — never directly - Change management: any change to import/export maps is a high-risk change - Periodic automated validation: probe from every VRF to targets that must not be reachable — all should fail 正确做法 ： - 泄漏点用 显式允许清单 （前缀级 + 端口级），默认拒绝 - fusion router 与 VRF 间访问一律经过防火墙/策略设备，不直连 - 变更管理：import/export map 的修改纳入高风险变更 - 定期自动化验证：从每个 VRF 发探测到"不该可达"的目标，应全部失败 🔥 Case 11: One Tenant Fills the Virtual Firewall's Session Table — Every Tenant Slows Down · 🔥 案例十一：一个租户打满虚拟防火墙会话表，全部租户同时变慢 Symptom : in a multi-tenant campus, all business domains s

The virtual context has no resource limits , so it consumes the whole physical firewall's session table and CPU. 排查 ：某租户的备份任务（大量短连接）在 20 分钟内建立 120 万会话，虚拟上下文 未设置资源限额 ，吃满整个物理防火墙的会话表与 CPU。 Root cause : one-to-many virtualisation without hard resource isolation — the textbook example of fate sharing. 根因 ： 一对多虚拟化没有资源硬隔离 （命运共享的典型表现）。 What should have been done : - Set session, throughput and new-connection-rate limits per context - Put critical tenants on separate physical firewalls (group by service class) - Monitor per-context sessions, CPU and new-connection rate, with thresholds and alerts - Rate-limit "short-connection storm" workloads upstream (load balancer / proxy) 正确做法 ： - 每上下文设置会话数/吞吐/新建速率上限 - 关键租户与普通租户分不同物理防火墙（按等级分组） - 监控每上下文的会话数、CPU、新建速率，设阈值告警 - 对"短连接风暴"类业务做前置限速（LB/代理） 🔥 Case 12: The Service Chain Only Had a Forward Arrow — the File Server "Logs In But Will Not Download" · 🔥 案例十二：服务链只画了去程，文件服务器"能登录不能下载" Symptom : against a protected file server users can log in and browse directories, but large downloads break at about 90%. Access from the operations subnet to the same server works fine. 现象 ：访问受保护的文件服务器：能登录、能看目录，下载大文件到 90% 就断；同一服务器从运维网段访问正常。 Investigation : PBR steers user→server traffic through the vFW, while the return path follows the server's default gateway straight back to the core ( asymmetric ). The vFW only sees one direction, and sessions time out and drop packets. Small files finish before the timeout, so everything "looks fine". 排查 ：策略路由把用户 → 服务器的流量引到 vFW，回程则由服务器的默认网关直接回核心（ 非对称 ）。vFW 只看到单向流，会话超时后丢包；小文件在超时前完成所以"正常"。 Root cause : the return path was never designed — truth 13 in the flesh. 根因 ： 回程路径未设计 （第 13 条反直觉认知的实景）。 What should have been done : - Put the service n

x: Field Notes · 实战经验总结 Count the functional blocks first, then pick the model. More than 3 blocks on a collapsed core is the most common — and most expensive — one-off mistake in campus design. The first deliverable of a campus design is not a topology diagram but a "failure-domain list" : write down the blast radius of every failure point, or the review has nothing to hold on to. The L2/L3 boundary is a one-way decision. It drives addressing, DHCP, policy and monitoring; changing it once means redoing the project once. "Layer 2 across closets" is the only genuine technical constraint. Anyone rejecting routed access because "the team is not comfortable with routing" has an organisational problem that can be solved. Routed access has exactly one acceptance criterion : no VLAN on access-layer devices may span devices. If that is not true, it is not routed access. STP root, FHRP active and IGP best exit must be on the same side. This single rule removes the most common "detour-style slowness" in campuses. FHRP guarantees the address never disappears; it does not guarantee the service never stops. Uplink failure needs track/IP SLA/BFD — "the device is alive" is not "the path is alive". peer-link and peer-keepalive must live in two different failure domains. Almost every dual-active incident starts with "we saved one cable". Size clusters for N−1 capacity : after one member fails, the survivors must still carry peak load, otherwise "high availability" just means "high-probability overload". EIGRP scalability equals query-scope control; OSPF scalability equals area and summarisation design. The protocol is not slow; the design decides whether it is fast. Summarisation always brings suboptimality. Write down the "acceptable suboptimality" instead of pretending summarisation is free. For compliance, the evidence is "policy devices + verification probes", never "we configured a VRF". Every inter-VRF leak point needs default deny plus explicit allow. One permit all on a fusion router can erase a year of isolation design. Service virtualisation succeeds or fails on the return path. A service chain whose design document has only a forward arrow will certainly deliver "ping works, application does not". One-to-many virtualisation must have resource limits (sessions, throughput, new-connection rate), or one tenant can take down all of them. MTU is the hidden tax of overlay networks : tunnels, service chains and encryption each take a cut; without adjust-mss , expect "large packets do not work". PoE and wireless are the two most commonly under-counted budgets in a campus. They are not on the topology diagram, but they turn straight into user complaints. High availability that has never been rehearsed does not exist. (the block count decides the tiers) How far does Layer 2 extend? (decides the access model and the failure domain) Where is the gateway, and is the root bridge on the same side? (removes detours and dual-active) What stops routing changes from spreading? (stub/areas/summarisation, which decide convergence time) Which is larger — the business value of isolation or its operational cost? (decides whether and how finely to virtualise) Have you drawn the return arrow of the service chain? (the difference between "ping works" and "work gets done") 这个园区有几块？ （功能块决定层次） 二层最远延伸到哪里？ （决定接入模型与故障域） 网关在哪里，根桥与它在同一侧吗？ （消除绕行与双主） 路由变化会被什么挡住？ （stub/区域/汇总，决定收敛时间） 隔离的业务价值和运维成本，哪个更大？ （决定是否虚拟化、粒度多细） 服务链的回程箭头画了吗？ （决定"能 ping 通"与"能干活"的差别） Get these six right, and vPC versus StackWise or EIGRP versus OSPF are just implementation details. 这六问答清楚，选 vPC 还是 StackWise、用 EIGRP 还是 OSPF，都只是实现细节。 📌 Next chapter (Chapter 16, Enterprise Internet Edge Architecture Design) moves the view from "inside the campus" to "the seam between the campus and the outside world": multihoming, BGP path selection, NAT, DDoS scrubbing, exit high availability. x: Chapter Roadmap: Fifteen Counter-intuitive Truths About the Internet Edge · 本章导读：互联网边缘的十五个反直觉认知 The internet edge is the chapter with "the least configuration and the most incidents" in the whole book. The reason is that it is governed by three rulebooks at once: your own routing policy, the provider's routing policy, and the session state of stateful devices (NAT / firewall) . Where the three disagree is exactly where failures happen. 互联网边缘是全书里"配置最少、事故最多"的一章。原因是它同时受三套规则约束： 你自己的路由策略、运营商的路由策略、状态设备（NAT / 防火墙）的会话状态 。三者不重合的地方，就是故障发生的地方。 1. The First-Order Question Is Not "Which Provider", It Is "How Does the Business Degrade When the Exit Fails" · 第一性问题不是"选哪家运营商"，而是"出口失效时业务如何降级" Choosing a provider is a procurement question; degradation is a design question. The same "dual ISP" plan can deliver a seamless experience or a ten-minute network-wide freeze — the difference is entirely whether the degradation behaviour was designed. 选运营商是采购问题，降级是设计问题。同一个"双 ISP"方案，可以做到业务无感，也可以做到全网卡死 10 分钟，差别全在降级动作是否被设计过。 Failure scenario Behaviour without design Behaviour with design Primary link down Routing fails over, but every NAT session dies and VPNs reconnect Session rebuild mechanisms, applications that retry, DNS with a backup exit Primary link "up but not passing traffic" The default route still points there → black hole BFD / IP SLA / prefix withdrawal triggers the switchover Primary ISP loses your prefix Inbound traffic vanishes while outbound is fine Keep a second inbound path + monitor inbound reachability Stateful device fails The session table is empty after failover State synchronisation, or "accept session rebuild" written into the SLA 失效场景 未设计时的表现 设计过的表现 主链路 down 路由切换了，但 NAT 会话全断、VPN 重连 会话有重建机制、应用可重试、DNS 有备用出口 主链路"活着但不通" 默认路由仍指过去 → 黑洞 BFD / IP SLA / 前缀撤销触发切换 主 ISP 丢失你的前缀 入向流量消失，出向正常 保留第二条入向路径 + 监控入向可达性 状态设备故障 切换后会话表为空 状态同步，或"接受会话重建"并写入 SLA ⚠️ The most common mistake : treating "dual ISP" as the answer to availability without writing down " in the 30 seconds after the primary

BGP Only Solves "Reachability and Path Selection", Not "Whether the Session Survives" · BGP 只解决"可达性与选路"，不解决"会话能不能活" Layer Who is responsible Behaviour after a failure Control plane (is the prefix reachable) BGP / IGP Seconds to minutes of convergence Forwarding plane (where do packets go) FIB Follows the control plane Session plane (TCP / NAT / firewall state) Hosts, NAT, firewalls Completely outside BGP's control 层次 由谁负责 故障后的行为 控制面（前缀是否可达） BGP / IGP 秒级到分钟级收敛 转发面（报文往哪走） FIB 跟随控制面 会话面（TCP / NAT / 防火墙状态） 主机、NAT、防火墙 BGP 完全管不到 So between "BGP converged" and "the user recovered" there is always a gap: NAT translations expire, firewall sessions are discarded, TCP retransmissions time out, and applications do not retry. 所以"BGP 收敛了"与"用户恢复了"之间，永远隔着一段：NAT 翻译失效、防火墙会话被丢弃、TCP 重传超时、应用不重试。 4. MED Is a Hint, Not an Instruction — and By Default Even the Hint Does Not Cross an AS · MED 是"暗示"不是"指令"，而且默认连暗示都不跨 AS MED means "tell this neighbour AS which entry point is better from my side". There are two hard limits: MED 的语义是"告诉我这个邻居 AS：从我这里进，哪个入口更好"。两个硬限制： By default it is only compared among paths from the same neighbour AS ( bgp always-compare-med changes this, but violates the standard semantics and behaves inconsistently across vendors) The neighbour may ignore it entirely (most providers honour customer MED, but not symmetrically) 默认只在 同一邻居 AS 的多条路径间比较（ bgp always-compare-med 可改，但违反标准语义，跨厂商行为不一致） 邻居可以完全忽略（多数运营商尊重客户 MED，但不对等） So using MED to make traffic "go out through provider A" is impossible in principle across ISPs. 所以"用 MED

The Root Cause of Asymmetric Routing Is Never the Routing Protocol — It Is the Stateful Device on the Path · 非对称路由的根因从来不在路由协议，而在"路径上的状态设备" One packet leaving via A and returning via B is completely fine for stateless forwarding — that is exactly what IP was designed to do. What breaks is: 同一个包去程走 A、回程走 B，对无状态转发毫无问题 —— 这正是 IP 的设计初衷。出问题的是： Stateful thing Consequence of asymmetry Firewall session table The return packet has no session → dropped by default (silent loss, the hardest to diagnose) NAT translation table The return packet's destination cannot be restored → dropped uRPF strict mode The return interface does not match the routing table → dropped TCP proxy / load balancer Half-open connections; the handshake succeeds but no data flows 有状态的东西 不对称时的后果 防火墙会话表 回程包无会话 → 默认丢弃 （静默丢包，最难查） NAT 翻译表 回程包目的地址无法还原 → 丢弃 uRPF 严格模式 回程接口与路由表不符 → 丢弃 TCP 代理 / 负载均衡 半连接、握手成功但数据不通 💡 The test : "ping works but the application does not" plus a capture showing only one direction = check the stateful device first, not the routing. 💡 判据 ： "能 ping 通但业务不通" + 抓包只看到单向 = 先查状态设备，不要先查路由。 7. NAT Is the Most Under-Rated "State" at the Edge, and the Most Easily Forgotten Break Point When Multihoming Switches Over · NAT 是互联网边缘最被低估的"状态"，也是多宿主切换时最容易被忽略的断点 A NAT entry (inside IP:port ↔ outside IP:port) is runtime state with a lifetime. In a multihomed environment: NAT 表项（内网 IP:端口 ↔ 公网 IP:端口）是有生命周期的运行时状态。多宿主环境里： The NAT pool is bound to an exit : the source address is translated into ISP-A's address, so return traffic must come back via ISP-A. When the primary link fails, established sessions cannot be restored over ISP-B (that address does not belong to it). NAT design must therefore answer : on failure, do we "wait for sessions to time out" (minutes) or "actively clear the table and make applications reconnect" (seconds)? Logging compliance : who used which public address at what time is an audit requirement; under CGNAT, no log means no traceability. NAT 池绑定出口 ：源地址

Multihoming designs must write "how sessions get rebuilt" down as a design item. 🎯 结论： NAT 不是"配个 ip nat inside/outside"，它是边缘的会话状态机。多宿主方案必须把"会话如何重建"写成设计条目。 8. Routing Neighbours Crossing the Firewall Is Normal — but It Needs Explicitly Cut Holes · 路由邻居穿过防火墙是常态，但需要显式"开洞" The typical edge topology is edge-router → firewall → internal network, but BGP neighbours often sit on opposite sides of the firewall: 典型的边缘拓扑是"边缘路由器—防火墙—内网"，但 BGP 邻居往往在防火墙两侧： Requirement What must be permitted / configured Common trap eBGP across the firewall ( ebgp-multihop ) TCP 179 in both directions, sufficient TTL Only outbound was permitted; or ttl-security and multihop are both enabled, which conflict iBGP across the firewall TCP 179 plus loopback reachability next-hop-self missed, so the next hop is unreachable BFD UDP 3784/4784 (plus echo mode) The firewall drops UDP; BFD never comes up and there is no alarm IPsec / NAT-T UDP 500/4500, ESP (50) Only UDP was permitted and ESP is blocked PMTUD ICMP type 3 code 4 ICMP was blocked → large-packet black hole 需求 必须放行/配置 常见坑 eBGP 跨防火墙多跳（ ebgp-multihop ） TCP 179 双向、TTL 足够 只放了 outbound；或同时开了 ttl-security 与 multihop，二者冲突 iBGP 跨防火墙 TCP 179 + 环回口可达 next-hop-self 漏配，下一跳不可达 BFD UDP 3784/4784（及回声模式） 防火墙丢弃 UDP，BFD 起不来却无告警 IPsec / NAT-T UDP 500/4500、ESP(50) 只放 UDP，ESP 被拦 PMTUD ICMP type 3 code 4 拦掉 ICMP 导致"大包黑洞" 💡 One rule of thumb : "holes opened for routing protocols" must be grouped separately in the policy and annotated with the reason , or the next engineer will close them during a "security hardening" exercise. 💡 一条经验 ： 边缘设备的策略里，"为了路由协议而开的洞"必须单独成组并注释原因 ，否则下一位工程师会在"安全加固"时把它们关掉。 9. A DMZ Is Not a VLAN — It Is "One Trust Level Plus One Unique Path" · DMZ 不是一个 VLAN，而是"一个信任等级 + 一条唯一路径" Putti

A DMZ means: inbound traffic can only enter this layer, and lateral traffic cannot return to the internal network . 把公网服务器放进一个 VLAN、再给它一个公网地址，不叫 DMZ。DMZ 的实质是： 入向流量只能进这一层，横向不能回到内网 。 Requirement Concrete design Single inbound entry Only the edge firewall's publication policy can reach the DMZ; direct access to the DMZ management plane from inside is forbidden Controlled outbound DMZ → internal allows only "the necessary database/API calls", listed as a direction and port allow list Independent management plane Out-of-band management network / jump hosts, management traffic on a different path from business traffic Loss containment when compromised Hosts inside the DMZ isolated from each other by default (micro-segmentation); outbound only via a proxy Logging and detection Full traffic retention plus IDS; alert on anomalous outbound connections (callbacks are the strongest signal) 要求 具体设计 入向唯一入口 只有边缘防火墙的发布策略能进 DMZ，禁止从内网直接访问 DMZ 管理面 出向受控 DMZ 到内网只允许"必要的数据库/接口调用"，方向与端口白名单化 管理面独立 带外管理网 / 跳板机，管理流量与业务流量不同路径 被攻破后的止损 DMZ 内主机之间默认隔离（微分段），出网仅经代理 日志与检测 全流量留存 + IDS，出向异常连接告警（回连是最强信号） ⚠️ The most common incident chain : a DMZ server is compromised → it has a "permit rule to the internal database" → the attacker uses that rule to move laterally. A DMZ's value is defined by "what it can reach inside", not by "which VLAN it is in". ⚠️ 最常见的事故链 ：DMZ 服务器被拿下 → 它有一条"到内网数据库的放通规则" → 攻击者用这条规则横向移动。 DMZ 的价值由"它能到内网什么"决定，而不是由"它在哪个 VLAN"决定。 10. A Default Route Is Not a Design — It Is a Last Resort · 默认路由不是设计，是最后手段 Two default routes and no health checking is the classic internet-edge black-hole factory: 两条默认路由 + 无健康检查，是互联网边缘最经典的黑洞制造机： Outbound: 0.0.0.0/0 → ISP-A (AD 1) / ISP-B (AD 2, floating) Symptom: a metro-network failure on the ISP-A side; the link stays up, the next hop is reachable, the route is still preferred → traffic goes into a black hole 出向：0.0.0.0/0 → ISP-A（AD 1） / ISP-B（AD 2 浮动） 现象：ISP-A 侧城域网故障，链路 up、下一跳可达、路由仍然优选 → 流量进黑洞

Asymmetric Routing: the Most Expensive Trap in Multihoming · 四、非对称路由：多宿主设计里最贵的一个坑 Why Stateful Devices Care About Symmetry · 为什么状态设备在意对称 A firewall's forwarding decision depends on the session table: it must see the outbound SYN to create the session, and only then can the return packet pass . In a multihomed environment the outbound and return paths come from two completely independent routing decisions: 防火墙的转发决策依赖"会话表"： 看到去程 SYN 才建立会话，回程包才能通过 。多宿主环境里，去程与回程由两套完全独立的路由决策产生： Outbound: internal host → default route → edge router A → ISP-A (source NATed into ISP-A's pool) Return: internet → global BGP → ISP-B → edge router B (the destination belongs to ISP-A's pool on arrival) → edge router B has no such NAT entry → drop (or forward to A, but the state is already asymmetric) 去程：内网主机 → 默认路由 → 边缘路由器 A → ISP-A（源地址被 NAT 成 ISP-A 池） 回程：Internet → 全球 BGP → ISP-B → 边缘路由器 B（到达时目的地址属于 ISP-A 池） → 边缘路由器 B 没有该 NAT 表项 → 丢弃（或转给 A，但状态已不对称） This is the most under-rated cost of outbound load sharing : you share bandwidth and sacrifice sessions. 这就是"出向负载分担"最容易被低估的代价 ：分担的是带宽，牺牲的是会话。 Five Solutions and Their Boundaries · 五种解法与适用边界 # Solution Principle Where it fits Cost 1 Converge on a single stateful device Both ISPs connect to the same firewall pair (HA cluster); BGP and NAT live there Medium-large, public services That device becomes the capacity and failure focus (HA mandatory) 2 Active-standby One exit is preferred for all directions , the other only backs it up Small-medium The standby idles; sessions break on switchover 3 PBR to force symmetry Pin outbound to the same exit as the return path by source/destination Clear traffic classification Operationally complex, conflicts with routing policy, hard to troubleshoot 4 eBGP multihop plus NAT on the edge router BGP and NAT both on the edge; the firewall only inspects internal↔DMZ You need "exit decoupled from inspection" The firewall cannot see outbound traffic (a security blind spot) 5 Accept asymmetry, remove state dependencies Dis

The carrier repairs it 40 minutes later. 现象 ：主链路接口 up、光功率正常、Ping 下一跳也通，但用户访问外网全部超时；40 分钟后运营商修复。 Investigation : a MAN failure on the ISP-A side, but "the CE–PE segment" is still reachable. lb: Chapter 16 · Enterprise Internet Edge Architecture Design (English)
s: Field Notes · 实战经验总结
x: Field Notes · 实战经验总结 Edge availability is multiplicative : exits × state synchronisation × detection. If any factor is zero, the product is zero. "Dual ISP" must be verified down to the physical layer : same duct, same central office, same rack, same power feed — any shared element is a single point. NAT is the biggest hidden state at the edge. A design document without "how sessions are rebuilt" has not done multihoming. BGP convergence ≠ service recovery. Somebody must own the gap: NAT tables, firewall sessions, TCP reconnects, DNS caches. Outbound is controllable; inbound can only be influenced. Any plan to "control cross-ISP inbound with MED" should be rejected outright. Prepending is the only always-available inbound tool , but it only affects the upstream's selection and must be configured as a pair (primary and backup). MED works only within the same neighbour AS ; using it across ISPs is a semantic error, not a configuration error. Attribute policy must state its direction. Asking "does this affect outbound or return?" in a review kills half of all bad designs. Stateful devices must have exactly one owner. When NAT is at the edge and inspection at the firewall, say explicitly who rebuilds sessions. For asymmetric routing, check the state first, not the routes. One-way reachability or "ping works, app does not" is usually the session table. Multihoming always uses loose uRPF. Strict uRPF in an environment with uncertain return paths means random packet loss. Addresses are a ten-year asset : with inbound services or multiple ISPs, get PI plus a public AS — otherwise the first ISP change is a company-wide project. A private AS is hidden risk with multiple ISPs : it depends on the carrier doing remove-private-as . Do not gamble. "Holes for routing protocols" must be opened as a group and annotated : TCP 179, BFD UDP, ICMP type 3/4, IPsec ESP — miss one and you lose hours. ttl-security and ebgp-multihop are mutually exclusive ; write that into the comment header

x: of the configuration template. A default route is a last resort : run BGP if you can; if not, use IP SLA + track with several probe targets. A DMZ's value is defined by what it can reach inside , not by which VLAN it sits in. DDoS resistance lives on the carrier side : when the link is saturated, the strongest local device can only watch. Size VPN headends on measured encrypted throughput , and plan tunnels as "peak × 2" with N−1 redundancy. High availability that has never been drilled does not exist : cable pulls, power loss, carrier-side failures and attacks — all four must be timed. 互联网边缘的可用性是乘法 ：出口数 × 状态同步 × 检测手段，任一项为 0 则整体为 0。 "双 ISP"必须验证到物理层 ：同管道、同局房、同机柜、同电源，任何一处共享都是单点。 NAT 是边缘最大的隐藏状态 。设计文档里没有"会话如何重建"这一条的，等于没做多宿主。 BGP 收敛 ≠ 业务恢复 。两者之间的那段（NAT 表、防火墙会话、TCP 重连、DNS 缓存）必须有人负责。 出向可控、入向只能影响 。任何"用 MED 控制跨 ISP 入向"的方案都要被打回。 prepending 是唯一永远可用的入向手段 ，但它只影响上游的选路，且必须成对配置（主备两侧）。 MED 只在同一邻居 AS 内有效 ，跨 ISP 使用是语义错误，不是配置错误。 属性策略要写清"作用方向" 。评审时问一句"这条策略影响去程还是回程"，能挡掉一半错误设计。 状态设备只能有一个所有者 。NAT 在边缘、检测在防火墙时，必须明确"谁负责会话重建"。 非对称路由的第一动作是查状态，不是查路由 。单通、能 ping 不通业务，八成是会话表。 多宿主一律用松散 uRPF 。严格的 uRPF 在回程不确定的环境里等于随机丢包。 地址是十年资产 ：有入向服务或多 ISP，就上 PI + 公网 AS；否则第一次换运营商就是一次全公司项目。 私有 AS 在多 ISP 场景是隐性风险 ：能不能用取决于运营商是否 remove-private-as ，不要赌。 "路由协议开洞"必须成组并注释 ：TCP 179、BFD UDP、ICMP type 3/4、IPsec ESP，缺一个就是几小时的排障。 ttl-security 与 ebgp-multihop 互斥 ，这条要写进配置模板的注释里。 默认路由是最后手段 ：能跑 BGP 就跑 BGP；不能就用 IP SLA + track，并选多个探测目标。 DMZ 的价值由"它能到内网什么"决定 ，不由"它在哪个 VLAN"决定。 抗 DDoS 的能力在运营商侧 ：本地设备再强，链路被打满时也只能看着。 VPN 头端按"加密后实测吞吐"选型 ，并按 N−1 与"峰值 × 2"规划隧道数。 没演练过的高可用等于不存在 ：拔线、断电、运营商侧故障、攻击，四类用例都要计时。

The correct order is always: business and degradation → trust levels → homing model → routing and announcements → state and sessions → resilience and validation. 本章题型的陷阱是： 把"多宿主"当成"高可用"的答案 （纠结双 ISP 还是双设备），却忽略"入向不可控 + 状态不可复制"这两条硬约束。正确顺序永远是：业务与降级 → 信任等级 → 宿主模型 → 路由与宣告 → 状态与会话 → 弹性与验证。 Scenario 1: A Manufacturing Group Wants "Centralised Exit + Good SaaS Experience", but the Budget Only Covers One MPLS Link · 情景一：制造业集团要"集中出口 + SaaS 体验"，但预算只够一条 MPLS Background : the group has one headquarters (2,500 people), one data centre and 38 factories/branches (9,000 people in total). Only what can be verified counts as design : if you cannot write down "who sees what within 30 seconds of a failure", you do not yet have a design. 冗余是乘法不是加法 ：出口 × 状态 × 检测，缺一即零。 状态越少越可靠 ：边缘的每次故障，几乎都能追溯到"某个状态没人负责"。 入向只能影响 ：所有"控制入向"的方案都要被打回，改成"影响 + 容量兜底"。 能被验证的才叫设计 ：写不出"故障后 30 秒内谁会看到什么"，就还没有设计。

Chapter 17: Enterprise WAN Architecture Design · 第 17 章：企业 WAN 架构设计 English study notes on the CCDE 400-007 Official Cert Guide | original pages 774–849 Where this chapter sits : it is the longest chapter in the book and the one with the least design freedom . In the campus you can swap hardware, pull fibre and carve VLANs; in the WAN the circuits are rented, the backbone belongs to somebody else, and the SLA is only paper . So the central question of WAN design becomes: given that the last mile is not yours, how do overlays, routing policy and QoS wrap "transport you cannot control" into "a service you can" . 《CCDE 400-007 Official Cert Guide》中文翻译与精讲 | 原书第 774-849 页 本章定位 ：全书篇幅最大的一章，也是"设计自由度最小"的一章。园区里你可以换设备、加光纤、画 VLAN；WAN 里 线路是租的、骨干是别人的、SLA 是纸上的 。于是 WAN 设计的核心问题变成： 在"最后一公里不归你管"的前提下，如何用覆盖层、路由策略与 QoS，把"不可控的传输"包装成"可控的服务" 。

The reason is simple: you control only the two ends, and for the middle you can only "trust" . The fifteen points below are the ones most often challenged in design reviews. WAN 是全书里"最容易画出漂亮拓扑、最难解释故障行为"的一章。原因很简单： 你只能控制两端，中间那段只能"相信" 。以下十五条，是设计评审里最常被追问的地方。 1. The First-Order Question in WAN Design Is Not "MPLS or Internet" — It Is "Who Fills the SLA Gap" · WAN 设计的第一性问题不是"用 MPLS 还是 Internet"，而是"SLA 缺口由谁补" The SLA your carrier signs covers only its own segment , while the business experiences end to end . The gap opens in three places: the last mile, inter-carrier interconnection, and your own CPE and policy . 运营商给你的 SLA 只覆盖"它那段"，而业务感知的是"端到端"。缺口在三处： 最后一公里、跨运营商互联、你自己的 CPE 与策略 。 SLA item What the carrier promises What end-to-end actually looks like 99.9% availability Its backbone and PE segment Lower once local loops and CPE are added Latency PE to PE (the usual basis) Higher once local loop and queueing are added Loss/jitter Usually not committed, or loosely committed Voice and video suffer first Fault response Measured against ticket time Business outage starts counting from second one SLA 项 运营商承诺 实际端到端 可用性 99.9% 其骨干与 PE 段 叠加本地环路与 CPE 后更低 时延 PE 到 PE（常见口径） 加上本地环路与排队后更高 丢包/抖动 通常不承诺或宽松 语音/视频最先受害 故障响应 按工单时长 业务中断从第一秒就算 🎯 Design conclusion : first compute how much is left after the carrier's promise, then decide whether you need your own overlay and redundancy . Do not console yourself with a "99.99%" contract. 🎯 设计结论 ： 先算"运营商承诺之外还剩多少"，再决定要不要自建覆盖层与冗余 。别用"99.99%"的合同安慰自己。 2. "Internet + Overlay" Is Not a Cheap Substitute; It Is a Different Failure Model · "Internet + 覆盖层"不是廉价替代品，而是另一种失效模型 MPLS fails by the carrier telling you it is down ; the Internet fails by nobody telling you anything — it simply does not work . MPLS 的失效是"运营商告诉你断了"；Internet 的失效是" 没人告诉你，但就是不通 "。 Dimension MPLS Internet + Overlay Predictability of quality High (SLA, queues) Low (per-hop, cross-domain, invisible congestion) Failure visibility Carrier alarms plus PE-CE state Only your own probes (SLA/BFD/application probes) Encryption Optional (already isolated) Mandatory (runs over the public Internet) Cost Priced by bandwidth and distance, expensive Cheap, easy to scale up Multicast Needs mVPN Needs GRE/DMVPN to carry it Verdict For core services that "must be stable" For general traffic that needs flexibility and multiple paths 维度 MPLS Internet + Overlay 质量可预期性 高（有 SLA、有队列） 低（逐跳、跨域、拥塞不可见） 故障可见性 运营商告警 + PE-CE 状态 只能靠自己探测（SLA/BFD/应用探测） 加密 可选（本就隔离） 必需 （公网传输） 成本 按带宽、距离计价，贵 便宜、易扩容 组播 需 mVPN 需 G

The Hub Is the Most Expensive Single Point in the WAN: Bandwidth by N−1, Hardware by Encrypted Throughput · Hub 是 WAN 里最贵的单点：带宽按"N−1"算，设备按"加密后吞吐"算 A common mistake: set hub bandwidth = Σ(branch bandwidth) × a convergence ratio, then size it from "average utilisation". 一个常见错误：Hub 带宽 = Σ(分支带宽) × 收敛比，然后按"平均利用率"选型。 80 branches × 20 Mbps = 1.6 Gbps (aggregate peak) Hub egress at a 2:1 ratio = 800 Mbps - looks sufficient But: branch upstream bursts arrive together + multicast/broadcast + 40% loss after encryption Actually needed: = 1.6 Gbps, and still compliant after encryption 分支 80 个 × 20 Mbps = 1.6 Gbps（汇聚峰值） Hub 出口按 2:1 收敛 = 800 Mbps → 看似够 但：分支上行突发同时到达 + 组播/广播 + 加密后吞吐下降 40% 实际需要：≥1.6 Gbps 且加密后仍达标 🎯 Conclusion : size hub bandwidth for "all branches at peak simultaneously", and size hub hardware for "measured throughput with encryption enabled" . Skip either one and the hub becomes the throttle for the whole network. 🎯 结论 ： Hub 的带宽要按"所有分支同时峰值"设计，设备要按"开启加密后的实测吞吐"设计 。这两条都不做，Hub 会成为全网的节流阀。 8. x: The Six-Step WAN Design Method · WAN 设计的六步方法论 The easiest mistake in WAN design is to start by comparing carrier quotes. The correct order is: business reachability first, then transport model, then redundancy shape, then overlay and virtualisation, then routing and QoS, and finally capacity and verification . WAN 设计最容易犯的错，是从"比较运营商报价"开始。正确顺序是： 先定业务可达性需求，再定传输模型，再定冗余形态，再定覆盖与虚拟化，再定路由与 QoS，最后定容量与验证 。 1 Set the business map Site list / density / who talks to whom / latency sensitivity - topology needs 2 Set the transport L2 MPLS / L3 MPLS / Internet / hybrid - carrying option per site class 3 Set the redundancy Single/dual link, single/dual CPE, single/dual carrier - availability target 4 Set overlay and segmentation Encryption, multicast, VRF segmentation? - DMVPN/SD-WAN/Multi-VRF CE 5 Set routing and QoS Routing domains, summarisation boundaries, marking and shaping points - convergence and experience 6 Set capacity and validation Hub bandwidth / encrypted throughput / tunnel count / convergence budget - sizing and acceptance ① 定业务地图 站点清单 / 站点密度 / 互访关系 / 时延敏感度 → 拓扑需求 ② 定传输模型 L2 MPLS / L3 MPLS / Internet / 混合 → 每类站点的承载 ③ 定冗余形态 单/双链路、单/双 CPE、单/双运营商 → 可用性目标 ④ 定覆盖与隔离 是否需要加密、组播、分段（VRF）→ DMVPN/SD-WAN/Multi-VRF CE ⑤ 定路由与QoS 路由域划分、汇总边界、标记与整形点 → 收敛与体验 ⑥ 定容量验证 Hub 带宽/加密吞吐/隧道数/收敛预算 → 选型与验收 Expanding the Six Steps: Inputs, Outputs and the Hurdle You Cannot Skip · 六步展开：每步的输入、输出与"过不去的坎" Step Input Output (deliverable) The hurdle you must clear on the spot ① Business map Site count and spread, application inventory, latency requirements Site tiers (A/B/C) plus a reachability matrix Is there a "any two points must communicate" requirement? WAN Virtualisation: Multi-VRF CE, CSC and Inter-AS · 四、WAN 虚拟化：Multi-VRF CE、CSC 与 Inter-AS Multi-VRF CE (VRF-Lite) The CE keeps several VRFs but runs no MP-BGP towards the carrier ; instead each VRF maps to a "logical link" through a subinterface/802.1Q tag, and the carrier side terminates it in a matching VRF. CE 上维护多个 VRF，但 不向运营商跑 MP-BGP ，而是用子接口/802.1Q 把每个 VRF 映射到一个"逻辑链路"，运营商侧用 VRF 承接。 +-- CE (VRFs: production / office / guest) --+ | Gi0/0.10 - VRF production -------------+-- PE (VRF production) | Gi0/0.20 - VRF office -------------+-- PE (VRF office) | Gi0/0.30 - VRF guest -------------+-- PE (VRF guest) +-------------------------------------------+ ┌── CE（VRF: 生产 / 办公 / 访客）──┐ │ Gi0/0.10 → VRF 生产 ─────────┼── PE（VRF 生产） │ Gi0/0.20 → VRF 办公 ─────────┼── PE（VRF 办公） │ Gi0/0.30 → VRF 访客 ─────────┼── PE（VRF 访客） └─────────────────────────────────┘ Advantages Disadvantages The CE needs no MP-BGP or advanced VRF features Every extra segment means another subinterface/circuit Clean segmentation boundary (physical/subinterface level) Subinterface count limits; the carrier side must match Supports overlapping addresses No global any-to-any; each segment is designed separately Pairs naturally with firewalls and service chaining Scale bounded by segments × sites 优点 缺点 CE 不需要 MP-BGP/VRF 高级特性 每增加一个分段就多一条子接口/电路 分段边界清晰（物理/子接口级） 子接口数量限制、运营商侧需同步配置 地址重叠场景可支持 无全局 any-to-any，需逐段设计 与防火墙/服务链配合直观 扩展性受"段数 × 站点数"约束 💡 When to use it : few segments (2–5), many sites, and no appetite for MP-BGP on the CE → Multi-VRF CE is the best value for money. 💡 适用判据 ： 分段少（2–5 个）、站点多、且不想在 CE 上跑 MP-BGP → Multi-VRF CE 是性价比最高的方案。 CSC (Carrier Supporting Carrier) A "carrier's carrier": one carrier (the customer carrier) treats another carrier's MPLS network as its own backbone and keeps selling VPN services from its own PEs. "运营商的运营商"：一家运营商（客户运营商）把另一家（承载运营商）的 MPLS 网络当作自己的骨干，在自己的 PE 上继续提供 VPN 服务。 Scenario Description Wholesale/multinational A local carrier with no global backbone rents capacity from a tier

If the design deliverable contains only the end-state topology, the implementation team will invent its own migration order, and once that order is wrong the problems stay in production as "intermittent loops and suboptimal paths". 原书在 WAN 虚拟化之后专门用一节讲迁移，理由很直接： WAN 项目的失败多数不在"目标架构不对"，而在"中间态没人设计" 。设计交付物里如果只有终态拓扑，实施团队就会自己发明迁移顺序，而迁移顺序一旦错了，问题会以"间歇性环路/次优"的形式留到生产。 Why Migration Is a Design Problem, Not an Implementation Problem · 为什么迁移是设计问题，不是实施问题 The book's judgement: designers pour all their energy into the "end state", but a good design must include the strategy that takes you from today's state to that end state ; and the migration plan must answer one technical question — when only part of the network has been migrated, how do the control-plane protocols and the applications interact? 原文的判断：设计者常把精力全放在"终态"，但一份好的设计必须包含 从现状走到终态的策略 ；而且迁移计划要回答一个技术问题—— 当网络只迁移了一部分时，控制面协议与应用之间如何交互 。 What delivering only the end state causes How it shows up Dual-point redistribution appears in the intermediate state The backdoor link and MPLS both advertise, producing loops or suboptimal paths The default-route origin drifts Halfway through, some sites still default towards a decommissioned hub Summarisation points break mid-migration A black hole opens between migrated and non-migrated areas Administrative distance decides the path Which path "wins" is decided by AD by accident rather than by design Long-lived sessions are cut Voice/video/ERP sessions break, and the business finds the problem before technical acceptance does 只交终态的后果 具体表现 中间态出现双点重分发 backdoor 链路与 MPLS 同时宣告，路由环路 / 次优 默认路由生成点漂移 迁移到一半，部分站点默认指向失效的旧 Hub 汇总点在中间态失效 迁移区与非迁移区之间出现黑洞 AD 变化决定选路 新旧路径"谁赢"由管理距离

x: ted at the "carrier layer" but not at the "physical layer" (point 13 of this chapter). 根因 ： 冗余只做到"运营商层"，没做到"物理层" （本章第 13 条）。 What should have been done : - Require different access types (for example fibre plus 5G/microwave) or different cable routes - Dual CPE, dual power and separate racks at critical sites - Draw the physical paths on one diagram for single-point review (many design documents have no such diagram) 正确做法 ： - 要求"接入方式不同"（如光纤 + 5G/微波），或"路由方向不同" - 关键站点双 CPE + 双电源 + 不同机柜 - 把物理路径画在同一张图上做单点评审（很多设计文档里没有这张图） 🔥 Case 9: MPLS Plus Internet Dual Transport — SaaS Traffic Still Hairpins Through Headquarters · 🔥 案例九：MPLS + Internet 双传输，SaaS 流量绕行总部 Symptom : branches have a poor M365 experience (documents take 10 s+ to open), yet neither link is heavily utilised. 现象 ：分支用 M365 体验差（打开文档 10 s+），但两条链路利用率都不高。 Investigation : the Internet link serves only as backup; everything, SaaS included, follows the default route to headquarters before going out to the Internet. 排查 ：Internet 链路只做备份，所有流量（含 SaaS）按默认路由回总部再出互联网。 Root cause : dual transport was used for redundancy, not for traffic steering . 根因 ： 双传输只做了"冗余"，没做"分流" 。 What should have been done : - Steer by application/destination: SaaS out through local DIA (with cloud security), internal traffic over MPLS - Use application recognition (SD-WAN or router NBAR) instead of guessing by port - Keep an explicit "back to headquarters" path after steering (compliance and audit) 正确做法 ： - 按应用/目的地分流：SaaS 走本地 DIA（配云安全），内网走 MPLS - 用应用识别（SD-WAN/路由器 NBAR）而不是"按端口猜" - 分流后仍保留"回总部"的明确路径（合规与审计） 🔥 Case 10: QoS Only at Headquarters — Voice Dies First When the Branch Uplink Congests · 🔥 案例十：QoS 只在总部做，分支上行拥塞时语音先死 Symptom : when a branch uploads a large file, VoIP calls at that same branch break up badly. 现象 ：分支上传大文件时，同一分支的 VoIP 通话严重断续。 Investigation : headquarters egress has LLQ, but the branch CE uplink has neither shaping nor queues; during uplink congestion voice shares a queue with bulk traffic. 排查 ：总部出口有 LLQ，分支 CE 上行未配置整形与队列；上行拥塞时语音与批量流量同队列

the edge must not trust endpoint markings - Verify at acceptance by saturating the uplink and measuring voice MOS 正确做法 ： - 分支 CE 上行：整形到 CIR + 分类队列 + LLQ - 标记在可信边界完成（终端/接入交换机），边缘不信任终端标记 - 验收时用"上行灌满 + 语音 MOS"实测 🔥 Case 11: Multicast Video Training Saturates the Hub · 🔥 案例十一：组播视频培训把 Hub 打满 Symptom : headquarters runs HD video training to 80 branches; hub egress instantly hits 100% and all other traffic suffers. 现象 ：总部向 80 个分支做高清视频培训，Hub 出口瞬间 100%，全网业务受影响。 Investigation : multicast is carried in GRE tunnels with the hub replicating per branch (80 copies), and no bandwidth limit was applied. 排查 ：用 GRE 隧道承载组播，Hub 逐分支复制（80 份），且未做带宽限制。 Root cause : the replication point for multicast was chosen wrongly (hub replication = hub bandwidth × branch count). 根因 ： 组播的复制点选错 （Hub 复制 = Hub 带宽 × 分支数）。 What should have been done : - For large-scale distribution, use mVPN (replication at the carrier PE) or application-layer CDN/distribution - If tunnel multicast must stay: cap per-branch bitrate, use a lower bitrate, and stagger sessions - For training scenarios prefer application-layer distribution and let the network just carry it 正确做法 ： - 大规模分发用 mVPN（复制点在运营商 PE）或应用层 CDN/分发 - 若保留隧道组播：限制每分支码率 + 使用更低码率 + 错峰 - 培训类场景优先"应用层分发"，网络只做承载 🔥 Case 12: Encrypted Throughput Sized on the Nameplate — Half the Throughput Once IPsec Is On · 🔥 案例十二：加密吞吐按标称选型，开启 IPsec 后吞吐腰斩 Symptom : a new hub device rated 10 Gbps delivers only 3.5 Gbps with IPsec on, and even after the upgrade it is not enough. 现象 ：新 Hub 设备标称 10 Gbps，实际开启 IPsec 后只有 3.5 Gbps，扩容后仍不够。 Investigation : the nameplate figure is "forwarding without encryption"; with encryption it is limited by CPU or accelerator capacity, and there was no N−1 planning. 排查 ：标称值为"无加密转发"

x: Field Notes · 实战经验总结 The first-order WAN question is "who fills the SLA gap" : the carrier only guarantees its own segment, so end-to-end depends on redundancy, overlay and probing. L2 versus L3 is decided by one fact : whether you have a business requirement that "must run Layer 2 across the WAN". Every other reason is a preference. Do not treat the Internet as "MPLS at a lower price" : it has no queue guarantees, no failure notification and no end-to-end latency commitment. Overlay selection = site count × direct-path need × transport count — three questions give the answer. "Summarise + direct spoke paths" means DMVPN Phase 3 only. Phase 2 plus summarisation is the most common silent failure. The tunnel's first tax is MTU : GRE 24 bytes, IPsec 50–73 bytes, VXLAN 50 bytes; once stacked you must clamp MSS. Size hub capacity on "all sites at peak × simultaneity" at N−1, and size hardware on "measured encrypted throughput". In the WAN, "link up" almost never means "path usable" : use BGP, or IP SLA with tracking. Dual carriers must be verified for physical diversity : same duct, same exchange, same access type = single point. Dual links with a single CPE are not high availability : one device, one rack, one power feed. QoS belongs on every egress that can congest , above all the branch uplink; LLQ at headquarters cannot save a branch's voice. LLQ must be rate-limited , otherwise traffic "marked as voice" starves the whole network. There is only one shaping point: your egress. Shaping to 95% of the contracted CIR is more controllable than being dropped by the carrier. Redistribution in the WAN must be one-way, whitelisted and tagged ; two-way redistribution is a synonym for "it works but nobody can explain it". The multicast replication point decides the cost : hub replication = hub bandwidth × branch count; at scale use mVPN or application distribution. Multi-VRF CE is segmentation, not encryption ; prove isolation with "active probes + baseline diffing", not with "w

Size encrypted throughput on measured values ; nameplate figures are usually taken without encryption and with 64-byte packets. Out-of-band management and rollback are the WAN's lifeline : one bad route can cut 80 sites off at once. WAN scalability is the scalability of operating cost : how many places must change to add one site decides how many years the architecture lives. WAN 的第一性问题是"SLA 缺口由谁补" ：运营商只保它那段，端到端要靠冗余、覆盖层与探测。 L2 还是 L3，只由一个事实决定 ：有没有"必须在 WAN 上跑二层"的业务。其余理由都是偏好。 不要把 Internet 当成"便宜版 MPLS" ：它没有队列保证、没有故障通知、没有端到端时延承诺。 覆盖技术选型 = 站点数 × 是否直连 × 传输数量 ，三个问题定答案。 要"汇总 + Spoke 直连"，只有 DMVPN Phase 3 。Phase 2 + 汇总是最常见的隐性故障。 隧道的第一笔税是 MTU ：GRE 24 字节、IPsec 50–73 字节、VXLAN 50 字节，叠加后必须钳 MSS。 Hub 容量按"所有站点峰值 × 同时率"并 N−1 ；设备按"加密后实测吞吐"。 "链路 up" 在 WAN 里几乎不代表"路径可用" ：要么 BGP，要么 IP SLA + track。 双运营商必须验证物理多样性 ：同管道、同局房、同接入方式 = 单点。 单 CPE 双链路不是高可用 ：设备是唯一的、机柜是唯一的、电源是唯一的。 QoS 要在每个会拥塞的出口做 ，尤其是分支上行；总部的 LLQ 救不了分支的语音。 LLQ 必须限速 ，否则"标记为语音"的流量会饿死整个网络。 整形点只有一个：你的出口 。按合同 CIR 的 95% 整形，比被运营商丢包更可控。 WAN 上的重分发必须单向 + 白名单 + 标签 ；双向重分发是"能用但不可解释"的同义词。 组播的复制点决定成本 ：Hub 复制 = Hub 带宽 × 分支数；大规模要用 mVPN 或应用分发。 Multi-VRF CE 是分段不是加密 ；证明隔离靠"主动探测 + 基线比对"，不靠"配了 VRF"。 Inter-AS 选项由"VPN 数 × AS 数"决定 ，不要用 Option A 做大规模。 加密吞吐要按实测值选型 ，标称值通常在无加密、64 字节小包条件下测得。 带外管理与回滚是 WAN 的生命线 ：一条错误路由能让 80 个站点同时失联。 WAN 的可扩展性是"运营成本的可扩展性" ：加一个站点要动几处，决定了这套架构能活几年。

x: Design Judgement Checklist (Usable for Any Proposal) · 设计判断清单（任何方案都能用） Is the requirement real? Is it backed by measurement, or is it just someone's opinion? Are all the constraints on the table? Including the uncomfortable ones: budget, contract terms, team capability, organisational boundaries. Have the rejected options been documented? For each: one sentence on why it was rejected. Where is the single point of failure? Including power, cooling, physical paths, carriers and vendors. Has the convergence time been verified? Measured, not assumed. What happens if the new technology fails? Can we fail over? How long is the rollback? What would the strongest objection to this design be? Who would make it, and how would you answer? 需求是真的吗？ 有测量数据支持，还是只是某人的说法？ 约束都列全了吗？ 预算、时间、合规、遗留系统、人力。 这个方案解决了当前问题，还是解决了想象的问题？ （过度设计检查） 故障域有多大？ 一处故障会影响多少业务？ 谁在 Day 2 维护它？ 现有团队接得住吗？ 怎么验证它有效？ 有可测指标吗？ 否决它的理由是什么？ 能不能自己说出三个反对意见？ 💡 Item 7 is the most effective self-check : if your proposal cannot survive the objections you raise yourself, it will not survive a design review. 💡 第 7 条是最有效的自检 ：如果你的方案经不起自己提的反对意见，它经不起评审。

Business outcomes 2, 5 Rewritten as: cost −30%, new site live in ≤4 weeks, plant isolation, zero audit findings 2. Baseline 2 Measured: 82% of traffic is IP; only 3 legacy systems need Layer 2 3. Requirements and constraints 1, 3 Constraint discovered: three MPLS contracts still have 18 months left, so a big-bang cutover is impossible 4. Architecture boundaries 5, 15–17 Split into campus / WAN / Internet edge / cloud access, with one convergence point per domain 5. Layered decisions 6–14 WAN: MPLS plus Internet SD-WAN hybrid; campus: Layer 3 to the access layer; security: segmentation plus cloud security service; automation: template-driven configuration 6. Validation 12, 14 Before/after comparison on one plant pilot: convergence, cost, configuration time 7. Migration and Day 2 12 Three batches over 18 months, one batch per MPLS contract expiry; monitoring and change process handed over 步骤 用到哪章 做法 1. 澄清需求 1、2 访谈发现真实痛点是"新产线上线要 10 周"，其中 4 周等网络 2. 定义成果 2、5 目标改为"新产线上线 ≤ 5 周"，而不是"网络升级" 3. 摸清应用 3 产线 MES 对丢包敏感（ 0.1%），办公以 HTTP/文件为主 4. 安全定性 4 产线网与办公网必须隔离，且产线不允许跨厂二层互通 5. 传输选型 6、17 工厂改 MPLS L3VPN（不再需要二层）；办事处改 Internet + SD-WAN 6. 二层收敛 7 拆掉跨厂大二层，工厂内部按产线划分 VLAN，STP 只在厂内 7. 三层设计 8 总部/工厂走 BGP（便于策略与多运营商），厂内 OSPF 8. 分段 9 产线单独 VRF，办公与产线之间只在指定点互通 9. 接入 11 车间 Wi-Fi 与 AGV 用独立 SSID 与频段规划 10. 自动化 12 新产线网络用模板 + 自动化开通，把

s: Cross-Chapter Trade-Off Lookup: One Question, Many Answers · 跨章取舍速查：同一个问题，各章给了什么答案
x: Cross-Chapter Trade-Off Lookup: One Question, Many Answers · 跨章取舍速查：同一个问题，各章给了什么答案 The same requirement has answers at different layers in different chapters. The most common error in design is answering at the wrong layer — for example, solving an isolation requirement with a firewall rule (Layer 4–7) when a VRF (Layer 3) would have been cheaper and cleaner. 同一个需求在不同章里有不同层次的解法。 设计时最容易出错的地方，是在错误的层次回答 。下面这张表用来快速定位"该在哪一层解决"： Question Answers by chapter Boundary Should the two sites be connected over Layer 2 or Layer 3? Ch7: Layer 2 extension enlarges the failure domain; Ch6: L2VPN offers transparency; Ch8: routing gives convergence Only extend Layer 2 when a non-IP protocol or fixed addressing genuinely requires it How is isolation achieved? Ch7 VLAN; Ch8 VRF; Ch9 VXLAN segment; Ch10 micro-segmentation/policy By business and compliance granularity Where does high availability come from? Ch7 STP/clustering; Ch8 BGP/IGP convergence; Ch2 RTO/RPO Depends on the acceptable outage time How is cost reduced? Ch6 service choice; Ch12 automation; Ch17 SD-WAN Automation reduces opex, transport choice reduces circuit cost How is security implemented? Ch4 principles; Ch9 segmentation; Ch10 controls; Ch15–17 placement Security is a constraint on every layer, not one device How is mobility supported? Ch11 wireless; Ch9 overlay; Ch14 services Roaming requirements decide the design 问题 各章的答案 分界点 两个站点互通 第 6 章：传输服务（EPL/EVPL/EVPN） 第 9 章：L3VPN / Overlay 第 17 章：WAN 架构（MPLS / Internet + SD-WAN） 是否真的需要二层？需要 → 传输层/二层服务；不需要 → 三层 VPN 或 Overlay 隔离 第 7 章：VLAN + Private VLAN 第 9 章：VRF、VXLAN 分段 第 10 章：SGT、微分段、802.1X 第 15 章：园区分段（业务/管理/访客） 范围与精度：同一交换机内 → VLAN；跨站点 → VRF；东西向精细 → 微分段 高可用 第 7 章：STP/vPC/堆叠 第 8 章：路由收敛、BFD、ECMP 第 15 章：园区冗余模型 第 16 章：多宿主、状态同步 第 17 章：WAN 冗余形态 先定 RTO/RPO（第 2 章），再选层：秒级 → 协议收敛；分钟级 → 设备冗余；小时级 → 备件与流程 加密 第 4 章：策略要求 第 9 章：MPLS VPN 本身不加密 第 10 章：IPsec / MACsec / GET VPN 第 16 章：边缘加密边界 运营商 MPLS 是"隔离"不是"加密"；需要保密性就自己加 IPsec/MACsec MTU 第 6 章：伪线封装开销 第 9 章：VXLAN/IPsec 开销 第 10 章： ip mtu + adju

Part III (Chapters 15–17) Can you map requirements onto a reference architecture 问题 用哪一部分回答 判据 为什么做这件事？ Part I（第 1–5 章） 有没有可测的业务成果与约束清单 用什么技术做？ Part II（第 6–14 章） 能不能说清每个选择的代价与适用边界 在具体场景怎么组合？ Part III（第 15–17 章） 能不能按"边界 → 层次 → 路由 → 隔离 → 容量 → 验证"的顺序推进 Three closing recommendations: 三条收尾建议： Use the knowledge map for navigation, not memorisation.
